item.title: [BM] Anwar Akui Kerajaan Hanya Mampu 'Sebahagian' Bantu Kos Sara Hidup — Janji Bincang Di Kabinet Hari Rabu Selepas 2.5 Tahun Berkuasa
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim, berucap di perhimpunan bulanan bersama kakitangan kementerian di Putrajaya pada 4 Mei 2026, mengakui kerajaan hanya mampu membantu “sebahagian” rakyat Malaysia yang bergelut dengan kos sara hidup. “Adakah kita mampu membantu? Jawapan saya sebahagiannya ya — kita tidak mampu membantu semua orang,” katanya. Beliau mengakui laporan rasmi mendakwa harga terkawal, tetapi maklum balas daripada peniaga kecil — pengusaha gerai makanan — menunjukkan harga naik “secara beransur-ansur minggu demi minggu” dengan kesan besar terhadap operasi perniagaan. Rancangan besarnya: bawa isu ini ke mesyuarat Kabinet hari Rabu.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Akui Kerajaan Hanya Mampu 'Sebahagiannya' Bantu Kos Sara Hidup — Janji Bincang Di Kabinet Hari Rabu Selepas 2.5 Tahun Berkuasa

Jawapan saya sebahagiannya ya — kita tidak mampu membantu semua orang,” katanya. Beliau mengakui bahawa laporan rasmi mendakwa harga terkawal, tetapi mengaku maklum balas daripada peniaga kecil — pengusaha gerai makanan — menunjukkan harga naik “beransur-ansur setiap minggu” dengan kesan ketara terhadap operasi perniagaan. Rancangan besarnya: bangkitkan isu ini di Kabinet hari Rabu.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Berlindung Di Sebalik Titah Diraja Untuk Kekalkan PH Berkuasa Di Negeri Sembilan — Selepas Hilang Majoriti Apabila 14 ADUN UMNO Keluar
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 4 Mei, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim bertindak balas terhadap krisis politik Negeri Sembilan dengan enggan mengulas keputusan UMNO menarik sokongan daripada kerajaan negeri pimpinan PH, sebaliknya merujuk kepada titah Tuanku untuk mengekalkan keadaan sedia ada. “Kenyataan Umno (Negeri Sembilan) belum jelas. Saya tidak mahu mengulas mengenainya,” kata Anwar kepada wartawan di perhimpunan kementerian di Putrajaya. Kesemua 14 ADUN UMNO di negeri itu menarik sokongan terhadap Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun pada 27 April, memetik campurannya dalam krisis perlembagaan melibatkan ketua-ketua adat yang cuba menjatuhkan Yang di-Pertuan Besar Tuanku Muhriz. Daripada menangani kehilangan majoriti, Anwar berkata: “Kita patuhi titah Yang di-Pertuan Besar, yang menyeru kestabilan dan supaya Menteri Besar meneruskan tugasnya.” Setiausaha Agung DAP Anthony Loke secara berasingan menegaskan kerajaan negeri “kekal utuh dan stabil.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Berlindung Di Sebalik Titah Raja Untuk Kekalkan PH Berkuasa Di Negeri Sembilan — Selepas Hilang Majoriti Apabila 14 ADUN UMNO Tarik Sokongan
item.description:

Pada 4 Mei, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim bertindak balas terhadap krisis politik Negeri Sembilan dengan enggan mengulas pendirian UMNO yang menarik sokongan daripada kerajaan negeri pimpinan PH, sebaliknya menggunakan titah Yang Dipertuan Besar untuk mengekalkan status quo. “Kenyataan UMNO (Negeri Sembilan) belum jelas. Saya tidak mahu mengulas mengenainya,” kata Anwar kepada wartawan di Putrajaya. Kesemua 14 ADUN UMNO di negeri itu menarik sokongan terhadap Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun pada 27 April, atas alasan beliau campur tangan dalam krisis perlembagaan melibatkan Undang-undang yang cuba memecat Yang Dipertuan Besar Tuanku Muhriz. Anwar berkata: “Kita patuh kepada titah Yang Dipertuan Besar yang menyeru kestabilan dan Menteri Besar meneruskan tugasnya.” Setiausaha Agung DAP Anthony Loke pula menegaskan kerajaan negeri “kekal utuh dan stabil.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Janji Jimat Cermat Tak Sentuh Penjagaan Kesihatan — Beberapa Hari Selepas Perbendaharaannya Sendiri Cadang Potong RM3 Bilion Dari Bajet Kesihatan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Health

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu perhimpunan kementerian di Putrajaya pada 4 Mei bahawa langkah jimat cermat yang sedang dilaksanakan di seluruh kementerian persekutuan tidak akan menjejaskan “program teras,” termasuk perkhidmatan penjagaan kesihatan kritikal dan pengambilan doktor serta jururawat baharu. Ini berlaku beberapa hari selepas Perbendaharaan mengeluarkan arahan pada 29 April mengarahkan semua kementerian mengkaji semula dan memotong perbelanjaan operasi 2026 mereka — dengan cadangan pemotongan RM5.4 bilion menyasarkan Kementerian Kesihatan (RM3.06 bilion daripada peruntukan RM46.5 bilion) dan Kementerian Pengajian Tinggi (RM2.39 bilion). Pemotongan ini didorong oleh bil subsidi yang membengkak daripada RM15 bilion kepada unjuran RM58.4 bilion tahun ini, ketika konflik Timur Tengah menyebabkan harga tenaga melonjak.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Suruh Penjawat Awam 'Jelaskan' Beban Subsidi RM5 Bilion Sebulan — Kerana Kerajaan Sendiri Tak Mampu Beri Penjelasan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, berucap di perhimpunan bulanan Kementerian Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Sekitar di Putrajaya pada 4 Mei, menggesa penjawat awam membantu “menjelaskan” tekanan fiskal kerajaan di tengah krisis tenaga Timur Tengah. Beliau mengakui kerajaan kini membayar sehingga RM5 bilion sebulan untuk subsidi petrol RON95 sahaja di bawah skim Budi95, mengakui bahawa kos sara hidup memang masalah — “Adakah kita ada masalah kos sara hidup? Ya, saya tidak menafikan” — dan berkata kerajaan hanya mampu memberi bantuan “separa,” sambil menegaskan harga bahan api akan kekal disubsidi.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Suruh Penjawat Awam 'Jelaskan' Beban Subsidi RM5 Bilion Sebulan — Sebab Kerajaan Tak Mampu Jelaskan Sendiri
item.description:

Beliau mengakui kerajaan kini membayar sehingga RM5 bilion sebulan untuk subsidi petrol RON95 di bawah skim Budi95, mengaku kos sara hidup memang jadi masalah — “Adakah kita ada masalah kos sara hidup? Ya, saya tidak menafikan” — dan berkata kerajaan hanya mampu memberi bantuan “sebahagian” sahaja, sambil menegaskan harga bahan api akan kekal disubsidi.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Pertahan Akta Hasutan Yang PH Janji Nak Mansuh — Kini Kata 'Perlu' Untuk Isu 3R
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 4 Mei 2026, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mempertahankan penggunaan berterusan Akta Hasutan 1948, menyatakan ia masih “perlu” untuk kes melibatkan kaum, agama dan raja (3R) tetapi tidak sepatutnya digunakan terhadap kritikan politik. Bercakap dalam sesi langsung Facebook bertajuk “Tanya — Jangan Sentap!”, Fahmi kata PM Anwar Ibrahim sedang “menetapkan nada baharu” dengan mengehadkan tindakan penguatkuasaan kepada isu yang menjejaskan ketenteraman awam, perpaduan nasional dan institusi Raja-Raja Melayu — sambil menegaskan hal politik perlu diselesaikan melalui saluran politik.

item.title: [BM] Nik Nazmi Paksa Pengkritik Mohon Maaf Di Mahkamah Atas Dakwaan Rasuah Projek Tebatan Banjir — Gabungan Reformasi Yang Perjuangkan Kebebasan Bersuara Kini Saman Ia Sampai Bisu
item.description:
Said by: Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad, Former Natural Resources & Environmental Sustainability Minister (PKR, Setiawangsa MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 4 Mei 2026, bekas Menteri Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad — yang masih Ahli Parlimen PKR Setiawangsa — menyelesaikan saman fitnah terhadap bekas ahli PKR Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) di Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur. Chegubard membaca permohonan maaf terbuka di mahkamah, secara rasmi menarik balik dakwaan yang dibuatnya dalam empat hantaran Facebook pada Disember 2023 yang menuduh Nik Nazmi terlibat dalam rasuah berkaitan projek tebatan banjir, termasuk dakwaan tender terbuka dimanipulasi dan kos projek membengkak sehingga RM16.6 bilion. Nik Nazmi memfailkan saman pada 15 Januari 2024, mendakwa hantaran tersebut berniat jahat dan merosakkan kredibilitinya. Kes diselesaikan melalui penghakiman persetujuan — Chegubard mengakui dakwaannya “palsu dan tidak berasas.”

item.title: [BM] Nik Nazmi Paksa Pengkritik Mohon Maaf Di Mahkamah Atas Dakwaan Rasuah Tebatan Banjir — Gabungan Reformasi Yang Juara Kebebasan Bersuara Kini Samannya Sehingga Bisu
item.description:
Said by: Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad, Former Natural Resources & Environmental Sustainability Minister (PKR, Setiawangsa MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 4 Mei 2026, bekas Menteri Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Sekitar Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad — masih Ahli Parlimen PKR Setiawangsa — menyelesaikan saman fitnah terhadap bekas ahli PKR Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) di Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur. Chegubard membacakan permohonan maaf secara terbuka di mahkamah terbuka, secara rasmi menarik balik dakwaan yang dibuatnya dalam empat catatan Facebook pada Disember 2023 yang menuduh Nik Nazmi rasuah berkaitan projek tebatan banjir, termasuk dakwaan proses tender terbuka telah dimanipulasi dan kos projek membengkak kepada RM16.6 bilion. Nik Nazmi memfailkan saman pada 15 Januari 2024, mendakwa catatan itu berniat jahat dan merosakkan kredibilitinya. Perkara itu diselesaikan melalui penghakiman persetujuan — Chegubard mengakui dakwaannya “palsu dan tidak berasas.”

item.title: [BM] Pejabat Loke Guna Laporan Polis Untuk Bungkamkan Pengkritik Atas Krisis Negeri Sembilan — Setiausaha Politik Main Kad '3R' Terhadap Chegubard
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister & DAP Secretary-General (via political secretary Ho Weng Wah)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 4 Mei 2026, Ho Weng Wah — setiausaha politik kepada Menteri Pengangkutan dan Setiausaha Agung DAP Anthony Loke — membuat laporan polis di Ibu Pejabat Polis Daerah Seremban terhadap bekas ketua bahagian Bersatu Badrul Hisham Shaharin, lebih dikenali sebagai Chegubard. Laporan dibuat berhubung posting Facebook bertajuk “Anthony Loke mesti disiasat kerana membiayai entiti haram — Majlis Dato Lembaga Adat Sungei Ujong,” yang mendakwa Loke menyalurkan sejumlah besar dana kepada entiti yang didakwa haram dan mengaitkannya dengan gangguan terhadap institusi diraja di Negeri Sembilan. Ho memberitahu pemberita bahawa posting tersebut “menyentuh isu sensitif 3R (kaum, agama dan raja), yang berpotensi mencetuskan ketegangan dan memecahbelahkan masyarakat.”

item.title: [BM] Pejabat Loke Gunakan Laporan Polis Sebagai Senjata Untuk Bungkam Pengkritik Atas Krisis Negeri Sembilan — Setiausaha Politik Mainkan Kad '3R' Terhadap Chegubard

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Lapor Diri Ke SPRM Atas Perjanjian Arm Bernilai RM1.1B Yang Dia Desak Semasa Jadi Menteri Ekonomi PH — Jangka Didakwa, Persoal Masa Siasatan
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Bekas Menteri Ekonomi Datuk Seri Rafizi Ramli melaporkan diri ke ibu pejabat Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) di Putrajaya pada 4 Mei untuk disoal siasat berhubung dakwaan penyelewengan dalam perjanjian pelaburan semikonduktor bernilai RM1.1 bilion antara Kementerian Ekonomi dan gergasi cip UK, Arm Holdings. SPRM telah merakamkan 22 kenyataan setakat ini dalam siasatan yang bermula pada 13 Februari. Rafizi, yang meninggalkan Kabinet pada pertengahan 2025 dan menjadi pengkritik paling lantang PM Anwar Ibrahim, berkata pada 1 Mei bahawa beliau menerima notis saman pada jam 3 petang yang mengarahkannya hadir pada 10 pagi Isnin — dan beliau menjangkakan akan didakwa. Siasatan tertumpu kepada sama ada Rafizi telah menekan Kabinet untuk meluluskan perjanjian tersebut semasa beliau menjadi Menteri Ekonomi.

item.title: Anwar Admits Government Can Only 'Partly' Help With Cost of Living — Promises to Discuss It at Cabinet on Wednesday After 2.5 Years in Power
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, speaking at a monthly assembly with ministry staff at Putrajaya on May 4, 2026, admitted that the government can only “partly” help Malaysians struggling with the cost of living. “Are we able to help? My answer is partly yes — we are not able to help everyone,” he said. He acknowledged that official reports claim prices are under control, but conceded that feedback from petty traders — food stall operators — shows prices are rising “gradually week by week” with significant impact on business operations. His big plan: raise the issue at Cabinet this Wednesday.

item.title: Anwar Hides Behind Royal Decree to Keep PH in Power in Negeri Sembilan — After Losing Majority When 14 UMNO Assemblymen Walk Out
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

On May 4, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim responded to the Negeri Sembilan political crisis by refusing to comment on UMNO’s decision to withdraw support from the PH-led state government, instead invoking the Ruler’s decree to maintain the status quo. “The Umno (Negeri Sembilan) statement is not yet clear. I do not wish to comment on it,” Anwar told reporters at a ministry assembly in Putrajaya. All 14 UMNO assemblymen in the state withdrew support for Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun on April 27, citing his interference in a constitutional crisis involving traditional chieftains attempting to depose the state ruler Tuanku Muhriz. Rather than address the loss of majority, Anwar said: “We abide by the Ruler’s decree, which calls for stability and for the Menteri Besar to continue his duties.” DAP secretary-general Anthony Loke separately insisted the state government “remains intact and stable.”

item.title: Anwar Promises Austerity Won't Touch Healthcare — Days After His Own Treasury Proposed Slashing RM3 Billion From the Health Budget
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Health

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told a ministry assembly in Putrajaya on May 4 that austerity measures currently being rolled out across federal ministries will not affect “core programmes,” including critical healthcare services and the recruitment of new doctors and nurses. This came days after the Treasury issued a directive on April 29 ordering all ministries to review and cut their 2026 operating expenditures — with a suggested RM5.4 billion in cuts targeting the Health Ministry (RM3.06 billion from its RM46.5 billion allocation) and the Higher Education Ministry (RM2.39 billion). The cuts are driven by a subsidy bill that has ballooned from RM15 billion to a projected RM58.4 billion this year, as the Middle East conflict sends energy prices surging.

item.title: Anwar Tells Civil Servants to 'Explain' RM5 Billion Monthly Subsidy Burden — Because the Government Can't Do the Explaining Itself
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, speaking at the Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Ministry’s monthly assembly in Putrajaya on May 4, urged civil servants to help “explain” the government’s fiscal strain amid the Middle East energy crisis. He admitted the government is now paying up to RM5 billion a month for RON95 petrol subsidies alone under the Budi95 scheme, conceded that cost of living is a real problem — “Do we have a problem with living cost? Yes, I am not denying it” — and said the government can only provide “partial” help, while insisting fuel prices will stay subsidised.

item.title: Fahmi Defends Sedition Act PH Promised to Abolish — Now Says It's 'Needed' for 3R Issues
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

On May 4, 2026, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil defended the continued use of the Sedition Act 1948, stating it remains “necessary” for cases involving race, religion, and royalty (3R) but should not target political criticism. Speaking during a live Facebook session titled “Tanya — Jangan Sentap!”, Fahmi said PM Anwar Ibrahim was “setting a new tone” by reserving enforcement action for issues affecting public order, national unity, and the institution of the Malay Rulers — while insisting political matters should be handled through political channels.

item.title: Loke's Office Weaponises Police Report to Silence Critic Over Negeri Sembilan Crisis — Political Secretary Invokes '3R' Card Against Chegubard
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister & DAP Secretary-General (via political secretary Ho Weng Wah)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

On May 4, 2026, Ho Weng Wah — the political secretary to Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General Anthony Loke — lodged a police report at the Seremban District Police Headquarters against former Bersatu division leader Badrul Hisham Shaharin, better known as Chegubard. The report was filed over a Facebook post titled “Anthony Loke must be investigated for funding an illegal entity — Majlis Dato Lembaga Adat Sungei Ujong,” which alleged that Loke had channelled a substantial amount of funds to an entity claimed to be illegal and linked the matter to disturbances involving the royal institution in Negeri Sembilan. Ho told reporters the post “touches on sensitive 3R issues (race, religion and royalty), which could potentially incite tension and divide the community.”

item.title: Nik Nazmi Forces Critic to Apologize in Court Over Flood Mitigation Corruption Claims — The Reform Coalition That Championed Free Speech Now Sues It Into Silence
item.description:
Said by: Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad, Former Natural Resources & Environmental Sustainability Minister (PKR, Setiawangsa MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

On May 4, 2026, former Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Minister Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad — still a PKR MP for Setiawangsa — settled a defamation suit against former PKR member Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) at the Kuala Lumpur High Court. Chegubard read out a public apology in open court, formally retracting allegations he made in four Facebook posts in December 2023 that accused Nik Nazmi of corruption linked to flood mitigation projects, including claims that an open tender process was rigged and project costs had ballooned to RM16.6 billion. Nik Nazmi filed the suit on January 15, 2024, claiming the posts were malicious and damaged his credibility. The matter was concluded via consent judgment — Chegubard admitted his allegations were “false and baseless.”

item.title: Rafizi Reports to MACC Over RM1.1B Arm Deal He Pushed as PH Economy Minister — Expects Charges, Calls Probe's Timing Suspicious
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-04

📌 What Happened

Former Economy Minister Datuk Seri Rafizi Ramli reported to the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) headquarters in Putrajaya on May 4 for questioning over alleged irregularities in a RM1.1 billion semiconductor investment deal between the Economy Ministry and UK-based chip giant Arm Holdings. MACC has recorded 22 statements so far in the probe, which began on February 13. Rafizi, who quit the cabinet in mid-2025 and became one of PM Anwar Ibrahim’s most vocal critics, said on May 1 that he received a summons notice at 3pm requiring him to appear at 10am on Monday — and that he expects to be charged. The probe centres on whether Rafizi pressured the Cabinet to approve the deal during his tenure as Economy Minister.

item.title: [BM] Malaysia Jatuh 7 Tangga Dalam Indeks Kebebasan Akhbar Di Bawah Pengawasan Fahmi — Menteri Yang Kata Ranking RSF 'Bukan Standard Emas' Kini Mengetuai Tindakan Keras

[BM] Malaysia Jatuh 7 Tangga Dalam Indeks Kebebasan Akhbar Di Bawah Pengawasan Fahmi — Menteri Yang Kata Ranking RSF ‘Bukan Standard Emas’ Kini Mengetuai Tindakan Keras

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Malaysia jatuh tujuh tangga — dari kedudukan ke-88 ke ke-95 daripada 180 negara — dalam Indeks Kebebasan Akhbar Dunia 2026 yang dikeluarkan Reporters Without Borders (RSF) pada 30 April. Skor keseluruhan negara merosot dari 56.09 kepada 52.73, dengan kemerosotan merentasi petunjuk utama termasuk dimensi undang-undang dan sosial. Majlis Media Malaysia (MMM) pada 3 Mei membangkitkan kemerosotan ini dan menyeru perlindungan lebih kukuh bagi wartawan dan kebebasan media. Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil, yang menyelia Suruhanjaya Komunikasi dan Multimedia Malaysia (SKMM), pernah menolak indeks RSF sebagai “bukan standard emas” — pendirian yang semakin nampak selesa ketika Malaysia terus merudum di bawah pentadbirannya.

item.title: [BM] Mat Sabu Suruh Rakyat 'Berbelanja Berhemah' Ketika Harga Makanan Bakal Melonjak — Selepas 2.5 Tahun, Pelan Keterjaminan Makanan Beliau Masih 'Makan Kurang'

item.title: Anwar Declares Bumiputera Agenda 'Bolder Than Ever' Under MADANI — The Same Man Who Promised to End Race-Based Affirmative Action in 2008
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-03

📌 What Happened

On May 3, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim declared at a MARA event in Kuala Lumpur that the Bumiputera empowerment agenda has been pursued “more assertively, firmly and boldly” under his MADANI government. He rejected allegations that his administration subscribes to elitism or sidelines Malay interests, citing automatic matriculation placement for 10A students regardless of race and a rise in Bumiputera household income of more than 10 percent. He also set a three-month deadline for the revised MARA Act 1966, while MARA chairman Datuk Dr Asyraf Wajdi Dusuki confirmed the draft amendments are undergoing stakeholder engagement.

item.title: Malaysia Drops 7 Places in Press Freedom Index Under Fahmi's Watch — The Minister Who Called RSF Rankings 'Not the Gold Standard' Now Presides Over the Crackdown
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-03

Malaysia Drops 7 Places in Press Freedom Index Under Fahmi’s Watch — The Minister Who Called RSF Rankings ‘Not the Gold Standard’ Now Presides Over the Crackdown

📌 What Happened

Malaysia dropped seven places — from 88th to 95th out of 180 countries — in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index released by Reporters Without Borders (RSF) on April 30. The country’s overall score fell from 56.09 to 52.73, with deterioration across key indicators including the legal and social dimensions. The Malaysian Media Council (Majlis Media Malaysia) on May 3 flagged the decline and called for stronger protections for journalists and media independence. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil, who oversees the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC), has previously dismissed the RSF index as “not the gold standard” — a position that looks increasingly convenient as Malaysia slides further down the rankings under his watch.

item.title: Mat Sabu Tells Malaysians to 'Spend Prudently' as Food Prices Set to Spike — After 2.5 Years, His Food Security Plan Is Still 'Eat Less'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Sabu, Agriculture and Food Security Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-03

📌 What Happened

Agriculture and Food Security Minister Mohamad Sabu, on May 3, 2026, acknowledged that cost pressures in the food supply chain may push prices higher in the coming months. Rather than announcing new interventions or structural reforms, Mat Sabu’s prescription for Malaysians was to “spend prudently, avoid waste, and prioritise essential needs.” This came just days after Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah confirmed that food input costs were already rising — chicken up 3.3%, eggs up 7.3%, and vegetables climbing — and weeks after traders warned that prices could surge by as much as 50% due to soaring fuel costs linked to the Iran conflict.

item.title: Nga Kor Ming Tells Rain Rave Critics to 'Stay Home' — A Knife Incident, 80,000 Crowd, and Zero Accountability Later
item.description:
Said by: Nga Kor Ming, Housing and Local Government Minister (DAP)

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-03

📌 What Happened

On May 3, 2026, Housing and Local Government Minister Nga Kor Ming defended the government-backed Rain Rave Water Music Festival in Bukit Bintang, which drew 80,000 participants and 200,000 online viewers. Echoing Tourism Minister Tiong King Sing, Nga told critics: “For those who disagree, it is your right to choose to stay at home and not to come. Simple as that.” He framed the event as proof that “Malaysia Truly Asia is not a slogan but our culture and way of life.” His statement came the same day the South China Morning Post reported that a 28-year-old woman carrying a knife had been tackled and arrested by the crowd at the festival on Saturday night.

item.title: [BM] Belia PH Tuntut 'Gencatan Politik' Ketika Bil Subsidi Meletup 290% — Terjemahan: Berhenti Bertanya Sementara Kami Bakar RM58 Bilion
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-02

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Dakwa UMNO Mahu Paksa PRU Menjelang Oktober — Lelaki Yang Hilang Jawatan Timbalan Presiden Kini Bermain Ahli Strategi Gabungan Dari Bangku Belakang
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-02

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 2 Mei 2026, bekas Timbalan Presiden PKR dan Ahli Parlimen Pandan Rafizi Ramli secara terbuka mendakwa bahawa krisis politik Negeri Sembilan — yang tercetus apabila 14 Ahli Dewan Undangan Negeri UMNO-BN menarik balik sokongan daripada kerajaan negeri pimpinan PH — adalah sebahagian daripada strategi UMNO yang sengaja untuk memaksa pilihan raya umum menjelang Oktober 2026. Berucap ketika sekutu PH terus terhuyung-hayang daripada episod itu, Rafizi memberi amaran bahawa keputusan UMNO akan membawa “akibat yang tidak dijangka” dan mengingatkan pengundi tentang prestasi buruk UMNO dalam pilihan raya lepas, memposisikan krisis itu sebagai rampasan kuasa UMNO dan bukannya kegagalan pengurusan gabungan PH.

item.title: PH Youth Demands 'Political Truce' as Subsidy Bill Explodes 290% — Translation: Stop Asking Questions While We Burn Through RM58 Billion
item.description:
Said by: Ammar Atan, PH Youth Information Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-02

📌 What Happened

On May 2, 2026, Pakatan Harapan Youth’s information chief Ammar Atan called on all political parties to observe a “political truce” as Malaysia faces mounting economic pressure from the US-Iran conflict. Ammar said subsidy commitments had surged nearly 290% to RM58.4 billion this year from an initial estimate of RM15 billion, declaring that “political stability is no longer an option, but a necessity.” He welcomed remarks by Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani that “now is not the time for political manoeuvring,” adding that “the government must be given space to steer the country through this crisis.”

item.title: Rafizi Claims UMNO Wants to Force GE by October — The Man Who Lost His Deputy Presidency Now Plays Coalition Strategist From the Backbench
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-02

📌 What Happened

On May 2, 2026, former PKR deputy president and Pandan MP Rafizi Ramli publicly claimed that the Negeri Sembilan political crisis — triggered when 14 UMNO-BN assemblymen withdrew support from the PH-led state government — is part of a deliberate UMNO strategy to force a general election by October 2026. Speaking as PH allies continued to reel from the episode, Rafizi warned that UMNO’s decision would have “unintended consequences” and reminded voters of UMNO’s poor performance in the last polls, positioning the crisis as an UMNO power grab rather than a failure of PH coalition management.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Akui Kerajaan Sendiri Tak Mampu Laksana — Arah Laporan Pelaksanaan 2 Minggu Selepas 2.5 Tahun Pengumuman Tanpa Tindakan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di sambutan Hari Pekerja 2026 di Unifi Arena, Bukit Jalil pada 1 Mei, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengarahkan semua agensi kerajaan mengemukakan laporan pelaksanaan terperinci mengenai inisiatif pekerja yang baru diumumkan dalam tempoh dua minggu. Beliau memberitahu kumpulan 15,000 pekerja: “Saya tidak mahu berulang amalan lama di mana pengumuman dibuat, tetapi pelaksanaan mengambil masa enam bulan, setahun atau lebih lama.” Laporan mesti sampai ke meja menteri dalam tempoh dua minggu dan dibentangkan untuk pertimbangan Kabinet dalam tempoh tiga minggu.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Berceramah Kepada Korporat Malaysia Tentang 'Gaji Adil' — Dua Hari Selepas Perbendaharaannya Pangkas RM10 Bilion Dari Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim menggunakan sambutan Hari Pekerja kebangsaan pada 1 Mei 2026 untuk secara terbuka memalukan korporat Malaysia, menyindir syarikat yang mencatatkan keuntungan RM1-2 bilion yang “masih sukar untuk meluluskan kenaikan gaji RM40 pun kepada pekerja.” Beliau bermegah tentang “pertumbuhan kukuh Malaysia, pelaburan tertinggi dalam sejarah, pengangguran rendah, dan prestasi ringgit yang mantap” dan menuntut sektor swasta memadankan keuntungan dengan belas kasihan. Ini disampaikan hanya dua hari selepas Perbendaharaannya, pada 29 April, mengeluarkan arahan mengarahkan semua kementerian persekutuan memotong belanjawan operasi 2026 mereka — termasuk RM3.06 bilion daripada Kementerian Kesihatan dan RM2.39 bilion daripada Pendidikan Tinggi — sebagai sebahagian daripada pakej penjimatan RM10 bilion yang dicetuskan oleh kesan perang Iran terhadap subsidi bahan api.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Beri Kementerian Dua Minggu Untuk Laksana Inisiatif Pekerja — Selepas Akui Kerajaannya Sendiri Ambil 'Enam Bulan, Setahun Atau Lebih Lama'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

item.title: [BM] Anwar Dedah 'Pakej PACE' RM710J Pada Hari Pekerja — Dua Hari Selepas Perbendaharaannya Arah Potongan RM5.4 Bilion Untuk Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 1 Mei 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim naik pentas di sambutan Hari Pekerja Kebangsaan di Arena Unifi, Bukit Jalil, untuk mendedahkan Pakej Ketahanan Ekonomi PACE bernilai RM710 juta — direklamakan sebagai langkah untuk “mengukuhkan pekerjaan, kemahiran dan ketahanan gaji.” Beliau mengakui harga minyak telah melonjak daripada AS$70 kepada AS$115 setong dan berjanji kerajaan akan “terus mengambil langkah yang perlu” menghadapi ketidaktentuan ekonomi global. Ini disampaikan hanya dua hari selepas Setiausaha Agung Perbendaharaan Johan Mahmood Merican mengeluarkan arahan dalaman pada 29 April mengarahkan potongan bajet menyeluruh di semua kementerian: pengurangan 10% untuk perkhidmatan penting, potongan 20% untuk badan berkanun, pembekuan pengambilan pekerja, dan cadangan potongan RM5.4 bilion untuk kesihatan dan pengajian tinggi — termasuk RM3.06 bilion dipotong daripada penjagaan kesihatan sahaja.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Tak Akan Khianati Mandat' — Sambil Senyap-Senyap Rancang Pilihan Raya Mengejut Untuk Elak Potong Subsidi Bahan Api
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 1 Mei 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu orang ramai Hari Pekerja bahawa kerajaannya “tidak akan mengkhianati mandat rakyat” ketika harga minyak melonjak ke AS$115 setong — naik daripada AS$70 hanya tiga bulan sebelumnya. Beliau berjanji mengekalkan harga RON95 bersubsidi pada RM1.99 seliter. Sementara itu, Bloomberg melaporkan pada 24 April — memetik sumber tanpa nama — bahawa Anwar sedang mempertimbangkan untuk mengadakan pilihan raya umum menjelang suku ketiga 2026, mungkin seawal Oktober, khususnya untuk mendahului pemotongan subsidi bahan api yang beracun dari segi politik. Bil subsidi bahan api bulanan Malaysia telah melonjak hampir 10 kali ganda kepada kira-kira RM7 bilion sejak perang AS-Israel dengan Iran bermula pada Februari.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Tak Akan Khianati Mandat' — Sementara Senyap-Senyap Rancang Pilihan Raya Kilat Untuk Elak Potong Subsidi Bahan Api

Bil subsidi bahan api bulanan Malaysia telah melonjak hampir 10 kali ganda kepada kira-kira RM7 bilion sejak perang AS-Israel dengan Iran bermula pada Februari, mengancam untuk memecahkan sasaran defisit bajet kerajaan. Menteri Kewangan II Amir Hamzah Azizan mengakui pembaharuan terkini belum sepenuhnya menghapuskan beban subsidi.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Lancar 'Pakej PACE' RM710 Juta Pada Hari Pekerja — Dua Hari Selepas Perbendaharaan Arah Pemotongan RM5.4 Bilion Kepada Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 1 Mei 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim naik pentas di sambutan Hari Pekerja Kebangsaan di Unifi Arena, Bukit Jalil, untuk melancarkan Pakej Ketahanan Ekonomi PACE bernilai RM710 juta — diwar-warkan sebagai langkah “mengukuhkan pekerjaan, kemahiran dan ketahanan gaji.” Beliau mengakui harga minyak telah melonjak dari AS$70 ke AS$115 setong dan berjanji kerajaan akan “terus mengambil langkah perlu” menghadapi ketidaktentuan ekonomi sejagat. Ini disampaikan hanya dua hari selepas Ketua Setiausaha Perbendaharaan Johan Mahmood Merican mengeluarkan arahan dalaman pada 29 April mengarahkan pemotongan belanjawan menyeluruh merentas semua kementerian: pengurangan 10% untuk perkhidmatan penting, pemotongan 20% untuk badan berkanun, pembekuan pengambilan pekerja, dan cadangan pemotongan RM5.4 bilion kepada kesihatan dan pendidikan tinggi — termasuk RM3.06 bilion dipotong dari penjagaan kesihatan sahaja.

Ini berlaku hanya dua hari selepas Ketua Setiausaha Perbendaharaan Johan Mahmood Merican mengeluarkan arahan dalaman pada 29 April yang mengarahkan pemotongan belanjawan menyeluruh di semua kementerian: pengurangan 10% untuk perkhidmatan penting, potongan 20% untuk badan berkanun, pembekuan pengambilan pekerja, dan cadangan potongan RM5.4 bilion untuk kesihatan dan pendidikan tinggi — termasuk RM3.06 bilion dipotong daripada penjagaan kesihatan sahaja.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Merayu Syarikat Berbilion Ringgit Naikkan Gaji RM40 'Dengan Belas Ihsan' — Selepas 2.5 Tahun, Dasar Gajinya Masih 'Tolong Baik Hati'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di sambutan Hari Pekerja kebangsaan di Bukit Jalil pada 1 Mei 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim menyeru majikan supaya “lebih bertimbang rasa dan berbelas ihsan” terhadap pekerja. Beliau menyindir syarikat yang mencatat keuntungan RM1–2 bilion yang “masih sukar meluluskan kenaikan gaji RM40 sekalipun.” Beliau secara jelas menyatakan bukan mencadangkan apa-apa yang boleh menyebabkan kerugian kepada syarikat atau menjejaskan daya saing — hanya meminta pemimpin “tunjukkan lebih belas ihsan.” Beliau memuji kenaikan gaji minimum kerajaan sebelum ini dari RM1,200 ke RM1,500 dan lantai GLC sebanyak RM3,000 sebagai bukti tindakan.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Umum 'Pakej PACE' RM710J Sempena Hari Pekerja — Dua Hari Selepas Perbendaharaan Arah Pemotongan RM5.4 Bilion Kepada Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 1 Mei 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim naik pentas di sambutan Hari Pekerja Kebangsaan di Unifi Arena, Bukit Jalil, untuk mengumumkan Pakej Ketahanan Ekonomi PACE bernilai RM710 juta — kononnya untuk “mengukuhkan pekerjaan, kemahiran dan ketahanan gaji.” Beliau mengakui harga minyak melonjak dari US$70 ke US$115 setong dan berjanji kerajaan akan “terus mengambil langkah perlu” menghadapi ketidaktentuan ekonomi global. Ucapan ini dibuat hanya dua hari selepas Ketua Setiausaha Perbendaharaan Johan Mahmood Merican mengeluarkan arahan dalaman pada 29 April yang mengarahkan pemotongan belanja menyeluruh: pengurangan 10% ke atas perkhidmatan penting, 20% ke atas badan berkanun, pembekuan pengambilan pekerja baharu, dan cadangan pemotongan RM5.4 bilion kepada kesihatan dan pendidikan tinggi — termasuk RM3.06 bilion daripada kesihatan sahaja.

item.title: [BM] Dzulkefly Jangka Pemotongan 10% Bajet Kesihatan — Terima Pengurangan Lebih Dalam Daripada Cadangan Awal RM3B Perbendaharaan Sambil Tegaskan 'Perkhidmatan Teras Selamat'
item.description:
Said by: Dzulkefly Ahmad, Health Minister

Category: Health

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Kesihatan Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad mendedahkan pada 1 Mei 2026 bahawa beliau menjangkakan pemotongan kira-kira 10% daripada bajet RM46.5 bilion Kementerian Kesihatan untuk 2026 — angka yang jauh lebih tinggi daripada RM3.06 bilion (6.6%) yang pada mulanya dicadangkan oleh Perbendaharaan dalam arahan 29 April. Bercakap selepas Perbendaharaan mengarahkan semua kementerian persekutuan mengurangkan perbelanjaan operasi akibat kesan fiskal perang AS-Israel ke atas Iran, Dzulkefly menegaskan bahawa “perkhidmatan teras penting” termasuk rawatan pesakit, rawatan kecemasan, dan bekalan ubat-ubatan akan dilindungi, sambil mengakui bidang bukan teras akan menghadapi pelarasan.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Bermain Mangsa Apabila SPRM Menghampiri Perjanjian Arm Holdings RM1.1 Bilion — 'Tiada Wang Terlibat,' Katanya, Seolah-Olah Itu Menyelesaikan Segalanya
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Bekas Menteri Ekonomi Rafizi Ramli mengumumkan pada 1 Mei 2026 bahawa beliau telah dipanggil oleh Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) untuk memberi kenyataan pada 4 Mei di ibu pejabatnya di Putrajaya, berhubung siasatan terhadap usahasama kerajaan bernilai RM1.1 bilion dengan gergasi cip Britain Arm Holdings yang ditandatangani pada Mac 2025 semasa tempohnya. Rafizi mendakwa siasatan itu dicetuskan oleh laporan daripada Perkasa — NGO yang ditolaknya sebagai “tidak pernah sebelum ini menunjukkan minat dalam isu rasuah” — dan berkata beliau menjangka akan didakwa atas pecah amanah jenayah atau memberikan maklumat mengelirukan kepada Kabinet. Beliau menegaskan “tiada wang terlibat” dan membingkaikan siasatan itu sebagai bermotif politik, menyatakan ia telah menjadi “keutamaan paling tinggi” SPRM sejak Februari.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Bermain Mangsa Apabila SPRM Semakin Hampir Dengan Perjanjian Arm Holdings RM1.1 Bilion — 'Tiada Wang Terlibat,' Katanya, Seolah-Olah Itu Sudah Selesai

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Dakwa Siasatan SPRM Bermotif Politik, Kata 'Tiada Wang Terlibat' — Pejuang Anti-Rasuah Yang Tiba-Tiba Berbunyi Macam Setiap Ahli Politik Yang Pernah Dia Dedahkan
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 1 Mei 2026, bekas Menteri Ekonomi Datuk Seri Rafizi Ramli mendedahkan beliau telah dipanggil oleh Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) untuk memberi keterangan di ibu pejabatnya di Putrajaya pada 4 Mei. Saman itu berkaitan siasatan terhadap usaha sama kerajaan bernilai RM1.1 bilion dengan firma semikonduktor British, Arm Holdings, yang ditandatangani semasa Rafizi menjadi menteri. Siasatan dimulakan selepas aduan oleh NGO Perkasa, dan tertumpu kepada dakwaan bahawa Rafizi menekan Kabinet untuk meluluskan perjanjian itu dengan segera. Dalam responsnya di X, Rafizi berkata beliau menjangkakan akan didakwa atas pecah amanah, tetapi menegaskan “tiada motif kewangan — tiada wang terlibat,” dan mempersoalkan mengapa Perkasa — NGO yang tidak pernah menunjukkan minat terhadap isu rasuah — tiba-tiba membuat laporan.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Jangka Didakwa SPRM Atas Perjanjian Arm Holdings RM1.1B — 'Jangan Jadi Macam Rafizi,' Katanya, Sementara Janji Anti-Rasuah PH Makan Tuan
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Bekas Menteri Ekonomi Rafizi Ramli mendedahkan pada 1 Mei bahawa beliau telah dipanggil oleh Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) untuk memberi keterangan pada 4 Mei di ibu pejabat SPRM Putrajaya, berhubung siasatan terhadap usahasama kerajaan bernilai RM1.1 bilion dengan syarikat semikonduktor British, Arm Holdings. Rafizi, Ahli Parlimen PKR Pandan, berkata beliau menjangkakan akan didakwa atas pecah amanah atau memberikan maklumat palsu yang didakwa menyebabkan Kabinet meluluskan perjanjian itu secara tergesa-gesa. Bekas pembantunya, penganalisis politik James Chai, telah disoal siasat selama tiga hari berturut-turut sebelum ini. Dalam satu catatan sinis di X, Rafizi berkata: “Jangan jadi macam Rafizi — kalau kau tak setuju dengan sesuatu, duduk diam-diam saja,” memberi amaran bahawa suara pembangkang dalam politik Malaysia mengundang pendakwaan.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Jangka Pertuduhan SPRM Atas Perjanjian Arm Holdings RM1.1B — 'Jangan Jadi Macam Rafizi,' Katanya, Sementara Janji Anti-Rasuah PH Makan Diri Sendiri

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Jerit 'Aniaya Politik' Selepas Saman SPRM Atas Perjanjian ARM RM1.1 Bilion — Lelaki Yang Bina Kerjaya Atas Anti-Rasuah Kini Tak Tahan Disiasat
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Rafizi Ramli, bekas Menteri Ekonomi dan Ahli Parlimen PKR Pandan, mengumumkan pada 1 Mei bahawa beliau menerima saman SPRM untuk memberi kenyataan di ibu pejabat Putrajaya pada hari Isnin jam 10 pagi. Siasatan berkaitan perjanjian usaha sama bernilai RM1.1 bilion antara kerajaan Malaysia dan firma semikonduktor UK Arm Holdings, yang ditandatangani pada Mac 2025 semasa tempoh beliau sebagai menteri. Rafizi berkata siasatan memfokuskan sama ada beliau menekan Kabinet untuk menandatangani perjanjian itu secara tergesa-gesa, dan beliau menjangkakan kemungkinan pertuduhan termasuk pecah amanah jenayah atau memberi maklumat mengelirukan. Beliau menolak siasatan itu sebagai bermotif politik, menyatakan aduan itu dibuat oleh Perkasa, sebuah NGO yang didakwanya “tidak pernah sebelum ini menunjukkan minat dalam isu rasuah.”

Beliau menolak siasatan itu sebagai bermotif politik, menyatakan aduan dibuat oleh Perkasa, NGO yang beliau dakwa “tidak pernah sebelum ini menunjukkan minat dalam isu rasuah.”

item.title: [BM] Tiong King Sing Suruh Pengkritik 'Berhenti Mempolitikkan' Pesta Air Anjuran Kerajaan — Selepas Kementeriannya Sendiri Dicela PM Atas Isu Arak
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 1 Mei 2026, Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing menolak kritikan yang semakin meningkat terhadap Rain Rave Water Music Festival 2026, yang diadakan malam sebelumnya di Bukit Bintang di bawah kempen Melawat Malaysia 2026. Tiong menyuruh pengkritik “berhenti mempolitikkan” acara itu, mendakwa lebih 50,000 orang hadir, berbangga kerana basah di atas pentas, dan menegaskan pesta itu “bukan Songkran” — sambil menunjukkan apa yang beliau panggil “piawai berganda” kerana perayaan Songkran di Kedah pada 18 April tidak menghadapi tentangan serupa. Beliau mengesahkan telah menerima memorandum daripada pengkritik yang menuntut peletakan jawatannya.

item.title: [BM] Tiong Suruh Pengkritik Pesta Hujan Diam Dan Pergi Belanja — Kerajaan Tolak Kebimbangan Moral Atas Pesta Air Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing pada 1 Mei memberitahu pengkritik Pesta Muzik Air Rain Rave (RRWMF) supaya berhenti “mempolitikkan” acara itu, yang telah mendapat bantahan daripada pihak berkuasa agama, parti pembangkang, dan juga anggota gabungan pemerintah. Festival muzik bertema air selama tiga hari itu, diadakan di Bukit Bintang dari 30 April hingga 2 Mei sebagai sebahagian daripada Melawat Malaysia 2026, dianjurkan bersama oleh Tourism Malaysia dan syarikat acara The Fame. Apabila ditekan mengenai bantahan daripada Jabatan Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan (JAWI), yang memberi amaran acara itu boleh menjejaskan standard moral, Tiong menjawab: “Jika anda rasa agama anda tidak membenarkan, maka jangan datang.” Beliau juga menggunakan whataboutism, menunjuk kepada festival Songkran di Kedah pimpinan PAS pada 18 April dan bertanya mengapa tiada seruan untuk menteri besar itu meletak jawatan.

item.title: [BM] Tiong Suruh Pengkritik Pesta Hujan Duduk Rumah — Jawapan Menteri Kerajaan Kepada Kontroversi Adalah 'Jangan Datang Kalau Tak Suka'
item.description:

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Tiong King Sing menghabiskan hari-hari pertama Mei mempertahankan Pesta Muzik Air Rain Rave 2026 yang disokong kerajaan di Bukit Bintang — bukan dengan menangani kebimbangan pengkritik, tetapi dengan menyuruh mereka diam. Pada 30 April, Tiong memberitahu akhbar: “Jika anda rasa agama anda tidak membenarkan, maka jangan datang.” Pada 1 Mei, melalui Malay Mail, beliau menggesa semua pihak “berhenti mempolitikkan” acara itu dan berkata: “Jangan jadikan setiap program isu politik. Kalau kita buat begitu, macam mana nak bangunkan ekonomi?” Beliau menunjuk kepada festival Songkran yang diadakan di Kedah pimpinan PAS sebagai bukti kritikan yang “tidak konsisten,” dan mengisytiharkan acara itu — yang menarik lebih 50,000 orang ke Bukit Bintang — sebagai “kejayaan besar.”

item.title: Anwar Admits His Own Government Can't Deliver — Orders 2-Week Implementation Reports After 2.5 Years of Announcements Without Action
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

At the Labour Day 2026 celebration at Unifi Arena, Bukit Jalil on May 1, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim ordered all government agencies to submit detailed implementation reports on newly announced workers’ initiatives within two weeks. He told the crowd of 15,000 workers: “I do not want a repeat of past practices where announcements are made, but implementation takes six months, a year or even longer.” Reports must reach ministers’ desks within two weeks and be presented for Cabinet consideration within three weeks.

item.title: Anwar Begs Billion-Ringgit Companies for RM40 Pay Rises 'With Compassion' — After 2.5 Years, His Wage Policy Is Still 'Please Be Nice'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

At the national Workers’ Day celebration at Bukit Jalil on May 1, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim called on employers to be “more considerate and compassionate” toward workers. He singled out companies recording RM1–2 billion in profits that “still find it difficult to approve even a RM40 salary increase.” He explicitly said he was not proposing anything that would cause companies losses or hurt competitiveness — only asking leaders to “show greater compassion.” He touted the government’s previous minimum wage hike from RM1,200 to RM1,500 and the GLC floor of RM3,000 as evidence of action.

item.title: Anwar Gives Ministries Two Weeks to Deliver Workers' Initiatives — After Admitting His Own Government Takes 'Six Months, a Year or Even Longer'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, at the national Workers’ Day celebration at Unifi Arena, Bukit Jalil — attended by 15,000 workers — Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim announced a RM710 million PACE Economic Resilience Package and a Post-Maternity Leave Allowance, then gave all relevant agencies a two-week deadline to submit implementation reports to their ministers. “I do not want a repeat of past practices where announcements are made, but implementation takes six months, a year or even longer,” he said. Within three weeks, the reports must reach the Cabinet.

item.title: Anwar Lectures Corporate Malaysia on 'Fair Wages' — Two Days After His Treasury Slashed RM10 Billion From Health and Education
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim used the national Workers’ Day celebration on May 1, 2026 to publicly shame corporate Malaysia, singling out companies recording RM1-2 billion in profits that “still find it difficult to approve even a RM40 salary increase to workers.” He boasted about Malaysia’s “strong growth, record-high investments, low unemployment, and a robust ringgit performance” and demanded that the private sector match profits with compassion. This was delivered just two days after his own Treasury, on April 29, issued a directive ordering all federal ministries to slash their 2026 operating budgets — including RM3.06 billion from the Health Ministry and RM2.39 billion from Higher Education — as part of a RM10 billion austerity package triggered by the Iran war’s impact on fuel subsidies.

item.title: Anwar Says He 'Won't Betray the Mandate' — While Quietly Planning Snap Elections to Dodge Fuel Subsidy Cuts
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told a Labour Day crowd that his government “will not betray the people’s mandate” as oil prices surged to US$115 per barrel — up from US$70 just three months earlier. He pledged to maintain the subsidised RON95 price at RM1.99 per litre. Meanwhile, Bloomberg reported on April 24 — citing unnamed sources — that Anwar is considering calling a general election by the third quarter of 2026, potentially as early as October, specifically to get ahead of politically toxic fuel subsidy cuts. Malaysia’s monthly fuel subsidy bill has surged nearly 10-fold to approximately RM7 billion since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in February, threatening to blow up the government’s budget deficit targets. Second Finance Minister Amir Hamzah Azizan acknowledged recent reforms haven’t fully eliminated the subsidy burden.

item.title: Anwar Tells Everyone to 'Focus on Economy' While His Own MB Lost Majority — Democracy Can Wait, Apparently
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, speaking to reporters after Friday prayers in Rawang on May 1, urged all parties to “remain calm” over the Negeri Sembilan political crisis and to “prioritise economic recovery” instead of escalating political disputes. He said the situation must be handled in accordance with the state constitution and the decree of the Yang di-Pertuan Besar, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir, who directed Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun to continue in office — despite 14 UMNO assemblymen having withdrawn confidence in him.

item.title: Anwar Tells Everyone to 'Remain Calm' and 'Prioritise the Economy' as His Own Coalition Fractures in Negeri Sembilan — The Unity Government's Crisis Management Playbook Is Just 'Shh, Don't Look'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & PH Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim responded to the Negeri Sembilan political crisis — in which all 14 UMNO-BN assemblymen withdrew support for PH Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun — by urging “all parties to remain calm” and insisting that “the priority now is to restore the national economy rather than escalate political issues.” He said the situation must be handled “in accordance with the state constitution” while respecting the Yang di-Pertuan Besar’s decree for Aminuddin to continue in office. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil had earlier on April 28 claimed the turmoil had “no impact on the federal level” and called it “something unique to Negeri Sembilan.”

item.title: Anwar Unveils RM710M 'PACE Package' on Labour Day — Two Days After His Treasury Ordered RM5.4 Billion in Cuts to Health and Education
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took the stage at the National Workers’ Day celebration at Unifi Arena, Bukit Jalil, to unveil the RM710 million PACE Economic Resilience Package — billed as a measure to “strengthen jobs, skills and wage resilience.” He acknowledged that oil prices had surged from US$70 to US$115 per barrel and pledged the government would “continue taking necessary measures” to face global economic uncertainty. This was delivered just two days after the Treasury Secretary-General Johan Mahmood Merican issued an internal directive on April 29 ordering sweeping budget cuts across all ministries: a 10% reduction on essential services, 20% cuts to statutory bodies, a hiring freeze, and a proposed RM5.4 billion in cuts to health and higher education — including RM3.06 billion slashed from healthcare alone.

item.title: Dzulkefly Expects 10% Health Budget Cut — Accepts Even Deeper Slash Than Treasury's Initial RM3B Proposal While Insisting 'Core Services Safe'
item.description:
Said by: Dzulkefly Ahmad, Health Minister

Category: Health

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Health Minister Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad revealed on May 1, 2026 that he expects a cut of approximately 10% to the Ministry of Health’s RM46.5 billion budget for 2026 — a figure significantly higher than the RM3.06 billion (6.6%) initially proposed by the Treasury in its April 29 directive. Speaking after the Treasury ordered all federal ministries to trim operating expenditure due to the fiscal impact of the US-Israeli war on Iran, Dzulkefly maintained that “essential core services” including patient treatment, emergency care, and the supply of medicines would be protected, while acknowledging that non-core areas would face adjustments.

item.title: Rafizi Claims MACC Probe Is Political, Says 'No Money Involved' — The Anti-Corruption Crusader Who Suddenly Sounds Like Every Politician He Ever Exposed
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, former Economy Minister Datuk Seri Rafizi Ramli revealed he had been summoned by the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) to give a statement at its Putrajaya headquarters on May 4. The summons relates to an ongoing investigation into the government’s RM1.1 billion joint venture with UK-based semiconductor firm Arm Holdings, signed during Rafizi’s tenure. The probe, initiated after a complaint by NGO Perkasa, centres on allegations that Rafizi pressured the Cabinet to expedite approval of the deal. In his response posted on X, Rafizi said he expects to be charged with breach of trust, but insisted “there is no monetary motive — no money is involved,” and questioned why Perkasa — an NGO with no track record on corruption issues — suddenly filed the report.

item.title: Rafizi Cries 'Political Persecution' After MACC Summons Over RM1.1B ARM Deal — The Man Who Built His Career on Anti-Corruption Now Can't Handle an Investigation
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Rafizi Ramli, former Economy Minister and PKR’s Pandan MP, announced on May 1 that he received a MACC summons to give a statement at its Putrajaya headquarters on Monday at 10am. The investigation concerns the RM1.1 billion joint venture agreement between the Malaysian government and UK-based semiconductor firm Arm Holdings, signed in March 2025 during his tenure as minister. Rafizi said the probe focuses on whether he pressured Cabinet to sign the deal hastily, and that he expects possible charges including criminal breach of trust or providing misleading information. He dismissed the investigation as politically motivated, noting the complaint was lodged by Perkasa, an NGO he claims has “never previously shown interest in corruption issues.”

item.title: Rafizi Expects MACC Charges Over RM1.1B Arm Holdings Deal — 'Don't Be Like Rafizi,' He Says, as PH's Anti-Corruption Promises Eat Their Own
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Former Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli disclosed on May 1 that he has been summoned by the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) to give a statement on May 4 at MACC headquarters in Putrajaya, in connection with an investigation into the government’s RM1.1 billion joint venture with British semiconductor firm Arm Holdings. Rafizi, the PKR MP for Pandan, said he expects to be charged with breach of trust or providing false information that allegedly caused the Cabinet to approve the deal hastily. His former aide, political analyst James Chai, was questioned for three consecutive days prior. In a sardonic post on X, Rafizi remarked: “Don’t be like Rafizi — if you disagree with something, just sit quietly,” warning that dissent in Malaysian politics invites prosecution.

item.title: Rafizi Plays Victim as MACC Closes In on RM1.1 Billion Arm Holdings Deal — 'No Money Involved,' He Says, as If That Settles It
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Former Economy Minister (PKR, Pandan MP)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Former Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli announced on May 1, 2026 that he has been summoned by the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) to give a statement on May 4 at its Putrajaya headquarters, in connection with a probe into the government’s RM1.1 billion joint venture with British chip giant Arm Holdings signed in March 2025 during his tenure. Rafizi claimed the investigation was triggered by a report from Perkasa — an NGO he dismissed as having “never previously shown interest in corruption issues” — and said he expects to be charged with criminal breach of trust or providing misleading information to Cabinet. item.title: Tiong King Sing Tells Critics to 'Stop Politicising' Government-Backed Water Rave — After His Own Ministry Drew PM's Wrath Over Alcohol
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing dismissed mounting criticism of the Rain Rave Water Music Festival 2026, held the previous night at Bukit Bintang under the Visit Malaysia 2026 campaign. Tiong told critics to “stop politicising” the event, claimed over 50,000 people attended, boasted about getting soaked on stage, and insisted the festival “is not Songkran” — while pointing to what he called a “double standard” because a Songkran celebration in Kedah on April 18 faced no similar backlash. He confirmed he had received a memorandum from critics calling for his resignation over the festival.

item.title: Tiong King Sing Tells Rain Rave Critics to Shut Up and Shop — Government's Flagship VMY2026 Event Is a Water Cannon Rave and You're Not Allowed to Question It
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

On May 1, 2026, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing told all parties to stop “politicising” the government-backed Rain Rave Water Music Festival (RRWMF) in Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur — the flagship event of Visit Malaysia Year 2026. In response to weeks of criticism from PAS, PKR members within his own coalition, civil society groups, and the public, Tiong dismissed concerns by saying: “Do not turn every programme into a political issue. If we do that, how can we develop the economy?” He told critics who felt the event was inappropriate to simply not attend, adding: “No one is forced. We must learn to respect other people’s choices.” He also pointed critics to local hawkers, daring them to ask traders whether they were “happy or angry” with the festival — as if street vendor satisfaction is the standard for evaluating national tourism policy.

item.title: Tiong Tells Rain Rave Critics to Shut Up and Shop — Government Dismisses Moral Concerns Over Its Own Water Festival
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-05-01

📌 What Happened

Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing on May 1 told critics of the Rain Rave Water Music Festival (RRWMF) to stop “politicising” the event, which has drawn objections from religious authorities, opposition parties, and even members of the ruling coalition. The three-day water-themed music festival, held in Bukit Bintang from April 30 to May 2 as part of Visit Malaysia 2026, was co-organised by Tourism Malaysia and event company The Fame. When pressed on objections from the Federal Territories Islamic Religious Department (JAWI), which warned the event could undermine moral standards, Tiong responded: “If you feel your religion does not permit it, then do not come.” He also deployed whataboutism, pointing to a Songkran festival in PAS-led Kedah on April 18 and asking why there were no calls for that menteri besar’s resignation.

Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister Tiong King Sing spent the first days of May defending the government-backed Rain Rave Water Music Festival 2026 in Bukit Bintang — not by addressing critics’ concerns, but by telling them to shut up. item.title: [BM] Akmal Akui Bekalan Bahan Api Hanya Terjamin Hingga Jun — Menteri Ekonomi Ke Bloomberg Kata 'Kami Masih Berunding'
item.description:
Said by: Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, Economy Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 30 April 2026, Menteri Ekonomi Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir tampil di Bloomberg Television — ditemu bual oleh Haslinda Amin — dan mengakui Malaysia hanya mampu mengekalkan bekalan bahan apinya sehingga akhir Jun 2026. Beliau mengesahkan Petronas “sedang berbincang dengan pembekal berpotensi” tetapi menekankan rundingan mesti mendapatkan “harga yang betul.” Beliau juga menyatakan kerajaan telah mengurangkan kuota bahan api bersubsidi daripada 300 liter kepada 200 liter setiap rakyat Malaysia dan memperkenalkan pengaturan kerja dari rumah untuk penjawat awam bagi mengurus permintaan. Beliau mendakwa kerajaan “masih mempunyai kelenturan” untuk mengurus subsidi dan defisit fiskal.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Pemotongan RM5.4 Bilion Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan Hanya 'Perbelanjaan Tidak Kritikal' — Sedangkan Kementerian Kesihatan Kehilangan RM3 Bilion
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 30 April, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Fahmi Fadzil mempertahankan arahan Perbendaharaan yang mengarahkan pemotongan RM10 bilion dalam perbelanjaan mengurus di seluruh kementerian persekutuan, termasuk RM3.06 bilion daripada Kementerian Kesihatan dan RM2.39 bilion daripada Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi. Fahmi memberitahu wartawan selepas mesyuarat Kabinet bahawa pemotongan yang dicadangkan hanya melibatkan “perbelanjaan tidak kritikal” dan “semua perbelanjaan teras kementerian akan diteruskan seperti yang diluluskan di bawah Bajet 2026.” Arahan bertarikh 29 April itu dikeluarkan berikutan tekanan fiskal akibat konflik Iran dan kos subsidi bahan api yang melambung sehingga dianggarkan RM7 bilion sebulan.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Sahkan Belanjawan Dipotong RM10 Bilion Tapi Kata Kerajaan Tak Akan Kembali Ke Parlimen — Dewan Rakyat Luluskan, Kabinet Tulis Semula
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 29 April, Perbendaharaan Malaysia mengeluarkan arahan mengarahkan semua kementerian, jabatan dan agensi persekutuan memotong belanjawan operasi 2026 mereka — langkah yang dijangka menjimatkan RM10 bilion — selepas bil subsidi kerajaan membengkak daripada RM15 bilion yang diluluskan kepada unjuran RM58.4 bilion akibat krisis tenaga perang Iran. Keesokan harinya, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Fahmi Fadzil mengesahkan arahan itu di sidang akhbar tetapi menyatakan “tiada perancangan kerajaan untuk membentangkan semula belanjawan 2026 ke parlimen buat masa ini,” membingkai rombakan perbelanjaan besar-besaran itu sebagai “penentukuran semula” rutin dan bukannya apa yang jelas ia adalah: penulisan semula menyeluruh perbelanjaan yang diluluskan Parlimen.

item.title: [BM] Kebebasan Akhbar Malaysia Jatuh Ke Ke-95 Di Bawah Pengawasan Fahmi — Menteri Komunikasi Pernah Tolak RSF Sebagai 'Bukan Piawaian Emas'
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Malaysia jatuh tujuh tangga ke kedudukan ke-95 daripada 180 negara dalam Indeks Kebebasan Akhbar Dunia RSF 2026, diterbitkan pada 30 April. Skor keseluruhan negara jatuh daripada 56.09 kepada 52.73, dengan penurunan dalam empat daripada lima penunjuk. Penunjuk politik — mengukur kebebasan media daripada tekanan politik — merosot daripada 44.66 kepada 43.00, manakala penunjuk ekonomi menjunam daripada 48.67 kepada 40.28. Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil, yang menyelia MCMC dan dasar media, sebelum ini menolak indeks RSF sebagai “bukan piawaian emas” apabila Malaysia jatuh 34 tangga ke ke-107 pada 2024.

item.title: [BM] Kementerian Kewangan Kata Pemotongan RM5.4 Bilion Kepada Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan 'Tidak Kritikal' — RM3 Bilion Dari Hospital Bukan Penting?
item.description:
Said by: Finance Ministry / Treasury (under Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 29 April, Perbendaharaan mencadangkan pemotongan perbelanjaan operasi sebanyak RM5.4 bilion yang menyasarkan Kementerian Kesihatan (RM3.06 bilion) dan Kementerian Pengajian Tinggi sebagai sebahagian daripada usaha penjimatan RM10 bilion merentasi semua agensi persekutuan. Pemotongan ini — dibingkaikan sebagai tindak balas kepada kesan konflik Iran terhadap subsidi bahan api — termasuk menangguhkan acara, mengehadkan lawatan luar negara, menjimatkan utiliti, menangguhkan pengambilan kakitangan bagi “jawatan tidak kritikal,” dan mengoptimumkan rizab agensi. Pada 30 April, Kementerian Kewangan mengeluarkan kenyataan menegaskan bahawa “perkhidmatan penting tidak akan terganggu” dan pelarasan hanya melibatkan “perkara tidak kritikal.”

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Bangga Jimat RM1.9 Juta Bahan Api WFH Dalam 10 Hari — Sementara Berdarah RM4 Bilion Sebulan Untuk Subsidi
item.description:
Said by: Wan Ahmad Dahlan Abdul Aziz, Director-General of Public Service

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 30 April 2026, Ketua Pengarah Perkhidmatan Awam Tan Sri Wan Ahmad Dahlan Abdul Aziz dengan bangganya mengumumkan bahawa inisiatif kerja dari rumah (WFH) kerajaan — diperkenalkan pada 15 April sebagai tindak balas kecemasan kepada kos bahan api yang melonjak — telah menjimatkan RM1.9 juta subsidi petrol RON95 dalam 10 hari pertamanya. Itu bersamaan 979,632 liter petrol, atau RM239,215.68 sehari. Hanya 20,136 penjawat awam kini menyertai skim itu, naik daripada 15,452 pada pelancaran.

Said by: Wan Ahmad Dahlan Abdul Aziz, Director-General of Public Service

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 30 April 2026, Ketua Pengarah Perkhidmatan Awam Tan Sri Wan Ahmad Dahlan Abdul Aziz dengan bangganya mengumumkan bahawa inisiatif kerja dari rumah (WFH) kerajaan — diperkenalkan pada 15 April sebagai respons kecemasan kepada kos bahan api yang melonjak akibat konflik Timur Tengah — telah menjimatkan RM1.9 juta dalam subsidi petrol RON95 dalam 10 hari pertamanya. Itu bersamaan 979,632 liter petrol, atau RM239,215.68 sehari. Hanya 20,136 penjawat awam yang kini menyertai skim tersebut, meningkat daripada 15,452 semasa pelancaran. KPA menggambarkan penjimatan itu sebagai “sumbangan bermakna daripada penjawat awam dalam membantu kerajaan mengurus tekanan kewangan.”

item.title: [BM] Tiong Bela Pesta Rave Tajaan Kerajaan Sebagai 'Sihat Dan Inklusif' — Sementara JAWI Kata Tidak Bermoral Dan Perbendaharaan Potong Berbilion Daripada Kesihatan
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing membela Festival Muzik Air Rain Rave 2026 — pesta rave air selama tiga hari tajaan kerajaan di Bukit Bintang dari 30 April hingga 2 Mei — daripada kritikan yang semakin meningkat daripada parti pembangkang, masyarakat sivil, dan bahkan agensi agama persekutuan. Tiong menyifatkan bantahan itu “palsu dan tidak berasas,” mengecam pengkritik di platform media sosial Threads sebagai “menghasut dan memfitnah,” dan menegaskan sesiapa yang tidak suka acara itu boleh “pilih untuk tidak menyertai.” Pada hari yang sama festival dibuka, Jabatan Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan (JAWI) mengeluarkan nasihat rasmi menyifatkan acara itu tidak bermoral dan menggesa penganjur menyemak semula konsep tersebut. Festival ini sebahagian daripada Tahun Melawat Malaysia 2026.

item.title: Akmal Admits Fuel Supply Only Secured Until June — Economy Minister Goes on Bloomberg to Say 'We're Still Negotiating'
item.description:
Said by: Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, Economy Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

On April 30, 2026, Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir went on Bloomberg Television — interviewed by Haslinda Amin — and admitted that Malaysia can only sustain its fuel supply until the end of June 2026. He confirmed that Petronas “is having conversations with potential suppliers” but stressed that negotiations must secure “the right price.” He also noted the government has already reduced the subsidised fuel quota from 300 litres to 200 litres per Malaysian and introduced civil servant work-from-home arrangements to manage demand. He claimed the government “still has flexibility” to manage subsidies and the fiscal deficit.

item.title: Fahmi Confirms RM10 Billion Budget Slash But Says Government Won't Go Back to Parliament — The Dewan Rakyat Approved It, the Cabinet Rewrote It
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

On April 29, Malaysia’s Treasury issued a directive ordering all federal ministries, departments, and agencies to slash their 2026 operating budgets — a move expected to save RM10 billion — after the government’s subsidy bill ballooned from the originally approved RM15 billion to a projected RM58.4 billion due to the Iran war energy crisis. The next day, Communications Minister and government spokesperson Fahmi Fadzil confirmed the directive at a press briefing but stated there were “no plans by the government to re-submit its 2026 budget to parliament for now,” framing the massive spending overhaul as routine “recalibration” rather than what it plainly is: a wholesale rewrite of Parliament-approved expenditure.

item.title: Fahmi Says RM5.4 Billion Health and Education Cuts Are 'Only Non-Critical Spending' — While the Health Ministry Loses RM3 Billion
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

On April 30, Communications Minister and government spokesperson Fahmi Fadzil defended a Treasury directive ordering RM10 billion in operating expenditure cuts across all federal ministries, including RM3.06 billion from the Health Ministry and RM2.39 billion from the Higher Education Ministry. Fahmi told reporters after a Cabinet meeting that the proposed cuts target “only non-critical spending” and that “all core ministry expenditures will continue as approved under the 2026 budget.” The directive, dated April 29, was issued in response to the fiscal strain caused by the Iran conflict and ballooning fuel subsidy costs estimated at RM7 billion monthly.

item.title: Finance Ministry Says RM5.4B Cuts to Health and Education Are 'Non-Critical' — RM3 Billion From Hospitals Isn't Essential?
item.description:
Said by: Finance Ministry / Treasury (under Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

On April 29, the Treasury proposed RM5.4 billion in operational spending cuts targeting the Ministry of Health (RM3.06 billion) and the Ministry of Higher Education as part of a broader RM10 billion austerity drive across all federal agencies. The cuts — framed as a response to the Iran conflict’s impact on fuel subsidies — include postponing events, limiting overseas trips, saving on utilities, delaying recruitment for “non-critical positions,” and optimising agency reserves. On April 30, the Finance Ministry issued a statement insisting that “essential services will not be disrupted” and that adjustments only involve “non-critical items.”

item.title: Government Trumpets RM1.9 Million WFH Fuel Savings in 10 Days — While Bleeding RM4 Billion a Month on Subsidies
item.description:
Said by: Wan Ahmad Dahlan Abdul Aziz, Director-General of Public Service

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

On April 30, 2026, Director-General of Public Service Tan Sri Wan Ahmad Dahlan Abdul Aziz proudly announced that the government’s work-from-home (WFH) initiative — introduced on April 15 as an emergency response to soaring fuel costs from the Middle East conflict — had saved RM1.9 million in RON95 petrol subsidies over its first 10 days. That works out to 979,632 litres of petrol, or RM239,215.68 per day. Only 20,136 civil servants are currently participating in the scheme, up from 15,452 at launch. The DG described the savings as “a meaningful contribution from civil servants in helping the government manage financial pressures.”

item.title: Malaysia's Press Freedom Drops to 95th Under Fahmi's Watch — Communications Minister Once Dismissed RSF as 'Not the Gold Standard'
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

Malaysia dropped seven places to 95th out of 180 countries in the 2026 Reporters Without Borders (RSF) World Press Freedom Index, published on April 30. The country’s overall score fell from 56.09 to 52.73, with declines in four of five indicators. The political indicator — measuring media independence from political pressure — slipped from 44.66 to 43.00, while the economic indicator plunged from 48.67 to 40.28. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil, who oversees the MCMC and media policy, had previously dismissed the RSF index as “not the gold standard” when Malaysia dropped 34 spots to 107th in 2024.

item.title: Tiong Defends Government-Backed Rave Festival as 'Healthy and Inclusive' — While JAWI Calls It Immoral and Treasury Slashes Billions From Health
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-04-30

📌 What Happened

Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing defended the Rain Rave Water Music Festival 2026 — a government-backed three-day water rave in Bukit Bintang running April 30 to May 2 — against mounting criticism from opposition parties, civil society, and even a federal religious agency. Tiong called the backlash “false and baseless,” condemned critics on social media platform Threads as “inflammatory and defamatory,” and insisted anyone who doesn’t like the event can “simply choose not to participate.” On the same day the festival opened, the Federal Territories Islamic Religious Department (JAWI) issued a formal advisory calling the event immoral and urging organisers to review the concept. The festival is part of Visit Malaysia Year 2026.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Arah 'Jimat Cermat Lembut' — Kecilkan Acara, Tapi Jangan Berani Bentang Semula Bajet
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 29 April, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil — bercakap sebagai jurucakap kerajaan selepas mesyuarat Majlis Tindakan Ekonomi Negara (MTEN) — mengumumkan bahawa semua kementerian, agensi, badan berkanun, GLC dan GLIC mesti mengecilkan acara rasmi dan memangkas perbelanjaan operasi. Kementerian Kewangan telah mengarahkan semua kementerian mencadangkan pemotongan bajet menjelang 15 Mei. Walau bagaimanapun, Fahmi secara jelas menyatakan bahawa Bajet 2026 tidak akan dibentangkan semula di Parlimen, menegaskan pelarasan itu melibatkan “pengoptimuman perbelanjaan sedia ada” tanpa mengubah rangka kerja keseluruhan.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Fadzil Dakwa 'Belanjawan 2026 Tidak Berubah' Sementara Perbendaharaan Arah Semua Kementerian Potong Perbelanjaan Menjelang 15 Mei
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson (PKR)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 29 April 2026, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengesahkan di sidang akhbar mingguannya bahawa semua kementerian telah menerima arahan daripada Kementerian Kewangan untuk menyemak dan memotong perbelanjaan operasi Belanjawan 2026. Ketua Setiausaha Perbendaharaan Datuk Johan Mahmood Merican mengeluarkan arahan rasmi pada hari yang sama, mengarahkan semua kementerian, jabatan dan agensi mengemukakan cadangan pemotongan perbelanjaan sebelum 15 Mei. Alasan yang diberikan ialah kesan konflik Timur Tengah — khususnya perang AS-Israel ke atas Iran — yang menyebabkan harga tenaga global melonjak dan memaksa Malaysia membelanjakan berbilion ringgit lagi untuk subsidi bahan api. Dalam nafas yang sama, Fahmi mendakwa “kerajaan tidak bercadang untuk membentangkan semula Belanjawan 2026 di Parlimen” dan belanjawan itu “kekal tidak berubah” — dengan alasan pelarasan hanyalah “mengoptimumkan perbelanjaan sedia ada.”

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Fadzil Kata Bajet 2026 Tak Perlu Disemak — Sementara Perbendaharaan Arah Pemotongan RM5.4 Bilion Dengan Tarikh Akhir 15 Mei
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

item.title: [BM] Perbendaharaan Arah Pemotongan Bajet RM10 Bilion — Kesihatan Dan Pendidikan Paling Teruk Dipukul Sementara Bil Subsidi Meletup Dari RM5B Ke RM58.4B
item.description:

Category: Economy

item.title: Aminuddin Says 'I'll Accept Whatever Leadership Decides' — PH's Negeri Sembilan MB Can't Even Resign Without Permission

item.title: Fahmi Calls RM10 Billion Budget Slash 'Streamlining' — Budget 2026 Won't Be Re-Tabled Despite Subsidy Bill Ballooning 290%
