item.title: Fahmi Fadzil Claims 'Budget 2026 Unchanged' While Treasury Orders All Ministries to Slash Spending by May 15
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesperson (PKR)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 What Happened

On April 29, 2026, Communications Minister and government spokesperson Datuk Fahmi Fadzil confirmed at his weekly press conference that all ministries had received directives from the Ministry of Finance to review and cut operating expenditures for Budget 2026. Finance Ministry secretary-general Datuk Johan Mahmood Merican issued the formal directive the same day, ordering all ministries, departments, and agencies to propose spending cuts by May 15. The reason cited was the impact of the Middle East conflict — specifically the US-Israeli war on Iran — which has sent global energy prices soaring and forced Malaysia to spend billions more on fuel subsidies. In the same breath, Fahmi claimed that “the government has no intention of tabling Budget 2026 in Parliament again” and that the budget “remains unchanged” — insisting the adjustments are merely about “optimising existing spending.”

item.title: Treasury Orders RM10 Billion in Budget Cuts — Health and Education Take the Biggest Hit While Subsidy Bill Explodes From RM5B to RM58.4B
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister; Johan Mahmood Merican, Treasury Secretary-General

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 What Happened

On April 29, 2026, Treasury Secretary-General Johan Mahmood Merican issued a government directive ordering all federal ministries and agencies to cut their operating budgets for 2026, citing the impact of rising energy prices from the Middle East conflict. The directive proposed a staggering RM10 billion in total cuts, with the Health Ministry taking the biggest hit at RM3.06 billion and the Higher Education Ministry at RM2.39 billion. The reason: the government’s subsidy bill had exploded from the RM5 billion originally approved in Budget 2026 to a projected RM58.4 billion — a 1,068% overrun — driven by rising global oil prices. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, who doubles as Finance Minister, is directly responsible for the fiscal policy that budgeted RM5 billion for subsidies while maintaining expensive universal subsidy programmes that were supposed to have been reformed.

item.title: Treasury Slashes RM5.4 Billion From Health and Education — PH's 'Rakyat First' Government Cuts Where It Hurts Most
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 What Happened

On April 29, 2026, Malaysia’s Treasury issued a directive proposing RM5.4 billion in operating budget cuts targeting the Ministry of Health (RM3.06 billion) and the Ministry of Higher Education (RM2.39 billion). The cuts are part of a broader RM10 billion savings target across all federal agencies, triggered by the fiscal strain of the Iran war — specifically, ballooning fuel subsidy costs estimated at RM7 billion monthly. Ministries must submit revised budgets by May 15 to the National Budget Office. Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s Treasury framed this as “fiscal sustainability” — but the targets tell a different story about whose welfare this government actually prioritises.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Fadzil Isytihar Kerajaan Perpaduan 'Stabil' Ketika Negeri Sembilan Terbakar — 14 ADUN UMNO Keluar dan Jurucakap Kerajaan Kata 'Tiada Apa-Apa'

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Gelar Langkah BN Di Negeri Sembilan 'Pengkhianatan' — Sementara MB PH Sendiri Yang Gagal Urus Krisis Diraja
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-28

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 28 April, Pengarah Komunikasi PH Fahmi Fadzil keluarkan kenyataan mengecam kesemua 14 ADUN UMNO-BN Negeri Sembilan yang menarik balik sokongan terhadap Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun, menggelarnya ’tindakan pengkhianatan’ dan cubaan merampas kerajaan negeri. Penarikan sokongan itu berlaku selepas Aminuddin gagal mengurus krisis melibatkan empat Undang Yang Empat yang mengisytiharkan pemecatan Yang di-Pertuan Besar, Tuanku Muhriz — satu krisis yang BN kata berpunca daripada Aminuddin sendiri yang mengambil pihak dan bukannya kekal neutral, sehingga menyebabkan penangguhan DUN pada 23 April.

item.title: Fahmi Calls BN's Negeri Sembilan Move 'Betrayal' — While PH's Own MB Bungled the Royal Crisis That Triggered It
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson / PH Communications Director)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-28

📌 What Happened

On April 28, PH Communications Director Fahmi Fadzil issued a statement condemning all 14 UMNO-BN state assemblymen in Negeri Sembilan for withdrawing their support from Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun, calling it ‘acts of betrayal’ and an attempt to seize the state government. The withdrawal came after Aminuddin’s handling of a crisis involving four Adat Perpatih territorial chieftains who declared they were deposing the Yang di-Pertuan Besar, Tuanku Muhriz — a crisis BN says Aminuddin mismanaged by taking sides instead of remaining neutral, leading to the indefinite postponement of the State Legislative Assembly on April 23.

item.title: Fahmi Fadzil Declares Unity Government 'Stable' While Negeri Sembilan Burns — 14 UMNO Assemblymen Walk Out and the Government Spokesman Says 'Nothing to See Here'
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister & Government Spokesman (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-28

📌 What Happened

On April 28, 2026, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil — the official spokesman of the unity government — held a press conference after the Asia Pacific Online Safety Dialogue 2026 and told reporters that the Negeri Sembilan political crisis “does not affect the federal government.” He described the situation as “something that may be unique to Negeri Sembilan” and insisted all other unity state governments were “functioning as usual.” This came just one day after all 14 UMNO and Barisan Nasional assemblymen in Negeri Sembilan unanimously withdrew support for Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun, plunging the state into a leadership crisis triggered by a rare royal constitutional dispute.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Puji Azam Baki 'Jalankan Tugas Dengan Baik' — Selepas 3 Lanjutan Kontrak, Pendedahan 'Mafia Korporat', Dan Protes Jalanan Menuntut Tangkapannya
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-25

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 25 April 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim secara terbuka memuji ketua Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) yang bakal berundur, Azam Baki, dengan mengatakan beliau telah “menjalankan tugas dengan baik” dan sudah tiba masanya untuk “kepimpinan SPRM baharu.” Ini berlaku pada hari yang sama ratusan rakyat Malaysia berkumpul di Kuala Lumpur untuk himpunan “Tangkap Azam Baki”, menuntut bukan sekadar pertukaran kepimpinan tetapi pembaharuan sistemik terhadap agensi antirasuah itu. Anwar mengumumkan bekas hakim Mahkamah Tinggi Halim Aman sebagai pengganti Azam berkuat kuasa 13 Mei, sambil mengelak daripada menangani timbunan dakwaan yang belum diselesaikan terhadap orang yang digantikannya.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Puji Azam Baki 'Jalankan Tugas Dengan Baik' — Selepas 3 Sambungan Kontrak, Pendedahan Mafia Korporat, Dan Protes Jalanan Menuntut Penangkapannya
item.description:

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Lantik Ketua SPRM Baharu Beberapa Jam Sebelum Bantahan — Penggantian, Bukan Reformasi
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar, Chief Secretary to the Government

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-25

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada pagi 25 April, Ketua Setiausaha Negara Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar mengumumkan bekas Hakim Mahkamah Tinggi Abdul Halim Aman akan menggantikan ketua SPRM Azam Baki berkuat kuasa 13 Mei — sehari selepas kontrak setahun Azam tamat. Pengumuman itu diwaktukan dengan tepat: hanya beberapa jam sebelum himpunan “Tangkap Azam Baki” yang dianjurkan oleh Bersih dan kumpulan masyarakat sivil. Ribuan hadir di pusat bandar Kuala Lumpur petang itu, meskipun hujan lebat, menuntut bukan sahaja penyingkiran Azam tetapi penangkapannya dan Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) ke atas salah laku SPRM. Laporan penyalahgunaan dalam agensi itu mula timbul pada Februari 2026. Selama tiga bulan, kerajaan enggan menggantung Azam, menolak seruan RCI, dan membiarkan masa kontraknya habis.

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Lantik Ketua SPRM Baharu Beberapa Jam Sebelum Protes — Penggantian, Bukan Pembaharuan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar, Chief Secretary to the Government

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-25

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada pagi 25 April, Ketua Setiausaha Negara Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar umum bekas Hakim Mahkamah Tinggi Abdul Halim Aman akan ganti ketua SPRM Azam Baki berkuat kuasa 13 Mei — sehari selepas kontrak setahun Azam tamat. Pengumuman itu tepat masanya: beberapa jam sebelum himpunan “Tangkap Azam Baki” anjuran Bersih dan kumpulan masyarakat sivil. Ribuan orang turun ke pusat bandar Kuala Lumpur petang itu, walaupun hujan lebat, menuntut bukan sekadar penyingkiran Azam tetapi tangkapannya dan Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) mengenai salah laku SPRM. Laporan penyalahgunaan dalam agensi itu mula timbul pada Februari 2026. Selama tiga bulan, kerajaan enggan gantung Azam, tolak gesaan RCI, dan biarkan kontraknya habis sendiri.

item.title: Anwar Praises Azam Baki as Having 'Performed Duties Well' — After 3 Contract Extensions, Corporate Mafia Exposés, and Street Protests Demanding His Arrest
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-25

📌 What Happened

On April 25, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim publicly praised outgoing Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) chief Azam Baki, saying he had “performed duties well” and that it was simply “time for new MACC leadership.” This came on the same day hundreds of Malaysians gathered in Kuala Lumpur for an “Arrest Azam Baki” rally, demanding not just a leadership change but systemic reforms to the anti-graft agency. Anwar announced former High Court judge Halim Aman as Azam’s replacement effective May 13, describing him as “suited” for the role — while conspicuously refusing to address the mountain of unresolved allegations against the man he was replacing.

item.title: Government Names New MACC Chief Hours Before Protest — Replacement, Not Reform
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar, Chief Secretary to the Government

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-25

📌 What Happened

On the morning of April 25, Chief Secretary to the Government Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar announced that former High Court judge Abdul Halim Aman would replace MACC chief Azam Baki effective May 13 — the day after Azam’s one-year contract expires. The announcement was timed precisely: just hours before the “Tangkap Azam Baki” rally organised by Bersih and civil society groups. Thousands turned out in downtown Kuala Lumpur that evening, despite heavy rain, demanding not just Azam’s removal but his arrest and a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) into MACC misconduct. Reports of abuse within the agency first emerged in February 2026. For three months, the government refused to suspend Azam, rejected calls for an RCI, and let the clock run down on his contract.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Bawa Bukti' Atas Dakwaan Dana Dicuri — PM Yang Janji Ketelusan Kini Suruh Orang Lain Buat Siasatan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-24

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 24 April 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim disoal wartawan di Kampus Pendidikan Guru Temenggong Ibrahim di Johor Bahru mengenai video tular 49 saat oleh seorang wanita bernama Sofia Rini Buyong, yang mendakwa bekas pegawai Anwar telah diarahkan memindahkan wang awam yang dicuri ke Afrika dan memiliki kekayaan yang tidak dapat dijelaskan bernilai “berbilion ringgit.” Anwar menolak dakwaan itu mentah-mentah, berkata beliau tidak akan melayan dakwaan tidak berasas dari media sosial, bertanya “Bagaimana saya melayan dakwaan sedemikian? Jika saya ada 1,000 komen, adakah saya perlu menjawab setiap satu?” Beliau mencabar penuduh “bawa bukti,” menambah tanpa bukti, dakwaan sedemikian hanyalah “tempat pembiakan pembohongan.” Ahli politik pembangkang dari PAS dan Bersatu telah menyeru siasatan. Tiada bukti diberikan dalam video itu.

item.title: Anwar Says 'Bring the Evidence' on Stolen Funds Allegations — The PM Who Promised Transparency Now Demands Others Do the Investigating
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-24

📌 What Happened

On April 24, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim was confronted by reporters at the Temenggong Ibrahim Teachers Education Campus in Johor Bahru about a viral 49-second video by a woman named Sofia Rini Buyong, who alleged that a former officer of Anwar’s had been instructed to move stolen public money to Africa and possessed unexplained wealth worth “billions of ringgit.” Anwar dismissed the allegations outright, saying he would not entertain baseless claims from social media, asking “How do I entertain such allegations? If I have 1,000 comments, do I have to answer every one?” He challenged accusers to “bring the evidence,” adding that without proof, such allegations were merely a “breeding ground for lies.” Opposition politicians from PAS and Bersatu had called for an investigation. No evidence was provided in the video.

item.title: [BM] KDN Saifuddin Haramkan Tiga Buku Sejarah — Kemudian U-Turn Selepas Kecaman, Masih Guna Undang-Undang Kolonial Yang PH Janji Nak Mansuh
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-23

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 April 2026, Kementerian Dalam Negeri (KDN) mengeluarkan perintah larangan terhadap dua buah buku terbitan Gerakbudaya — Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari AWAS ke Regimen ke-10 dan Komrad Asi Regimen 10: Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah — dengan alasan buku-buku ini mengandungi “unsur dan ideologi komunis” yang mengancam keselamatan negara. Seminggu kemudian, sebuah lagi buku — terjemahan Melayu buku akademik mengenai Mao Zedong, Mao Zedong: China dalam Dunia Abad ke-20 — turut diharamkan. Pada 23 April, Menteri Dalam Negeri Saifuddin Nasution Ismail mengumumkan kerajaan akan membatalkan ketiga-tiga larangan tersebut selepas kecaman hebat daripada kumpulan masyarakat sivil, penerbit, ahli akademik, dan ahli parlimen, sambil memperkenalkan proses baharu di mana beliau sendiri akan menyemak larangan buku pada masa hadapan.

item.title: [BM] Kementerian Dalam Negeri Saifuddin Haramkan Tiga Buku Sejarah — Kemudian Berpatah Balik Selepas Kecaman, Masih Guna Undang-Undang Penjajah Yang PH Janji Mansuhkan
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Minister

Category: Politics

Pada 23 April, Menteri Dalam Negeri Saifuddin Nasution Ismail mengumumkan kerajaan akan membalikkan ketiga-tiga larangan selepas kecaman hebat daripada kumpulan masyarakat sivil, penerbit, ahli akademik, dan penggubal undang-undang pembangkang, dan memperkenalkan proses baharu di mana beliau secara peribadi akan menyemak larangan masa hadapan.

item.title: Anwar Says 'Let's See' on Cabinet Pay Cuts — The PM Who Hasn't Drawn His Salary Wants Credit for Sacrifice While His Ministers Keep Theirs
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-17

📌 What Happened

On April 17, after Friday prayers at Surau Bomba in Cyberjaya, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim was asked whether Malaysia would follow Indonesia in cutting ministerial salaries amid the worsening global energy crisis. His answer: ‘Let’s see.’ Anwar told reporters that ministers’ salaries are ‘already relatively low’ and that ‘what matters is that they serve well.’ He said the government is ‘prepared to consider’ further pay reductions if the economy deteriorates, but pivoted to his own gesture of not drawing a salary since 2022. Two days later, Fahmi Fadzil confirmed Cabinet members are ‘ready for further pay cuts’ — without actually committing to them.

item.title: [BM] KDN Haramkan Buku Atas 'Ideologi Komunis' Di Bawah PH Reformis — Lebih Banyak Buku Diharamkan Di Bawah Anwar Berbanding Mana-Mana Kerajaan Terkini
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 16 April, Kementerian Dalam Negeri Malaysia mengharamkan dua buah buku di bawah Akta Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan atas dakwaan mengandungi “unsur dan ideologi komunis.” Salah satu naskhah yang diharamkan berkait dengan memoir Shamsiah Fakeh, tokoh terkemuka dalam sejarah Kiri Melayu Malaysia. Pengharaman itu segera dikecam oleh masyarakat sivil, penerbit, dan tokoh pembangkang. Seminggu kemudian, pada 24 April, kementerian mengumumkan ia akan mengamalkan “pendekatan lebih perundingan” dan melibatkan penerbit sebelum mengeluarkan pengharaman pada masa hadapan — tanda jelas kawalan kerosakan selepas kecaman.

item.title: [BM] KDN Saifuddin Haramkan Buku Atas 'Ideologi Komunis' — Kemudian Tergesa-Gesa Tarik Balik Selepas Gabungan PH Sendiri Memberontak
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 16 April 2026, Kementerian Dalam Negeri Malaysia — diketuai Saifuddin Nasution Ismail daripada PKR — mengeluarkan perintah larangan terhadap dua buku, mengisytiharkannya ancaman kepada keselamatan negara kerana mengandungi “unsur dan ideologi komunis.” Salah satu buku yang diharamkan adalah memoir nenek kepada sekutu politik Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim. Larangan berasingan juga dikenakan ke atas terjemahan bahasa Melayu sebuah kajian akademik tentang Mao Zedong, yang dibiayai kerajaan negeri Selangor pimpinan PKR. Kumpulan masyarakat sivil termasuk Article 19 dan Gerak Budaya serta-merta mengecam pengharaman itu. Gerak Budaya, penerbit bebas yang menerima perintah larangan, mengumumkan ia akan mencabar keputusan itu melalui saluran undang-undang.

item.title: [BM] KDN Saifuddin Haramkan Buku Yang Tidak Pernah Diharamkan BN Atau PN — Kemudian Berpatah Balik Seminggu Kemudian Selepas AP PH Sendiri Memberontak
item.description:

Date: 2026-04-16

Cucu Shamsiah, Jamaliah Jamaluddin, adalah ADUN DAP dan sekutu Anwar. Setakat Mac 2026, kerajaan MADANI sudah mengharamkan 27 buku — lebih daripada keseluruhan 24 buku yang diharamkan pada 2025.

item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

Kementerian Dalam Negeri Saifuddin Haramkan Tiga Buku Sejarah Komunisme — Kemudian Tergopoh-Gopoh Tarik Balik Selepas Reaksi Keras Mendedahkan Reformasi Kosong PH

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15–16 April 2026, Kementerian Dalam Negeri Malaysia mengeluarkan perintah larangan terhadap dua buku terbitan Gerakbudaya — Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari AWAS ke Rejimen ke-10 dan Komrad Asi (Rejimen 10): Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah — dengan alasan “ideologi komunis” yang mengancam keselamatan negara. Menjelang 22 April, sebuah lagi buku, terjemahan Bahasa Melayu teks akademik mengenai Mao Zedong, turut diharamkan. Kementerian di bawah Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution Ismail menggunakan Akta Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan 1984 — undang-undang peninggalan penjajah yang PH sendiri pernah berikrar untuk mansuhkan semasa menjadi pembangkang. Kumpulan masyarakat sivil, PEN Malaysia, badan kebebasan akhbar antarabangsa Article 19, malah ahli parlimen berhaluan PH sendiri mengecam tindakan ini. Selepas tekanan berterusan, kementerian mengumumkan pada 24 April akan “berunding dengan penerbit sebelum mengharamkan buku” dan memulakan proses membatalkan larangan tersebut.

item.title: [BM] Kementerian Saifuddin Haram Buku Sejarah Sebagai 'Ancaman Komunis' — Lepas Tu Mengaku Dia Sendiri Tak Tahu Pasal Pengharaman Itu
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Affairs Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 16 April 2026, Kementerian Dalam Negeri Malaysia mengumumkan pengharaman dua buah buku sejarah berbahasa Melayu — Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari AWAS ke Rejimen Ke-10 dan Komrad Asi (Rejimen 10): Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah — terbitan Gerak Budaya, dengan alasan mengandungi “unsur dan ideologi komunis” yang kononnya mengancam keselamatan negara. item.title: [BM] Kementerian Saifuddin Nasution Haramkan Buku Sejarah Anti-Penjajah, Kemudian U-Turn Selepas Kecaman — 27 Buku Diharamkan Di Bawah MADANI 'Reformis' Pada 2026 Sahaja
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Affairs Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 April 2026, Kementerian Dalam Negeri (KDN) Malaysia yang diketuai Saifuddin Nasution Ismail dari PKR mengeluarkan perintah larangan ke atas dua buah buku — Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari AWAS ke Regimen Ke-10 dan Komrad Asi (Regimen 10): Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah — atas alasan “unsur dan ideologi komunis” yang kononnya mengancam ketenteraman awam dan keselamatan negara. Shamsiah Fakeh ialah seorang nasionalis Melayu, feminis, dan pejuang anti-penjajah yang memoirnya pertama kali diterbitkan oleh UKM pada 2004 — lebih dua dekad lalu. Menjelang Mac 2026, Malaysia sudah mengharamkan 27 buah buku di bawah kerajaan MADANI, melebihi 24 buku yang diharamkan sepanjang 2025. Selepas kecaman serta-merta daripada pertubuhan masyarakat sivil, ahli parlimen PH sendiri — termasuk ADUN Bandar Utama Jamaliah Jamaluddin, cucu Shamsiah — dan organisasi kebebasan akhbar antarabangsa seperti ARTICLE 19, Saifuddin mengumumkan pada 23 April bahawa beliau “dalam proses membatalkan” larangan ke atas tiga buah buku, tetapi hanya selepas kerosakan terhadap imej reformis Malaysia sudah berlaku.

item.title: [BM] Kementerian Saifuddin Nasution Haramkan Buku Tentang Sejarah Anti-Penjajah, Kemudian Berpatah Balik Selepas Dikecam — 27 Buku Diharamkan Di Bawah MADANI 'Reformis' Pada 2026 Sahaja

Shamsiah Fakeh adalah nasionalis Melayu, feminis, dan pejuang anti-penjajah yang memoirnya pertama kali diterbitkan oleh UKM pada 2004 — lebih dua dekad lalu. Menjelang Mac 2026, Malaysia sudah mengharamkan 27 buku di bawah kerajaan MADANI, melebihi 24 buku yang diharamkan sepanjang 2025. Selepas kecaman serta-merta daripada kumpulan masyarakat sivil, penggubal undang-undang PH sendiri — termasuk ADUN Bandar Utama Jamaliah Jamaluddin, cucu Shamsiah — dan organisasi kebebasan akhbar antarabangsa seperti ARTICLE 19, Saifuddin mengumumkan pada 23 April bahawa beliau “sedang dalam proses membatalkan” pengharaman tiga buku, tetapi hanya selepas kerosakan kepada imej reformis Malaysia sudah berlaku.

item.title: [BM] Kementerian Saifuddin Nasution Haramkan Buku Tentang Wanita Anti-Penjajah Malaysia, Kemudian U-Turn Selepas Kecaman — Kerajaan Reformasi Tak Reti Nak Sensor Pun
item.description:

Category: Politics

KDN mengisytiharkan kedua-dua buku ini mengancam keselamatan negara kerana mengandungi “unsur dan ideologi komunis.” Penerbit bebas Gerakbudaya menerima notis larangan itu, dan KDN turut menyiasat penerbit SIRD. Selepas kecaman hebat daripada masyarakat sivil, akademik, ahli parlimen, dan sekutu PH sendiri, Saifuddin mengumumkan sekitar 23 April bahawa kerajaan akan membatalkan larangan dan memperkenalkan proses semakan baharu yang memerlukan perundingan dengan penerbit sebelum sebarang larangan masa depan.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Kata 'Tiada Isu' Beri Bestinet Kontrak Pekerja Asing Lagi — Ahli Parlimen PKR Sendiri Tuntut Siasatan
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 16 April, Menteri Sumber Manusia R. Ramanan memberitahu The Star bahawa kementeriannya nampak “tiada isu” dengan Bestinet Sdn Bhd — syarikat yang diasaskan oleh jutawan Aminul Islam — membangunkan sistem pengrekrutan pekerja asing baharu yang dipanggil TURAP (The Universal Recruitment Advanced Platform). Ini berlaku beberapa minggu selepas Bloomberg menerbitkan siasatan terhadap rasuah berleluasa dalam pengrekrutan pekerja asing Malaysia dari Bangladesh, menamakan Bestinet dan Aminul. Ramanan pada mulanya menolak laporan Bloomberg sebagai “tidak disahkan dan tidak tepat,” tetapi kemudian memberitahu The Star kementeriannya terbuka kepada sistem itu. Menjelang 20 April, sembilan ahli parlimen kerusi belakang PKR — termasuk Wong Chen (Subang), Nik Nazmi (Setiawangsa), dan Lee Chean Chung (Petaling Jaya) — mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama menuntut siasatan terhadap kementerian Ramanan atas kaitan Bestinet.

item.description:

item.title: Home Ministry Bans Books for 'Communist Ideologies' Under Reformist PH — More Books Banned Under Anwar Than Any Recent Government
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 What Happened

On April 16, Malaysia’s Home Affairs Ministry banned two books under the Printing Presses and Publications Act for allegedly containing “communist elements and ideologies.” One of the banned titles is linked to the memoirs of Shamsiah Fakeh, a prominent figure in Malaysia’s Malay Left history. The ban drew swift criticism from civil society, publishers, and opposition figures. A week later, on April 24, the ministry announced it would adopt a “more consultative approach” and engage publishers before issuing future bans — a clear sign of damage control after the backlash.

item.title: Home Ministry Bans Books on Malaysia's Communist History as 'Dangerous' — Then Reverses Course After Its Own Coalition Screams
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Affairs Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 What Happened

On April 15, 2026, Malaysia’s Home Affairs Ministry issued a prohibition order against two books published by independent publisher Gerakbudaya: Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari Awas ke Rejimen ke-10 — a memoir of Shamsiah Fakeh, a Malay feminist and anti-colonial fighter who joined the Communist Party of Malaya — and Komrad Asi (Rejimen 10): Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah. A third book, a Malay-language translation of an academic study on Mao Zedong funded by the PKR-led Selangor state government, was also banned. The ministry claimed the books contained “communist ideologies” that could “undermine public harmony and order.” Days later, after swift backlash from civil society groups including PEN Malaysia and Article 19, PH’s own coalition members, and Shamsiah Fakeh’s granddaughter Jamaliah Jamaluddin — a Selangor state exco member under PKR — Home Affairs Minister Saifuddin Nasution Ismail announced the bans were being revoked.

Publisher Gerakbudaya received the prohibition notice under the colonial-era Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984. Civil society groups, academics, and even PH lawmakers condemned the move. One week later, on April 23, Home Minister Saifuddin announced the government would reverse the ban after widespread backlash.

item.title: Ramanan Says 'No Issue' Giving Bestinet Another Migrant Worker Contract — His Own PKR MPs Demand an Investigation
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-16

📌 What Happened

On April 16, Human Resources Minister R. Ramanan told The Star that his ministry sees “no issue” with Bestinet Sdn Bhd — the company founded by tycoon Aminul Islam — developing a new foreign worker recruitment system called TURAP (The Universal Recruitment Advanced Platform). This came weeks after Bloomberg published an investigation into endemic corruption in Malaysia’s migrant worker recruitment from Bangladesh, naming both Bestinet and Aminul. Ramanan initially rejected the Bloomberg report as “unverified and inaccurate,” but then told The Star his ministry was open to the system. By April 20, nine PKR backbenchers — including Wong Chen (Subang), Nik Nazmi (Setiawangsa), and Lee Chean Chung (Petaling Jaya) — issued a joint statement demanding an investigation into Ramanan’s ministry over the Bestinet connection.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Arah 441 Hantaran 'Berita Palsu' Dipadam Dan Rakyat Didakwa Kerana Bincang Harga Bahan Api — Reformasi Sudah Menjadi Represi

Pada 15 April 2026, Kementerian Dalam Negeri Malaysia — diketuai Saifuddin Nasution Ismail dari PKR — mengeluarkan perintah larangan terhadap dua buku terbitan penerbit bebas Gerakbudaya: Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari Awas ke Rejimen ke-10 dan Komrad Asi (Rejimen 10): Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah. Kedua-dua buku menceritakan perjuangan Parti Komunis Malaya menentang penjajahan British. Sebuah lagi buku — terjemahan Melayu kajian akademik mengenai Mao Zedong, dibiayai kerajaan negeri Selangor pimpinan PKR — turut diharamkan. KDN mendakwa buku-buku tersebut mengandungi “ideologi komunis” dan menggunakan Akta Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan 1984 sebagai asas. Selepas bantahan serta-merta daripada kumpulan masyarakat sivil, ahli gabungan PH sendiri, penerbit, dan organisasi kebebasan akhbar antarabangsa termasuk ARTICLE 19, Saifuddin mengumumkan pada 23 April bahawa kementerian sedang memproses pembatalan ketiga-tiga larangan tersebut.

item.title: Fahmi Orders 441 'Fake News' Posts Removed and Citizens Charged for Discussing Fuel Prices — Reformasi Has Become Represi
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-15

📌 What Happened

Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced on April 15, 2026, that the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC) had flagged 441 posts about the global energy crisis for removal from social media, opened 54 investigation papers against citizens, submitted 12 cases to the Attorney General’s Chambers, charged one person in the Sepang Sessions Court, and compounded five others at RM25,000 each — all under Section 233 of the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998 for posting about fuel price increases, diesel costs, electricity tariffs, and energy policy during Malaysia’s worst energy crisis in years, with oil hitting US$115 per barrel.

item.title: Saifuddin Nasution Bans Books on Anti-Colonial History Using Authoritarian Law PH Promised to Repeal — Then U-Turns in a Week
item.description:
Said by: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Home Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-15

📌 What Happened

On April 15, 2026, Malaysia’s Home Ministry — led by PKR’s Saifuddin Nasution Ismail — issued a prohibition order banning two books published by independent bookstore Gerakbudaya: Memoir Shamsiah Fakeh: Dari Awas ke Rejimen ke-10 and Komrad Asi (Rejimen 10): Dalam Denyut Nihilisme Sejarah. Both recount the struggles of the Malayan Communist Party against British colonialism. A third book — a Malay translation of an academic study on Mao Zedong, funded by the PKR-led Selangor state government — was also banned. The Home Ministry cited “communist ideologies” as the basis, invoking the Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984. After immediate backlash from civil society groups, PH’s own coalition members, publishers, and international press freedom organisations including ARTICLE 19, Saifuddin announced on April 23 that the ministry was in the process of revoking all three bans.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Fokus Ekonomi' Apabila Ditanya Soal Pecat Rafizi — Reformis Yang Enggan Reformasi Parti Sendiri

Menteri Sumber Manusia Ramanan sudah menggelar Rafizi “menteri gagal” dengan “agenda tidak sihat untuk memecahbelahkan parti.”

item.title: Anwar Says 'Focus on Economy' When Asked About Sacking Rafizi — The Reformist Who Won't Reform His Own Party
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / PKR President

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-04-10

📌 What Happened

On April 10, PKR president and Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim was asked by reporters whether the party should sack former deputy president Rafizi Ramli, who had just received a second show-cause letter from PKR’s disciplinary board and publicly challenged the party to expel him. Anwar brushed aside the question, saying: “Nevermind, I just think everyone should calm down as focusing on the economic problem is more important than on a personal problem.” This came after months of Rafizi openly accusing Anwar of surrounding himself with “yes-men,” protecting vested interests, defending MACC chief Azam Baki, and failing to deliver on reforms. Human Resources Minister Ramanan had already called Rafizi a “failed minister” with an “unhealthy agenda to divide the party.”

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Keputusan WFH Penjawat Awam Ditangguh Sampai Lepas Hari Raya — Krisis Sekarang, Tapi Rancangan Boleh Tunggu (Sumber Tunggal)

Beliau menekankan perkhidmatan barisan hadapan seperti penjagaan kesihatan dan pendidikan tidak akan terjejas, dan menyatakan sektor swasta bebas melaksanakan dasar WFH sendiri.

Ia sudah tiada lagi, ia terbatal,” katanya. Beberapa jam kemudian, kementeriannya sendiri mengeluarkan pembetulan menyatakan menteri telah “tersilap cakap,” tanpa penjelasan lanjut. Menjelang Isnin, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memberitahu wartawan selepas Kabinet bahawa MITI akan “terus berunding” dengan Washington, sementara lapan AP PKR mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama menuntut kerajaan menjelaskan status perjanjian dan memberi amaran perjanjian itu “berat sebelah.”

item.title: Fahmi Delays WFH Decision for Civil Servants Until After Hari Raya — The Government That Told You to 'Reduce Energy Usage' Can't Even Decide on Working From Home
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced after a post-Cabinet meeting that the government’s decision on implementing work-from-home for civil servants would be delayed until after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. This came just four days after FMT reported on March 13 that the decision was supposed to be made on Tuesday, March 17. Fahmi said “several aspects still need to be refined” and the matter would go to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) via the Chief Secretary to the Government. He stressed frontline services like healthcare and education would not be affected.

item.title: Fahmi Kicks WFH Decision to After Hari Raya — Government's Oil Crisis Response Is to Study, Review, Then Delay
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after a Cabinet meeting that a final decision on implementing work-from-home (WFH) arrangements for the public sector will only come after the Hari Raya Aidilfitri holidays. Fahmi said ministers had reviewed an ‘initial report’ on flexible working arrangements but that ‘several aspects still need to be refined.’ The matter will be referred to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) via the Chief Secretary to the Government for a post-Raya decision. This WFH proposal was first floated as an austerity measure in response to the oil crisis triggered by the US-Iran conflict in West Asia, after PM Anwar directed the Chief Secretary and PSD director-general to study it.

item.title: Fahmi Says WFH Decision for Civil Servants Delayed Until After Hari Raya — The Crisis Is Now, But the Plan Can Wait
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil confirmed that the Cabinet has reviewed an initial report on work-from-home arrangements for public sector employees but will not make a final decision until after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Speaking after a post-Cabinet meeting in Putrajaya, Fahmi said the matter would be referred to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) by the Chief Secretary to the Government, citing the need for “proper coordination” and “refinement” before implementation. He stressed frontline services like healthcare and education would not be affected, and noted the private sector is free to implement its own WFH policies.

item.title: High Court Rules Steven Sim Was 'Clearly Biased' in Bank Festive Aid Dispute — The 'Workers' Champion' Sided With the Banks
item.description:
Said by: Steven Sim Chee Keong, Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development Minister (former HR Minister)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, 2026, the Kuala Lumpur High Court ruled that former Human Resources Minister Steven Sim Chee Keong failed to maintain neutrality when he intervened in a trade dispute between the Malayan Commercial Banks’ Association (MCBA) and the National Union of Bank Employees (NUBE) over 2024 Hari Raya festive aid payments. Justice Aliza Sulaiman found that Sim had met with MCBA representatives while the matter was undergoing conciliation at the Industrial Relations Department — after which the banks agreed to pay only a half-month bonus instead of the one-month payment the union had demanded. The judge said Sim had ‘improperly aligned his office with the association’ and ‘subverted the statutory process designed for impartial resolution.’ Sim, now Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development Minister, and the MCBA have filed an appeal.

item.title: Johari Says Trade Deal 'Null and Void' — Then His Own Ministry Says He 'Misspoke,' and PH's Own MPs Demand Answers

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

On Sunday March 16, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani told reporters the Malaysia-US Agreement on Reciprocal Trade was “null and void” following the US Supreme Court’s decision striking down Trump’s tariff powers — “It is not on hold. It is no longer there, it’s null and void,” he said. Hours later, his own ministry issued a correction stating the minister had “misspoken,” without further explanation. By Monday, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after Cabinet that MITI would “continue engaging” Washington, while eight PKR backbenchers issued a joint statement demanding the government clarify the deal’s status and warning the agreement was “one-sided.”

item.title: [BM] Amir Hamzah Tolak Pakej Rangsangan Ekonomi Ketika Krisis Minyak — Rancangan Kerajaan? Tunggu Dan Lihat Jika Ia Selesai Sendiri

item.title: [BM] Anwar Gelar Tindakan AS-Israel 'Neo-Imperialis' dan Kata Iran Tidak Boleh Diminta 'Menahan Diri Begitu Sahaja' — Sementara Malaysia Rugi RM2 Bilion Sebulan
item.description:

Beliau menggambarkan serangan AS-Israel ke atas Iran sebagai “paparan keangkuhan semata-mata” dan “reka bentuk neo-imperialis,” dan berkata: “Sukar untuk meminta mereka menahan diri begitu sahaja.” Beliau mengesahkan konflik itu menelan belanja Malaysia “subsidi tambahan RM2 bilion sebulan” untuk mengekalkan harga RON95. Beliau juga memberi amaran terhadap “unsur-unsur tidak bertanggungjawab yang mengeksploitasi kes itu dan menggunakannya sebagai senjata politik, mempersenjatainya untuk menyerang.”

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Madani Guna Seksyen 124B Terhadap 14 Aktivis Dan Ahli Akademik — Gabungan Yang Janji Reformasi Kini Ayun Senjata Kegemaran BN

Pada 16 Mac, gabungan pertubuhan masyarakat sivil mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama mengecam kerajaan Madani, bertanya: “Adakah kita mahu kembali ke zaman kerajaan tidak boleh dikritik?” Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil, jurucakap kerajaan, menetapkan nada pada 27 Februari apabila beliau menyifatkan dakwaan komplot itu sebagai “perkara yang sangat serius” dan berkata kerajaan akan “serahkan kepada polis.” Kerajaan tidak membuat sebarang kenyataan awam untuk mengecilkan skop siasatan atau menangani kebimbangan tentang kebebasan sivil sejak siasatan diperluaskan kepada tokoh masyarakat sivil.

item.title: Amir Hamzah Rules Out Stimulus Amid Oil Crisis — Tells Rakyat to 'Reduce Energy Usage' Instead
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah Azizan told reporters on March 16 that no economic stimulus package will be introduced in response to the West Asia conflict. Speaking after the Malaysia Co-Investment Fund (MyCIF) Engagement Day, he said the government’s approach is to “ensure stability over the short term” and urged citizens and companies to “reduce energy usage.” He added that the government bears RM3.2 billion a month in fuel subsidies — up from RM700 million before the crisis.

item.title: Amir Hamzah Rules Out Stimulus Package Amid Oil Crisis — Government's Plan Is to 'Wait and See'
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

On March 16, Finance Minister II Datuk Seri Amir Hamzah Azizan told reporters after launching the Malaysia Co-Investment Fund engagement day in Kuala Lumpur that the government will not introduce an economic stimulus package despite the escalating West Asia conflict. His reasoning: “We do not yet know whether the crisis in West Asia will continue or not. If it does not continue, I think there is no need to implement something like that.” His stated approach: “Look at the short term and ensure the stability that we have.” He confirmed the government is now spending RM3.2 billion a month on fuel subsidies — RM2 billion on petrol and RM1.2 billion on diesel — and encouraged the public and businesses to “reduce energy use.”

item.title: Anwar Calls US-Israel Actions 'Neo-Imperialistic' and Says Iran Can't Be Asked to 'Simply Contain Themselves' — While Malaysia Bleeds RM2 Billion a Month
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

At the launch of the Mushaf Malaysia MADANI in Putrajaya on March 16, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim disclosed that he had held a second round of discussions with leaders from Iran, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, the UAE, and Türkiye about the West Asia conflict. He described the US-Israeli strikes on Iran as a “sheer display of arrogance” and “neo-imperialistic design,” and said: “It is difficult to ask them simply to contain themselves.” He confirmed the conflict is costing Malaysia an “additional subsidy of RM2 billion a month” to maintain RON95 prices. He also warned against “irresponsible elements exploiting the case and using it as a political weapon, weaponising it to attack.”

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Says KL's RM33m Road Budget 'Not Enough' — After Three Years as Minister, She Just Noticed

The remarks were made during a site visit to inspect road resurfacing works at a public housing project in Pudu.

Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

The Royal Malaysia Police have summoned 14 activists, academics, and political researchers for questioning under Section 124B of the Penal Code — a provision carrying up to 20 years in prison — as part of an investigation into an alleged plot to “topple the government and sabotage national stability.” Among those questioned was C4 Centre CEO Pushpan Murugiah, grilled for 90 minutes on March 10. On March 16, a coalition of civil society groups issued a joint statement condemning the Madani government, asking: “Do we want to return to a time when the government cannot be criticised?” Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil, the government’s spokesperson, set the tone on February 27 when he called the alleged plot “a very serious matter” and said the government would “leave it to the police.” The government has made no public statement to narrow the scope of the investigation or address concerns about civil liberties since the probe widened to include civil society figures.

item.title: [BM] Akmal Kata Malaysia Mesti 'Percepatkan' Peralihan Tenaga — Tiga Tahun Berkuasa, Dan Perang Terpaksa Beritahu Mereka

Beliau membuat kenyataan ini selepas menghadiri program “Jualan Rahmah Kasih Sayang,” menjawab cadangan akademik bahawa Malaysia perlu mengurangkan kebergantungan bahan api fosil berikutan konflik Asia Barat yang telah menolak minyak melepasi $100 setong dan menutup Selat Hormuz. Akmal menyatakan Malaysia kini mempunyai kira-kira 25% kapasiti terpasang dari sumber boleh diperbaharui dan berkata kerajaan “secara berterusan menilai langkah-langkah” untuk mempercepatkan proses.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 40% Hasil Sabah 'Kes Ditutup, Noktah' — Sambil Memfailkan Permohonan Mahkamah Untuk Membuka Semula Bahagian Penghakiman

item.title: [BM] Anwar Umum Cuti Raya Tambahan Di Tengah Krisis Minyak — Kerana Tiada Apa Yang Lebih Melambangkan 'Penjimatan' Selain Hari Cuti Tambahan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan cuti umum tambahan untuk Hari Raya Aidilfitri pada 15 Mac 2026, bercakap di sambutan Hari Pengguna Kebangsaan di Suria Sabah, Kota Kinabalu. Hari cuti tambahan itu akan jatuh pada sama ada Jumaat 20 Mac atau Isnin 23 Mac, bergantung pada penyaksian anak bulan Syawal. Anwar membingkaikannya sebagai ganjaran atas “usaha dan dedikasi” rakyat semasa Ramadan, berkata pengumuman awal akan membantu rakyat Malaysia merancang perjalanan mereka. Pengumuman itu dibuat bersama Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri Armizan Mohd Ali, yang serentak melancarkan skim kawalan harga perayaan 15 hari meliputi 22–24 barangan keperluan.

item.title: [BM] Guan Eng Dakwa 'Durian Runtuh' RM1.6 Bilion Dari Bon Samurai 2019 — Keuntungan Itu Nasib Forex, Bukan Kepakaran Dasar
item.description:
Said by: Lim Guan Eng, DAP Chairman and MP for Bagan

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Lim Guan Eng, Pengerusi DAP dan bekas Menteri Kewangan, mengumumkan pada 15 Mac bahawa Malaysia bakal meraih keuntungan RM1.6 bilion daripada bon samurai bernilai 200 bilion yen yang diterbitkannya pada Mac 2019. Merujuk jawapan parlimen daripada Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan Anwar Ibrahim bertarikh 2 Mac, Guan Eng berkata susut nilai yen sebanyak 27.8% berbanding ringgit — daripada RM3.62 setiap 100 yen semasa terbitan kepada RM2.59 menjelang Disember 2025 — telah mengurangkan nilai pokok bon daripada RM7.2 bilion kepada RM5.2 bilion. Selepas menolak anggaran RM400 juta kos faedah, keuntungan bersih pertukaran asing adalah kira-kira RM1.6 bilion. Bon ini matang pada 2029.

item.title: [BM] Johari Isytihar Perjanjian Dagang AS-Malaysia 'Batal dan Tidak Sah' — Selepas PH Tandatangan Perjanjian Berat Sebelah Dan Diselamatkan Mahkamah
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 Mac 2026, Menteri Pelaburan, Perdagangan dan Industri Johari Abdul Ghani mengesahkan bahawa Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik (ART) antara Malaysia dan Amerika Syarikat kini ‘batal dan tidak sah.’ Perjanjian itu, ditandatangani oleh Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim dan Presiden Donald Trump di Kuala Lumpur pada Oktober 2025, menjadi tidak terpakai selepas Mahkamah Agung AS membatalkan kuasa tarif luas Trump di bawah IEEPA pada 20 Februari 2026. Johari beritahu wartawan bahawa AS ’tidak boleh kenakan tarif secara menyeluruh’ dan berkata Washington kini beralih kepada mekanisme penguatkuasaan perdagangan Seksyen 122 dan Seksyen 301 — termasuk siasatan terhadap 60 negara, Malaysia antara mereka, mengenai buruh paksa dan lebihan kapasiti perindustrian.

item.title: [BM] Johari Isytihar Perjanjian Dagang AS-Malaysia 'Terbatal' — Mahkamah Agung AS Yang Bertindak, Bukan Dia

Johari beritahu wartawan: “Ia bukan ditangguhkan. Ia sudah terbatal.” AS kini kenakan tarif seragam 10% kepada semua rakan dagang dan lancarkan siasatan Seksyen 301 terhadap 60 negara termasuk Malaysia, berhubung buruh paksa dan lebihan kapasiti pengeluaran.

item.title: [BM] Johari Sahkan Perjanjian Dagang AS-Malaysia Batal — 'Kejayaan Diplomatik' PH Bertahan Lima Bulan Sahaja
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Menteri Pelaburan, Perdagangan dan Perindustrian

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 Mac 2026, Menteri Pelaburan, Perdagangan dan Perindustrian Johari Abdul Ghani mengesahkan bahawa Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik Malaysia-AS (ART), yang ditandatangani oleh Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim dan Presiden AS Donald Trump pada Oktober 2025, telah dibatalkan. “Ia bukan ditangguhkan. Ia batal dan tidak sah,” kata Johari kepada wartawan. Mahkamah Agung AS memutuskan tarif menyeluruh Trump sebagai tidak sah, meruntuhkan rangka kerja tarif yang menjadi asas ART. Perjanjian itu telah mengikat Malaysia untuk menyediakan “akses pasaran keutamaan yang signifikan” bagi produk AS merangkumi bahan kimia, jentera, kenderaan, tenusu, ayam, daging babi, beras, dan etanol bahan api. Sebagai balasan, AS mengekalkan tarif timbal balik 19% ke atas barangan Malaysia, dengan kadar sifar hanya untuk produk terpilih. Johari berkata AS kini bergantung kepada Seksyen 122 Akta Perdagangan 1974, membenarkan tarif sementara sehingga 10%. Empat AP PKR sebelum ini sudah gesa Putrajaya tangguhkan semua langkah ratifikasi selepas keputusan mahkamah. Sementara itu, AS melancarkan siasatan Seksyen 301 terhadap 60 negara termasuk Malaysia atas lebihan kapasiti pengeluaran dan buruh paksa.

Ia terbatal dan tidak sah,” kata Johari kepada wartawan. Mahkamah Agung AS memutuskan tarif menyeluruh Trump adalah menyalahi undang-undang, meruntuhkan rangka kerja tarif yang menjadi asas ART. Sebagai pertukaran, AS mengekalkan tarif timbal balik 19% ke atas barangan Malaysia, dengan kadar sifar hanya untuk produk terpilih. Johari berkata AS kini bergantung kepada Seksyen 122 Akta Perdagangan 1974, membenarkan tarif sementara sehingga 10%. Empat ahli parlimen PKR sebelum ini menggesa Putrajaya menangguhkan semua langkah ratifikasi selepas keputusan mahkamah. Sementara itu, AS telah melancarkan siasatan Seksyen 301 ke atas 60 negara, termasuk Malaysia, atas lebihan kapasiti pengeluaran dan buruh paksa.

item.title: Akmal Says Malaysia Must 'Accelerate' Energy Transition — Three Years Into Power, and a War Had to Tell Them
item.description:
Said by: Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, Economy Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir told reporters in Johor Bahru on March 15, 2026, that Malaysia needs to “accelerate” the implementation of the National Energy Transition Roadmap (NETR), particularly the development of solar and hydropower, to reduce reliance on fossil fuels. He made the remarks after attending a “Jualan Rahmah Kasih Sayang” programme, responding to suggestions by academics that Malaysia should cut its fossil fuel dependence following the West Asia conflict that has pushed oil past $100 per barrel and effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz. Akmal noted that Malaysia currently has about 25% installed capacity from renewable sources and said the government is “continuously assessing measures” to accelerate the process.

item.title: Anwar Announces Extra Raya Holiday Amid Oil Crisis — Because Nothing Says 'Austerity' Like Another Day Off
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced an additional public holiday for Hari Raya Aidilfitri on March 15, 2026, speaking at the National Consumer Day celebration at Suria Sabah in Kota Kinabalu. The extra day off will fall on either Friday March 20 or Monday March 23, depending on the moon sighting for Syawal. Anwar framed it as a reward for the people’s “efforts and dedication” during Ramadan, saying the early announcement would help Malaysians plan their travel. The announcement was made alongside Domestic Trade Minister Armizan Mohd Ali, who simultaneously launched a 15-day festive price control scheme covering 22–24 essential goods.

item.title: Anwar Says Malaysia 'Cannot Get Involved' Militarily in Middle East — Nobody Asked, But Thanks for Clarifying
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At the National Consumer Day 2026 event in Kota Kinabalu on March 15, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim declared that Malaysia “cannot get involved in what is happening in the Middle East, especially through military intervention.” He said Malaysia, as a “free country,” can voice its objections to war and violence, and stated: “We object to the attacks by Israel and the United States on Iran.” He acknowledged that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz would have “serious” implications that are “likely to worsen” and that “the cost of living would definitely rise.”

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue 'Case Closed, Period' — While Filing a Court Application to Reopen Parts of the Judgment
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on March 15, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim declared that Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 is “final, case closed” and that there will be “no appeal, no negotiations, period.” In the same speech, he explained that the federal government is going to court — not to appeal the 40 per cent, he insists, but to “seek clarification” on parts of the High Court judgment that he says unfairly questioned the roles of past leaders including Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, and Sabah stalwarts like Tun Fuad Stephens and Tan Sri Harris Salleh. A stay of execution application is scheduled for hearing at the Court of Appeal on March 31. The Sabah government has indicated it will oppose the stay.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue 'Case Closed' — While Simultaneously Filing a Court Application Over the Same Judgment

A stay of execution application is scheduled for the Court of Appeal on March 31. The High Court’s 180-day compliance deadline expires April 15.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue Is 'Case Closed' — While His Government Files to Court and Seeks a Stay of Execution
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on March 15, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told the audience — including Sabah Chief Minister Hajiji Noor — that the federal government’s position on Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under MA63 is ‘final’ and ‘case closed.’ In the same breath, he confirmed Putrajaya is going to court — not to appeal the 40 per cent, he insists, but to ‘seek clarification’ on parts of the High Court judgment that he claims unfairly questioned the legacies of Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, Tun Mustapha, Tun Fuad Stephens, and others. A stay of execution application is scheduled to be heard at the Court of Appeal on March 31, and the Sabah government has indicated it will oppose it.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue Is 'Case Closed' — While His Government Heads to Court to Challenge the Judgment
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On March 15, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah in Kota Kinabalu that the federal government’s commitment to Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 is ‘final’ and ’not subject to appeal.’ He declared: ‘No negotiations. We are committed to honour our commitment of 40 per cent to the people of Sabah. Period.’ He repeated the line at a separate event, calling it ‘case closed.’ Yet in the same breath, he confirmed the government is going to court — not to challenge the 40 per cent, he insists, but to ‘seek clarification’ on parts of the October 2025 High Court judgment that he says unfairly questioned the legacies of past national and state leaders. A stay of execution hearing is set for March 31. The Sabah government has said it will oppose the stay.

item.title: Anwar Tells Sabah '40 Per Cent, No Negotiations, Period' — While the Rest of Malaysia Is Told to Tighten Belts and Grow Vegetables
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, speaking at the Madani 2026 Iftar Ceremony at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on March 15, declared that the federal government’s commitment to Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 (MA63) is ‘final’ and not subject to appeal. “No negotiations. We are committed to honour our commitment of 40 per cent of the state’s revenue to the people of Sabah. Period,” Anwar said. He added that while detailed discussions are needed on implementation, the policy decision is firm and has been declared in both Cabinet and Parliament.

item.title: Guan Eng Claims RM1.6 Billion 'Windfall' From 2019 Samurai Bond — The Profit Is Forex Luck, Not Policy Genius
item.description:
Said by: Lim Guan Eng, DAP Chairman and MP for Bagan

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Lim Guan Eng, DAP chairman and former Finance Minister, announced on March 15 that Malaysia stands to record a RM1.6 billion profit from the 200 billion yen samurai bond he issued in March 2019. Citing a parliamentary reply from Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim dated March 2, Guan Eng said the yen’s 27.8% depreciation against the ringgit — from RM3.62 per 100 yen at issuance to RM2.59 by December 2025 — has reduced the bond’s principal value from RM7.2 billion to RM5.2 billion. After deducting an estimated RM400 million in interest costs, the net foreign exchange gain is approximately RM1.6 billion. The bond matures in 2029.

item.title: Johari Confirms Malaysia-US Trade Deal 'Null and Void' — PH Spent Political Capital Defending a Deal That No Longer Exists
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani confirmed on March 15 that the Malaysia-US Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) is “null and void.” The deal, signed by Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and President Donald Trump on October 26, 2025, was rendered inapplicable after the US Supreme Court in February 2026 struck down Trump’s broad tariff measures as unconstitutional. “It is not on hold. It is no longer there, it’s null and void,” Johari told reporters. The US is now pivoting to Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974, imposing a temporary 10% tariff, with Section 301 investigations launched into 60 countries — including Malaysia — covering excess capacity, forced labour, and environmental violations.

item.title: Johari Confirms Malaysia-US Trade Deal 'Null and Void' — PH's Biggest Diplomatic 'Win' Lasted Five Months
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On Saturday, March 15, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani confirmed that the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) between Malaysia and the United States has been nullified. The US Supreme Court struck down President Trump’s blanket tariff regime, rendering the deal — signed by Anwar Ibrahim and Trump in October 2025 during the ASEAN summit in Kuala Lumpur — null and void. ‘It is not on hold. It’s null and void,’ Johari told reporters after handing out Hari Raya aid to constituents. The US is now pivoting to Section 122 of its Trade Act 1974, which allows temporary 10% tariffs, and has launched Section 301 investigations into 60 countries including Malaysia for excess capacity and forced labour.

item.title: Johari Confirms US-Malaysia Trade Deal Is Dead — The Deal PH Celebrated Was Worse for Malaysia Than No Deal at All
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On March 15, 2026, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani confirmed that the Malaysia-US Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART), signed in October 2025, is now “null and void” following a US Supreme Court ruling that struck down President Trump’s sweeping reciprocal tariffs. Speaking at an Aidilfitri contribution event in Desa Pandan, Johari said that under the now-defunct deal, Malaysia had agreed to a 19% tariff rate, whereas the current global baseline tariff stands at just 10% under Section 122 of the US Trade Act of 1974. He noted the US will review within five months whether to impose a new tariff under Section 301.

item.title: Johari Confirms US-Malaysia Trade Deal Nullified — PH's 'Diplomatic Win' Lasted Five Months
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On March 15, 2026, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani confirmed that the Malaysia-US Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART), signed by Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and US President Donald Trump in October 2025, has been nullified. “It is not on hold. It’s null and void,” Johari told reporters. The US Supreme Court ruled that Trump’s blanket tariffs were unlawful, striking down the tariff framework the ART was built on. The deal had committed Malaysia to providing “significant preferential market access” for US products across chemicals, machinery, vehicles, dairy, poultry, pork, rice, and fuel ethanol. In exchange, the US maintained a 19% reciprocal tariff on Malaysian goods, with zero rates only for selected products. Johari said the US is now relying on Section 122 of its Trade Act of 1974, allowing temporary tariffs of up to 10%. Four PKR MPs had earlier urged Putrajaya to suspend all ratification steps following the court ruling. Meanwhile, the US has launched Section 301 investigations into 60 countries, including Malaysia, over excess production capacity and forced labour.

Johari told reporters the US ‘cannot impose tariffs on a blanket basis’ and said Washington is now shifting to Section 122 and Section 301 trade enforcement tools — including investigations into 60 countries, Malaysia among them, over forced labour and excess industrial capacity.

item.title: MOE Considers Reviving Home-Based Learning as Oil Crisis Response — Because Nothing Says 'Austerity' Like Sending Kids Back to Their Laptops
item.description:
Said by: Mohd Azam Ahmad, Education Director-General (under Education Minister Fadhlina Sidek)

Category: Education

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On March 15, Education Director-General Datuk Dr Mohd Azam Ahmad announced the Ministry of Education will hold a special meeting next week, chaired by Education Minister Fadhlina Sidek, to review the implementation of Work From Home and Home-Based Teaching and Learning (PdPR) mechanisms as part of the government’s austerity response to the global oil crisis. When asked whether the savings policy would extend to schools and students — effectively reviving the COVID-era PdPR system — Mohd Azam said “further study is required” and that the ministry would “examine whether there is a rationale to involve schools.”

item.title: Puah Admits PH Core Voters Are 'Swinging' — Three Years In, And They Still Need to 'Convince' People They're Reformists
item.description:
Said by: Jimmy Puah Wee Tse, PKR MP for Tebrau

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On March 15, 2026, PKR MP Jimmy Puah Wee Tse — the Tebrau MP and Johor PKR vice-chief — told FMT that Pakatan Harapan’s core voter base, particularly the M40 group and urban electorate, has been “swinging.” Puah said the coalition must convince these voters that it has “actually delivered” on reforms, or at least is “in the midst of delivering,” before it can negotiate coalition partnerships for GE16. Political scientist Wong Chin Huat of Sunway University echoed the warning, noting that PH’s core supporters are closely watching how Anwar has managed Malaysia’s racial and religious balance, and that “flip-flopping between appeasing Muslim nationalists and wooing minorities and liberals” could alienate them further.

item.title: Wong Kah Woh Says MOE Reviewing PdPR for Students Amid Oil Crisis — Three Years of Reform, and Kids Might Go Back to Zoom School
item.description:
Said by: Wong Kah Woh, Deputy Education Minister (DAP)

Category: Education

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Deputy Education Minister Wong Kah Woh told reporters at a breaking-of-fast event at Taiping Lake Gardens on March 15 that the Ministry of Education will conduct a “comprehensive review” of PdPR — Teaching and Learning from Home — for school students and ministry civil servants. Wong said the ministry would ensure “any decision taken will not adversely affect pupils and students.” This follows Education Director-General Mohd Azam Ahmad’s confirmation the day before that Education Minister Fadhlina Sidek will chair a special meeting next week to review WFH and PdPR mechanisms, pending the Cabinet’s final decision. The DG acknowledged that the MOE would “leverage its experience with WFH during the Covid-19 pandemic” to develop a strategy.

item.title: Zafrul Preaches 'Courageous Politics' in Op-Ed — From the Man Whose Government Shields MACC Chief and Failed Its Own Reforms
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister, published an opinion column in The Edge Malaysia’s March 16–22 edition titled Can Malaysian politics unite the country when the world is coming apart? In it, he called for ‘courageous politics’ — ’the courage to speak honestly to the rakyat,’ ’the courage to make tough but unpopular decisions,’ and ’the courage to reject divisive politics for short-term gain.’ He warned that ‘Malaysia cannot afford the luxury of self-indulgent partisanship’ and argued that social cohesion is ‘fundamental to economic strength.’

item.title: Zafrul Says Malaysia 'On Firm Footing' Amid Oil Crisis — While Telling Critics to Stop 'Misleading' the Public
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On Sunday, March 15, Tengku Datuk Seri Zafrul Abdul Aziz — Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister — told reporters at a Singgah Sahur event at Ampang Jaya district police headquarters that Malaysia’s economy remains ‘on firm footing’ despite the West Asia crisis. He said the government has taken ‘strong, proactive fiscal measures,’ pointed to RON95 staying at RM1.99 under Budi95, and then warned ‘certain parties’ not to ‘mislead the public or politicise these issues.’ He added: ‘Compared to other countries, we are in a stronger position to face these challenges.’

item.title: [BM] Armizan Kata Subsidi Diesel Malaysia Timur Boleh Berganda Kepada RM4.6 Bilion — Jawapan Kerajaan? Operasi Tangkap Penyeludup, Bukan Reformasi
item.description:
Said by: Armizan Mohd Ali, Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup Armizan Mohd Ali mendedahkan pada 14 Mac 2026 bahawa subsidi diesel kerajaan untuk Sabah dan Sarawak dijangka melonjak lebih dua kali ganda daripada RM2 bilion pada 2025 kepada RM4.6 bilion pada 2026, didorong oleh konflik Asia Barat yang menolak harga minyak mentah Brent melepasi AS$100 setong. Diesel di Malaysia Timur dijual pada RM2.15 seliter — kurang separuh daripada harga pasaran RM4.30 — manakala Semenanjung Malaysia membayar RM3.92. Jawapan Kabinet, diputuskan pada 11 Mac, adalah mengaktifkan Jawatankuasa Penyelarasan Antara Agensi Peringkat Tinggi Membanteras Ketirisan dan Penyeludupan, dipengerusikan oleh TPM Fadillah Yusof.

item.title: [BM] Johari Kata 'Tiada Pemotongan Subsidi Buat Masa Ini' — Tapi Akui Kerajaan Hanya Boleh 'Bertahan' Dua Hingga Tiga Bulan
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 14 Mac 2026, Menteri Pelaburan, Perdagangan dan Industri Datuk Seri Johari Abdul Ghani memberitahu wartawan bahawa kerajaan pada masa ini tidak merancang untuk memotong subsidi, tetapi mengakui ia hanya boleh ‘bertahan untuk dua atau tiga bulan seterusnya’ jika konflik Asia Barat terus menolak harga minyak melebihi AS$100 setong. Beliau berkata Kementerian Kewangan akan memberikan ‘kemas kini berkala’ dan mengakui perang telah mewujudkan ‘kebimbangan meluas di peringkat global,’ menjejaskan ekonomi ASEAN dan Eropah. Petikan utamanya: ‘Apabila ada ketidaktentuan dalam ekonomi, orang ramai cenderung menahan perbelanjaan kerana mereka tidak pasti tentang masa depan.’

item.title: [BM] Johari Kata MITI Akan 'Jelaskan' Dakwaan Buruh Paksa Kepada AS — Tiga Tahun Janji Reformasi, Malaysia Masih Perlu Beri Penjelasan
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 14 Mac, Menteri Pelaburan, Perdagangan dan Industri Datuk Seri Johari Abdul Ghani memberitahu pemberita bahawa MITI akan menjawab siasatan AS terhadap dakwaan lebihan kapasiti pengeluaran dan buruh paksa dalam eksport Malaysia. Pembelaan Johari: lebihan kapasiti pengeluaran “tidak bermakna Malaysia mengambil langkah lambakan produk yang dieksport ke AS.” Mengenai dakwaan buruh paksa — noda berterusan dalam sektor eksport Malaysia termasuk elektronik, minyak sawit dan sarung tangan getah — menteri hanya menawarkan untuk “menjelaskan” keadaan kepada Washington.

item.title: Anwar Calls Corruption 'Treason to the Nation' — While His Government Shields MACC Chief and Interrogates Anti-Corruption NGOs
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and PKR President

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 What Happened

On March 14, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim addressed PKR Sarawak members at a ‘mini convention’ in Kuching, where he backed Yang di-Pertuan Agong Sultan Ibrahim’s call to fight corruption, describing graft as ’treason to the nation.’ He urged party members to remain united and reaffirmed PKR’s commitment to reform, justice, and inclusive progress. The statement came as part of a two-day working visit to Sarawak that included meetings with state leaders and a Madani iftar event.

item.title: Armizan Says East Malaysia Diesel Subsidy Could Double to RM4.6 Billion — Government's Answer? Crack Down on Smuggling, Not Reform
item.description:
Said by: Armizan Mohd Ali, Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 What Happened

Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Minister Armizan Mohd Ali disclosed on March 14, 2026, that the government’s diesel subsidy for Sabah and Sarawak is projected to more than double from RM2 billion in 2025 to RM4.6 billion in 2026, driven by the West Asia conflict pushing Brent crude past US$100 per barrel. Diesel in East Malaysia is sold at RM2.15 per litre — less than half the market price of RM4.30 — while Peninsular Malaysia pays RM3.92. The Cabinet’s response, decided on March 11, was to activate a High-Level Inter-Agency Coordination Committee to Combat Leakage and Smuggling, chaired by DPM Fadillah Yusof.

item.title: DAP's Sangeet Kaur Calls Topple-Government Probe 'Vague' and 'Intimidating' — While Her Own Coalition Built the Narrative
item.description:
Said by: Sangeet Kaur Deo, DAP Women’s Wing Legal Bureau Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 What Happened

On March 14, 2026, DAP women’s wing legal bureau chief Sangeet Kaur Deo issued a statement criticising the police investigation into the alleged plot to overthrow the government. She called the probe based on ‘vague allegations’ and warned that ‘sweeping calls for interrogation inevitably create an atmosphere of intimidation and raise concerns about the potential misuse of investigative powers.’ She stressed that ‘state machinery must never be used to silence critics’ and said that if genuine crimes exist, authorities should identify them clearly and state the specific conduct said to constitute those offences. This comes after commentators and civil society figures were summoned for questioning in connection with the probe.

item.title: Johari Says 'No Subsidy Cuts For Now' — But Admits Government Can Only 'Hold Out' Two to Three Months
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 What Happened

On March 14, 2026, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Datuk Seri Johari Abdul Ghani told reporters that the government currently has no plans to cut subsidies, but admitted it can only ‘hold out for the next two or three months’ if the West Asia conflict continues to push oil prices above US$100 per barrel. He said the Ministry of Finance would provide ‘regular updates’ and acknowledged the war has created ‘widespread concern globally,’ affecting ASEAN economies and Europe. His money quote: ‘When there is uncertainty in the economy, people tend to hold back on spending because they are unsure about the future.’

item.title: Johari Says MITI Will 'Clarify' Forced Labour Allegations to US — Three Years of Reform Promises, and Malaysia Still Has to Explain Itself
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 What Happened

On March 14, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Datuk Seri Johari Abdul Ghani told reporters that MITI will respond to a US probe into allegations of excess production capacity and forced labour in Malaysian exports. Johari’s defence: excess production capacity “does not mean that Malaysia is dumping products exported to the US.” On the forced labour allegation — a persistent stain on Malaysia’s export sectors including electronics, palm oil, and rubber gloves — the minister offered to “clarify” the situation to Washington.

item.title: [BM] Amir Hamzah Kata Ekonomi 'Dijangka Kekal Kukuh' 2026 — Sementara Minyak Lepas $100, KLCI Jatuh, Dan Kabinet Umum Langkah Penjimatan

Beliau berkata demikian walaupun mengakui perang Asia Barat telah menaikkan harga minyak melepasi AS$100 setong, dan pada hari sama Kabinet mengumumkan langkah penjimatan termasuk mengharamkan rumah terbuka Raya dan menyekat perjalanan luar negara menteri. item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and PKR President

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 13 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim berucap kepada ahli PKR Sarawak di ‘konvensyen mini’ di Kuching dan mengakui PKR ’tidak sempurna’ dan reformasi tidak dilaksanakan ‘secepat yang kita inginkan.’ Beliau menyuruh ahli parti ‘rapatkan saf’ dan teruskan perjuangan reformasi, mengisytiharkan: ‘Ujian sebenar melaksanakan perubahan atau reformasi ialah apabila seseorang berada di kerusi kuasa, bukan selepas kalah atau ditarik turun.’ Ini diucapkan pada hari yang sama mesyuarat Kabinet khasnya menangguhkan keputusan WFH kepada satu lagi semakan, menggandakan tiga subsidi RON95 kepada RM2 bilion berbanding mereformasinya, dan Menteri Pertaniannya menyuruh rakyat Malaysia menanam sayur sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Khas Bermesyuarat Untuk Krisis Minyak — Keputusan WFH Anwar? Satu Lagi Kajian, Kembali Selasa
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada Jumaat, 13 Mac, kerajaan Malaysia mengadakan Mesyuarat Kabinet Khas yang dinanti-nantikan untuk menangani kesan ekonomi daripada krisis minyak Asia Barat, dengan minyak mentah Brent melepasi $100/tong dan Selat Hormuz terganggu. Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan selepas itu bahawa Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim telah mengarahkan Ketua Setiausaha Negara (KSN) dan Ketua Pengarah Perkhidmatan Awam (KPPA) untuk “mengkaji cadangan kerja dari rumah bagi memastikan beberapa aspek diselaraskan dengan baik.” Keputusan sama ada melaksanakan kerja dari rumah untuk penjawat awam akan dibuat pada Selasa, 17 Mac — empat hari kemudian, dan seminggu penuh selepas Thailand dan Vietnam mengarahkan kerja dari rumah untuk sektor awam mereka.

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Gandakan Tiga Kali Subsidi RON95 Kepada RM2 Bilion — Tiga Tahun 'Reformasi' Berakhir Dengan Selimut Lebih Besar
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada Jumaat, 13 Mac, Menteri Kewangan II Amir Hamzah Azizan mengumumkan kerajaan akan meningkatkan perbelanjaan subsidi petrol RON95 daripada RM700 juta kepada RM2 bilion — hampir tiga kali ganda peruntukan — untuk mengekalkan harga runcit tetap RM1.99 seliter di tengah-tengah harga minyak global yang melonjak melepasi $100/tong. Pengumuman itu dibuat selepas Mesyuarat Khas Kabinet yang diadakan untuk menangani kesan ekonomi konflik Asia Barat. Subsidi itu meliputi RON95, bahan api pengangkutan paling meluas digunakan di Malaysia, dimakan oleh majoriti besar pemandu.

item.title: [BM] Loke Akui DAP Gagal Dapat RCI Soal 'Mafia Korporat' SPRM — Parti Terbesar Dalam Kerajaan Tak Mampu Pertanggungjawabkan Kabinetnya Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Setiausaha agung DAP dan Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke mengakui dalam temu bual di program dalam talian The Keywords — diterbitkan sekitar 12-13 Mac 2026 — bahawa DAP tidak mampu memujuk kabinet untuk menubuhkan Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) terhadap dakwaan ‘mafia korporat’ dalam Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM). Loke berkata tindak balas kerajaan terhadap skandal itu ’tidak mencukupi’ dan jangkaan orang ramai tidak dipenuhi. Beliau menekankan bahawa siasatan telah ‘diperluaskan’ tetapi jauh daripada siasatan bebas sepenuhnya yang DAP desak sejak akhir Februari, apabila Bloomberg pertama kali melaporkan bahawa pegawai SPRM didakwa membantu rangkaian ahli perniagaan merampas kawalan syarikat melalui serbuan dan siasatan.

item.title: [BM] Loke Akui DAP Gagal Dapat RCI Untuk 'Mafia Korporat' SPRM — Parti Terbesar Dalam Kerajaan Tak Mampu Pegang Kabinet Sendiri Bertanggungjawab
item.description:
