Arahan itu datang berminggu-minggu selepas Bloomberg menerbitkan siasatan menghancurkan bertajuk Siapa Mengawasi Badan Pencegah Rasuah Malaysia? yang mendakwa pegawai SPRM telah menekan tokoh korporat dalam kes pengambilalihan. Ketara tiada dalam pengumuman Fahmi: sebarang sebutan mengenai Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI), meskipun desakan semakin membesar daripada ahli parlimen — termasuk Teresa Kok daripada PH sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Kabinet Mahu Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — PH Janji Mansuh Undang-Undang Sekat Kebebasan Bersuara, Kini Tulis Yang Baru
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah memutuskan tindakan tegas mesti diambil terhadap isu 3R — kaum, agama, dan raja — termasuk di media sosial. Fahmi berkata kerajaan sedang mempertimbangkan untuk meminda undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan perundangan baru untuk menutup apa yang disifatkannya sebagai kelemahan yang membenarkan individu tertentu mengabaikan langkah penguatkuasaan.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Umum Jawatankuasa Khas 'Kaji' Kesan Ekonomi Konflik AS-Iran — Buku Panduan Krisis Kerajaan Adalah Satu Lagi Jawatankuasa
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan pada 11 Mac bahawa sebuah jawatankuasa khas yang diketuai pengerusi Petronas Amir Hamzah dan termasuk Menteri Ekonomi Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, akan menilai kesan ekonomi konflik AS-Iran terhadap Malaysia ‘secara harian.’ Penemuan jawatankuasa ini akan dibentangkan pada mesyuarat Kabinet khas yang dijadualkan pada Jumaat, 13 Mac. Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim berkata bekalan petroleum Malaysia ‘mencukupi sekurang-kurangnya sehingga Mei 2026,’ walaupun pasaran minyak global bergolak akibat gangguan di Selat Hormuz dan serangan balas antara Iran, AS dan Israel yang bermula pada 28 Februari.

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Akhirnya Bincang Laporan Azam Baki — Serah Keputusan Kepada KSN, Enggan Dedahkan Penemuan
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / Cabinet

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah menerima dan membincangkan penemuan jawatankuasa khas — dipengerusikan oleh Peguam Negara Mohd Dusuki Mokhtar — yang menyiasat kontroversi pegangan saham ketua pesuruhjaya SPRM Azam Baki. Keputusan Kabinet: serahkan kepada Ketua Setiausaha Negara Tan Sri Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar untuk menentukan ’langkah seterusnya.’ Fahmi enggan mendedahkan kandungan laporan. Apabila ditanya secara langsung sama ada Kabinet membincangkan pelanjutan kontrak Azam, Fahmi berkata: ‘Ia tidak dibincangkan.’

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Kekal RON95 Pada RM1.99 — Anwar Kata 'Keputusan Sukar' Sambil Mengelak Reformasi Subsidi Tiga Tahun Berturut-turut
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan pada 11 Mac 2026 — selepas mesyuarat Kabinet — bahawa harga petrol RON95 di bawah mekanisme subsidi bersasar Budi95 akan kekal pada RM1.99 seliter. Beliau menyebutnya ‘keputusan sukar,’ menyatakan bahawa harga pasaran RON95 telah meningkat kira-kira tiga kali ganda akibat konflik AS-Iran yang semakin meningkat.

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Ini bukan kemurahan hati — ia keruntuhan reformasi. Kerajaan Anwar menjanjikan penstrukturan semula subsidi bahan api bersasar sebagai tunjang disiplin fiskal. Mekanisme Budi95, yang dilancarkan sebagai kompromi yang dicairkan, sepatutnya menjadi langkah pertama ke arah memansuhkan subsidi menyeluruh. Sebaliknya, krisis geopolitik memberi kerajaan alasan sempurna untuk menunda reformasi selama-lamanya sambil membelanjakan berbilion untuk subsidi bahan api tanpa sasaran menjelang pilihan raya kilat yang dijangka secara meluas.

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Lulus Terminal Ketiga Pelabuhan Klang Di Pulau Carey — Projek Mega 5,000 Ekar Penuh Cap Jari GLC
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke mengumumkan Kabinet telah meluluskan pembangunan Terminal Ketiga Pelabuhan Klang di Pulau Carey — projek mega yang terbengkalai bertahun-tahun. Projek ini melibatkan lebih 5,000 ekar tanah, dengan SD Guthrie (GLC di bawah PNB) dan Perbadanan Kemajuan Negeri Selangor (PKNS) sudah menuntut ribuan hektar tanah dan dasar laut. PKNS diperuntukkan 1,011 hektar tanah dasar laut dan 688 hektar plot Yayasan Selangor diletakkan di bawah pengurusan bersama PKNS. PM Anwar mengeluarkan arahan pada Disember 2025 untuk mempercepatkan projek ini.

item.title: [BM] KPDN Kelam-Kabut Soal Penyeludupan Minyak Lepas Harga Cecah $100 — Armizan Janji Penguatkuasaan Yang Sepatutnya Sudah Lama Ada
item.description:
Said by: Armizan Mohd Ali, Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10–11 Mac, Menteri KPDN Armizan Mohd Ali mengumumkan kementeriannya akan “memperkukuh penguatkuasaan” terhadap penyeludupan minyak dan mempergiatkan operasi Ops Tiris di sempadan negara, selepas harga minyak global melepasi AS$100 setong akibat konflik AS-Israel-Iran yang semakin memuncak. Armizan mengakui jurang yang melebar antara harga minyak bersubsidi Malaysia (RON95 pada RM1.99) dan harga pasaran di negara jiran mewujudkan “risiko tinggi” penyeludupan. Beliau memberitahu orang ramai tiada “keperluan untuk bimbang atau membeli panik” dan mendakwa pelan kontingensi sudah sedia. Secara berasingan, NST melaporkan Anwar melantik Timbalan Perdana Menteri Fadillah Yusof mengetuai jawatankuasa penguatkuasaan khas khusus menyasarkan penyeludupan diesel.

item.title: [BM] Minyak Lepas $100, Selat Hormuz Ditutup, Rakyat Bakar Minyak Pergi Kerja — Anwar Taknak WFH, Taknak Beku Tol, Taknak Kawal Harga Makanan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perang Iran-AS telah menolak harga minyak global melepasi $100 setong, menutup Selat Hormuz — laluan hampir 80% minyak Asia — dan menyebabkan FBM KLCI Malaysia menjunam 2.55% dalam satu sesi pada 9 Mac. RON97 naik ke RM3.25, diesel ke RM3.12, dan Anwar sendiri mengakui pada 7 Mac kerajaan hanya mampu mengekalkan RON95 pada RM1.99 untuk ‘satu atau dua bulan lagi.’ Kos pengangkutan melonjak, harga makanan akan menyusul, dan pakar memberi amaran tentang inflasi import yang akan menghentam meja makan rakyat. Tindak balas Anwar setakat ini: tweet solidariti, usul parlimen kecemasan mengutuk Israel, dan Zafrul berkata Malaysia ‘bersedia’ — tanpa menamakan satu pun langkah ekonomi domestik konkrit.

item.title: [BM] Mohamad Hasan Kata Agensi Pelancongan Mesti Bawa Pulang Jemaah Umrah Terperangkap — 'Tak Boleh Serah Kerajaan Sahaja'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Hasan, Foreign Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Luar Negeri Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan, bercakap pada sidang akhbar di Putrajaya pada 11 Mac, mengisytiharkan bahawa syarikat pelancongan dan agensi yang menguruskan pakej umrah mesti bertanggungjawab sepenuhnya membawa pulang jemaah yang terperangkap akibat konflik Asia Barat. Beliau berkata syarikat penerbangan juga mesti menghormati tiket mereka: ‘Jika tiket dengan Malaysia Airlines, MAS mesti bawa pulang. Jika tiket AirAsia, AirAsia mesti buat demikian.’ Beliau menambah tegas: ‘Ia tidak boleh diserahkan kepada kerajaan Malaysia sahaja.’ Ini pada hari yang sama penerbangan pemindahan pertama kerajaan — pesawat sewa Malaysia Airlines A330-300 — mendarat di KLIA dengan hanya 163 rakyat Malaysia dari Arab Saudi, Qatar, Jordan dan Syria.

item.title: [BM] Polis Soal Siasat Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif C4 Antirasuah Bawah Seksyen 124B — Kerajaan Anwar Guna Siasatan 'Komplot Guling' Untuk Gertak Masyarakat Sivil
item.description:
Said by: Bukit Aman (Royal Malaysia Police) / C4 Center (Pushpan Murugiah, CEO)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10 Mac 2026, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Pusat Membanteras Rasuah dan Kronisme (C4) Pushpan Murugiah dipanggil ke Bukit Aman dan disoal siasat selama kira-kira 90 minit di bawah Seksyen 124B Kanun Keseksaan — aktiviti yang memudaratkan demokrasi berparlimen. Soal siasat itu dikaitkan dengan siasatan polis terhadap dakwaan komplot menggulingkan kerajaan. Tetapi soal siasat melangkaui e-mel tersebut. Polis mempersoalkan sumber pembiayaan C4, sama ada organisasi itu menerima arahan untuk mengeluarkan kenyataan, dan — yang mengejutkan — mencabar hak C4 untuk mengulas hal ehwal tadbir urus negara. C4 mengesahkan beberapa pengulas politik dan ahli akademik lain turut dipanggil ke Bukit Aman di bawah siasatan yang sama.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Ugut 'Tindakan Tegas' Atas Kebebasan Bersuara, Kabinet Timbang Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — Gabungan Yang Janji Mansuhkan Akta Hasutan
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, Menteri Sumber Manusia Datuk Seri R. Ramanan mengeluarkan kenyataan memberi amaran bahawa kerajaan akan mengambil “tindakan tegas” terhadap sesiapa yang “sengaja mengancam keamanan negara,” terutamanya dalam perkara melibatkan agama, kaum, dan raja (3R). Beliau berkata kebebasan bersuara “tidak sepatutnya disalahgunakan untuk menghasut atau memecahbelahkan masyarakat.” Dua hari kemudian, pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengesahkan bahawa Kabinet telah memutuskan “tindakan tegas mesti diambil terhadap perkara berkaitan 3R” dan kerajaan sedang mempertimbangkan meminda undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan perundangan baharu yang lebih ketat untuk menangani isu 3R. Menjelang 15 Mac, Timbalan Menteri Komunikasi Aaron Ago Dagang berkata semua kementerian akan memainkan peranan dalam menangani perkara 3R.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Ugut 'Tindakan Tegas' Terhadap Kebebasan Bersuara, Kabinet Timbang Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — Gabungan Yang Janji Mansuh Akta Hasutan
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, Menteri Sumber Manusia Datuk Seri R. Ramanan mengeluarkan kenyataan memberi amaran bahawa kerajaan akan mengambil “tindakan tegas” terhadap sesiapa yang “sengaja mengancam keamanan negara,” khususnya berkaitan agama, kaum, dan raja (3R). Beliau kata kebebasan bersuara “tidak seharusnya disalahgunakan untuk menghasut atau memecahbelahkan masyarakat.” Dua hari kemudian, pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengesahkan Kabinet telah memutuskan “tindakan tegas perlu diambil terhadap isu 3R” dan kerajaan sedang aktif mempertimbangkan pindaan undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan undang-undang baharu yang lebih ketat. Menjelang 15 Mac, Timbalan Menteri Komunikasi Aaron Ago Dagang berkata semua kementerian akan memainkan peranan menangani isu 3R.

item.title: [BM] Sabah Tolak PH Di Peti Undi — Kini Mustapha Sakmud Kata Dia Suara Mereka Di Putrajaya
item.description:
Said by: Mustapha Sakmud, Sabah PH Chairman / Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Pengerusi PH Sabah dan Menteri Hal Ehwal Sabah dan Sarawak Mustapha Sakmud memberitahu FMT bahawa PH Sabah akan berperanan sebagai ‘saluran’ untuk memastikan isu negeri disuarakan di peringkat persekutuan. Beliau berkata beliau berhasrat memanfaatkan pelantikan menteri — dibuat pada 15 Februari — untuk membawa kebimbangan rakyat Sabah ke mesyuarat Kabinet.

item.title: Anwar Bans Raya Open Houses for 'Fiscal Discipline' — Days After Announcing RM15 Billion in Cash Handouts and RM500 Bonuses
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced that all government agencies, GLCs, and GLICs are banned from holding Aidilfitri open house celebrations this year — a decision agreed upon in Cabinet that morning. He framed it as a signal of fiscal discipline amid global uncertainty caused by the Middle East conflict. In the same breath, Anwar also announced tighter restrictions on overseas travel for ministers and government officials, saying only pre-scheduled and essential foreign engagements would be approved. A special Cabinet meeting has been called for March 13 to assess the fiscal situation.

item.title: Anwar Says Petroleum Supply 'Secure Until May' — While Strait of Hormuz Burns and Ships Get Attacked
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim held a live-streamed press conference in Putrajaya to address the escalating Middle East energy crisis. He claimed that Malaysia’s petroleum product supplies are “sufficient at least until May 2026,” citing checks with Petronas. He reaffirmed the RM1.99 subsidised RON95 price under Budi Madani, called it a “difficult decision,” and announced a special task force of ministers to review economic impacts daily. He also tasked the Deputy Prime Minister and KPDN with cracking down on fuel smuggling.

item.title: Cabinet Finally Discusses Azam Baki Report — Punts Decision to Chief Secretary, Refuses to Reveal Findings
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / Cabinet

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced that Cabinet had received and discussed the findings of the special committee — chaired by Attorney General Mohd Dusuki Mokhtar — investigating MACC chief commissioner Azam Baki’s shareholding controversy. Cabinet’s decision: hand the matter to Chief Secretary to the Government Tan Sri Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar to determine “next steps.” Fahmi refused to disclose the report’s contents. When asked directly whether Cabinet discussed the extension of Azam’s contract, Fahmi said: “It was not discussed.” Separately, Cabinet instructed the police, Securities Commission, MACC itself, and the Inland Revenue Board to continue investigating Bloomberg’s “corporate mafia” allegations — including seizing proceeds believed to have criminal elements.

item.title: Cabinet Greenlights Port Klang Third Terminal on Carey Island — A 5,000-Acre Megaproject With GLC Fingerprints All Over It
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Transport Minister Anthony Loke announced that Cabinet has approved the development of Port Klang’s Third Terminal on Carey Island — a megaproject that has been in limbo for years. The project involves over 5,000 acres of land, with SD Guthrie (a GLC under PNB) and the Selangor State Development Corporation (PKNS) already staking claims on thousands of hectares of land and seabed. PKNS was allocated 1,011 hectares of seabed land and a 688-hectare Yayasan Selangor plot was placed under joint PKNS management. PM Anwar issued a directive in December 2025 to accelerate the project, and now Cabinet has formally greenlit it.

item.title: Cabinet Maintains RON95 at RM1.99 — Anwar Calls It a 'Difficult Decision' While Dodging Subsidy Reform for the Third Year Running
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced on March 11, 2026 — following a Cabinet meeting — that the price of RON95 petrol under the Budi95 targeted subsidy mechanism will remain at RM1.99 per litre. He called it a “difficult decision,” noting that the market price of RON95 has risen roughly threefold due to the escalating US-Iran conflict disrupting oil markets and threatening Gulf shipping routes. RON97 had already risen to RM3.25, unsubsidised RON95 to RM2.67, and diesel to RM3.12. Anwar framed the decision as a sacrifice for the rakyat.

item.title: Fahmi Announces Special Committee to 'Assess' Economic Impact of US-Iran Conflict — Government's Crisis Playbook Is Another Committee
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced on March 11 that a special committee, led by Petronas chairman Amir Hamzah and including Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, will evaluate the economic impact of the US-Iran conflict on Malaysia ‘on a daily basis.’ The committee’s findings will be presented at a special Cabinet meeting scheduled for Friday, March 13. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Malaysia’s petroleum supply is ‘sufficient at least until May 2026,’ even as global oil markets reel from the Strait of Hormuz disruption and retaliatory strikes between Iran, the US, and Israel that began on February 28.

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Orders 'Corporate Mafia' Probe — But Lets MACC Investigate Itself and Ignores RCI Calls
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil announced that the Cabinet had ordered enforcement agencies — including the police (PDRM), Securities Commission (SC), Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC), and Inland Revenue Board (LHDN) — to carry out a “detailed probe” into allegations of a “corporate mafia” network operating within MACC. The order came weeks after Bloomberg published a damning investigation titled Who’s Watching Malaysia’s Anti-Corruption Watchdog? alleging that MACC officers had pressured corporate figures in takeover cases. Notably absent from Fahmi’s announcement: any mention of a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI), despite growing calls from MPs — including PH’s own Teresa Kok.

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Orders 'Thorough Probe' Into MACC Corporate Mafia — But an RCI? Don't Hold Your Breath
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister and Government Spokesman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, Communications Minister and government spokesman Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after a Cabinet meeting that enforcement agencies — including the police, Securities Commission, MACC, and Inland Revenue Board — had been instructed to conduct a “thorough” investigation into allegations that certain MACC officials were involved in corporate takeover manoeuvres. Fahmi confirmed the Cabinet had received the special committee’s report on MACC chief Azam Baki’s shareholding scandal but refused to reveal its findings, saying further action would be taken by Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar. When asked whether Azam’s contract extension was discussed, Fahmi said: “It was not discussed.”

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Wants Stricter 3R Laws — PH Promised to Repeal Restrictive Speech Laws, Now They're Writing New Ones
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Communications Minister and government spokesperson Fahmi Fadzil announced that Cabinet has decided firm action must be taken on 3R issues — race, religion, and royalty — including on social media. Fahmi said the government is considering amending existing laws or introducing new legislation to close what it describes as loopholes that allow certain individuals to ignore enforcement measures. He said the Attorney General has been directed to act decisively, and that the review would examine gaps in current laws that prevent early enforcement actions such as detentions.

item.title: KPDN Scrambles on Fuel Smuggling After Oil Tops $100 — Armizan Promises Enforcement That Should Have Been in Place for Years
item.description:
Said by: Armizan Mohd Ali, Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 10–11, KPDN Minister Armizan Mohd Ali announced that his ministry would “strengthen enforcement” against fuel smuggling and intensify Ops Tiris operations at national borders, after global oil prices topped US$100 per barrel due to the escalating US-Israel-Iran conflict. Armizan acknowledged that the widening gap between Malaysia’s subsidised fuel prices (RON95 at RM1.99) and market prices in neighbouring countries creates “high risk” of smuggling. He told the public there was “no need for concern or panic buying” and claimed contingency plans were in place. Separately, NST reported that Anwar appointed Deputy Prime Minister Fadillah Yusof to chair a special enforcement committee specifically targeting diesel smuggling (single-source: NST).

item.title: Mohamad Hasan Says Travel Agencies Must Bring Home Stranded Umrah Pilgrims — 'It Cannot Be Left to the Government Alone'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Hasan, Foreign Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Foreign Minister Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan, speaking at a press conference in Putrajaya on March 11, declared that travel companies and agencies managing umrah packages must take full responsibility for bringing home pilgrims stranded by the West Asia conflict. He said airlines must also honour their tickets: ‘If the ticket is with Malaysia Airlines, MAS must bring them home. If it is an AirAsia ticket, AirAsia must do so.’ He added bluntly: ‘It cannot be left to the Malaysian government alone.’ This came the same day the government’s first evacuation flight — a chartered Malaysia Airlines A330-300 — landed at KLIA with just 163 Malaysians from Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan and Syria, after days of airspace closures and flight disruptions across the Gulf.

item.title: Oil Past $100, Strait of Hormuz Shut, Rakyat Burning Fuel to Commute — Anwar Won't Mandate WFH, Freeze Tolls, Cap Food Prices, or Cut GLC Fat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

The Iran-US war has pushed global oil past $100 per barrel, effectively shut down the Strait of Hormuz — through which nearly 80% of Asia’s oil transits — and sent Malaysia’s FBM KLCI plunging 2.55% in a single session on March 9. RON97 is up to RM3.25, diesel to RM3.12, and Anwar himself admitted on March 7 that the government can only hold RON95 at RM1.99 for ‘one or two more months.’ Freight costs are surging, food prices are next, and experts from NST to Hong Leong IB are warning of imported inflation hitting the rakyat’s kitchen table. Anwar’s response so far: a strongly worded tweet about solidarity, an emergency parliamentary motion condemning Israel, and Zafrul saying Malaysia is ‘prepared’ — without naming a single concrete domestic measure to protect workers and families from the economic fallout.

item.title: PH Backbenchers Call for Snap Election Dressed Up as 'Reform' — Hold GE16 With All State Polls, Save Money, They Say
item.description:
Said by: Azli Yusof (Amanah-Shah Alam) / Jimmy Puah (PKR-Tebrau)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, two Pakatan Harapan backbenchers — Shah Alam MP Azli Yusof (Amanah) and Tebrau MP Jimmy Puah (PKR) — called for all state assembly elections to be held concurrently with the 16th General Election. Speaking to FMT, both MPs argued that separate elections lead to lower voter turnout, waste public money, and produce state governments with weaker mandates. Azli said separate polls are “unfair to voters, especially those who live far away from where they vote.” Puah called it “simply too tiring for people to come out and vote twice.” Putrajaya spent RM725 million on GE15 in 2022 and a further RM420 million on six subsequent state elections in 2023.

item.title: Police Question C4 Anti-Corruption CEO Under Section 124B — Anwar's Government Uses 'Plot to Topple' Probe to Interrogate Civil Society
item.description:
Said by: Bukit Aman (Royal Malaysia Police) / C4 Center (Pushpan Murugiah, CEO)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 10, 2026, the Center to Combat Corruption and Cronyism (C4) CEO Pushpan Murugiah was summoned to Bukit Aman and questioned for approximately 90 minutes under Section 124B of the Penal Code — activities detrimental to parliamentary democracy. The questioning was linked to the police investigation into an alleged plot to topple the government, reportedly because Pushpan’s name appeared in an email deemed relevant to the probe. But the interrogation went far beyond that email. Police questioned C4’s sources of funding, whether the organisation had received instructions to issue statements, and — remarkably — challenged C4’s right to comment on matters of national governance. C4 confirmed that several other political commentators and academics had also been summoned to Bukit Aman under the same investigation.

item.title: Ramanan Warns of 'Firm Action' on Free Speech, Cabinet Mulls Stricter 3R Laws — The Coalition That Promised to Repeal the Sedition Act
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Human Resources Minister Datuk Seri R. Ramanan issued a statement warning that the government would take “firm action” against anyone who “deliberately threatens national peace,” particularly on matters involving religion, race, and the monarchy (3R). He said freedom of speech “should not be misused to incite or divide society.” Two days later, on March 11, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil confirmed that the Cabinet had decided “firm action must be taken on matters related to 3R” and that the government was actively considering amending existing laws or introducing new, stricter legislation to tackle 3R issues. By March 15, Deputy Communications Minister Aaron Ago Dagang said all ministries would play a role in handling 3R matters.

item.title: Sabah Rejected PH at the Ballot Box — Now Mustapha Sakmud Says He'll Be Their Voice in Putrajaya Anyway
item.description:
Said by: Mustapha Sakmud, Sabah PH Chairman / Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Sabah PH chairman and Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister Mustapha Sakmud told FMT that Sabah PH will serve as a “conduit” to ensure state issues are voiced at the federal level. He said he intends to leverage his ministerial appointment — made on February 15 — to bring Sabahan concerns to Cabinet meetings and government agencies. “This is the role we aim to play, and we hope the people of Sabah will appreciate it when their fundamental needs are addressed,” he said.

item.title: [BM] DAP Akhirnya Desak RCI Terhadap SPRM — Lambat Berminggu, Dan PAS Betul Panggil Ia Teater Politik
item.description:
Said by: DAP Leadership / Ahmad Fadhli Shaari, PAS Information Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10 Mac, DAP — parti terbesar dalam gabungan Pakatan Harapan dengan 40 kerusi parlimen — secara rasmi menuntut Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) untuk menyiasat Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia atas dakwaan yang pertama kali dilaporkan oleh Bloomberg, termasuk bahawa ketua SPRM Azam Baki melanggar had pegangan saham penjawat awam dan agensi itu terlibat dalam ugutan korporat. Ketua penerangan PAS Ahmad Fadhli Shaari menyifatkan tuntutan itu sebagai “teater politik,” menyatakan DAP berdiam diri apabila laporan Bloomberg yang sama mendakwa PM Anwar Ibrahim secara peribadi campur tangan dalam siasatan SPRM.

item.title: [BM] Dzulkefly Janji — Sekali Lagi — Nak Banteras Buli Tempat Kerja Di Hospital Kerajaan
item.description:
Said by: Dzulkefly Ahmad, Health Minister

Category: Health

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Kesihatan Dzulkefly Ahmad mengumumkan pada 10 Mac 2026 bahawa Kementerian Kesihatan akan “memperkukuh penguatkuasaan” terhadap buli tempat kerja di kemudahan kesihatan kerajaan. Beliau berkata hospital awam sepatutnya menjadi “persekitaran kerja yang profesional dan beretika” dan merujuk kepada pekeliling Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam (JPA) yang melarang bahasa kasar dan penderaan lisan di tempat kerja. Beliau berjanji untuk “mempertingkatkan pelaksanaan” pekeliling tersebut.

item.title: [BM] Penduduk Kampung Lee Kong Chian 99 Tahun Disuruh Keluar — RM50K Sekepala, Hannah Yeoh 'Tak Dapat Hadir'
item.description:
Said by: Lo Su Fui, Deputy Minister (Federal Territories) / Hannah Yeoh, Minister (Federal Territories)

Category: Housing

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Lebih 150 penduduk Kampung Lee Kong Chian di Setapak — satu-satunya kampung Cina swasta yang masih tinggal di Kuala Lumpur, ditubuhkan pada 1927 sebagai kuarters pekerja Kumpulan Getah Lee — mengadakan perhimpunan aman pada 8 Mac 2026 selepas 146 isi rumah menerima notis pengusiran pada November 2025 yang mengarahkan mereka mengosongkan premis menjelang September. Tanah telah dijual kepada syarikat swasta. Penduduk ditawarkan pampasan RM50,000 setiap isi rumah, yang mereka tolak, menuntut unit Projek Perumahan Rakyat (PPR) sebagai ganti. Menteri Wilayah Persekutuan Hannah Yeoh tidak hadir pada sambutan Chap Goh Meh terakhir kampung pada 10 Mac; Timbalan Menteri Lo Su Fui muncul, menyerahkan RM10,000 untuk jamuan makan malam, dan berkata beliau akan “membawa perkara ini kembali ke Jabatan Wilayah Persekutuan.”

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Senyap-Senyap Tarik Balik Kes Bankrap NFCorp — Pejuang Antirasuah Berdamai Dengan Orang Yang Pernah Didedahkan
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Rafizi Ramli, MP Pandan dan bekas Menteri Ekonomi yang membina kerjaya politik atas pendedahan skandal Perbadanan Fidlot Nasional (NFCorp), telah secara senyap menarik balik prosiding kebankrapan dan penggulungannya terhadap pengarah NFCorp Datuk Seri Dr Mohamad Salleh Ismail dan syarikat itu sendiri. Notis Pemberhentian difailkan pada 3 Mac, dan Mahkamah Tinggi membatalkan kes pada 10 Mac tanpa perintah kos. Peguam Rafizi, Razlan Hadri Zulkifli, mengesahkan perkara itu “diselesaikan secara baik.” Kes ini berpunca daripada kos yang diperintahkan mahkamah kepada Rafizi selepas Mahkamah Persekutuan membenarkan rayuannya pada April 2022 — NFCorp dan Salleh membayar RM300,000 pada Disember 2022 tetapi berhenti membayar baki faedah tertunggak.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Dakwa 'Ejen Berbayar' Dalang Ketegangan Kaum — Janji Tindakan Kabinet Bukan Selesaikan Punca
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Aaron Ago Dagang, National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Sumber Manusia dan Naib Presiden PKR Datuk Seri R. Ramanan mengadakan sidang akhbar khas di Putrajaya pada 9 Mac diiringi pegawai PKR, mendakwa “ejen provokasi” dibayar untuk mencetuskan ketegangan kaum dan agama di Malaysia. Beliau berkata perkara itu akan dibangkitkan di Kabinet pada 11 Mac, dan tangkapan sudah dibuat. Menteri Perpaduan Negara Aaron Ago Dagang menyokong seruan itu pada 10 Mac. Kedua-dua menteri tidak menamakan provokator yang didakwa atau pembiaya mereka.

item.title: 99-Year-Old Kampung Lee Kong Chian Residents Told to Get Out — RM50K Per Family, Hannah Yeoh 'Unable to Attend'
item.description:
Said by: Lo Su Fui, Deputy Minister (Federal Territories) / Hannah Yeoh, Minister (Federal Territories)

Category: Housing

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

More than 150 residents of Kampung Lee Kong Chian in Setapak — Kuala Lumpur’s sole surviving private Chinese village, established in 1927 as quarters for Lee Rubber Group factory workers — held a peaceful rally on 8 March 2026 after 146 households received eviction notices in November 2025 ordering them to vacate by September. The land has been sold to a private company. Residents were offered RM50,000 per household in compensation, which they rejected, demanding People’s Housing Project (PPR) units instead. Federal Territories Minister Hannah Yeoh was absent from the village’s final Chap Goh Meh celebration on 10 March; Deputy Minister Lo Su Fui showed up, handed over RM10,000 for the dinner, and said he would “bring this matter back to the Federal Territories Department to explore how we can best provide assistance.” The government’s official position, per NST, is that it will “review the situation before deciding whether to intervene.”

item.title: DAP Finally Demands RCI on MACC — Weeks Late, and PAS Correctly Calls It Political Theatre
item.description:
Said by: DAP Leadership / Ahmad Fadhli Shaari, PAS Information Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

On March 10, DAP — the largest party in the Pakatan Harapan coalition with 40 parliamentary seats — formally called for a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) to investigate the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission over allegations first reported by Bloomberg, including that MACC chief Azam Baki breached civil servant shareholding limits and that the agency was involved in corporate intimidation. PAS information chief Ahmad Fadhli Shaari responded by calling the demand “political theatre,” noting that DAP had remained silent when the same Bloomberg reports alleged that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim personally interfered in MACC investigations.

item.title: Dzulkefly Promises — Again — to Crack Down on Workplace Bullying in Government Hospitals
item.description:
Said by: Dzulkefly Ahmad, Health Minister

Category: Health

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad announced on March 10, 2026 that the Health Ministry will “bolster enforcement” against workplace bullying in government health facilities. He said public hospitals should be “professional and ethical workplace environments” and pointed to a Public Services Department (PSD) circular that bans coarse language and verbal abuse in the workplace. He pledged to “enhance implementation” of the circular to ensure “no ambiguity” in handling misconduct — language that strongly implies the existing rules are not being enforced.

item.title: Rafizi Quietly Drops NFCorp Bankruptcy Bid — The Anti-Corruption Crusader Makes Nice With the People He Once Exposed
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

Rafizi Ramli, the Pandan MP and former Economy Minister who built his political career on exposing the National Feedlot Corporation (NFCorp) scandal, has quietly dropped his bankruptcy and winding-up proceedings against NFCorp director Datuk Seri Dr Mohamad Salleh Ismail and the company itself. A Notice of Discontinuance was filed on March 3, and the High Court struck out the case on March 10 without an order as to costs. Rafizi’s lawyer Razlan Hadri Zulkifli confirmed the matter was “amicably resolved.” The case stemmed from court-ordered costs owed to Rafizi after the Federal Court upheld his appeal in April 2022 — NFCorp and Salleh had paid RM300,000 in December 2022 but stopped paying the outstanding interest balance.

item.title: Ramanan Claims 'Paid Agents' Are Behind Racial Tensions — Promises Cabinet Crackdown Instead of Addressing Root Causes
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Aaron Ago Dagang, National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President Datuk Seri R. Ramanan held a special press conference in Putrajaya on March 9 flanked by PKR officials, claiming that “agents of provocation” are being paid to incite racial and religious tensions in Malaysia. He said the matter would be raised at Cabinet on March 11, and that arrests have already been made. National Unity Minister Aaron Ago Dagang echoed the call on March 10, urging police to “take stern action” against anyone disrupting harmony. Neither minister named the alleged provocateurs or their financiers — Ramanan specifically said he would not name them to avoid “making them famous.”

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Frasa “reformasi tidak boleh dirunding” akan berkuasa jika ia datang daripada kerajaan yang sebenarnya menyampaikan reformasi. Sebaliknya, ia datang daripada PM yang sama yang kerajaannya, dalam dua minggu lepas sahaja:

Tetapi Anwar tidak menggantung Azam sekarang. Beliau tidak mengarahkan siasatan awam bebas. item.title: [BM] Pengkhianatan Muktamad: Anwar Bina Harapan, Jual Kepada UMNO, Dan Panggil Ia Reformasi
item.description:
Said by: Compilation: CSIS, Toda, CNA, East Asia Forum, ISEAS, Amnesty, HRW, Freedom House

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Selepas tiga tahun berkuasa, keputusan daripada badan pemerhati antarabangsa, badan pemikir, dan penganalisis adalah sebulat suara: Anwar Ibrahim gagal menyampaikan agenda reformasinya.

  • CSIS: ‘Kematian Reformasi.’
  • Institut Keamanan Toda: ‘Memburukkan keadaan.’
  • Amnesty International: ‘Mengkhianati ikrar reformasi.’
  • HRW: ‘Agenda reformasi terhenti.’
  • Freedom House: ‘Separa Bebas’ (tidak berubah).
  • CNA: ‘Ribut sempurna’ krisis.
  • East Asia Forum: ‘Aspirasi reformasi bertembung dengan realiti politik.’
  • ISEAS: ‘Memerlukan ketegasan, keadilan dan kesedaran diri.’ 🔥 KENAPA IA PENTING: Ini bukan seorang pengkritik, satu perspektif, atau satu serangan partisan. Ini adalah KONSENSUS merentas institusi paling dihormati di dunia bahawa projek reformasi Anwar telah gagal. Apabila CSIS di Washington, Amnesty di London, ISEAS di Singapura, Toda di Tokyo, dan Freedom House semuanya mencapai kesimpulan yang sama secara bebas, ia bukan berat sebelah — ia kebenaran.

💩 KENAPA IA KARUT: Anwar mempunyai SEGALANYA: naratif peribadi penderitaan, gerakan dibina atas harapan, mandat pengundi, bilangan parlimen, muhibah antarabangsa, dan pengalaman berdekad. Beliau mempunyai lebih banyak modal politik daripada mana-mana PM yang masuk dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dan beliau membelanjakan SEMUANYA untuk mengekalkan kuasa melalui rangkaian naungan UMNO dan bukannya menyampaikan reformasi yang mewajarkan keseluruhan kewujudan politiknya. Ini bukan kegagalan keadaan — ini kegagalan watak.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Ugut 'Tindakan Tegas' Atas Kebebasan Bersuara — Janji Reformasi PH Bertahan Selagi Tiada Siapa Gunakannya

item.title: [BM] Sudah Mac 2026 — Mana Janji Anwar Hapuskan Kemiskinan Tegar Menjelang S1?
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 7 Disember 2025, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengisytiharkan secara terbuka bahawa Malaysia akan menghapuskan kemiskinan tegar menjelang suku pertama 2026. Berucap di penutupan program Rancakkan Madani di Putrajaya, Anwar memetik kadar kemiskinan tegar 0.09% — kira-kira 7,000 isi rumah — dan berkata baki kes boleh diselesaikan dalam beberapa bulan. “Kita antara negara di dunia… kita berjaya mengurangkan kadar nasional kemiskinan tegar kepada hanya 0.09 peratus,” kata Anwar. “Kita boleh menamatkannya menjelang suku pertama 2026.” Janji itu dilaporkan oleh Bernama, Malay Mail, The Star, New Straits Times, The Edge, dan The Sun. Ia merupakan dakwaan utama — diulang semasa Bajet 2026 dan jerayawara Rancakkan Madani. Kini sudah 9 Mac 2026. S1 berakhir dalam tiga minggu. Tiada pengumuman rasmi bahawa kemiskinan tegar telah dihapuskan. Tiada sidang akhbar. Tiada berita kilat Bernama. Tiada kenyataan PMO yang penuh kemenangan.

item.title: [BM] Timbalan Menteri Ekonomi Kata Pertumbuhan Stabil 4-4.5% — Di Tengah Perang Serantau Dan Ketidaktentuan Global

Beliau membuat kenyataan ini di sidang kemuncak yang pengerusinya sendiri, Tan Sri Majid Khan, memberi amaran bahawa ketegangan geopolitik sedang “menilai semula risiko di seluruh rantau kita.” Konflik AS-Iran semakin meningkat, harga minyak melonjak akibat gangguan Selat Hormuz, dan gangguan GPS menjejaskan perkapalan di seluruh Teluk.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul Kata Malaysia 'Bersedia' Hadapi Kesan Ekonomi Konflik Timur Tengah — Lebih Vibes, Tiada Pelan

Beliau menyatakan minyak sebelum ini pernah mencecah AS$100/tong dan berkata Kementerian Kewangan dan Kementerian Ekonomi ’telah membuat persediaan.’ Tiada persediaan khusus didedahkan.

item.title: Anwar Announces 125,000 Civil Servant Promotions From Grade 1 to Grade 5 — A Two-Week Course and a Pay Bump Before the Election
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced on March 9, 2026 that 125,000 lower-ranked civil servants currently at Grade 1 will be promoted to Grade 5 starting January 2027. The only requirement: completing a two-to-three-week training course covering IT skills and other competencies. Anwar directed the Public Service Department (PSD) to work out the details. This announcement came during the same week as the RM500 civil servant bonuses, the RM15 billion STR cash handouts brought forward before Hari Raya, and the RM500 payments to 70,000 mosque and religious personnel.

item.title: Anwar Announces RM500 Cash Handout for Civil Servants and Mosque Staff — Hari Raya Election Season Begins
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 9 March 2026, Anwar Ibrahim announced Special Financial Assistance (Bantuan Kewangan Khas, BKK) 2026: RM500 for civil servants Grade 15 and below, RM250 for pensioners and veterans, and RM500 for approximately 70,000 mosque and religious personnel — imams, bilal, siak, marbut, KAFA and takmir teachers. Payments land on 13 March, days before Hari Raya Aidilfitri, when household spending peaks and political goodwill is most visible. Anwar holds both the PM and Finance Minister portfolios, giving him unilateral authority over the timing and targeting of such disbursements.

item.title: Anwar Brings Forward RM15 Billion STR Cash Handout — Record Spending, Hari Raya Timing, Snap Election Vibes
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On March 9, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced that Phase 2 of the Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) cash transfer programme would be brought forward to March 10 — weeks ahead of its originally scheduled date. The early disbursement will benefit 5.2 million recipients.

Anwar framed the move as helping Malaysians prepare for Hari Raya Aidilfitri. The total 2026 allocation for STR and SARA (Sumbangan Asas Rahmah) stands at RM15 billion — the highest in the history of the Federal Government’s direct cash assistance programmes.

item.title: Anwar Condemns Iran's Attacks on Kuwait — Weeks After Parliament Motion Defending Iran Against US-Israel Strikes
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim called the Prime Minister of Kuwait, Sheikh Ahmad Abdullah Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, to condemn Iranian attacks targeting Kuwait. He expressed condolences for the casualties and affirmed Malaysia’s support for Kuwait’s security and territorial integrity. This phone call came exactly one week after Anwar tabled an emergency motion in Parliament on March 2 condemning US-Israel strikes on Iran, during which he declared that Malaysia could ’no longer swallow’ Western human rights lectures and PH backbencher Syahredzan Johan called on MPs to boycott all US embassy events.

item.title: Anwar Launches Capital Market Masterplan, Says 'Reform Non-Negotiable' — While Every Actual Reform Gets Delayed or Killed
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim delivered the keynote address at the launch of the Securities Commission’s Capital Market Masterplan 2026–2030 (CMP4) on March 9, 2026. He declared that “the government has made reform non-negotiable” and that Malaysia’s capital market “must drive shared prosperity, not just profit.”

The CMP4 targets growing Malaysia’s capital market to RM6.3 trillion by 2030 and includes initiatives like the “MY Value Up” program to boost PLC valuations.

item.title: Anwar Orders Mass Promotion of 125,000 Civil Servants — During Austerity, Ahead of Elections, After a 2-Week Course
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On March 9, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced at the Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN) assembly in Putrajaya that 125,000 Grade 1 civil servants — administrative, clerical, and financial assistants — will be promoted to Grade 5 effective January 2027. The only requirement: complete a two-to-three-week training course covering basic IT skills. Anwar directed Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar and the Public Service Department (PSD) to ensure all 125,000 promotions are processed within six months.

item.title: Anwar Repeats 'Aid Based on Need, Not Race' in Dewan Negara — Same Script, Different Session, Zero Structural Change
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim told the Dewan Negara on March 9, 2026, that government aid and assistance are allocated based on need, not race. He affirmed that the Madani government would “remain fair to all states” and that assistance targets those most in need regardless of background.

This is not the first time Anwar has used this exact line. In August 2025, he told the same Dewan Negara the same thing — almost word for word — as reported by The Star and NST. Before that, the 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP) was framed around the same “needs-based, not race-based” rhetoric.

item.title: Anwar Won't Suspend Azam Baki — Will Just Let His Contract Expire in May While the Country Burns
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Straits Times sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The Straits Times reported on March 9, 2026 — citing high-level government and legal sources — that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has decided not to renew MACC chief commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki’s tenure when it expires on May 12, 2026. This would mark the end of Azam’s fourth annual extension since reaching retirement age in 2023. According to the report, Anwar has “repeatedly stressed to Cabinet in recent weeks that Azam won’t be renewed.” But crucially, Anwar is not suspending Azam now. He is not ordering an independent public inquiry. He is not referring the matter to Parliament. He is simply going to let the clock run out — two more months of an anti-corruption chief accused of being the head of a “corporate mafia.” This comes after Bloomberg reported that the MACC under Azam had abused its powers to extort and manipulate corporate figures; Azam was found to have breached civil servant shareholding rules multiple times, most recently in January 2026, holding 17.7 million shares in Velocity Capital Bhd; former Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli and 8 PKR MPs publicly demanded Azam’s immediate suspension; Bersih demanded resignation and organised protests; DAP Secretary-General Anthony Loke called the government’s response “inadequate”; and a Feb 15 rally in Kuala Lumpur demanded Azam’s arrest.

item.title: Anwar's Government Fights 531,976 Retirees in Court — Wins Appeal to Block RM1.7 Billion Pension Payout
item.description:
Said by: Federal Government / Senior Federal Counsel Sallehuddin Ali

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On 9 March 2026, the Court of Appeal unanimously overturned a High Court order that would have required Anwar Ibrahim’s government to pay RM1.7 billion in pension arrears to 531,976 former civil servants. The three-judge panel — led by Justice Azhahari Kamal Ramli, with Justices Lim Chong Fong and Meor Hashimi Abdul Hamid — ruled that the pensioners’ application was res judicata (already adjudicated) and constituted an “abuse of court process.” The government, represented by Senior Federal Counsel Sallehuddin Ali, successfully argued that the 2016 Public Service Department Circular (PP 1/2016) was an “enhancement” to the civil service scheme, not a mandatory salary revision triggering pension adjustments. The original case was brought by Aminah Ahmad, a retired Ministry of Foreign Affairs officer, on behalf of 56 other retirees in 2017.

item.title: Daim's Family Sues Anwar's Government Over 'Zionist Plot' Claims — Calls Police Probe Unlawful and Unconstitutional
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Daim Zainuddin’s Family (Respondents)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

The family of late former finance minister Daim Zainuddin — his widow Naimah Abdul Khalid, two sons, and two family lawyers — filed a lawsuit at the Kuala Lumpur High Court on March 7, 2026, seeking a declaration that the police investigation into the alleged plot to topple Anwar’s government is unlawful, unconstitutional, and tainted by bad faith. This comes after Anwar told Parliament on March 3 that a suspect in the alleged conspiracy had engaged an international PR firm to launch coordinated attacks on national institutions, claiming the plot involved ‘a prominent Zionist group,’ foreign lobbyists, bankers, and international media agencies.

item.title: DAP Brings Forward Congress to July — Will Vote on Whether Leaders Should Quit Government, But Promises to Stay Anyway
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, DAP Secretary-General / Transport Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

DAP, the largest component party in Anwar’s Pakatan Harapan coalition by parliamentary seats, has brought forward its national congress from September to July 12, 2026. At the congress, more than 4,000 delegates will vote in an internal referendum on whether party leaders should resign from their government posts. DAP secretary-general and Transport Minister Anthony Loke told Malaysiakini on February 24 that “the government’s response has been inadequate and does not meet public expectations” regarding the MACC scandal. The move comes after DAP lost every seat it contested in November’s Sabah state polls and faces mounting grassroots anger over stalled reforms, the MACC crisis, and the perception that DAP is enabling a government that has abandoned its own platform.

item.title: Deputy Economy Minister Says Growth Steady at 4-4.5% — Amid a Regional War and Global Volatility
item.description:
Said by: Mohd Shahar Abdullah, Deputy Economy Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 9 March 2026, Deputy Economy Minister Mohd Shahar Abdullah projected 4–4.5% GDP growth for Malaysia at the Asean Banking and Finance Summit, citing domestic consumption, infrastructure investment, the digital economy, and Visit Malaysia 2026. He made this statement at the very summit whose chairman, Tan Sri Majid Khan, warned that geopolitical tensions are “repricing risk across our entire region.” The US-Iran conflict was escalating, oil prices were spiking due to Strait of Hormuz disruptions, and GPS jamming was affecting shipping across the Gulf.

item.title: It's March 2026 — Where Is Anwar's Promise to Eradicate Hardcore Poverty by Q1?
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 7 December 2025, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim publicly declared that Malaysia would eradicate hardcore poverty by the first quarter of 2026. Speaking at the closing of the Rancakkan Madani programme in Putrajaya, Anwar cited a hardcore poverty rate of 0.09% — roughly 7,000 households — and said the remaining cases could be resolved within months. “We are one of the countries in the world… we have managed to reduce the national rate of hardcore poverty to just 0.09 per cent,” Anwar said. “We can end it by the first quarter of 2026.” The promise was reported by Bernama, Malay Mail, The Star, New Straits Times, The Edge, and The Sun. It was a flagship claim — repeated during Budget 2026 and the Rancakkan Madani roadshow. It is now 9 March 2026. Q1 ends in three weeks. There has been no official announcement that hardcore poverty has been eradicated. No press conference. No Bernama flash. No triumphant PMO statement.

item.title: PKR's Own MP Warns Anwar Risks Legitimacy by Ignoring Nurul Izzah and Backbenchers on MACC
item.description:
Said by: Hassan Abdul Karim, PKR MP for Pasir Gudang

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On 9 March 2026, PKR’s Pasir Gudang MP Hassan Abdul Karim publicly warned Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim — his own party president — that ignoring concerns raised by MPs and PKR deputy president Nurul Izzah Anwar about the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) puts the PM’s legitimacy at risk. Speaking to Malaysiakini, Hassan said Anwar cannot keep turning a deaf ear to internal party concerns about the MACC’s conduct, particularly after Nurul Izzah called for the agency to be placed under parliamentary oversight and criticised the “high-handed manner” of investigations including the RM1.1 billion Arm Holdings deal probe.

item.title: Ramanan Threatens 'Firm Action' Over Free Speech — PH's Reform Promise Lasts Until Someone Uses It
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President Datuk Seri R. Ramanan issued a public statement warning that the government will take “firm action” against anyone who “deliberately threatens national peace,” particularly on matters involving religion, race, and the monarchy — the so-called 3R issues. Ramanan said there has been “a worrying rise in statements, social media posts and online comments aimed at provoking racial tensions” and warned that “freedom of speech should not be misused to incite or divide society.” The following day, he told reporters he would personally raise the issue of unnamed “provocateurs” at the March 11 Cabinet meeting. Entrepreneur and Cooperative Development Minister Steven Sim echoed the call, demanding police “act firmly against all perpetrators.”

item.title: Sports Minister Says 'Learn Lessons and Move On' From Heritage Player Scandal — Where's the Government Accountability?
item.description:
Said by: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq Johari, Youth and Sports Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On March 9, 2026, Youth and Sports Minister Dr. Mohammed Taufiq Johari called on the Football Association of Malaysia (FAM) to “take lessons” from the heritage player scandal and move forward with grassroots football development.

“The legal process has taken place and we accept the decision that has been made. We will now examine what follow-up steps need to be taken,” Taufiq said at an Iftar Ramadan event in Tikam Batu.

item.title: The Ultimate Betrayal: Anwar Built Hope, Sold It to UMNO, and Called It Reform
item.description:
Said by: Compilation: CSIS, Toda, CNA, East Asia Forum, ISEAS, Amnesty, HRW, Freedom House

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: After three years in power, the verdict from international watchdogs, think tanks, and analysts is unanimous: Anwar Ibrahim has failed to deliver on his reform agenda.

  • CSIS: ‘The Death of Reformasi.’
  • Toda Peace Institute: ‘Making things worse.’
  • Amnesty International: ‘Betrayed reform pledges.’
  • HRW: ‘Reform agenda stalled.’
  • Freedom House: ‘Partly Free’ (unchanged).
  • CNA: ‘Perfect storm’ of crises.
  • East Asia Forum: ‘Reform aspirations clashed with political realities.’
  • ISEAS: ‘Needs rigour, fairness and self-awareness.’ 🔥 WHY IT MATTERS: This is not one critic, one perspective, or one partisan attack. This is a CONSENSUS across the world’s most respected institutions that Anwar’s reform project has failed. When CSIS in Washington, Amnesty in London, ISEAS in Singapore, Toda in Tokyo, and Freedom House all reach the same conclusion independently, it’s not bias — it’s the truth.

💩 WHY IT’S BULLSHIT: Anwar had EVERYTHING: a personal narrative of suffering, a movement built on hope, a mandate from voters, parliamentary numbers, international goodwill, and decades of experience. He had more political capital than any incoming PM in Malaysian history. And he spent it ALL on maintaining power through UMNO’s patronage network rather than delivering the reforms that justified his entire political existence. This isn’t a failure of circumstance — it’s a failure of character.

item.title: Zafrul Says Malaysia 'Prepared' for Middle East Conflict Economic Fallout — More Vibes, No Plan
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to PM

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 9 March 2026, Tengku Zafrul — now Senior Political Advisor to the PM — told media that the government is ‘prepared to face any eventuality affecting the country’s economic position’ from the Middle East conflict, including implications for petrol subsidies. He noted oil had previously reached US$100/barrel and said the Finance Ministry and Economy Ministry ‘have made preparations.’ He disclosed no specific preparations.

item.title: Zafrul Testifying in Muhyiddin Corruption Trial — The Man Who Served Both Sides Takes the Stand
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz / Muhyiddin Yassin Defence Team

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Tengku Zafrul is scheduled to testify in the corruption trial of former PM Muhyiddin Yassin, who faces charges of soliciting RM232.5 million in bribes for Bersatu through the Jana Wibawa programme. Zafrul served as Muhyiddin’s Finance Minister during the period the alleged offences occurred (March 2020 to August 2021). The defence team has also signalled plans to call tycoon Syed Mokhtar to testify. Hearing dates are set through August 2026.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Suruh Rakyat 'Berbelanja Bijak' Dan 'Berjimat' — Selepas Hulur RM15 Bilion Bantuan Tunai, Bonus RM500, Dan RM200 Juta Untuk Palestin

Mesej kepada rakyat: kami boleh berbelanja bebas, tetapi anda kena berjimat.

item.title: Anwar Claims PKR's 2016 US Lobbying Was 'Only About His Release' — 84-Page Dossier Shows It Called for Washington to Intervene Against Malaysia
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Nurul Izzah Anwar, PKR Deputy President / Sivarasa Rasiah, PKR Senior Leader

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-08

📌 What Happened

On March 8, MalaysiaNow published details of an 84-page dossier titled White Paper on the case of Anwar Ibrahim: Citizen of Malaysia v. Government of Malaysia, prepared jointly by PKR’s Sivarasa Rasiah and American consultant Jared Genser of Perseus Strategies in April 2016. The document, which a senior PKR MP confirmed was delivered to several US Congress members, called on the Obama administration to take a greater interest in Malaysia’s domestic politics, publicly rebuke the Najib government, and demand Anwar’s release. Anwar had previously stated that PKR’s hiring of Genser was “solely to press for his release from prison.”

item.title: Anwar Tells Rakyat to 'Spend Wisely' and 'Be Thrifty' — After Handing Out RM15 Billion in Cash, RM500 Bonuses, and RM200 Million for Palestine
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

On March 6, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim addressed reporters after Friday prayers at IOI City Mall Putrajaya and told Malaysians to “be prudent, learn to be thrifty and save” as a “precautionary measure” against the economic fallout of the US-Iran conflict. He cited soaring oil prices, the blockade of over 200 tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, and spiking food and fertiliser costs from Ukraine, Russia and Europe. By March 8, the advice had become a national headline: “Spend wisely, PM urges.”

item.title: PKR Issues Show-Cause Letter to Rafizi, Then Backs Down — Party Can't Even Discipline Its Most Prominent Critic
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Fuziah Salleh, PKR Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-08

📌 What Happened

On February 19, Pandan MP Rafizi Ramli revealed he had received a show-cause letter from PKR secretary-general Fuziah Salleh after telling Sin Chew Daily he would contest in Pandan at GE16 but likely not as a PKR candidate. Rafizi responded saying the meaning of his comments was “understandable to anyone with a good command of Malay” and that he was free to make his own plans after Parliament was dissolved. On March 6, PKR conveyed its decision by email — no action taken, just a reminder to adhere to the party constitution and code of ethics. On March 8, Rafizi publicly described this as a “U-turn,” saying the show-cause letter was issued “with the intention to give him the boot” but the party ultimately blinked.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Beritahu Pengundi PH 'Tunggu Hingga Jun' — Bayangkan Berpisah Daripada PKR Dan 'Belayar Kapal Sendiri'

item.title: Anwar Warns of 'Wealthy Elites' Manipulating Media — While His Own Government Shields the MACC Chief From Accountability
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-07

📌 What Happened

On March 7, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim used an iftar event in Kulim to accuse unnamed Malaysian elites of “corruptly using their wealth to exert influence on international media, online narratives and local politics.” He said he was not referring only to the opposition but to “everyone,” and urged Malaysians to “remain vigilant” against “foreign schemes and conspiracies.” The statement came just four days after he told Parliament about an alleged plot — involving a former senior minister’s wife, foreign PR firms, and Bloomberg — to destabilise his government.

item.title: Anwar's 'Perfect Storm': Anti-Graft Crisis, Party Fractures, Coalition Jitters
item.description:
Said by: CNA Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-07

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Multiple challenges are converging on Anwar Ibrahim that may force him to call early elections nearly two years ahead of the February 2028 deadline. An anti-graft crisis at MACC (Bloomberg exposés on Azam Baki), PKR internal fractures following Rafizi Ramli’s departure from cabinet, and coalition partners openly reconsidering their ties. CNA described it as a “perfect storm” of political instability. UMNO’s secret Bangkok meeting with opposition parties, DAP reviewing coalition ties, and the PKR factional war all threaten to bring down the Unity Government before its term ends.

item.title: Rafizi Tells PH Voters to 'Wait Till June' — Hints at Breaking Away from PKR and 'Sailing His Own Ship'
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-07

📌 What Happened

Former Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli, who quit the cabinet in May 2025 after losing the PKR deputy presidency contest, told Pakatan Harapan supporters in a Sin Chew Daily interview to “wait till June,” hinting that a new political option would be unveiled. Rafizi said he and his allies are open to “sailing their own ship” and are exploring “different political configurations” — which could involve a new party, coalition, or political platform. He confirmed he will defend his Pandan parliamentary seat in the next general election but definitively not under the PKR banner. Separately, Reuters reported that several PKR lawmakers are considering contesting as independents, having lost confidence in Anwar’s leadership.

item.title: [BM] 238 Pelantikan Politik Ke Badan Berkanun Dan GLC Di Bawah Anwar — Laporan IDEAS Dedah 'Kenalan Mengatasi Kecekapan'
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS Report / Anwar Ibrahim Administration

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Institut Demokrasi dan Hal Ehwal Ekonomi (IDEAS) mengeluarkan laporan bertajuk Who Sits at the Table: From Political to Public Appointees in Malaysia’s Federal Statutory Bodies pada 6 Mac 2026, mendedahkan bahawa 238 pelantikan politik dibuat ke badan berkanun persekutuan (FSB) dan syarikat berkaitan kerajaan (GLC) di bawah pentadbiran Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim antara November 2022 dan Oktober 2025. Daripada jumlah ini, 222 ke FSB dan 16 ke GLC. Laporan itu mengkaji 135 agensi dan mendapati 78% jawatan pengerusi diisi berdasarkan hubungan politik dan bukannya kecekapan. Kebanyakan tidak mempunyai kriteria kelayakan yang jelas.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Akui Hanya Mampu Kekal Subsidi RON95 'Satu Atau Dua Bulan' — Sementara Harga Minyak Melonjak Merata
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 6 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu pemberita bahawa Malaysia boleh mengekalkan harga petrol RON95 bersubsidi pada RM1.99 seliter di bawah skim Budi95 — tetapi hanya untuk ‘satu atau dua bulan.’ Kata-kata tepat beliau: ‘Kita akan cuba mengawal kesan konflik Iran, termasuk untuk RON95, iaitu RM1.99 seliter. Kita akan memantau keadaan ini kerana setakat ini, kita masih boleh menangguhkan selama satu atau dua bulan.’ Ini pada minggu sama RON97 naik 10 sen ke RM3.25 seliter, RON95 tak bersubsidi naik 8 sen ke RM2.67, dan diesel di Semenanjung naik 8 sen ke RM3.12.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Bangga Pelaburan Diluluskan 'Rekod' RM426.7B — Tapi 'Diluluskan' Bukan Bermakna 'Tiba'
item.description:

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-06

item.title: [BM] Anwar Nafi Pilihan Raya Kilat Pada Disember — Kini Kerajaannya Senyap-Senyap Bersedia Untuk Pilihan Raya 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Unity Government sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada Disember 2025, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu wartawan bahawa pilihan raya kilat tidak dalam pertimbangan — keutamaannya, katanya, ialah melaksanakan reformasi dan menangani kos sara hidup. Mara pantas ke Mac 2026: pelbagai orang dalam kerajaan, pemimpin akar umbi parti, dan penjawat awam memberitahu CNA bahawa persediaan sedang berjalan secara senyap untuk kemungkinan pilihan raya umum pada separuh kedua 2026. Ahli politik Johor dari kerajaan perpaduan berkata akar umbi telah diberitahu untuk meningkatkan persediaan selepas Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Penjawat awam kanan mengesahkan pegawai pentadbiran kerajaan telah diletakkan dalam keadaan berwaspada dan sumber ditetapkan “dalam keadaan bersedia” dari Jun. Timbalan Pengerusi SPR Azmi Sharom berkata suruhanjaya bersedia, termasuk untuk pilihan raya negeri dan parlimen serentak.

Berucap selepas program Ihya’ Ramadan Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam di Putrajaya, Anwar memanggil kenyataan Bersih “tidak adil” dan berkata kumpulan itu “tidak membuat kenyataan yang bersih.” Beliau kemudian menambah: “Jangan menyerang orang tanpa terlebih dahulu mendapatkan maklumat, terutamanya semasa Ramadan.” Beliau menunjuk kepada jawatankuasa siasatan kerajaan dan Peguam Negara sebagai alasan untuk menangguhkan kritikan.

item.title: [BM] Tony Pua Ugut DAP Akan Keluar Gabungan Jika Reformasi Tak Dilaksanakan — Parti Terbesar Dalam Kerajaan Baru Mengaku Mungkin Blah
item.description:
Said by: Tony Pua, DAP Disciplinary Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

Pua kata DAP tidak akan tarik sokongan penggal ini bagi elak ketidakstabilan, tetapi memberi amaran: “Jika kita tidak tarik diri, parti akan hilang semua kredibiliti dan boleh jangka keputusan pilihan raya yang menghukum.” Kenyataan ini dibuat ketika skandal SPRM/Azam Baki memuncak, kekalahan pilihan raya negeri November 2025, dan kegagalan rang undang-undang had penggal PM pada 2 Mac. Secara berasingan, ahli Parlimen PKR Hassan Karim tuntut Anwar “pecat ketua SPRM serta-merta dan segera tubuhkan RCI.”

item.title: 238 Political Appointments to FSBs and GLCs Under Anwar — IDEAS Report Exposes 'Connections Over Competence'
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS Report / Anwar Ibrahim Administration

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

The Institute for Democracy and Economic Affairs (IDEAS) released a report titled Who Sits at the Table: From Political to Public Appointees in Malaysia’s Federal Statutory Bodies on March 6, 2026, revealing that 238 political appointments were made to federal statutory bodies (FSBs) and government-linked companies (GLCs) under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s administration between November 2022 and October 2025. Of these, 222 were to FSBs and 16 to GLCs. The report reviewed 135 agencies and found that 78% of chairperson positions were filled based on political connections rather than competence. Most lacked clearly defined qualification criteria. The appointments were concentrated in key ministries, and the governance provisions around them were described as inconsistent and fragmented.

item.title: Anwar Admits He Can Only Hold RON95 Subsidy for 'One or Two Months' — While Fuel Prices Spike Across the Board
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

On March 6, 2026, Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim told reporters that Malaysia can maintain the subsidised RON95 petrol price at RM1.99 per litre under the Budi95 scheme — but only for ‘one or two months.’ His exact words: ‘We will try to control the effects of the Iranian conflict, including for RON95, which is RM1.99 per litre. We will monitor this situation because so far, we can still hold off for one or two months.’ This came the same week that RON97 petrol rose 10 sen to RM3.25 per litre, unsubsidised RON95 climbed 8 sen to RM2.67, and diesel in Peninsular Malaysia jumped 8 sen to RM3.12 — all driven by the escalating Middle East conflict and 200 vessels stuck in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Anwar Boasts RM426.7B 'Record' Approved Investments — But 'Approved' Doesn't Mean 'Arrived'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On March 6, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced that Malaysia recorded its highest-ever approved investments of RM426.7 billion in 2025 — an 11% increase from RM384.4 billion in 2024. According to MIDA, 8,390 projects were approved, with the potential to create 244,902 jobs. Anwar framed this as a vindication of his reform agenda and evidence of global confidence in Malaysia’s economic direction.

item.title: Anwar Denied Snap Polls in December — Now His Government Is Quietly Preparing for Elections in 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Unity Government sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

In December 2025, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told journalists that snap elections were not on the cards — his priority, he said, was implementing reforms and addressing cost of living. Fast forward to March 2026: multiple government insiders, party grassroots leaders, and civil servants have told CNA that preparations are quietly underway for a possible general election in the second half of 2026. A Johor politician from the unity government said grassroots have been told to ramp up preparations after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. A senior civil servant confirmed government administrative officers have been placed on alert and resources put “on standby” from June. EC deputy chairman Azmi Sharom said the commission is ready, including for concurrent state and parliamentary polls.

item.title: Anwar Tells Bersih to Stop Criticising MACC 'During Ramadan' — Uses the Holy Month as a Shield Against Accountability
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

On March 6, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim publicly dismissed the Coalition for Clean and Fair Elections (Bersih)’s accusation that the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) has become a political tool of the government. Speaking after the Public Service Department’s Ihya’ Ramadan programme in Putrajaya, Anwar called Bersih’s statement “unfair” and said the group was “not making clean statements.” He then added: “Do not attack people without first obtaining information, especially during Ramadan.” He pointed to the government’s investigative committee and the Attorney General as reasons to defer criticism, saying no reports had been received yet.

item.title: Tony Pua Threatens DAP Will Quit Coalition If Reforms Not Delivered — The Largest Party in Government Just Admitted It Might Walk
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

On March 6, 2026, Tony Pua — DAP’s disciplinary chief and one of the party’s most prominent voices — told Reuters that DAP will “evaluate its position in the relevant coalitions when the time comes for elections.” He confirmed the party plans a July meeting to decide whether its leaders should resign from all government positions, including the cabinet, if promised reforms are not implemented. Pua said DAP would not pull support this term to avoid instability, but warned: “If we don’t withdraw, the party will lose all credibility and can expect a punishing outcome from the elections.” The statement came amid the MACC/Azam Baki scandal, DAP’s November 2025 regional election loss, and the failed PM term-limit bill on March 2. Separately, PKR lawmaker Hassan Karim demanded Anwar “terminate the contract of the MACC chief immediately and promptly form the RCI.”

item.title: [BM] Loke Akui DAP Gagal Dapat Persetujuan Kabinet Untuk Siasatan Diraja SPRM — Parti Reformasi Tak Mampu Reformasi Kerajaannya Sendiri

Setiausaha Agung DAP dan Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke pertama kali mencadangkan RCI kepada Kabinet pada akhir Februari, memanggil tindak balas kerajaan terhadap laporan penyiasatan Bloomberg 11 Februari “tidak memadai.” Tetapi walaupun seruan awam berulang dan sokongan CEC, Loke seterusnya mengakui bahawa DAP tidak mampu memujuk Kabinet untuk menubuhkan RCI. Setiausaha politik Anwar Kamil Azmil Munawar menolak cadangan itu, menyatakan sebarang tindakan “mesti bersandarkan fakta yang mantap dan bukti yang boleh dipercayai” — seolah-olah Suruhanjaya Diraja itu sendiri bukan badan pencari fakta.

item.title: [BM] Pengerusi DAPSY Amaran SPRM Mewujudkan 'Suasana Ketakutan' — Sayap Belia PH Sendiri Bersuara Menentang Taktik Penguatkuasaan
item.description:
Said by: Woo Kah Leong, DAPSY National Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 5 Mac 2026, Pengerusi Kebangsaan DAPSY YB Woo Kah Leong mengeluarkan kenyataan akhbar rasmi tujuh perkara mengkritik Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) kerana menjalankan siasatan yang beliau sifatkan tidak setimpal dan menggeruni.

Perkara utama kenyataan tersebut:

  • DAPSY “amat bimbang” tentang cara SPRM menjalankan siasatan berprofil tinggi baru-baru ini
  • Individu yang disiasat “bukan ahli kewangan pelarian seperti Jho Low mahupun ahli perniagaan berkuasa yang dikaitkan dengan tuduhan mafia korporat”
  • Sifat berprofil tinggi siasatan itu “kelihatan tidak setimpal dan tidak perlu”
  • SPRM “tidak boleh terlibat dalam pemburuan ahli sihir politik terhadap rakyat biasa”
  • Jika kuasa penguatkuasaan dilaksanakan secara terpilih, “Kerajaan Perpaduan pasti akan menanggung akibat politiknya”
  • Usaha antirasuah mesti “mengukuhkan demokrasi dan memastikan tadbir urus yang baik, bukannya melemahkannya dengan mewujudkan tanggapan bahawa jentera kerajaan digunakan untuk menekan atau menyenyapkan individu”

🔥 KENAPA INI PENTING

Ini bukan serangan pembangkang. Ini adalah sayap belia DAP sendiri — komponen utama gabungan Pakatan Harapan yang memerintah — secara terbuka menuduh agensi antirasuah kerajaan mewujudkan “suasana ketakutan” dan terlibat dalam “pemburuan ahli sihir politik.”

item.title: [BM] Pengerusi DAPSY Amaran SPRM Wujudkan 'Suasana Ketakutan' — Sayap Belia PH Sendiri Pecah Barisan Soal Taktik Penguatkuasaan

Antara perkara utama kenyataan itu:

  • DAPSY “amat bimbang” tentang cara SPRM menjalankan siasatan berprofil tinggi baru-baru ini

Ini bukan serangan pembangkang. Ini sayap belia DAP sendiri — komponen utama gabungan pemerintah Pakatan Harapan — secara terbuka menuduh agensi antirasuah kerajaan mewujudkan “suasana ketakutan” dan terlibat dalam “pemburuan ahli sihir politik.” Apabila sayap belia rakan gabungan anda sendiri mengeluarkan kenyataan akhbar rasmi memberi amaran bahawa SPRM mensasarkan individu secara terpilih, anda mempunyai krisis tadbir urus.

item.title: DAP Reviews Coalition Ties Over MACC Scandal — Unity Government Cracking
item.description:
