DAP called for an independent inquiry into MACC’s alleged “corporate mafia” operations, saying the government’s task force “does not go far enough.” The announcement came after weeks of Bloomberg exposés about MACC chief Azam Baki’s shareholdings and alleged misconduct.

item.title: DAPSY Chairman Warns MACC Creating 'Climate of Fear' — PH's Own Youth Wing Breaks Ranks on Enforcement Tactics
item.description:
Said by: Woo Kah Leong, DAPSY National Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 5 March 2026, DAPSY National Chairman YB Woo Kah Leong issued a formal seven-point press statement criticising the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) for conducting what he called disproportionate and intimidating investigations.

The key points of the statement:

  • DAPSY is “deeply concerned” about how MACC has conducted recent high-profile investigations
  • The individual being investigated is “neither a fugitive financier like Jho Low nor a powerful businessman linked to corporate mafia allegations”
  • The high-profile nature of the investigation “appears disproportionate and unnecessary”
  • MACC “must not engage in political witch-hunting against an ordinary citizen”
  • If enforcement powers are exercised selectively, “the Unity Government will inevitably bear the political consequences”
  • Anti-corruption efforts must “strengthen democracy and ensure good governance, instead of weakening it by creating the perception that government machinery is used to pressure or silence individuals” The statement is widely understood to refer to MACC’s search for a former aide to ex-Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli, identified in various reports as Chai. The MACC had launched a high-profile search operation that drew public attention and criticism.

🔥 WHY IT MATTERS

This is not an opposition attack. This is DAP’s own youth wing — a key component of the ruling Pakatan Harapan coalition — publicly accusing the government’s anti-corruption agency of creating a “climate of fear” and engaging in “political witch-hunting.”

item.title: Fahmi Blames 'Opposition Confusion' for PM Tenure Bill Failure — When 8 of His OWN MPs Didn't Show Up
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On March 5, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters in Putrajaya that the constitutional amendment bill to limit the PM’s tenure to 10 years failed because opposition MPs were “confused.” He claimed several opposition lawmakers mistakenly believed the bill was designed to give PM Anwar Ibrahim a 10-year term in office, rather than to cap any future PM’s tenure. Fahmi said: “There were MPs from the opposition who gave feedback to one of the ministers saying they thought the vote that day was meant to give Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim a 10-year term as prime minister.” He did not identify which opposition MPs were allegedly confused. PAS secretary-general Takiyuddin Hassan hit back, calling the claim “irresponsible” and “misplaced.”

item.title: Loke Admits DAP Failed to Get Cabinet to Agree on MACC Royal Inquiry — Reform Party Can't Reform Its Own Government
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 What Happened

On March 5, 2026, DAP’s Central Executive Committee reiterated its call for a Royal Commission of Inquiry into allegations that the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission operated as a “corporate mafia” under chief Azam Baki. DAP Secretary-General and Transport Minister Anthony Loke had first proposed the RCI to Cabinet in late February, calling the government’s response to Bloomberg’s February 11 investigative report “inadequate.” But despite repeated public calls and CEC backing, Loke subsequently admitted that DAP could not persuade Cabinet to establish the RCI. Anwar’s political secretary Kamil Azmil Munawar dismissed the proposal, stating any action “must be grounded in established facts and credible evidence” — as if a Royal Commission was not itself a fact-finding body.

item.title: PKR Accused of Lobbying US Against Najib — The SAME Thing Anwar Calls a 'Plot' When Done to Him

item.title: Anwar Claims 'Prominent Zionist Group' Behind Plot to Topple Government — Gets Sued by Daim's Family for It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told Parliament on March 3–4 that an alleged plot to topple his government involved a “prominent Zionist-linked figure,” foreign bankers, and an international media agency. He named no individual directly but said the suspects had engaged a UK-based PR firm to launch a “coordinated attack” on national institutions before the next election. Police had announced a Section 124B investigation on February 27, widely understood to target the family of late former finance minister Daim Zainuddin — specifically his widow Na’imah Abdul Khalid and their sons. On March 6, the Daim family filed a lawsuit at the Kuala Lumpur High Court against Anwar, Inspector-General of Police Mohd Khalid Ismail, and the government, seeking a declaration that the investigation is “unlawful, unconstitutional and tainted by bad faith.”

item.title: Deputy Minister Tells Parliament Hindu Endowments Must Be at State Level — The Constitution Says Otherwise
item.description:
Said by: R Yuneswaran, Deputy National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

On March 4, 2026, Deputy National Unity Minister R Yuneswaran told the Dewan Negara that Hindu endowments boards must be established at the state level, claiming this was in line with constitutional provisions under the State List of the Ninth Schedule. He was responding to a proposal by senator Dr RA Lingeshwaran for a national-level Hindu endowments board to regulate temple issues. Yuneswaran said the ministry would “fully support” states in setting up their own boards, citing Penang’s model. Former Penang assemblyman Satees Muniandy and former Penang Hindu Endowments Board chairman P Ramasamy immediately called out the deputy minister, pointing to Item 15(c) of the Federal List, which explicitly places Hindu endowments under federal — not state — jurisdiction.

item.title: Fahmi Says AG-PP Separation Bill Needs 3 More Months — PH's Flagship Reform Keeps Getting Pushed Back
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

On March 4, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced that the bill to separate the Attorney General and Public Prosecutor roles requires three more months of refinement before it can be tabled. A select committee chaired by Datuk Seri Azalina Othman Said will convene on March 16 to examine feedback from MPs. This came just one day after the government failed to pass the PM tenure limit bill — another flagship constitutional reform — falling two votes short of the required two-thirds majority. The AG-PP separation was one of Anwar’s earliest and most prominent reform pledges, first announced as part of his institutional reform package.

item.title: MACC Investigates Rafizi Over RM1.1 Billion ARM Holdings Deal — His Aide Flees to UK

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-04

In February-March 2026, MACC launched a formal investigation into a RM1.1 billion government deal with UK chip giant ARM Holdings, signed in March 2025 during Rafizi Ramli’s tenure as Economy Minister. The deal involved Malaysia Investment Development Authority (MIDA) obtaining intellectual property licences and compute subsystems valued at US$250 million, payable over 10 years.

item.title: Nearly RM1 Billion Paid in Court Damages for Government Negligence — Anwar's Fix? Letters of Reprimand
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim disclosed in a written parliamentary reply — responding to PH’s own William Leong (Selayang) — that the Malaysian government paid out RM933,360,633 in court-awarded damages between 2020 and 2025. The payouts were the result of negligence, misconduct, and other wrongdoing by government officials and agencies. Anwar outlined measures including instructing ministries to conduct investigations into the cases and “recommend disciplinary action” against those found negligent — and, spectacularly, issuing letters of reprimand.

item.title: Negri Sembilan MB Admits His Driver Runs Red Lights — 'I Have No Choice, Look at My Facebook Schedule'
item.description:
Said by: Aminuddin Harun, Menteri Besar of Negri Sembilan (PH-Lenggeng)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

On March 4, 2026, Negri Sembilan Menteri Besar Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun publicly admitted that his official car routinely runs red lights, after a viral video showed a vehicle believed to be his using blue strobe lights and a siren to blast through a red light on Jalan Rasah. Speaking to reporters after a state executive council meeting, Aminuddin said: “I admit that we have to beat the light at times, but I have no choice, as there are sometimes several official events lined up in a day.” He pointed to his Facebook page as proof of his hectic schedule. He added that a police officer is always present in the car, and that his office has sought “necessary approvals from the relevant authorities.”

item.title: [BM] Amirudin Puji Kegagalan RUU Had Penggal PM Sebagai Bukti 'Komitmen Reformasi' Anwar — Kalah Dua Undi Walaupun Pegang Majoriti Besar

Keesokan harinya, Menteri Besar Selangor Amirudin Shari memuji usaha yang gagal ini sebagai mencerminkan “komitmen Anwar terhadap reformasi” dan menyeru rakyat Malaysia jangan biarkan “satu insiden” mematikan semangat agenda reformasi, seperti dilaporkan The Star pada 3 Mac.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Dakwa 'Komplot Zionis' Jatuhkan Kerajaan Di Parlimen — Peguam Balu Daim Panggil Ia 'Pembohongan Terang-Terangan'

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Anwar buat dakwaan ini sebagai jawapan kepada soalan mengenai laporan MalaysiaNow yang mendedahkan beliau dan pemimpin kanan PKR sendiri pernah melantik perunding AS pada 2016 untuk melobi Rumah Putih menekan PM ketika itu Najib Razak. Daripada menjawab e-mel sedekad lalu itu, Anwar beralih kepada rancangan PR yang disediakan untuk Na’imah Abdul Khalid, balu bekas Menteri Kewangan Daim Zainuddin, dan mendakwa ia mengandungi konspirasi Zionis. Peguam Na’imah, Rajesh Nagarajan dan Sachpreetraj Singh, keluarkan kenyataan pada hari yang sama memanggil dakwaan Anwar “palsu, tidak masuk akal, keterlaluan, dan percubaan terang-terangan untuk mengelirukan Parlimen dan orang ramai.”

Pada 6 Mac, keluarga mendiang bekas Menteri Kewangan Daim Zainuddin — yang isterinya Na’imah Abdul Khalid dikenal pasti secara meluas sebagai sasaran siasatan — memfailkan saman terhadap Anwar, Ketua Polis Negara Mohd Khalid Ismail, dan kerajaan, mendakwa siasatan itu “menyalahi undang-undang” dan “berniat jahat.”

item.title: Amirudin Hails Failed PM Term Limit Bill as Proof of Anwar's 'Commitment to Reform' — The Bill Lost by Two Votes Despite a Supermajority

item.title: Anwar Claims 'Prominent Zionist Group' Behind Plot to Topple Government — Daim's Widow Calls It an 'Outright Lie'
item.description:

On March 3, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told Parliament that a “prominent Zionist group” was involved in an alleged plot to topple his government. He named Bloomberg as one of the media agencies targeted and said the strategy, running from August 2024 to the next general election, involved foreign lobbyists, bankers, and lawmakers. item.title: Fahmi Blames Opposition 'Confusion' for Failed PM Term Limit Bill — While 8 Government MPs Didn't Even Show Up
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 What Happened

On March 2, 2026, the Constitutional (Amendment) Bill 2026 to limit the Prime Minister’s tenure to two terms (10 years) was put to a bloc vote in the Dewan Rakyat. It needed a two-thirds supermajority of 148 votes. It got 146. Thirty-two MPs were absent, including eight from the government bloc, and 44 opposition MPs who were present abstained. The bill failed by two votes. The next day, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil blamed the opposition for “confusion” and said their abstentions proved they didn’t want to limit prime ministerial power — while glossing over the fact that his own government couldn’t even get full attendance for what was supposed to be a flagship reform.

item.title: Lynas Rare Earth License Renewed 10 Years — Radioactive Waste Still in Pahang

Category: Other

Greenpeace Malaysia warned that the country risks becoming a “pollution hub.” Environmental groups said government claims about thorium extraction from the waste are “scientifically unsound.” Close to a million tonnes of radioactive waste from Lynas’s processing operations remain stored in Pahang, with no permanent disposal solution in place.

item.title: PH's Own Term Limit Bill Falls 2 Votes Short — 32 MPs Absent, 44 Abstained, Zero Voted Against

Not a single MP voted against the bill. It failed because the government’s own coalition could not get its members into the chamber.

item.title: Anwar's Term Limit Bill Fails By Two Votes Despite Supermajority — Government's Answer? 'We'll Try Again In June'
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-02

📌 What Happened

On March 2, Malaysia’s Parliament voted down the Constitutional (Amendment) Bill 2026, which would have limited the Prime Minister’s tenure to two terms or 10 years. The bill received 146 votes — just two short of the 148 needed for a two-thirds majority. Anwar’s unity government holds at least 153 seats, meaning the bill should have passed easily. But enough coalition MPs simply did not show up. Law Minister Azalina Othman Said had championed the bill as a way to “bolster institutional integrity.” The following day, the government quietly delayed a vote on the attorney general-public prosecutor separation bill — another flagship reform promise. The government has since pledged to reintroduce the term limit bill in June.

item.title: PH's Own PM Term Limit Bill Fails by Two Votes — 8 Government MPs Didn't Even Show Up

Speaker Tan Sri Johari Abdul confirmed that 44 MPs abstained (mostly opposition), 32 were absent, and — in a telling detail — not a single MP voted against it. Among the absentees were 8 government-supporting MPs. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil later confirmed that only 2 of the 8 had submitted formal explanations; 6 had not even bothered. item.title: [BM] Saman Fitnah RM100J Azam Baki Terhadap Bloomberg — Ketua SPRM Lawan Media Bukan Rasuah

Saman itu datang selepas Bloomberg menerbitkan siasatan yang mendakwa Azam memiliki berjuta-juta saham dalam syarikat tersenarai awam — berpotensi melanggar had pemilikan penjawat awam. Bloomberg seterusnya mendakwa pegawai SPRM telah berpakat dengan ahli perniagaan untuk merancang pengambilalihan bermusuhan firma tersenarai, menggunakan serbuan dan ugutan untuk memaksa eksekutif menjual saham kepada kumpulan yang digelar “mafia korporat.” Respons Anwar ialah pasukan petugas — bukan siasatan bebas, bukan Suruhanjaya Diraja. DAP sendiri kata pasukan petugas “tidak cukup jauh.”

item.title: Azam Baki's RM100M Defamation Suit Against Bloomberg — MACC Chief Fights Media Instead of Corruption
item.description:
Said by: Bloomberg / Azam Baki, MACC Chief Commissioner

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-27

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 27 February 2026, it was reported that MACC Chief Commissioner Azam Baki filed a RM100 million defamation suit against Bloomberg. The suit came after Bloomberg published an investigation alleging that Azam owned millions of shares in publicly listed companies — potentially breaching civil servant ownership limits. Bloomberg further alleged that MACC officials had colluded with businessmen to orchestrate hostile takeovers of listed firms, using raids and intimidation to force executives into selling shares to groups dubbed the “corporate mafia.” Rather than resigning or submitting to an independent investigation, Azam chose to sue the messenger. Anwar’s response was to announce a task force — not an independent inquiry, not a Royal Commission. Even DAP, his own coalition partner, said a task force “does not go far enough.”

item.title: [BM] Timbalan Menteri Agama Arah Rakyat Ganti 'LGBT' Dengan 'Budaya Songsang' — Kerajaan Reformasi PH Kini Kawal Bahasa Rakyat
item.description:

Pada 26 Februari 2026, Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Agama) Marhamah Rosli memberitahu Dewan Negara bahawa rakyat perlu berhenti menggunakan istilah ‘LGBT’ dan menggantikannya dengan ‘budaya songsang.’ Menjawab soalan Senator Hussin Ismail mengenai usaha kerajaan memantau perhimpunan persendirian, Marhamah kata perubahan ini bertujuan “mengelakkan normalisasi” dan “membendung perkembangan algoritma kandungan berkaitan di media sosial.” Beliau juga kata ia akan memastikan “keseragaman istilah dalam pertuturan dan penulisan, serta mengelak promosi secara tidak langsung.” Arahan ini dibingkai sebagai perubahan dasar serta-merta di seluruh kerajaan.

item.title: Deputy Religious Affairs Minister Orders Public to Replace 'LGBT' With 'Deviant Culture' — PH's Reform Government Now Policing Language
item.description:
Said by: Marhamah Rosli, Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Religious Affairs)

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-26

📌 What Happened

On February 26, 2026, Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Religious Affairs) Marhamah Rosli told the Dewan Negara that the public should stop using the term ‘LGBT’ and replace it with ‘deviant culture’ (budaya songsang). Responding to a question from Senator Hussin Ismail about government efforts to monitor private gatherings, Marhamah said the change was intended to “avoid normalisation” and “curb the expansion of related content algorithms on social media platforms.” She added it would ensure “consistent terminology in speech and writing, while avoiding indirect promotion.” The directive was framed as an immediate, government-wide policy change.

Jawapannya: “Akauntabiliti bukan sahaja tentang hukuman tetapi juga pembetulan, penambahbaikan berterusan, dan tanggungjawab moral yang dipegang menteri untuk rakyat.” Tiada KPI pernah didedahkan secara awam untuk mana-mana menteri dalam kabinet Anwar. item.title: Every Cabinet Member Meeting KPIs, Says Anwar — Critics Ask: What KPIs?
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-25

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 25 February 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told Parliament that every cabinet member is meeting their KPIs and performing with integrity. He did not disclose what those KPIs were, how they were measured, or who evaluated them. Anwar was responding to an opposition MP who asked if ministers would be forced to resign for poor performance. His reply: “Accountability is not only about punishment but also correction, continuous improvement, and the moral responsibility ministers held for the people.” No KPIs have ever been publicly disclosed for any minister in Anwar’s cabinet. No minister has been penalised, demoted, or publicly reprimanded for underperformance. Two ministers were removed in the December 2025 reshuffle — including Rafizi Ramli — but Anwar framed it as “portfolio realignment,” not performance accountability.

item.title: Fahmi Confirms MCMC Blocked Grindr and Blued — PH's 'Reform Government' Now Runs Digital Censorship Against Minorities
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-25

📌 What Happened

On February 25, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil confirmed in a written parliamentary reply that the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC) has blocked the websites of Grindr and Blued — two of the world’s largest dating and networking platforms used by gay and bisexual men. Fahmi said MCMC is now “studying several legislative measures” to curb the apps from Google Play and the Apple App Store, though he acknowledged that control over foreign-owned platforms is “subject to regulations and policies set by the said platform providers.” By early March, both apps were removed from Malaysian app stores entirely. Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi separately announced a proposed Cyber Crime Bill to expand the government’s digital enforcement powers, including over “immoral” content.

item.title: Rawang Hindu Temple Demolished at Midnight — No Court Order, Police Assisted, PH State Government Silent
item.description:
Said by: Selangor PH State Government / Police

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-24

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 24 February 2026, the Sri Uchimalai Muniswaran temple in Rawang, Selangor was demolished in the middle of the night — hours after deities were allegedly relocated following pressure on the temple committee. The demolition was carried out with police assistance and without any court order.

Lawyers Rajesh Nagarajan and Sachpreetraj Singh issued a statement: “We strongly deny the claims by Yayasan Kubra representative Ariff Omar that the temple committee voluntarily removed the deities. That is false and ridiculous since the temple chairman lodged a police report only yesterday complaining that the temple was being pressured to vacate the land without any court order.”

Zafrul accused Rafizi of ‘distorting the facts’ and told him to ‘stop spinning — it’s exhausting to keep responding.’ Rafizi had argued the ART locked Malaysia into unfavourable terms. Zafrul countered that the 19% tariff no longer applied after the US Supreme Court struck down Trump’s tariff framework.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Dakwa Anwar Dalang Serangan Media Sosial Terhadapnya — Perpecahan Jadi Terbuka

Business Today melaporkan Rafizi menuduh Anwar “menyemarakkan pengaruh media sosialnya” — menggunakan akaun yang diselaraskan untuk menyerang kredibilitinya dan menjejaskan kedudukan politiknya dalam PKR. SCMP membuat susulan pada 18 Februari, merangka Rafizi sebagai merampas “panji reformasi dan kerajaan bersih yang dahulunya milik Anwar sendiri” dan bertanya sama ada beliau kini “nurani gerakan Reformasi.” Anwar menolak perpecahan sebagai “gangguan.” Rafizi sebelum ini memberi amaran kepada Anwar bahawa CPI yang mendatar di 50 mata “amat berbahaya” bagi kredibiliti kerajaan. Ganjarannya: disingkirkan dari kabinet dalam rombakan Disember 2025. Portfolio Kementerian Ekonomi dibiarkan kosong selama enam bulan selepas pemergiannya.

item.title: Rafizi Alleges Anwar Is Fueling Social Media Attacks Against Him — Rift Goes Public
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-22

Business Today reported Rafizi accused Anwar of “fueling his social media influence” — using coordinated accounts to attack his credibility and undermine his political standing within PKR. SCMP followed up on 18 February, framing Rafizi as seizing “the banner of reform and clean government that was once Anwar’s own” and asking whether he was now “the conscience of the Reformasi movement.” Anwar dismissed the rift as a “distraction.” Rafizi had previously warned Anwar that the CPI flatline at 50 points was “extremely dangerous” for the government’s credibility. His reward: being sidelined from cabinet in the December 2025 reshuffle. The Economy Ministry portfolio sat vacant for six months after his departure.

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-02-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 18 Februari 2026, Malaysia Airports Holdings Berhad (MAHB) — pengendali lapangan terbang awam yang mengurus 39 lapangan terbang seluruh negara — secara rasmi dinyahsenarai daripada Bursa Malaysia selepas konsortium GDA menyelesaikan pengambilalihannya pada RM11 sesaham. Konsortium diketuai Khazanah Nasional dan KWSP, dengan Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) BlackRock sebagai rakan utama. Kesemua lima pengarah bebas meletak jawatan sebagai bantahan, setelah menganggap tawaran itu “tidak adil dan tidak munasabah” kepada pemegang saham minoriti. Penilaian bebas Hong Leong Investment Bank menyimpulkan tawaran itu “tidak adil tetapi munasabah” — cara diplomatik berkata pemegang saham ditipu tetapi tiada pilihan lebih baik. Kumpulan masyarakat sivil membantah penglibatan GIP BlackRock di tengah kebimbangan boikot Palestin.

item.title: MAHB Delisted After GDA Takeover — Five Directors Resign in Protest
item.description:
Said by: Bursa Malaysia / GDA Consortium

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-02-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 18 February 2026, Malaysia Airports Holdings Berhad (MAHB) — the public airport operator managing 39 airports nationwide — was officially delisted from Bursa Malaysia after the GDA consortium completed its takeover at RM11 per share. The consortium was led by Khazanah Nasional and EPF, with BlackRock’s Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) as a key partner. All five independent directors resigned in protest, having deemed the offer “unfair and unreasonable” to minority shareholders. Hong Leong Investment Bank’s independent assessment concluded the offer was “not fair but reasonable” — a diplomatic way of saying shareholders were getting shortchanged but had no better option. Civil society groups protested BlackRock’s GIP involvement amid Palestine boycott concerns.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Lantik Bekas AG Kontroversi Ke Suruhanjaya Pelantikan Kehakiman — Majlis Peguam Saman Untuk Batalkan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Ahmad Terrirudin Mohd Salleh, Federal Court Judge

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 16 Februari 2026, Majlis Peguam Malaysia — mewakili 24,000 peguam — memfailkan permohonan semakan kehakiman di Mahkamah Tinggi untuk membatalkan pelantikan Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim terhadap hakim Mahkamah Persekutuan Ahmad Terrirudin Mohd Salleh ke Suruhanjaya Pelantikan Kehakiman (SPK). Terrirudin, bekas Peguam Negara Anwar, dilantik ke SPK pada 15 November 2025 walaupun merupakan hakim paling junior di bangku Mahkamah Persekutuan — melanggar konvensyen lama bahawa jawatan itu diberikan kepada hakim kanan. Majlis Peguam menamakan Anwar, Terrirudin, SPK, dan kerajaan sebagai responden.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Lantik Bekas PG Kontroversi Ke Suruhanjaya Pelantikan Kehakiman — Badan Peguam Malaysia Saman Untuk Batalkan
item.description:

Terrirudin, bekas Peguam Negara Anwar, dilantik ke SPK pada 15 November 2025 walaupun menjadi hakim paling muda di bangku Mahkamah Persekutuan — melanggar konvensyen lama bahawa jawatan itu diberikan kepada hakim kanan mahkamah tertinggi. Badan Peguam menamakan Anwar, Terrirudin, SPK, dan kerajaan sebagai responden.

item.title: Anwar Appoints Controversial Ex-AG to Judicial Appointments Commission — Malaysian Bar Sues to Quash It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Ahmad Terrirudin Mohd Salleh, Federal Court Judge

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-16

📌 What Happened

On February 16, 2026, the Malaysian Bar — representing 24,000 lawyers — filed a judicial review application at the High Court to quash Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s appointment of Federal Court judge Ahmad Terrirudin Mohd Salleh to the Judicial Appointments Commission (JAC). Terrirudin, Anwar’s former Attorney General, was appointed to the JAC on November 15, 2025 despite being the most junior judge on the Federal Court bench — breaking long-standing convention that the position goes to a senior apex court judge. The Bar named Anwar, Terrirudin, the JAC, and the government as respondents.

item.title: [BM] Gabungan Perpaduan 'Goyah' — Mandat Reformasi Tidak Ditunaikan, Perebutan Kuasa Terdedah
item.description:
Said by: UCA News Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: ‘Kerajaan Perpaduan Malaysia semakin kelihatan bukan seperti gabungan besar yang dibentuk atas kepentingan nasional tetapi lebih seperti gencatan senjata rapuh antara parti yang tidak lagi mempercayai satu sama lain.’ PH berkempen atas ikrar yang jelas, khusus, boleh diukur secara awam — kebanyakannya masih belum ditunaikan.

🔥 KENAPA INI PENTING: Apabila pemerhati antarabangsa yang bersimpati pun menggambarkan gabungan anda sebagai ‘goyah,’ naratif telah beranjak daripada ‘bolehkah mereka menyampaikan?’ kepada ‘berapa lama mereka boleh bertahan?’ Kerajaan perpaduan dijual sebagai kompromi perlu untuk menghalang puak pelampau. Tetapi kompromi tanpa penyampaian hanyalah perkongsian kuasa untuk kepentingan sendiri.

item.title: Unity Coalition 'Faltering' — Reform Mandate Unmet, Power Struggles Naked
item.description:
Said by: UCA News Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: ‘Malaysia’s Unity Government is beginning to look less like a grand coalition forged in the national interest and more like a fragile ceasefire among parties that no longer trust one another.’ PH campaigned on clear, specific, publicly measurable pledges — most remain unmet.

🔥 WHY IT MATTERS: When even sympathetic international observers describe your coalition as ‘faltering,’ the narrative has shifted from ‘can they deliver?’ to ‘how long can they survive?’ The unity government was sold as a necessary compromise to keep extremists out. But compromise without delivery is just power-sharing for its own sake.

item.title: [BM] Perang Dalaman DAP: Chow Lawan Guan Eng Soal Pelantikan Ahli Majlis Pulau Pinang
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow / Lim Guan Eng / Penang DAP

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-14

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: DAP Pulau Pinang terpaksa menjelaskan secara terbuka ‘dakwaan salah faham’ antara KM Chow Kon Yeow dan pendahulunya Lim Guan Eng mengenai pelantikan ahli majlis untuk kedua-dua majlis bandaraya. Setiausaha publisiti DAP Joshua Woo menegaskan pelantikan mengikut ‘syarat dan proses yang diperlukan’ dan konsisten dengan ‘preseden institusi.’ Kenyataan itu kawalan kerosakan selepas laporan mencadangkan perebutan kuasa puak antara kem Chow dan sekutu Guan Eng mengenai siapa mengawal pelantikan di Pulau Pinang.

item.title: DAP Internal War: Chow vs Guan Eng Over Penang Councillor Appointments
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow / Lim Guan Eng / Penang DAP

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-14

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Penang DAP was forced to publicly clarify an ‘alleged misunderstanding’ between CM Chow Kon Yeow and his predecessor Lim Guan Eng over the appointment of councillors for both city councils. DAP publicity secretary Joshua Woo insisted the appointments followed ‘required conditions and processes’ and were consistent with ‘institutional precedent.’ The statement was damage control after reports suggested a factional power struggle between Chow’s camp and Guan Eng’s allies over who controls appointments in Penang.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Bela Ketua SPRM Azam Baki Atas Skandal Pegangan Saham Kedua, Suruh Pengkritik 'Baca Penjelasannya'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada Februari 2026, Bloomberg melaporkan ketua SPRM Azam Baki merupakan pemegang saham utama dalam sebuah syarikat perkhidmatan kewangan — Velocity Capital Partners Berhad — berdasarkan pemfailan korporat. Ini merupakan skandal pegangan saham kedua Azam, berikutan kontroversi 2022 mengenai saham dalam Excel Force MSC Berhad.

Kumpulan masyarakat sivil termasuk C4 Center menuntut penggantungan segera Azam sambil menunggu siasatan. Mereka mencatat hubungan yang membimbangkan antara Velocity Capital Partners dan MMAG Holdings, di mana bekas pembantu kontroversi Anwar, Farhash Wafa Salvador, memperoleh 20% pegangan dan dilantik sebagai pengerusi.

item.title: [BM] Selangor Haramkan Semua Penternakan Babi — Amirudin Tunduk Kepada Titah Sultan, Penternak Cina Tiada Apa-Apa
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 12 Februari 2026, Menteri Besar Selangor Amirudin Shari mengumumkan kerajaan negeri telah berhenti mengeluarkan lesen penternakan babi dan akan mempercepatkan penutupan semua ladang babi sedia ada. Keputusan itu berikutan titah Sultan Sharafuddin Idris Shah, yang memerintahkan tiada ladang babi patut beroperasi di mana-mana daerah di Selangor.

Perancangan awal untuk memindahkan ladang babi ke Bukit Tagar — kawasan berpenduduk jarang di utara Selangor — ditangguhkan selepas penduduk Melayu membantah kerana berdekatan Sungai Selangor, sumber rawatan air utama. Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim campur tangan pada Januari untuk menghentikan pemindahan.

item.title: [BM] Tiong King Sing Tarik Kad 'Tahu Tak Siapa Saya?' Sambil Membebel Kakitangan Soal Biadap
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 12 Februari 2026, Menteri Pelancongan Tiong King Sing melancarkan kempen ‘Mesra Malaysia’ di KL Sentral — kempen tentang bersikap mesra dan bertimbang rasa kepada pelancong. Semasa pelancaran, Tiong mengadu tentang sikap biadap daripada kakitangan sektor awam dan swasta, berkata: “Sesetengah pegawai rasa mereka mempunyai banyak kuasa. Tetapi apabila orang tidak faham sesuatu isu, kita mesti jelaskan.”

item.title: Anwar Defends MACC Chief Azam Baki Over Second Shareholding Scandal, Tells Critics to 'Read His Explanation'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

In February 2026, Bloomberg reported that MACC chief Azam Baki was a key shareholder in a financial services company — Velocity Capital Partners Berhad — based on corporate filings. This was Azam’s second shareholding scandal, following the 2022 controversy over shares in Excel Force MSC Berhad.

Civil society groups including C4 Center demanded Azam’s immediate suspension pending investigation. They noted concerning links between Velocity Capital Partners and MMAG Holdings, where controversial former Anwar aide Farhash Wafa Salvador had acquired a 20% stake and was appointed chairman.

item.title: Selangor Bans All Pig Farming — Amirudin Caves to Sultan's Decree, Chinese Farmers Left With Nothing
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 12 February 2026, Selangor Menteri Besar Amirudin Shari announced that the state government has stopped issuing pig farming licences and will accelerate the closure of all existing pig farms. The decision followed a decree from Sultan Sharafuddin Idris Shah, who declared that no pig farms should operate in any district in Selangor.

An earlier plan to relocate pig farms to Bukit Tagar — a sparsely populated area in northern Selangor — was shelved after Malay residents objected due to proximity to Sungai Selangor, a major water treatment source. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim intervened in January to halt the relocation.

item.title: Tiong King Sing Pulls 'Do You Know Who I Am?' Card While Lecturing Staff About Rudeness
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 12 February 2026, Tourism Minister Tiong King Sing launched the ‘Mesra Malaysia’ (Friendly Malaysia) campaign at KL Sentral — a campaign about being welcoming and courteous to tourists. During the launch, Tiong complained about rudeness from public and private sector employees, saying: “Some officers think they have a lot of power. But when people don’t understand certain issues, we must explain.”

item.title: [BM] Projek MyKiosk Nga Kor Ming: Tiada Penilaian Keperluan, Tiada KPI, SPRM Panggil Kegagalan Tadbir Urus
item.description:
Said by: Nga Kor Ming, Housing and Local Government Minister

Category: Housing

Date: 2026-02-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 10 Februari 2026, Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) mendedahkan Kementerian Perumahan dan Kerajaan Tempatan (KPKT) di bawah Nga Kor Ming gagal menjalankan penilaian keperluan yang wajar sebelum melancarkan inisiatif MyKiosk — program seluruh negara untuk menyediakan kiosk moden kepada peniaga.

SPRM mengeluarkan lima cadangan penambahbaikan tadbir urus dan menyatakan: “Ketiadaan penilaian keperluan dan mekanisme pemantauan hasil yang menyeluruh, termasuk KPI, menghalang penilaian impak projek di peringkat pihak berkuasa tempatan.”

item.title: Nga Kor Ming's MyKiosk Project: No Needs Assessment, No KPIs, MACC Calls It a Governance Failure
item.description:
Said by: Nga Kor Ming, Housing and Local Government Minister

Category: Housing

Date: 2026-02-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 10 February 2026, the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) revealed that the Housing and Local Government Ministry (KPKT) under Nga Kor Ming failed to carry out a proper needs assessment before launching the MyKiosk initiative — a nationwide programme to provide traders with modern kiosks.

MACC issued five governance improvement recommendations and stated: “The absence of a needs assessment and a comprehensive outcome-monitoring mechanism, including KPIs, hindered the evaluation of the project’s impact at the local authority level.”

item.title: [BM] Pelajar Tunjuk Kad Merah Kepada Adam Adli Atas Janji AUKU Yang Dimungkiri — Anak Emas PH Sendiri Jadi Pemungkir
item.description:
Said by: Adam Adli Abdul Halim, Deputy Higher Education Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2026-02-09

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 9 Februari 2026, pelajar universiti berarak ke Parlimen menuntut pemansuhan Akta Universiti dan Kolej Universiti 1971 (AUKU). Sasaran mereka? Timbalan Menteri Pengajian Tinggi Adam Adli Abdul Halim — pernah menjadi aktivis pelajar paling terkenal Malaysia, kini penjelmaan hidup janji PH yang dimungkiri. Memansuhkan AUKU merupakan janji manifesto utama Pakatan Harapan dalam PRU14 (2018) dan PRU15 (2022). Pada lewat Januari 2026, Menteri Pengajian Tinggi Zambry Abd Kadir memberitahu Parlimen kerajaan “tidak bercadang” memansuhkan AUKU — pembalikan dasar yang disampaikan tanpa gembar-gembur. Pelajar menunjukkan kad merah kepada Adam Adli dan memanggilnya “pemungkir.” Zambry enggan menerima memorandum mereka. Adam Adli, 33, ditahan pada 2013 kerana menurunkan bendera di perhimpunan pelajar — tindakan yang menjadikannya simbol gerakan pelajar. PH memperjuangkan kesnya sebagai bukti AUKU tidak adil. Kini beliau duduk dalam kementerian yang menguatkuasakannya.

item.title: Students Flash Red Cards at Adam Adli Over Broken UUCA Promise — PH's Own Poster Boy Turns Reneger
item.description:
Said by: Adam Adli Abdul Halim, Deputy Higher Education Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2026-02-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 9 February 2026, university students marched to Parliament demanding the abolition of the Universities and University Colleges Act 1971 (UUCA). Their target? Deputy Higher Education Minister Adam Adli Abdul Halim — once Malaysia’s most famous student activist, now the living embodiment of PH’s broken promise. Abolishing UUCA was a key manifesto promise by Pakatan Harapan in both GE14 (2018) and GE15 (2022). In late January 2026, Higher Education Minister Zambry Abd Kadir told Parliament the government had “no plans” to abolish UUCA — a policy reversal delivered without fanfare. Students flashed red cards at Adam Adli and called him a “reneger.” Zambry refused to receive their memorandum. Adam Adli, 33, was arrested in 2013 for lowering a flag at a student rally — an act that made him a symbol of the student movement. PH championed his case as proof that UUCA was unjust. Now he sits in the ministry that enforces it.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Fadzil: Kebebasan Bersuara Bukan Bermakna Bebas Menghina Dalam Talian
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-07

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 7 Februari 2026, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memberitahu orang ramai bahawa kebebasan bersuara tidak bermakna bebas menghina atau memfitnah dalam talian. Ini selepas Mahkamah Persekutuan mengembalikan Seksyen 233 Akta Komunikasi dan Multimedia (AKM), yang menjenayahkan kandungan yang dianggap “amat menyinggung” — peruntukan yang PH pernah tentang. Fahmi berkata pindaan 2024 menaikkan ambang daripada “menyinggung” kepada “amat menyinggung,” mendakwa ini menjadikannya lebih sukar disalahguna. Akta Keselamatan Dalam Talian 2025 (ONSA) berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2026, memberikan SKMM kuasa mengenakan penalti sehingga RM10 juta kepada platform yang gagal membuang kandungan berbahaya. SKMM — badan yang memutuskan apa yang “amat menyinggung” — melapor terus kepada kementerian Fahmi.

item.title: Fahmi Fadzil: Free Speech Doesn't Mean Freedom to Offend Online
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-02-07

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 7 February 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told the public that free speech does not mean freedom to offend or defame online. This came after the Federal Court reinstated Section 233 of the Communications and Multimedia Act (CMA), which criminalises content deemed “grossly offensive” — a provision PH once opposed. Fahmi said the 2024 amendments raised the threshold from “offensive” to “grossly offensive,” claiming this made it harder to misuse. The Online Safety Act 2025 (ONSA) took effect on 1 January 2026, giving MCMC powers to penalise platforms up to RM10 million for failing to remove harmful content. MCMC — the body that decides what is “grossly offensive” — reports directly to Fahmi’s ministry.

item.title: [BM] SPRM Siasat Pegawai Kanan Negeri Pulau Pinang Soal Urus Niaga Tanah — Chow Kata 'Kami Bukan Penyiasat'
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-31

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 31 Januari 2026, KM Pulau Pinang Chow Kon Yeow mengesahkan SPRM sedang menyiasat dakwaan salah guna kuasa melibatkan pegawai kanan negeri mengenai urus niaga tanah. Chow berkata kerajaan negeri akan ‘memberikan ruang penuh’ kepada SPRM dan tidak akan menjalankan siasatan dalaman sendiri. ‘Kami bukan penyiasat, tetapi kami akan memberikan kerjasama penuh,’ beliau memberitahu wartawan. Pegawai tersebut dilaporkan terus menjalankan tugas seperti biasa semasa siasatan.

item.title: MACC Probes Senior Penang State Official Over Land Deal — Chow Says 'We Are Not Investigators'
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-31

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 31 January 2026, Penang CM Chow Kon Yeow confirmed that MACC was investigating allegations of abuse of power involving a senior state official over a land deal. Chow said the state government would ‘give full space’ to MACC and would not conduct its own internal probe. ‘We are not investigators, but we will provide full cooperation,’ he told reporters. The official was reportedly continuing to perform duties as usual during the investigation.

item.title: [BM] Kualiti Air Sungai Merosot — Lebih Banyak Sungai Tercemar Pada 2025 Berbanding 2024
item.description:
Said by: Natural Resources Ministry

Category: Other

Date: 2026-01-28

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Menurut data yang dikeluarkan Kementerian Sumber Asli pada lewat Januari 2026, kualiti air sungai Malaysia merosot tahun ke tahun. Sungai bersih menurun daripada 486 kepada 468. Sungai berkualiti “sederhana” meningkat daripada 161 kepada 171. Sungai “sedikit tercemar” melonjak daripada 25 kepada 33. Angka bergerak ke arah yang salah merentasi setiap kategori. Kemerosotan ini berlaku ketika kerajaan secara agresif mendorong pengembangan perlombongan nadir bumi — satu tapak di Perak sudah menukarkan sungai kepada warna biru akibat pelepasan perlombongan — dan terus mempromosikan Malaysia sebagai peneraju “ekonomi hijau.”

item.title: River Water Quality Declining — More Polluted Rivers in 2025 Than 2024
item.description:
Said by: Natural Resources Ministry

Category: Other

Date: 2026-01-28

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: According to data released by the Natural Resources Ministry in late January 2026, Malaysia’s river water quality deteriorated year-over-year. Clean rivers dropped from 486 to 468. “Moderate” quality rivers rose from 161 to 171. “Slightly polluted” rivers jumped from 25 to 33. The numbers are moving in the wrong direction across every category. This decline occurred as the government aggressively pushed rare earth mining expansion — one site in Perak already turned a river visibly blue from mining discharges — and continued to promote Malaysia as a “green economy” leader.

item.title: [BM] Kajian Malaysia: Analisis Kos-Faedah Perjanjian Dagang AS Tunjuk 'Kebimbangan' Tetapi Kerajaan Kata Jangan Keluar
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian Government

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-01-27

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2026, Bloomberg melaporkan kerajaan Malaysia mengumumkan analisis kos-faedah rasmi terhadap Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik (ART) AS-Malaysia yang kontroversi — berikutan kritikan berbulan-bulan daripada bekas AG Tommy Thomas (yang memanggilnya “perjanjian terburuk sejak merdeka”), bekas PM Mahathir, badan pemikir, dan ahli politik pembangkang. Tetapi dalam nafas yang sama, kerajaan memberi amaran kepada penggubal undang-undang supaya tidak keluar daripada pakatan. East Asia Forum menerbitkan analisis terperinci bertajuk “The Art of the Deal Lost in US-Malaysia Pact,” dengan hujah bahawa Malaysia menyerahkan kawalan eksport mineral kritikal, hak percukaian perkhidmatan digital, dan dasar perdagangan bebas sebagai pertukaran untuk pengurangan tarif daripada 25% kepada 19% — masih punitif mengikut mana-mana ukuran. Butiran perjanjian pertama kali diterbitkan di laman web Rumah Putih sebelum dikongsi dengan Parlimen Malaysia.

item.title: [BM] Kajian Malaysia: Analisis Kos-Manfaat Perjanjian Perdagangan AS Tunjuk 'Kebimbangan' Tetapi Kerajaan Kata Jangan Keluar
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian Government

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-01-27

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2026, Bloomberg melaporkan kerajaan Malaysia mengumumkan analisis kos-manfaat rasmi terhadap perjanjian Agreed Reciprocal Trade (ART) AS-Malaysia yang kontroversi — berikutan kritikan bertambah daripada bekas AG Tommy Thomas (yang menyebutnya “perjanjian paling teruk sejak merdeka”), bekas PM Mahathir, kumpulan pemikir, dan ahli politik pembangkang. Tetapi dalam nafas yang sama, kerajaan memberi amaran kepada penggubal undang-undang agar tidak meninggalkan pakatan. East Asia Forum menerbitkan analisis terperinci bertajuk “The Art of the Deal Lost in US-Malaysia Pact,” berhujah Malaysia menyerahkan kawalan eksport mineral kritikal, hak percukaian perkhidmatan digital, dan dasar perdagangan bebas sebagai ganti pengurangan tarif daripada 25% kepada 19% — masih menghukum menurut sebarang piawaian. Butiran perjanjian pertama kali diterbitkan di laman web Rumah Putih sebelum dikongsi dengan Parlimen Malaysia.

item.title: Malaysia Study: Cost-Benefit Analysis of US Trade Deal Shows 'Concerns' But Government Says Don't Quit
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian Government

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-01-27

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2026, Bloomberg reported that the Malaysian government announced a formal cost-benefit analysis of the controversial US-Malaysia Agreed Reciprocal Trade (ART) agreement — following months of mounting criticism from former AG Tommy Thomas (who called it “the worst agreement since independence”), former PM Mahathir, think tanks, and opposition politicians. But in the same breath, the government warned lawmakers not to quit the pact. East Asia Forum published a detailed analysis titled “The Art of the Deal Lost in US-Malaysia Pact,” arguing Malaysia surrendered critical mineral export controls, digital services taxation rights, and independent trade policy in exchange for a tariff reduction from 25% to 19% — still punitive by any standard. The deal’s details were first published on the White House website before being shared with Malaysian Parliament.

item.title: [BM] Krisis Pembuangan Sisa Haram Selangor — Bertahun Janji, Sifar Hasil Di Bawah Amirudin
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 26 Januari 2026, Amirudin Shari mengisytiharkan ’tiada lagi tunding jari’ dan mengarahkan ’tindakan keras menyeluruh’ terhadap pembuangan sisa haram di seluruh Selangor. Beliau berkata akan melawat tapak secara peribadi bersama pihak berkuasa tempatan dan ‘mengambil tindakan tegas.’ Beliau mengarahkan Pejabat Tanah dan pihak berkuasa tempatan memberi tumpuan kepada kebersihan. Ini berikutan pengisytiharan serupa pada awal 2026 di mana kerajaan Selangor mengumumkan usaha diperhebat untuk ‘membasmi’ pembuangan sisa haram.

item.title: [BM] Zulkifli Hasan Kata Tekanan Kerja Boleh Jadikan Orang Gay — Masyarakat Antarabangsa Ketawa, Malaysia Meringis
item.description:
Said by: Zulkifli Hasan, Minister in PM’s Department (Religious Affairs)

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 26 Januari 2026, Menteri Hal Ehwal Agama Zulkifli Hasan mengemukakan jawapan bertulis parlimen kepada AP PAS Siti Zailah Mohd Yusoff mengenai trend LGBT di Malaysia. Beliau memetik kajian 2017 dan menyenaraikan “pengaruh masyarakat, pengalaman seksual, tekanan kerja, dan faktor peribadi lain” sebagai kemungkinan punca “tingkah laku LGBT.” Dakwaan “tekanan kerja” segera menjadi viral — di peringkat global. CNA, SCMP, NDTV, Reuters, Hindustan Times, LGBTQ Nation, dan them.us semuanya melaporkannya. Rakyat Malaysia membanjiri media sosial dengan sindiran, secara sarkastik bertanya sama ada ahli parlimen sudah “menjadi gay” kerana mereka nampaknya tidak pernah bekerja cukup keras untuk mengalami tekanan. Zulkifli juga mendedahkan bahawa dari 2022 hingga 2025, 135 kes berkaitan “aktiviti LGBT” direkodkan sebagai tangkapan atau pendakwaan — di negara di mana hubungan sejenis masih dijenayahkan.

item.title: Selangor's Illegal Waste Dumping Crisis — Years of Promises, Zero Results Under Amirudin
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 26 January 2026, Amirudin Shari declared ’no more finger pointing’ and ordered a ’total crackdown’ on illegal waste dumping across Selangor. He said he would personally visit sites with local authorities and ’take firm action.’ He instructed the Land Office and local authorities to focus on cleanliness. This follows a similar declaration in early 2026 where the Selangor government announced intensified efforts to ’eradicate’ illegal waste dumping.

item.title: Zulkifli Hasan Says Work Stress Can Make People Gay — International Community Laughs, Malaysia Cringes
item.description:
Said by: Zulkifli Hasan, Minister in PM’s Department (Religious Affairs)

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On January 26, 2026, Religious Affairs Minister Zulkifli Hasan submitted a written parliamentary reply to PAS MP Siti Zailah Mohd Yusoff about LGBT trends in Malaysia. He cited a 2017 study and listed “societal influence, sexual experiences, work stress, and other personal factors” as possible causes of “LGBT behaviour.” The “work stress” claim went immediately viral — globally. CNA, SCMP, NDTV, Reuters, Hindustan Times, LGBTQ Nation, and them.us all covered it. Malaysians flooded social media with mockery, sarcastically asking whether parliament MPs had “turned gay” since they apparently never work hard enough to experience stress. Zulkifli also disclosed that from 2022 to 2025, 135 cases related to “LGBT activities” were recorded as arrests or prosecutions — in a country where same-sex relations remain criminalised.

item.title: [BM] Bahasa Melayu dan Sejarah Wajib Merentas SEMUA Sistem Pendidikan — Pengkritik Kata Ia Menyekat Kepelbagaian
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2026-01-21

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan bahawa Bahasa Melayu dan Sejarah akan diwajibkan merentas semua sistem pendidikan di Malaysia — termasuk sekolah vernakular (SJKC dan SJKT), sekolah antarabangsa, dan institusi swasta. Anwar berkata keperluan ini bertujuan “mengukuhkan kedudukan Bahasa Melayu sebagai bahasa kebangsaan” dan memberikan “pemahaman bersama tentang sejarah negara.” Pengkritik berhujah bahawa ini menjejaskan perlindungan perlembagaan untuk pendidikan vernakular di bawah Perkara 152(1)(a) dan menyekat kepelbagaian yang menjadikan sistem pendidikan Malaysia unik. Analisis mendalam CNA menyatakan “politik dan kesukaran” pembaharuan pendidikan Malaysia, menggambarkan bagaimana “bahasa dan agama” kekal sebagai bidang dasar paling mudah terbakar.

item.title: Mandatory Malay and History Across ALL Education Systems — Critics Say It Stifles Diversity
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2026-01-21

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced that Bahasa Melayu and History would be mandatory across all education systems in Malaysia — including vernacular schools (SJKC and SJKT), international schools, and private institutions. Anwar said the requirement aims to “bolster the status of Bahasa Melayu as the national language” and provide “a common understanding of national history.” Critics argued this undermines constitutional protections for vernacular education under Article 152(1)(a) and stifles the diversity that makes Malaysia’s education system unique. CNA’s in-depth analysis noted the “politics and difficulties” of Malaysian education reform, describing how “language and religion” remain the most combustible policy areas.

item.title: [BM] Wartawan FMT Rex Tan Ditangkap Di Bawah Akta Hasutan Kerana Bertanya 'Soalan Sensitif'
item.description:
Said by: Royal Malaysia Police

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-17

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2026, wartawan Free Malaysia Today Rex Tan ditangkap pada waktu subuh di bawah Akta Hasutan 1948 era penjajah kerana bertanya soalan di perdebatan awam yang mengaitkan krisis Gaza dengan layanan terhadap etnik Cina di Malaysia. Polis tiba di rumah Tan awal pagi Sabtu — lima hari selepas perdebatan — dan menangkapnya di bawah Seksyen 4(1) Akta Hasutan. Soalan itu provokatif tetapi jelas berada dalam sempadan wacana awam yang sah. SCMP melaporkan tangkapan itu “menimbulkan keraguan terhadap rekod pembaharuan Anwar.” Pertubuhan kebebasan akhbar antarabangsa, termasuk RSF dan CPJ, mengecam tangkapan tersebut. Lebih 90 tangkapan berkaitan hasutan telah berlaku sejak Anwar mengambil alih kuasa pada akhir 2022.

item.title: FMT Journalist Rex Tan Arrested Under Sedition Act for Asking a 'Sensitive Question'
item.description:
Said by: Royal Malaysia Police

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-17

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2026, Free Malaysia Today journalist Rex Tan was arrested at dawn under the colonial-era Sedition Act 1948 for asking a question at a public debate that linked the Gaza crisis to the treatment of ethnic Chinese in Malaysia. Police arrived at Tan’s home early on a Saturday morning — five days after the debate — and arrested him under Section 4(1) of the Sedition Act. The question was provocative but fell squarely within the bounds of legitimate public discourse. SCMP reported the arrest “casts doubts on Anwar’s reform record.” International press freedom organisations, including RSF and CPJ, condemned the arrest. Over 90 sedition-related arrests have occurred since Anwar took power in late 2022.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Menyeru 'Kesabaran dan Kebijaksanaan' Selepas Setiap Krisis — Tetapi Tidak Pernah Akauntabiliti
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Merentas setiap krisis besar dari 2024 hingga 2026, respons Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengikut templat yang sama: akui isu, seru “kesabaran dan kebijaksanaan,” ketepikan pengkritik, dan teruskan tanpa perubahan struktur. Apabila 47 pertuduhan Zahid digugurkan: “Saya tidak campur tangan dalam keputusan PG.” Apabila Shamsul Iskandar ditangkap mengeluarkan surat sokongan: “Surat itu kabur” — teguran sahaja. Apabila tawaran tahanan rumah Najib dibangkitkan: “Bertindak balas dengan kesabaran dan kebijaksanaan.” Apabila Bersih mengkritik SPRM: “Tidak adil” — suruh mereka tunggu. Apabila harga diesel naik: “Kita akan dikritik dengan fitnah dan pembohongan.” Apabila kedai KK Mart dibom api: “Jangan jadi pendakwa atau hakim.” Apabila PH dihapuskan di Sabah: “Kekalahan tidak akan hentikan pelaksanaan.” Apabila Rafizi menuduhnya serangan media sosial: memanggilnya “gangguan.”

item.title: Anwar Calls for 'Patience and Wisdom' After Every Crisis — But Never Accountability
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Across every major crisis from 2024 to 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s response has followed the same template: acknowledge the issue, call for “patience and wisdom,” dismiss critics, and move on without structural change. When Zahid’s 47 charges were dropped: “I don’t interfere in AG decisions.” When Shamsul Iskandar was caught issuing support letters: “The letters were vague” — reprimand only. When Najib’s house arrest bid was raised: “Respond with patience and wisdom.” When Bersih criticised MACC: “Unfair” — told them to wait. When diesel prices hiked: “We will be criticised with slander and lies.” When KK Mart stores were firebombed: “Don’t be prosecutor or judge.” When PH was wiped out in Sabah: “Defeat won’t stop delivery.” When Rafizi accused him of social media attacks: called it a “distraction.”

item.title: [BM] Solidariti Palestin Tetapi Senyap Mengenai Uyghur — Piawai Berganda Terdedah
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Critics

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-13

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sepanjang 2025 dan memasuki 2026, Malaysia di bawah Anwar Ibrahim mengekalkan salah satu pendirian paling lantang di dunia mengenai hak rakyat Palestin — memutuskan hubungan diplomatik dengan Israel, memboikot syarikat berkaitan Israel, dan menceramahi pemimpin dunia tentang “kemunafikan moral.” Walau bagaimanapun, pengkritik menunjukkan piawai berganda yang ketara: kesunyian Malaysia terhadap penganiayaan China ke atas Muslim Uyghur di Xinjiang, tindakan keras brutal Iran terhadap perbezaan pendapat dalaman, krisis kemanusiaan Yaman, dan genosid Myanmar terhadap Muslim Rohingya. Perbincangan Reddit dalam kalangan rakyat Malaysia menuduh kerajaan “aktivisme terpilih.” The Hindu melaporkan Malaysia “mengecam piawai berganda mengenai kekejaman Gaza” — sambil mengamalkan piawai bergandanya sendiri terhadap krisis majoriti Muslim yang lain.

item.title: Palestine Solidarity But Silence on Uyghurs — Double Standards Exposed
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Critics

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-13

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Throughout 2025 and into 2026, Malaysia under Anwar Ibrahim maintained one of the most vocal stances globally on Palestinian rights — cutting diplomatic ties with Israel, boycotting Israeli-linked companies, and lecturing world leaders about “moral hypocrisy.” However, critics pointed out a glaring double standard: Malaysia’s silence on China’s persecution of Uyghur Muslims in Xinjiang, Iran’s brutal crackdown on internal dissent, the Yemen humanitarian crisis, and Myanmar’s genocide against Rohingya Muslims. Reddit discussions among Malaysians accused the government of “selective activism.” The Hindu reported Malaysia “slams double standards on Gaza atrocities” — while practising its own double standards on other Muslim-majority crises.

item.title: [BM] Adakah 2026 Tahun PH Tunaikan Janji Pembaharuan? — FMT Bertanya, Sekali Lagi
item.description:
Said by: FMT editorial

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 10 Januari 2026, FMT menerbitkan artikel pendapat bertajuk “Adakah 2026 tahun PH menunaikan janji pembaharuan?” — soalan yang sama ditanya pada Januari 2024 dan Januari 2025. Pada 5 Januari, Anwar memberikan ucapan Tahun Baru menjanjikan bahawa janji pembaharuan akan “terlaksana tahun ini,” mengumumkan rang undang-undang pemisahan PG-PP akan menjadi “rang undang-undang pertama dibentangkan.” Rang undang-undang itu memang dibentangkan — kemudian serta-merta dirujuk kepada jawatankuasa parlimen untuk tiga bulan lagi “semakan.” Janji ini telah tertangguh sejak PRU14 pada 2018, kini lapan tahun tidak ditunaikan. Kad laporan pembaharuan selepas tiga tahun penuh: pemisahan PG-PP dihantar ke jawatankuasa, AUKU “tiada rancangan” untuk dimansuhkan, Akta Hasutan digunakan 90+ kali dan bukannya dimansuhkan, ICCPR tidak disahkan, pemansuhan tol digantikan dengan pembekuan RM591J, rang undang-undang had penggal PM gagal dengan 2 undi, IPCMC tidak ditubuhkan, Akta Kebebasan Maklumat tidak dibentangkan, pilihan raya kerajaan tempatan tidak dipulihkan.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Ceramah Dunia Tentang Kemunafikan Gaza — Sambil Mengamalkan Kemunafikan Terhadap Setiap Janji Pembaharuan di Tanah Air
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim / NST Report Jan 2026

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2026, Anwar Ibrahim menjadi tajuk berita antarabangsa menceramahi pemimpin dunia tentang “kemunafikan moral” mengenai Gaza, berkata “kepimpinan global gagal Gaza di tengah kemunafikan moral.” Beliau telah meletakkan dirinya sebagai suara utama untuk hak rakyat Palestin di pentas dunia, menghadiri sidang kemuncak, mengeluarkan kecaman, dan memutuskan hubungan diplomatik dengan Israel. CSIS menerbitkan analisis bertajuk “Kematian Reformasi” yang meneliti bagaimana postur antarabangsa Anwar berbeza dengan rekod domestiknya.

item.title: Anwar Lectures World on Gaza Hypocrisy — While Practising Hypocrisy on Every Reform Promise at Home
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim / NST Report Jan 2026

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2026, Anwar Ibrahim made international headlines lecturing global leaders about “moral hypocrisy” on Gaza, saying “global leadership is failing Gaza amid moral hypocrisy.” He has positioned himself as a leading voice for Palestinian rights on the world stage, attending summits, issuing condemnations, and cutting diplomatic ties with Israel. CSIS published an analysis titled “Death of Reformasi” examining how Anwar’s international posturing contrasts with his domestic record.

item.title: Will 2026 Be the Year PH Fulfils Its Reform Promises? — FMT Asks, Again
item.description:
Said by: FMT editorial

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 10 January 2026, FMT published an opinion piece titled “Will 2026 be the year PH fulfils its reform promises?” — the same question asked in January 2024 and January 2025. On 5 January, Anwar gave a New Year address promising that reform pledges would “materialise this year,” announcing the AG-PP separation bill would be “the first bill to be tabled.” The bill was indeed tabled — then immediately referred to a parliamentary committee for three more months of “review.” This promise has been pending since GE14 in 2018, now eight years unfulfilled. The reform scorecard after three full years: AG-PP separation sent to committee, UUCA “no plans” to abolish, Sedition Act used 90+ times instead of repealed, ICCPR unratified, toll abolition replaced by RM591M freezes, PM term limit bill failed by 2 votes, IPCMC not established, Freedom of Information Act not tabled, local government elections not restored.

item.title: [BM] 47 Pertuduhan Rasuah Zahid Hamidi NFA — 'Bukti Tidak Mencukupi' Selepas 7 Tahun
item.description:
Said by: Attorney-General’s Chambers

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-08

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 8 Januari 2026, Jabatan Peguam Negara (AGC) menamatkan semua 47 pertuduhan jenayah terhadap Timbalan Perdana Menteri Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, memetik “bukti tidak mencukupi.” Pertuduhan — difailkan pada 2018 selepas UMNO kehilangan kuasa — melibatkan RM31 juta daripada Yayasan Akalbudi, yayasan kebajikan yang dikawal Zahid. Pertuduhan termasuk pecah amanah jenayah, rasuah, dan pengubahan wang haram. Reuters melaporkan AGC mengeluarkan pelepasan tidak berjumlah pembebasan (DNAA) untuk sesetengah pertuduhan dan pembebasan penuh untuk yang lain. Majlis Peguam Malaysia membantah. CSIS menerbitkan analisis bertajuk “Kematian Reformasi.” The Diplomat memanggilnya penggugurkan pertuduhan terhadap “sekutu utama Anwar.”

item.title: Zahid Hamidi's 47 Corruption Charges NFA'd — 'Insufficient Evidence' After 7 Years
item.description:
Said by: Attorney-General’s Chambers

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-08

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 8 January 2026, the Attorney-General’s Chambers (AGC) ended all 47 criminal charges against Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, citing “insufficient evidence.” The charges — filed in 2018 after UMNO lost power — involved RM31 million from Yayasan Akalbudi, a charitable foundation Zahid controlled. The charges included criminal breach of trust, corruption, and money laundering. Reuters reported the AGC issued a discharge not amounting to an acquittal (DNAA) for some charges and a full acquittal for others. The Malaysian Bar objected. CSIS published an analysis titled “Death of Reformasi.” The Diplomat called it the dropping of charges against “a key Anwar ally.”

item.title: [BM] Cengkaman UMNO Ke Atas PH — Zahid Bebas Sambil Menentukan Dasar Gabungan
item.description:
Said by: Political Analysts / Opposition

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Dinamik paling merosakkan dalam politik Malaysia hari ini ialah pengaruh UMNO yang tidak seimbang ke atas PH dalam gabungan kerajaan perpaduan. TPM Ahmad Zahid Hamidi — yang 47 pertuduhan rasuahnya digugurkan dalam keputusan NFA yang mengejutkan komuniti undang-undang — kini secara efektif memegang kuasa veto ke atas dasar kerajaan. Sokongan UMNO penting untuk majoriti parlimen PH, dan UMNO tahu itu. Hasilnya: Zahid bebas, Najib mendapat pengurangan hukuman dan tawaran tahanan rumah, pemisahan PG-PP terbantut, DAP dipinggirkan dalam rombakan kabinet, dan agenda anti-rasuah secara fungsinya mati. UCA News menggambarkan gabungan perpaduan sebagai mempunyai “mandat yang retak.” CNA melaporkan Anwar menghadapi “krisis rasuah” dengan “perpecahan parti PKR” dan “kegelisahan gabungan PH.”

item.title: [BM] Doktor Kontrak: 33,000 MASIH Menunggu Jawatan Tetap — Janji Dibuat Pada 2020, Masih Dimungkiri Pada 2026
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian Medical Association / Contract Doctors

Category: Health

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sehingga Januari 2026, kira-kira 33,000 doktor kontrak dalam sistem penjagaan kesihatan awam Malaysia terus bekerja dengan kontrak sementara tanpa jaminan pekerjaan, faedah pencen, atau laluan kemajuan kerjaya yang tersedia untuk pegawai perubatan tetap. Sistem kontrak diperkenalkan sebagai langkah “sementara” untuk menyerap lonjakan graduan perubatan. Enam tahun kemudian, ia masih “sementara.” Doktor kontrak melakukan kerja yang sama dengan doktor tetap — mereka melihat pesakit yang sama, bekerja minggu 84 jam yang sama, mengendalikan kecemasan yang sama — tetapi tanpa status pekerjaan tetap. CNA melaporkan mengenai krisis “kekurangan doktor, gaji rendah, minggu kerja 84 jam.” P4H Network menggambarkan sistem penjagaan kesihatan Malaysia sebagai “bom jangka.”

item.title: [BM] Gaji Tidak Setanding Kos — Kuasa Beli Sebenar MEROSOT Di Bawah PH
item.description:
Said by: DOSM / BNM / Consumer Groups

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Walaupun gaji nominal meningkat sedikit di bawah PH — gaji minimum dinaikkan kepada RM1,500, kenaikan gaji sederhana merentas sektor — kos sara hidup telah meningkat lebih pantas. Diesel naik 56%. SST diperluaskan untuk meliputi lebih banyak keperluan asas. Harga makanan tertinggi di Asia Tenggara pada $1,940 seorang setahun menurut data USDA. Kos elektrik naik. Harga hartanah naik. Hasilnya: kuasa beli sebenar — apa yang ringgit anda benar-benar mampu beli — telah merosot bagi kebanyakan rakyat Malaysia. Tinjauan pengguna 2025 mendapati 77% rakyat Malaysia berkata kos telah meningkat dengan ketara, manakala inflasi rasmi mendakwa hanya 1.3%.

item.title: [BM] Generasi TikTok Hilang — Masa Skrin Belia Malaysia Antara Tertinggi di Dunia Manakala Kerajaan Rancang Haramkan Bawah 16 Tahun
item.description:
Said by: MCMC / Online Safety Act

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Belia Malaysia mempunyai antara masa skrin dan kadar penggunaan media sosial tertinggi di dunia. Respons kerajaan ialah Akta Keselamatan Dalam Talian, yang mengharamkan penggunaan media sosial untuk kanak-kanak bawah 16 tahun mulai 2026. Undang-undang ini meletakkan tanggungjawab penguatkuasaan kepada platform, dengan penalti sehingga RM10 juta untuk ketidakpatuhan. Walau bagaimanapun, butiran pelaksanaan kekal kabur — tiada prasarana pengesahan umur wujud, tiada kerangka teknikal diumumkan, dan mekanisme penguatkuasaan belum diuji. Laporan Freedom House 2024 menandakan trajektori kebebasan internet Malaysia yang merosot di bawah PH.

item.title: [BM] Langkah Khas Anwar: Whataboutisme — 'Tetapi BN Juga Buat' Bukan Agenda Pembaharuan
item.description:
Said by: Parliamentary Hansard / Media Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Corak retorik yang jelas telah muncul dalam respons parlimen dan awam Anwar Ibrahim terhadap kritikan: alihkan kepada apa yang kerajaan terdahulu atau pembangkang lakukan. Apabila dicabar mengenai surat sokongan untuk tender kerajaan, beliau menunjuk Kelantan. Apabila dicabar mengenai lobi, beliau membawa PKR dahulu. Apabila dicabar mengenai kegagalan pembaharuan, beliau memanggil “keadaan kucar-kacir yang kami warisi.” Ini adalah whataboutisme sistematik yang digunakan sebagai strategi pentadbiran. The Star melaporkan Anwar “menegur kemunafikan pembangkang mengenai surat sokongan” — menukarkan soalan tentang kelakuan kerajaannya sendiri menjadi serangan terhadap pembangkang. CSIS, dalam analisis “Kematian Reformasi"nya, menyatakan bagaimana Anwar secara konsisten mengalih akauntabiliti dengan membingkai semula kritikan sebagai niat jahat pembangkang.

item.title: [BM] Platform Media Sosial Dipaksa 'Dianggap Berlesen' — MCMC Ketatkan Cengkaman Internet
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Mulai 1 Januari 2026, platform media sosial dan pemesejan segera dengan 8 juta atau lebih pengguna Malaysia secara automatik “dianggap berlesen” di bawah kerangka kawal selia MCMC — sama ada mereka memohon lesen atau tidak. Ini bermakna platform seperti Meta (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), TikTok, Telegram, dan X kini tertakluk kepada keperluan perlesenan kerajaan Malaysia, kewajipan penyingkiran kandungan, dan penalti untuk ketidakpatuhan. Meta secara terbuka memberi amaran skim itu “kurang kejelasan dan mengancam inovasi.” Soyacincau melaporkan bahawa pendekatan MCMC secara efektif memintas proses permohonan perlesenan biasa dengan secara unilateral menganggap platform sebagai berlesen. Reuters melaporkan kebimbangan Meta mengenai kekaburan kerangka kawal selia.

item.title: [BM] Tiada Kerangka Akauntabiliti PRU16 — PH Tiada Sistem untuk Pengundi Jejak Kemajuan Manifesto
item.description:
Said by: Governance Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Tidak seperti beberapa negara demokrasi di mana kemajuan manifesto kerajaan dijejak secara terbuka, PH tidak mewujudkan sistem rasmi untuk pengundi memantau penyampaian terhadap kira-kira 60 janji yang dibuat dalam PRU15. Tiada papan pemuka awam, tiada laporan kemajuan manifesto tahunan, dan tiada mekanisme berstruktur untuk masyarakat sivil mempertanggungjawabkan kerajaan terhadap komitmen khususnya. Malaysiakini mewujudkan penjejak manifesto bebas kerana kerajaan tidak mahu. The Straits Times menjejak kemajuan PH 1.0 dan mendapati kebanyakan janji “masih jauh dari tercapai” selepas hanya satu tahun.

item.title: Anwar's Signature Move: Whataboutism — 'But BN Did It Too' Is Not a Reform Agenda
item.description:
Said by: Parliamentary Hansard / Media Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: A clear rhetorical pattern has emerged in Anwar Ibrahim’s parliamentary and public responses to criticism: deflect to what previous governments or the opposition did. When challenged on support letters for government tenders, he pointed to Kelantan. When challenged on lobbying, he brought up PKR’s past. When challenged on reform failures, he invokes the “mess we inherited.” This is systematic whataboutism deployed as governance strategy. The Star reported Anwar “calls out opposition’s hypocrisy over support letters” — turning a question about his own government’s conduct into an attack on the opposition. CSIS, in its “Death of Reformasi” analysis, noted how Anwar consistently deflects accountability by reframing criticism as opposition bad faith.

item.title: Contract Doctors: 33,000 STILL Waiting for Permanent Posts — Promise Made in 2020, Still Broken in 2026
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian Medical Association / Contract Doctors

Category: Health

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: As of January 2026, approximately 33,000 contract doctors in Malaysia’s public healthcare system continue to work on temporary contracts without job security, pension benefits, or career advancement pathways available to permanent medical officers. The contract system was introduced as a “temporary” measure to absorb a surge of medical graduates. Six years later, it is still “temporary.” Contract doctors do the same work as permanent doctors — they see the same patients, work the same 84-hour weeks, handle the same emergencies — but without permanent employment status. CNA reported on the “doctor shortage, low pay, 84-hour working week” crisis. P4H Network described Malaysia’s healthcare system as a “ticking bomb.”

item.title: No GE16 Accountability Framework — PH Has No System for Voters to Track Manifesto Progress
item.description:
Said by: Governance Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Unlike some democracies where government manifesto progress is publicly tracked, PH has established no formal system for voters to monitor delivery against the approximately 60 promises made in GE15. There is no public dashboard, no annual manifesto progress report, and no structured mechanism for civil society to hold the government accountable to its specific commitments. Malaysiakini created an independent manifesto tracker because the government wouldn’t. The Straits Times tracked PH 1.0’s progress and found most promises “still had some way to go” after just one year.

item.title: Social Media Platforms Forcibly 'Deemed Licensed' — MCMC Tightens Grip on Internet
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: From 1 January 2026, social media and instant messaging platforms with 8 million or more Malaysian users were automatically “deemed licensed” under MCMC’s regulatory framework — whether they applied for a licence or not. This means platforms like Meta (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), TikTok, Telegram, and X are now subject to Malaysian government licensing requirements, content takedown obligations, and penalties for non-compliance. Meta publicly warned the scheme “lacks clarity and threatens innovation.” Soyacincau reported that MCMC’s approach effectively bypassed the normal licensing application process by unilaterally deeming platforms as licensed. Reuters reported Meta’s concerns about the regulatory framework’s vagueness.

item.title: TikTok Generation Lost — Malaysian Youth Screen Time Among Highest in the World While Government Plans to Ban Under-16s
item.description:
Said by: MCMC / Online Safety Act

Category: Social

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysian youth have among the highest screen times and social media usage rates in the world. The government’s response was the Online Safety Act, which bans social media use for under-16s from 2026. The law places enforcement responsibility on platforms, with penalties up to RM10 million for non-compliance. However, implementation details remain vague — no age verification infrastructure exists, no technical framework has been announced, and enforcement mechanisms are untested. Freedom House’s 2024 report flagged Malaysia’s declining internet freedom trajectory under PH.

item.title: UMNO's Stranglehold on PH — Zahid Walks Free While Dictating Coalition Policy
item.description:
Said by: Political Analysts / Opposition

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The single most corrosive dynamic in Malaysian politics today is UMNO’s outsized leverage over PH within the unity government coalition. DPM Ahmad Zahid Hamidi — who had 47 corruption charges dropped in an NFA decision that shocked the legal community — now effectively holds veto power over government policy. UMNO’s support is essential for PH’s parliamentary majority, and UMNO knows it. The result: Zahid walks free, Najib gets sentence reductions and house arrest bids, the AG-PP separation is stalled, DAP is sidelined in the cabinet reshuffle, and the anti-corruption agenda is functionally dead. UCA News described the unity coalition as having a “fractured mandate.” CNA reported Anwar faces a “graft crisis” with “PKR party fractures” and “PH coalition jitters.”

item.title: Wages Haven't Kept Up with Costs — Real Purchasing Power Has DECLINED Under PH
item.description:
Said by: DOSM / BNM / Consumer Groups

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: While nominal wages have increased slightly under PH — minimum wage raised to RM1,500, modest salary increments across sectors — the cost of living has risen faster. Diesel is up 56%. SST was expanded to cover more essentials. Food prices are the highest in Southeast Asia at $1,940 per person per year according to USDA data. Electricity costs are up. Property prices are up. The result: real purchasing power — what your ringgit actually buys — has declined for most Malaysians. A 2025 consumer survey found 77% of Malaysians say costs have risen significantly, while official inflation claims just 1.3%.

item.title: [BM] Pengangkutan Awam 'Berfungsi Tetapi Rapuh' — Satu Gangguan dan Semua Orang Memandu
item.description:
Said by: Khazanah Research Institute (KRI)

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-31

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Kajian Khazanah Research Institute (KRI) yang diterbitkan pada akhir Disember 2025 mendapati bahawa sistem pengangkutan awam Greater KL “berfungsi tetapi rapuh” — gangguan kecil menyebabkan penumpang meninggalkannya sepenuhnya untuk kenderaan persendirian. KRI menyimpulkan bahawa rel “tidak pernah dimaksudkan untuk menyelesaikan masalah trafik Malaysia.” Kajian mendapati bahan api kekal murah secara buatan, tempat letak kereta banyak dan mampu milik, persekitaran berjalan kaki berpecah-pecah dan tidak mesra, dan sambungan jarak terakhir tidak mencukupi. Analisis FMT berhujah ia adalah “sistem yang belum siap, bukan prasarana, yang mengecewakan penumpang Malaysia.” Namun kerajaan terus mengumumkan projek rel mega — MRT3, LRT3, ECRL — seolah-olah membina lebih banyak landasan sahaja akan menyelesaikan mobiliti.

item.title: Public Transport 'Functional But Fragile' — One Disruption and Everyone Drives
item.description:
Said by: Khazanah Research Institute (KRI)

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-31
