📌 WHAT HAPPENED: A Khazanah Research Institute (KRI) study published in late December 2025 found that Greater KL’s public transport system is “functional but fragile” — minor disruptions cause commuters to abandon it entirely for private vehicles. KRI concluded that rail was “never meant to fix Malaysia’s traffic problem.” The study found that fuel remains artificially cheap, parking is abundant and affordable, walking environments are fragmented and hostile, and last-mile connectivity is inadequate. FMT’s analysis argued it is “an unfinished system, not infrastructure, that fails Malaysian commuters.” Yet the government continues announcing mega rail projects — MRT3, LRT3, ECRL — as if building more tracks alone will solve mobility.

item.title: [BM] Tawaran Tahanan Rumah Najib Ditolak — Mahkamah Putuskan Adendum Diraja Tidak Sah
item.description:
Said by: High Court Judge Alice Loke / Najib Razak

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-22

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 22 Disember 2025, Mahkamah Tinggi KL memutuskan bahawa adendum diraja yang membenarkan bekas PM Najib Razak yang disabitkan kesalahan menjalani baki hukuman 1MDB di bawah tahanan rumah adalah tidak sah. Hakim Alice Loke berkata budi bicara Yang di-Pertuan Agong mesti dilaksanakan “demi kepentingan awam” dan mendapati adendum itu tidak mempunyai asas undang-undang yang kukuh. Al Jazeera dan Reuters kedua-duanya melaporkan keputusan tersebut. Sultan Selangor sebelum ini memberi amaran bahawa pengampunan tidak boleh “sewenang-wenangnya untuk pihak tertentu.” Kerajaan Anwar sudah pun memotong separuh hukuman Najib melalui Lembaga Pengampunan pada Februari 2024 — tawaran tahanan rumah adalah langkah seterusnya dalam corak kelonggaran yang semakin meningkat bagi seorang kleptokrat yang disabitkan kesalahan yang kini partinya menjadi sandaran Anwar.

item.title: Najib House Arrest Bid Rejected — Court Rules Royal Addendum Invalid
item.description:
Said by: High Court Judge Alice Loke / Najib Razak

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-22

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 22 December 2025, the KL High Court ruled that the royal addendum allowing convicted former PM Najib Razak to serve his remaining 1MDB sentence under house arrest was invalid. Judge Alice Loke said the King’s discretion must be exercised “for the public good” and found the addendum lacked proper legal basis. Al Jazeera and Reuters both reported the ruling. The Selangor Sultan had earlier warned that pardons should not be “arbitrary for certain parties.” Anwar’s government had already halved Najib’s sentence via the Pardons Board in February 2024 — the house arrest bid was the next step in an escalating pattern of leniency for a convicted kleptocrat whose party Anwar now depends on.

item.title: [BM] Janji Mansuh Tol Dimungkiri — Kerajaan Bayar RM591J Untuk BEKU Kenaikan Sahaja
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: PH berjanji untuk memansuhkan tol lebuhraya dalam kedua-dua PRU14 dan PRU15. Sebaliknya, pada Disember 2025, kerajaan mengumumkan ia akan membelanjakan RM591 juta semata-mata untuk menghalang kenaikan tol di 10 lebuhraya pada 2026 — membayar syarikat konsesi dengan wang awam supaya tidak menaikkan harga. Menteri Kerja Raya mengakui memansuhkan tol sepenuhnya akan menelan belanja “berbilion.” Gerakan mengejek janji yang dimungkiri. FMT bertanya sama ada Anwar akan “mengulangi ikrar PH untuk memansuhkan tol” menjelang PRU16. Pemandu Malaysia terus membayar tol DAN cukai mereka kini mensubsidi pembekuan itu. Tempoh bebas tol perayaan juga dibatalkan.

item.title: Toll Abolition Promise Broken — Govt Pays RM591M to FREEZE Hikes Instead
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: PH promised to abolish highway tolls in both GE14 and GE15. Instead, in December 2025, the government announced it would spend RM591 million just to prevent toll increases on 10 highways in 2026 — paying concessionaires with public money to not raise prices. The Works Minister admitted that fully abolishing tolls would cost “billions.” Gerakan mocked the broken promise. FMT asked whether Anwar would “repeat PH’s pledge to abolish tolls” ahead of GE16. Malaysian drivers continue paying tolls AND their taxes now subsidise the freeze. Festive toll-free periods were also cancelled.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Masih Jauh' Soal Pilihan Raya Pada Disember 2025 — Kini Sedia PRU16 Kilat Untuk 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 17 Disember 2025, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu editor dan wartawan kanan di taklimat di Seri Perdana bahawa beliau menolak sebarang kemungkinan pilihan raya umum kilat pada 2026. “Pilihan raya masih jauh lagi. Saya tidak terfikir tentangnya,” katanya. “Saya menumpukan pada bagaimana kita terus melaksanakan pembaharuan dan meringankan masalah rakyat mengenai kos sara hidup yang lebih tinggi.”

item.title: [BM] Pelantikan Hannah Yeoh Cetuskan Tentangan Berasaskan Kaum — PAS Dan UMNO Sama-Sama Bangkang
item.description:
Said by: Takiyuddin Hassan, PAS Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Disember 2025, Anwar melantik Hannah Yeoh sebagai Menteri Wilayah Persekutuan dalam rombakan kabinetnya. Setiausaha Agung PAS Takiyuddin Hassan segera membantah — bukan terhadap kelayakan Yeoh, tetapi terhadap bangsanya. Beliau berhujah pelantikan itu akan “mengukuhkan pengaruh DAP” di kawasan bandar dan merugikan Melayu. Kumpulan Melayu sayap kanan memberi amaran bahawa DAP kini “menguasai tanah pegangan Melayu” melalui portfolio Wilayah Persekutuan, yang menyelia KL, Putrajaya, dan Labuan. Malah pemimpin UMNO secara senyap menyuarakan kebimbangan. Anwar membalas: “Menolak seseorang kerana warna kulit dan bangsanya, ini memalukan pada zaman ini.” Reaksi media sosial terpolarisasi.

item.title: Anwar Says 'Long Way to Go' on Elections in December 2025 — Now Preparing Snap GE16 for 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On December 17, 2025, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told editors and senior journalists at a briefing in Seri Perdana that he had ruled out any possibility of snap general elections in 2026. “The election still has a long way to go. I have not thought about it,” he said. “I am focusing on how we continue to implement reforms and alleviate the problems people face regarding the higher cost of living.”

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Appointment Sparks Race-Based Backlash — PAS and UMNO Both Object
item.description:
Said by: Takiyuddin Hassan, PAS Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In December 2025, Anwar appointed Hannah Yeoh as Federal Territories Minister in his cabinet reshuffle. PAS Secretary-General Takiyuddin Hassan immediately objected — not to Yeoh’s qualifications, but to her race. He argued the appointment would “strengthen DAP’s influence” in urban areas and disadvantage Malays. Rightist Malay groups warned that DAP was now “controlling Malay landholding” through the Federal Territories portfolio, which oversees KL, Putrajaya, and Labuan. Even UMNO leaders quietly raised concerns. Anwar hit back: “To reject a person because of her colour and race, this is atrocious in this day and age.” Social media reactions were polarised.

item.title: [BM] Rombakan Kabinet Anwar Cetuskan Kontroversi Kaum — Hannah Yeoh Menteri WP, Adam Adli Timbalan Hal Ehwal Agama
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 16 Disember 2025, Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan rombakan kabinet keduanya, melibatkan 28 perubahan menteri dan timbalan menteri. Antara pelantikan paling kontroversi:

Hannah Yeoh dinamakan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Wilayah Persekutuan) — bukan Melayu pertama memegang portfolio tersebut. PAS dan kumpulan Melayu sayap kanan segera menyerang pelantikan itu, mendakwa ia akan mengukuhkan “dominasi DAP” di KL.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul Dilantik Pengerusi MIDA Selepas Tinggalkan MITI — Pintu Pusingan Tak Pernah Berhenti Berputar
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MIDA Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Apabila rombakan kabinet Disember 2025 mengeluarkan Tengku Zafrul daripada portfolio MITI, beliau tidak dihantar ke bangku belakang. Sebaliknya, Anwar melantiknya sebagai Pengerusi MIDA (Lembaga Pembangunan Pelaburan Malaysia) — agensi yang berada di bawah bidang kuasa MITI — dan sebagai Penasihat Politik Kanan kepada PM. Orang yang menyelia MIDA sebagai menteri kini mengetuainya sebagai pelantikan politik.

item.title: Anwar's Cabinet Reshuffle Sparks Race Controversy — Hannah Yeoh as FT Minister, Adam Adli as Religious Affairs Deputy
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On December 16, 2025, Anwar Ibrahim announced his second cabinet reshuffle, involving 28 ministerial and deputy ministerial changes. Among the most controversial appointments:

Hannah Yeoh was named Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories) — the first non-Malay to hold the portfolio. PAS and right-wing Malay groups immediately attacked the appointment, claiming it would strengthen “DAP dominance” in KL and threaten Malay interests. Anwar called the criticism “atrocious” and said race should not determine ministerial capability.

item.title: Zafrul Appointed MIDA Chairman After Leaving MITI — The Revolving Door Never Stops Spinning
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MIDA Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: When the December 2025 cabinet reshuffle removed Tengku Zafrul from the MITI portfolio, he wasn’t sent to the backbench. Instead, Anwar appointed him as Chairman of MIDA (Malaysian Investment Development Authority) — the very agency that falls under MITI’s purview — and as Senior Political Advisor to the PM. The man who oversaw MIDA as minister now chairs it as a political appointee.

item.title: [BM] Dasar Ekonomi Berasaskan Kaum DEB Masih Tidak Boleh Disentuh — Pengkritik 'Sebulat Suara' Diabaikan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Think Tanks

Category: Social

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Eurasia Review menerbitkan analisis komprehensif pada Disember 2025 mendapati “pendapat hampir sebulat suara” dalam kalangan penganalisis bahawa dasar ekonomi berasaskan kaum Malaysia — berakar umbi dalam Dasar Ekonomi Baru (DEB) 1971 — telah gagal dalam “matlamat menyeluruh perpaduan nasional.” Namun analisis itu menyimpulkan kerajaan “sangat tidak mungkin meninggalkan” dasar-dasar tersebut. DEB dan penggantinya mengekalkan keutamaan Bumiputera dalam kontrak kerajaan, pendidikan, perumahan, dan ekuiti korporat. Walaupun 50+ tahun dasar ini, Malaysia kekal berpecah mendalam mengikut garis etnik.

item.title: [BM] LRT3 Ditangguh LAGI — Masalah Perisian, Ujian Gagal, Penalti RM475J Menanti
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Laluan LRT3 dari Bandar Utama ke Johan Setia — projek berbilion ringgit yang bertujuan mengubah ketersambungan di Lembah Klang — telah ditangguhkan berulang kali kerana kegagalan perisian isyarat dan ketidakupayaan menyelesaikan ujian tanpa kerosakan. Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke memberi amaran kontraktor mungkin menghadapi penalti melebihi RM475 juta untuk kelewatan tersebut. Tarikh pembukaan kekal tidak disahkan.

🔥 KENAPA INI PENTING: LRT3 sepatutnya beroperasi bertahun-tahun lalu. Kelewatan berulang bermakna penumpang terus bergantung kepada kereta, memburukkan kesesakan dan pencemaran di Lembah Klang. Wang awam terikat dalam sistem yang tiada siapa boleh guna — berbilion dilaburkan dengan pulangan sifar kepada penumpang. Kegagalan perisian isyarat menunjukkan isu lebih mendalam dengan pengurusan projek, keupayaan kontraktor, dan pengawasan kerajaan.

item.title: [BM] Perkhidmatan Awam 90% Bumiputera — Melayu Pegang 80%+ Jawatan Tertinggi
item.description:
Said by: Eurasia Review Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Menurut analisis Eurasia Review yang diterbitkan pada Disember 2025, perkhidmatan awam Malaysia yang berjumlah 1.3 hingga 1.6 juta pekerja adalah kira-kira 90% Bumiputera. Melayu memegang 77.5% daripada semua jawatan dan lebih 80% jawatan pengurusan tertinggi. Malaysia Cina hanya memegang 5.7% dan Malaysia India 3.8% — di sebuah negara di mana Cina membentuk 23% dan India 7% daripada populasi. Straits Times melaporkan “perdebatan dasar Bumiputera-dahulu” telah mengambil “campuran kuat kesihatan, pendidikan dan politik.”

item.title: Civil Service is 90% Bumiputera — Malays Hold 80%+ of Top Posts
item.description:
Said by: Eurasia Review Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: According to Eurasia Review analysis published in December 2025, Malaysia’s civil service of 1.3 to 1.6 million employees is approximately 90% Bumiputera. Malays hold 77.5% of all posts and over 80% of top management positions. Chinese Malaysians hold just 5.7% and Indian Malaysians 3.8% — in a country where Chinese make up 23% and Indians 7% of the population. The Straits Times reported the “Bumiputera-first policy debate” has taken on a “heady mix of health, education and politics.” When a UiTM professor suggested opening Bumiputera-only programmes to other races to address specialist shortages, the backlash was immediate and the idea was shut down.

item.title: LRT3 Delayed AGAIN — Software Glitches, Failed Test Runs, RM475M Penalties Looming
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The LRT3 line from Bandar Utama to Johan Setia — a multi-billion ringgit project intended to transform connectivity in the Klang Valley — has been postponed repeatedly due to signalling software failures and the inability to complete fault-free test runs. Transport Minister Anthony Loke warned contractors may face penalties exceeding RM475 million for the delays. The opening date remains unconfirmed. The Edge and Lowyat both reported the latest round of testing setbacks as the system failed to achieve the required reliability benchmarks.

item.title: Race-Based Economic Policies NEP Still Untouchable — 'Unanimous' Critics Ignored
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Think Tanks

Category: Social

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Eurasia Review published a comprehensive analysis in December 2025 finding “almost unanimous opinion” among analysts that Malaysia’s race-based economic policies — rooted in the New Economic Policy (NEP) of 1971 — have failed their “overarching goal of national unity.” Yet the analysis concluded the government is “highly unlikely to abandon” them. The NEP and its successors (NDP, NVP, and now Anwar’s various economic frameworks) maintain Bumiputera preferences in government contracts, education, housing, and corporate equity. Despite 50+ years of these policies, Malaysia remains deeply divided along ethnic lines, brain drain continues at alarming rates, and economic inequality persists within the Bumiputera community itself.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Janji Hapus Kemiskinan Tegar Menjelang Q1 2026 — Sekarang Mac 2026 Dan Tiada Siapa Bercakap Tentangnya
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-07

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 7 Disember 2025, di majlis penutup program Rancakkan Madani di Putrajaya, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengisytiharkan bahawa kadar kemiskinan tegar Malaysia telah jatuh kepada 0.09 peratus — melibatkan kira-kira 7,000 isi rumah — dan memberitahu penjawat awam bahawa memandangkan angka itu “terlalu kecil,” kerajaan boleh “menghapuskannya menjelang suku pertama 2026.” Bernama, Malay Mail, The Star, Business Today — semuanya menjadikannya berita utama. Kini pertengahan Mac 2026, jauh masuk ke dalam Q1. Tiada pengisytiharan kejayaan, tiada kemas kini tentang 7,000 isi rumah itu, dan tiada sesiapa dalam kerajaan yang kelihatan membincangkannya.

item.title: Anwar Promised to End Hardcore Poverty by Q1 2026 — It's March 2026 and Nobody's Talking About It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-07

📌 What Happened

On December 7, 2025, at the closing ceremony of the Rancakkan Madani programme in Putrajaya, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim publicly declared that Malaysia’s hardcore poverty rate had fallen to 0.09 per cent — affecting roughly 7,000 households — and told civil servants that since the number was “so small,” the government could “end it by the first quarter of 2026.” Multiple outlets — Bernama, Malay Mail, The Star, Business Today — ran the claim as headline news. It is now mid-March 2026, deep into Q1. There has been no victory declaration, no update on the 7,000 households, and no one in government appears to be talking about it.

item.title: [BM] Pembantu PM Sendiri Shamsul Iskandar Didakwa Rasuah — Perang Antirasuah Makan Diri Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Reuters / Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-04

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 4 Disember 2025, setiausaha politik kanan Anwar Ibrahim, Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin, didakwa menerima rasuah berjumlah RM176,829 daripada seorang ahli perniagaan tempatan. Pertuduhan mendakwa Shamsul menggunakan kedudukannya yang istimewa di pejabat Perdana Menteri untuk membantu ahli perniagaan tersebut mendapatkan lesen perlombongan mineral di Sabah, antara lain. Shamsul meletak jawatan beberapa hari sebelum didakwa, mengaku tidak bersalah, dan diberikan jaminan. Beliau menyifatkan pertuduhan itu sebagai “serangan” terhadapnya. Reuters melaporkan pertuduhan itu “meningkatkan penelitian terhadap ikrar perdana menteri untuk membanteras rasuah dengan ketara.” CNA melaporkan Anwar kini menghadapi “krisis rasuah” di samping “perpecahan parti PKR” dan “kegelisahan gabungan PH.”

item.title: [BM] Rasuah Balak Sabah — Berbilion Pembalakan Haram Sementara Shamsul Iskandar Dapat Lesen Perlombongan Dari Pejabat PMX
item.description:
Said by: Environmental Groups / MACC Investigations

Category: Other

Date: 2025-12-04

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sabah, rumah kepada antara hutan hujan primer terakhir Malaysia, terus menghadapi pembalakan haram dan tidak mampan secara besar-besaran yang didorong oleh rasuah dalam peruntukan lesen. Krisis ini dibawa ke perhatian tajam apabila setiausaha politik kanan Anwar sendiri, Shamsul Iskandar, didakwa pada 4 Disember 2025 menerima rasuah berjumlah RM176,829 daripada seorang ahli perniagaan tempatan untuk memudahkan lesen perlombongan mineral di Sabah. Reuters melaporkan pertuduhan itu mendedahkan rasuah “yang berpunca terus daripada pejabat PM.”

item.title: PM's Own Aide Shamsul Iskandar Charged with Bribery — Anti-Corruption Crusade Eats Itself
item.description:
Said by: Reuters / Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-04

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 4 December 2025, Anwar Ibrahim’s senior political secretary Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin was charged with receiving bribes totalling RM176,829 from a local businessman. The charges allege Shamsul used his privileged position in the Prime Minister’s office to assist the businessman in obtaining mineral mining licences in Sabah, among other favours. Shamsul resigned just days before being charged, pleaded not guilty, and was granted bail. He called the charges an “attack” against him. Reuters reported the charges “significantly increased scrutiny on the premier’s pledge to crack down on corruption.” CNA reported Anwar now faces a “graft crisis” alongside “PKR party fractures” and “PH coalition jitters.”

item.title: Sabah Timber Corruption — Billions in Illegal Logging While Shamsul Iskandar Got Mining Licences from PMX's Office
item.description:
Said by: Environmental Groups / MACC Investigations

Category: Other

Date: 2025-12-04

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Sabah, home to some of Malaysia’s last remaining primary rainforests, continues to face massive illegal and unsustainable logging driven by corruption in licence allocation. The crisis was brought into sharp focus when Anwar’s own senior political secretary, Shamsul Iskandar, was charged on 4 December 2025 with receiving bribes totalling RM176,829 from a local businessman for facilitating mineral mining licences in Sabah. Reuters reported the charges exposed corruption “emanating directly from the PM’s office.” The Shamsul case revealed how natural resource extraction in East Malaysia is systematically corrupted by political patronage — with the corruption pipeline running all the way to the Prime Minister’s doorstep.

item.title: [BM] Hutang 1MDB Masih RM50 Bilion — Beban Fiskal Terbesar Malaysia Di Bawah Pengawasan Anwar
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-03

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sehingga Disember 2025, hutang 1MDB Malaysia masih berjumlah kira-kira RM50 bilion — beban fiskal tunggal terbesar dalam sejarah negara. RM42 bilion telah dibayar dalam prinsipal dan faedah. RM29 bilion telah dipulihkan melalui tindakan penguatkuasaan. Kira-kira RM13 bilion masih perlu diselesaikan. Di bawah pengawasan Anwar, Najib Razak — PM yang mengetuai 1MDB — telah dipotong separuh hukuman penjara oleh Lembaga Pengampunan dan seterusnya diberikan tahanan rumah.

item.title: 1MDB Debt Still RM50 Billion — Malaysia's Largest Fiscal Burden Under Anwar's Watch
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-03

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: As of December 2025, Malaysia’s 1MDB debt still stands at approximately RM50 billion — the largest single fiscal burden in the country’s history. RM42 billion has already been paid in principal and interest. RM29 billion has been recovered through enforcement actions. Approximately RM13 billion remains to be settled. Under Anwar’s watch, Najib Razak — the PM who presided over 1MDB — had his jail sentence halved by the Pardons Board and was subsequently granted house arrest. The rakyat continues to pay the debt while the man responsible serves a comfortable sentence.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Bela Surat Sokongan Di Parlimen — Kemudian Serang Pembangkang Kerana Buat PERKARA SAMA
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim in Parliament / The Star

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-02

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Apabila dihadapkan di parlimen mengenai pembelaannya terhadap ‘surat sokongan’ (surat cadangan) untuk tender kerajaan, Anwar berpusing menyerang pembangkang dengan mendedahkan bahawa pegawai negeri Kelantan dan Terengganu juga mengeluarkan surat serupa. Beliau berkata: ‘Saya mesti menyeru kemunafikan — tiada satu perkataan pun mengenai surat oleh exco Kelantan dan Terengganu yang meminta kelulusan.’

🔥 Kenapa Ini Penting

Daripada menangani sama ada surat sokongan itu wajar (ia tidak — ia menjejaskan perolehan kompetitif), pembelaan Anwar ialah ‘pihak sana pun buat juga.’ Ini setaraf politik kanak-kanak yang ditangkap mencuri berkata ’tapi Johnny pun curi juga!’ Ia bukan pembelaan — ia pengakuan bahawa amalan itu sejagat dan tiada siapa, termasuk PH, berniat menghentikannya.

item.title: [BM] Nisbah Hutang-KDNK Masih 64.6% — Anwar Suruh Tunggu Sampai 2028 Untuk Kelegaan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Nisbah hutang-KDNK Malaysia berada pada 64.6% pada 2024 — melebihi siling sasaran 60% kerajaan sendiri yang ditetapkan di bawah Akta Kewangan Awam dan Tanggungjawab Fiskal. Pada Disember 2025, Anwar memberitahu Bloomberg bahawa tekanan hutang akan “reda menjelang akhir 2028” — enam tahun ke dalam tempoh pemerintahannya sebelum kesihatan fiskal mula bertambah baik. Pinjaman baru dikurangkan kepada RM75 bilion daripada RM100 bilion tetapi kekal besar. Warisan 1MDB sahaja masih menyumbang RM50 bilion dalam liabiliti.

item.title: Anwar Defends Support Letters in Parliament — Then Attacks Opposition for Doing the EXACT Same Thing
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim in Parliament / The Star

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-02

📌 What Happened

When confronted in parliament about his defence of ‘recommendation letters’ (surat sokongan) for government tenders, Anwar pivoted to attacking the opposition by revealing that Kelantan and Terengganu state officials had also issued similar letters. He said: ‘I must call out the hypocrisy — there was not a single word on the letters by the Kelantan and Terengganu exco asking for approval.’

item.title: Debt-to-GDP Still at 64.6% — Anwar Says Wait Until 2028 for Relief
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-02

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysia’s debt-to-GDP ratio stood at 64.6% in 2024 — above the government’s own 60% target ceiling set under the Public Finance and Fiscal Responsibility Act. In December 2025, Anwar told Bloomberg that debt pressure would “ease from end-2028” — six years into his tenure before fiscal health even begins to improve. New borrowings were reduced to RM75 billion from RM100 billion but remain massive. The 1MDB legacy alone still accounts for RM50 billion in liabilities. CNA reported on Malaysia’s “increased spending” alongside the “low debt ratio” aspiration that remains unfulfilled.

item.title: [BM] Kad Laporan Tiga Tahun Anwar: Ekonomi Stabil, Janji Dimungkiri, Kredibiliti Reformasi Runtuh
item.description:
Said by: Multiple analysts and media

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Ketika Anwar Ibrahim menandakan tiga tahun sebagai Perdana Menteri pada akhir 2025, pelbagai penganalisis dan media menyampaikan keputusan yang konsisten: ekonomi stabil, kredibiliti reformasi hancur. Pertumbuhan KDNK melebihi 5%, pelaburan asing mencecah rekod tertinggi, dan pengangguran mencapai paras terendah dalam satu dekad. Tetapi dalam reformasi — sebab sebenar PH dipilih — rekodnya amat mengecewakan: Akta Hasutan diperluaskan dengan 90 tangkapan, AUKU kekal utuh, ICCPR tidak diratifikasi, pemisahan PG-PP dihantar ke jawatankuasa selepas tiga tahun kelewatan, 47 pertuduhan rasuah Zahid digugurkan, SPRM diserang kerana politisasi, seorang wartawan ditangkap kerana bertanya soalan, dan Nurul Izzah dipasang sebagai No. 2 PKR.

item.title: [BM] Kegagalan Perancangan Pulau Pinang Terdedah — Trafik, Banjir, Ruang Hijau Lenyap Selepas 16 Tahun DAP
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow / Penang Forum / Aliran

Category: Social

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Disember 2025, Aliran menerbitkan laporan komprehensif yang mendokumenkan mengapa ‘perancangan pembangunan Pulau Pinang mengecewakan rakyatnya.’ Penduduk menuntut ketelusan ketika kesesakan trafik, banjir, dan kehilangan ruang hijau mendedahkan ‘kegagalan sistematik dalam perancangan’ di bawah kerajaan negeri pimpinan DAP. Laporan itu memperincikan bagaimana kelulusan pembangunan diteruskan tanpa infrastruktur yang mencukupi, penilaian alam sekitar tidak memadai, dan input komuniti diketepikan.

item.title: [BM] Khidmat Hutang Negara Makan 16% Hasil — Setiap Ringgit Keenam Pergi Bayar Faedah
item.description:
Said by: Ministry of Finance / Bloomberg

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Kos khidmat hutang Malaysia memakan kira-kira 16% daripada hasil kerajaan persekutuan — bermakna kira-kira setiap ringgit keenam yang dikutip dalam cukai pergi terus untuk membayar faedah hutang terkumpul dan bukannya membiayai sekolah, hospital, atau infrastruktur. Dengan nisbah hutang-KDNK pada 64.6% — melebihi sasaran 60% kerajaan sendiri — dan hutang warisan 1MDB masih berjumlah RM50 bilion dalam buku, ruang fiskal kekal amat terhad.

item.title: [BM] Konsesi Lebuhraya: Rakyat Bayar Tol Untuk Kayakan Kroni — Janji Mansuh Tol Dimungkiri LAGI
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Transport Ministry

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Janji teras manifesto PH untuk memansuhkan atau mengurangkan tol lebuhraya secara ketara telah dimungkiri secara sistematik. Daripada pemansuhan tol, kerajaan membelanjakan RM591 juta pada 2025 semata-mata untuk membekukan kenaikan tol — membayar syarikat konsesi dengan wang awam supaya tidak menaikkan harga yang sepatutnya tidak dikenakan. Tempoh bebas tol perayaan dibatalkan. Struktur asas konsesi lebuhraya — di mana syarikat swasta mengutip hasil terjamin daripada orang awam yang terperangkap sementara kerajaan menjamin keuntungan mereka — kekal sepenuhnya tidak berubah.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul: Orang Yang Khidmat Setiap PM — Dari Menteri Kewangan Muhyiddin Ke Menteri Perdagangan Anwar Ke 'Penasihat Kanan'
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz telah mencapai apa yang tiada ahli politik Malaysia lain capai: berkhidmat dalam peranan menteri kanan di bawah tiga PM berturut-turut daripada tiga gabungan berbeza. Beliau adalah Menteri Kewangan di bawah Muhyiddin (PN) dan Ismail Sabri (BN-PN), kemudian beralih ke PKR dan menjadi Menteri MITI di bawah Anwar (PH). Selepas dirombak pada Disember 2025, beliau segera dilantik sebagai Penasihat Politik Kanan kepada PM dan Pengerusi MIDA. SCMP memprofilkannya sebagai ‘harta panas’ — orang yang setiap PM mahukan.

item.title: Anwar's Three-Year Report Card: Steady Economics, Broken Promises, Collapsing Reform Credibility
item.description:
Said by: Multiple analysts and media

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: As Anwar Ibrahim marked three years as Prime Minister in late 2025, multiple analysts and media outlets delivered a consistent verdict: steady economics, shattered reform credibility. GDP growth exceeded 5%, foreign investment hit record highs, and unemployment reached decade lows. But on reform — the actual reason PH was elected — the record is dismal: the Sedition Act was expanded with 90 arrests, UUCA remains intact, ICCPR is unratified, AG-PP separation was sent to committee after three years of delay, Zahid’s 47 corruption charges were dropped, MACC is under fire for politicisation, a journalist was arrested for asking a question, and Nurul Izzah was installed as PKR No. 2.

item.title: Highway Concessions: Rakyat Pays Tolls to Make Cronies Rich — Toll Abolition Promise Broken AGAIN
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Transport Ministry

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The PH government’s core manifesto promise to abolish or significantly reduce highway tolls has been systematically broken. Instead of toll abolition, the government spent RM591 million in 2025 to merely freeze toll hikes — paying concessionaires with public money to not raise prices they shouldn’t be charging in the first place. Festive toll-free periods were cancelled. The fundamental structure of highway concessions — where private companies collect guaranteed revenue from a captive public while the government underwrites their profits — remains completely unchanged. Abolishing tolls was a core PH campaign promise in both GE14 (2018) and GE15 (2022). Three years into government, the promise has been quietly shelved with no accountability.

item.title: National Debt Servicing Eats 16% of Revenue — Every Sixth Ringgit Goes to Paying Interest
item.description:
Said by: Ministry of Finance / Bloomberg

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysia’s debt servicing costs consume approximately 16% of federal government revenue — meaning roughly every sixth ringgit collected in taxes goes straight to paying interest on accumulated debt rather than funding schools, hospitals, or infrastructure. With the debt-to-GDP ratio at 64.6% — above the government’s own 60% target — and 1MDB legacy debt still totalling RM50 billion on the books, fiscal space remains severely constrained. Anwar told Bloomberg that debt pressure would only “ease from end-2028.” The Star reported that 1MDB debt remains “Malaysia’s largest fiscal burden.”

item.title: Penang's Planning Failures Exposed — Traffic, Floods, Vanishing Green Spaces After 16 Years of DAP
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow / Penang Forum / Aliran

Category: Social

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In December 2025, Aliran published a comprehensive report documenting why ‘Penang’s development planning is failing its people.’ Residents demanded transparency as traffic congestion, floods, and vanishing green spaces exposed ‘systematic failures in planning’ under the DAP-led state government. The report detailed how development approvals continued without adequate infrastructure, environmental assessments were inadequate, and community input was sidelined. Penang Forum — a coalition of civil society groups — has been documenting these failures for years.

item.title: Zafrul: The Man Who Served Every PM — From Muhyiddin's Finance Minister to Anwar's Trade Minister to 'Senior Advisor'
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz has achieved what no other Malaysian politician has: serving in senior ministerial roles under three consecutive PMs from three different coalitions. He was Finance Minister under Muhyiddin (PN) and Ismail Sabri (BN-PN), then switched to PKR and became MITI Minister under Anwar (PH). After being reshuffled out in December 2025, he was immediately appointed Senior Political Advisor to the PM and MIDA Chairman. SCMP profiled him as ‘hot property’ — the man every PM wants.

item.title: [BM] Perang Tanah Felda-Terengganu — 15,000 Hektar Dieksploitasi 40 Tahun Tanpa Bayar Negeri Sesen Pun
item.description:
Said by: Terengganu State Government / Felda

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-30

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pertikaian tanah berdekad antara Lembaga Kemajuan Tanah Persekutuan (Felda) dan kerajaan negeri Terengganu meletup pada akhir November 2025 apabila negeri mengeluarkan notis pencerobohan meliputi 10 ladang berjumlah kira-kira 15,000 hektar. Terengganu menuduh Felda membangunkan tanah negeri selama lebih 40 tahun tanpa membayar premium, cukai, atau bahagian keuntungan — pada dasarnya mengekstrak berbilion hasil minyak sawit daripada tanah negeri secara percuma. FGV Holdings juga diberikan notis. TPM Zahid akhirnya masuk campur untuk rundingan.

item.title: [BM] PH Menang 1 Daripada 20 Kerusi Di Sabah — Anwar Kata Kekalahan Takkan Henti Penyampaian
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-30

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 30 November 2025, Pakatan Harapan dihancurkan dalam pilihan raya negeri Sabah. Gabungan itu memenangi hanya 1 daripada 20 kerusi yang dipertandingkan — turun daripada 7 sebelumnya. Itu kadar kekalahan 95%. Parti-parti berasaskan Sabah mendominasi, didorong sentimen anti-persekutuan dan tuntutan autonomi negeri yang lebih besar — terutama selepas keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi menyokong tuntutan Sabah terhadap 40% hasil persekutuan. Penganalisis politik Lee Kuok Tiung berkata terus terang: “Keputusan pilihan raya Sabah menunjukkan gabungan Anwar kalah teruk.” Jawapan Anwar: kekalahan itu “takkan menghalang penyampaian” janji kepada Sabah.

item.title: Felda-Terengganu Land War — 15,000 Hectares Exploited for 40 Years Without Paying the State a Sen
item.description:
Said by: Terengganu State Government / Felda

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-30

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: A decades-long land dispute between the Federal Land Development Authority (Felda) and the Terengganu state government exploded in late November 2025 when the state issued trespass notices covering 10 plantations totalling approximately 15,000 hectares. Terengganu accused Felda of developing state land for over 40 years without paying premiums, taxes, or profit shares — essentially extracting billions in palm oil revenue from state land for free. FGV Holdings was also served notices. DPM Zahid eventually stepped in for negotiations.

item.title: PH Wins 1 Out of 20 Seats in Sabah — Anwar Says Defeat Won't Stop Delivery
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-30

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 30 November 2025, Pakatan Harapan was demolished in the Sabah state election. The coalition won just 1 out of 20 seats it contested — down from 7 previously. That is a 95% loss rate. Sabah-based parties dominated, driven by anti-federal sentiment and demands for greater state autonomy — particularly after a High Court ruling supporting Sabah’s claim to 40% of federal revenue. Political analyst Lee Kuok Tiung said plainly: “The Sabah election outcome shows Anwar’s coalition lost badly.” Anwar’s response: the defeat “won’t stop delivery” of pledges to Sabah.

item.title: [BM] Amirudin Lancar Pelan Pemulihan Banjir — Selepas Banjir Terburuk Selangor Di Bawah Pengawasannya
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2025-11-29

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 29 November 2025, Amirudin melancarkan ‘mobilisasi besar-besaran’ untuk pemulihan pasca banjir apabila bilangan mangsa melonjak di seluruh Selangor. Air dari Selangor utara membanjiri Kuala Langat dan Sepang. JPS memasang empat pam di Kuala Selangor dengan enam lagi dirancang. Seorang pegawai polis dilaporkan hilang selepas kereta tergelincir ke dalam parit ribut berhampiran KLIA ketika banjir. Jabatan Meteorologi menarik amaran hujan lebat, tetapi kerosakan sudah meluas.

item.title: Amirudin Rolls Out Flood Recovery Plan — After Selangor's Worst Floods Under His Watch
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2025-11-29

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 29 November 2025, Amirudin rolled out a ‘major mobilisation’ for post-flood recovery as evacuee numbers surged across Selangor. Water from northern Selangor flooded into Kuala Langat and Sepang. JPS installed four pumps in Kuala Selangor with six more planned. A police officer went missing after a car skidded into a storm drain near KLIA during the floods. The Met Department withdrew severe rain warnings, but damage was extensive.

item.title: [BM] Banjir Perlis 2025 — 34,000 Dipindahkan, Ibu Baharu Terpaksa Lari Minggu Selepas Bersalin
item.description:
Said by: Government / NADMA

Category: Other

Date: 2025-11-25

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada akhir November 2025, banjir teruk melanda Malaysia utara — terutamanya Perlis, Kedah, dan Kelantan — memindahkan lebih 34,000 orang. Reuters menggambarkan pemandangan di mana air banjir mengubah seluruh komuniti menjadi apa yang kelihatan “seperti lautan.” Antara yang dipindahkan ialah seorang ibu baharu yang terpaksa melarikan diri hanya beberapa minggu selepas bersalin. Seorang pegawai polis hilang selepas kenderaan tergelincir ke dalam parit ribut berhampiran KLIA. Kerajaan mengumumkan Pelan Ketahanan Iklim sebagai respons, dan NADMA menyelaras operasi bantuan merentasi negeri-negeri terjejas.

item.title: Perlis Floods 2025 — 34,000 Evacuated, New Mother Forced to Flee Weeks After Birth
item.description:
Said by: Government / NADMA

Category: Other

Date: 2025-11-25

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In late November 2025, severe flooding across northern Malaysia — particularly in Perlis, Kedah, and Kelantan — displaced over 34,000 people. Reuters described scenes where floodwaters turned entire communities into what looked “like an ocean.” Among those evacuated was a new mother forced to flee just weeks after giving birth. A police officer went missing after a vehicle skidded into a storm drain near KLIA. The government announced a Climate Resilience Plan in response, and NADMA coordinated relief operations across affected states.

item.title: [BM] Larangan Media Sosial Untuk Bawah 16 Tahun — Pelan Penguatkuasaan: Belum Ditentukan
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2025-11-24

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan pada November 2025 bahawa Malaysia akan melarang akses media sosial untuk kanak-kanak bawah 16 tahun, mengikut jejak Australia. Larangan itu dijadualkan dilaksanakan pada 2026. Namun, NYT menyatakan pengumuman itu “kurang butiran” — tiada infrastruktur pengesahan umur, tiada mekanisme penguatkuasaan digariskan, dan tiada jadual pelaksanaan disediakan. Kerajaan membingkaikannya sebagai melindungi kanak-kanak daripada bahaya dalam talian, tetapi tidak menawarkan pelan teknikal untuk menjayakannya.

item.title: Social Media Ban for Under-16s — Enforcement Plan: TBD
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2025-11-24

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced in November 2025 that Malaysia would ban social media access for children under 16, following Australia’s lead. The ban was set for implementation in 2026. However, the NYT noted the announcement was “light on details” — no age verification infrastructure exists, no enforcement mechanism was outlined, and no timeline for implementation was provided. The government framed it as protecting children from online harms, but offered no technical plan for making it work.

item.title: [BM] Perolehan PTMP Pulau Pinang: Tiada Tender Terbuka, Hanya 'Permintaan Cadangan' Untuk Berbilion Kontrak
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow / DAP Penang / Civil Society Critics

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-21

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pelbagai laporan, termasuk dari FMT dan komuniti akademik, mendokumenkan bahawa Pelan Induk Pengangkutan Pulau Pinang (PTMP) DAP bergantung kepada mekanisme perolehan ‘permintaan cadangan’ (RFP) dan bukannya tender terbuka kompetitif untuk berbilion ringgit kontrak infrastruktur. Kumpulan masyarakat sivil mengkritik ini sebagai tidak telus dan mesra pemaju. PTMP termasuk terowong bawah laut (kini dalam perbicaraan rasuah), LRT Mutiara, dan pelbagai projek jalan raya — semuanya diperoleh tanpa proses tender terbuka standard yang dituntut PH daripada kerajaan persekutuan.

item.title: Penang PTMP Procurement: No Open Tenders, Just 'Request for Proposals' for Billions in Contracts
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow / DAP Penang / Civil Society Critics

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-21

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Multiple reports, including from FMT and the academic community, documented that DAP’s Penang Transport Master Plan (PTMP) relied on ‘request-for-proposal’ (RFP) procurement mechanisms rather than open competitive tenders for billions of ringgit in infrastructure contracts. Civil society groups criticised this as opaque and developer-friendly. The PTMP includes the undersea tunnel (now under corruption trial), the Mutiara LRT, and various road projects — all procured without the standard open tender process that PH demands from the federal government.

item.title: [BM] Sungai Perak Bertukar BIRU Akibat Perlombongan Nadir Bumi — Operasi Digantung
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Environment Minister

Category: Other

Date: 2025-11-20

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada November 2025, sebahagian Sungai Perak bertukar biru terang akibat pelepasan kimia daripada tapak perlombongan nadir bumi. Menteri Alam Sekitar Johari Abdul Ghani mengesahkan pencemaran itu dan memerintahkan operasi digantung sementara siasatan. Insiden ini berlaku ketika kerajaan Malaysia giat menggalakkan pengembangan nadir bumi — menandatangani perjanjian dengan AS dan meletakkan Malaysia sebagai pesaing kepada penguasaan China dalam mineral kritikal. Sungai biru itu menjadi simbol viral kos alam sekitar daripada usaha nadir bumi.

item.title: Perak River Turns BLUE from Rare Earth Mining — Operations Suspended
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Environment Minister

Category: Other

Date: 2025-11-20

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In November 2025, a stretch of the Perak River turned bright blue due to chemical discharges from a rare earth mining site. Environment Minister Johari Abdul Ghani confirmed the contamination and ordered operations suspended pending investigation. The incident occurred as the Malaysian government was aggressively pushing rare earth expansion — signing deals with the US and positioning Malaysia as a rival to China’s dominance in critical minerals. The blue river became a viral symbol of the environmental cost of the rare earth push.

item.title: [BM] Ledakan Pusat Data Keringkan Air Dan Kuasa — Johor Disuruh Tunggu Hingga 2027 Untuk Bekalan Air
item.description:
Said by: Johor state government and Anwar Ibrahim

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Kegilaan pusat data Malaysia terhantuk tembok pada penghujung 2025 apabila Johor — pusat utama cita-cita lembah silikon negara — memberitahu pelabur untuk menangguhkan projek berpendingin air sekurang-kurangnya 18 bulan kerana negeri itu tidak mampu membekalkan air secukupnya. Menjelang Februari 2026, Anwar membekukan semua kelulusan pusat data bukan AI sepenuhnya. Antara 2023 dan 2025, kerajaan telah meluluskan berbilion projek pusat data daripada Microsoft, Google, AWS, Oracle, ByteDance, dan GDS Holdings — tanpa memastikan infrastruktur mampu menyokongnya. Kadar air tidak berhasil (NRW) negara ialah 37.1%, bermakna lebih satu pertiga air terawat hilang melalui paip bocor sebelum sampai kepada pengguna.

item.title: [BM] Setiausaha Politik PM Didapati Keluarkan Surat Sokongan Untuk Kontraktor Hospital — Anwar Kata Teguran Sudah Cukup
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 18 November 2025, Anwar mengesahkan di Parlimen bahawa beliau telah menegur setiausaha politik kanan, Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin, mengenai surat sokongan yang menyenaraikan enam kontraktor untuk projek hospital di Johor. Anwar menggambarkan surat tersebut sebagai “kabur.” Pada 25 November, Shamsul meletak jawatan selepas tekanan media dan desakan Rafizi Ramli untuk siasatan SPRM. Seorang ahli perniagaan Sabah kemudian mendakwa memberikan RM152,000 kepada Shamsul — wang yang didakwa dibelanjakan untuk perabot rumah, cerut premium, dan sut bertempah. Pada 4 Disember 2025, SPRM mendakwa Shamsul dengan rasuah berjumlah RM176,829 berkaitan projek hospital itu.

item.title: Data Centre Boom Drains Water and Power — Johor Told to Wait Until 2027 for Water Supply
item.description:
Said by: Johor state government and Anwar Ibrahim

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysia’s data centre gold rush hit a wall in late 2025 when Johor — ground zero for the country’s silicon valley ambitions — told investors to postpone water-cooled projects for at least 18 months because the state couldn’t supply enough water. By February 2026, Anwar froze all non-AI data centre approvals entirely. Between 2023 and 2025, the government had approved billions in data centre projects from Microsoft, Google, AWS, Oracle, ByteDance, and GDS Holdings — without ensuring the infrastructure could support them. Malaysia’s national non-revenue water rate is 37.1%, meaning over a third of treated water is lost to leaking pipes before reaching consumers.

item.title: PM's Political Secretary Caught Issuing Support Letters for Hospital Contractors — Anwar Says a Reprimand Is Enough
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 18 November 2025, Anwar confirmed in Parliament that he had reprimanded his senior political secretary, Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin, over support letters listing six contractors for a hospital project in Johor. Anwar described the letters as “vague.” On 25 November, Shamsul resigned after mounting media pressure and calls from Rafizi Ramli for a MACC investigation. A Sabah businessman then claimed he provided RM152,000 to Shamsul — money allegedly spent on home furniture, premium cigars, and tailored suits. On 4 December 2025, MACC charged Shamsul with corruption over RM176,829 in gratification related to the hospital project.

item.title: [BM] Pembantu MB Selangor Dituduh Kekayaan Tidak Dapat Dijelaskan — Banglo RM3J, Perjalanan Mewah, Dan Terlalu Banyak Jawatan GLC
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada November 2025, kumpulan WhatsApp baharu bernama ‘MB Selangor’ — terdiri daripada ahli DUN dan pemimpin negeri — mencetuskan kontroversi dengan menuduh seorang pemimpin PKR rapat dengan Menteri Besar Selangor Amirudin Shari mempunyai kekayaan tidak dapat dijelaskan. Pentadbir kumpulan mempersoalkan bagaimana pemimpin itu mampu memiliki banglo RM3 juta, perjalanan mewah ke luar negara, dan penginapan hotel mewah sambil memegang banyak jawatan dalam agensi berkaitan negeri. Kumpulan itu bertanya: ‘Mengapa seorang dilantik ke begitu banyak jawatan, seolah-olah tiada orang lain yang layak di Selangor?’

item.title: Selangor MB's Aide Accused of Unexplained Wealth — RM3M Bungalow, Luxury Trips, and Too Many GLC Posts
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In November 2025, a newly created WhatsApp group named ‘MB Selangor’ — comprising state assembly members and leaders — triggered controversy by accusing a PKR leader close to Selangor Menteri Besar Amirudin Shari of unexplained wealth. The administrator questioned how the leader could afford a RM3 million bungalow, luxury overseas trips, and high-end hotel stays while holding numerous positions in state-linked agencies. The group asked: ‘Why is one person appointed to so many positions, as if there are no other qualified people in Selangor?’

item.title: [BM] Projek Terowong Bawah Laut Pulau Pinang 'Masih Aktif' — 14 Tahun, Sifar Pembinaan, Harga RM6.3 Bilion
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-14

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 14 November 2025, Chow Kon Yeow memberitahu media bahawa Projek Terowong Bawah Laut Pulau Pinang ‘bukan projek terbengkalai malah masih aktif dan dalam fasa semakan teknikal serta penyiapan reka bentuk.’ Projek bernilai RM6.3 bilion ini dicadangkan pada 2011 di bawah Pelan Induk Pengangkutan Pulau Pinang (PTMP). Empat belas tahun kemudian, tiada satu meter pun terowong dibina. Sementara itu, perbicaraan rasuah bekas Ketua Menteri Lim Guan Eng berkaitan projek ini diteruskan, dengan saksi SPRM menggambarkannya sebagai ‘umpama penipuan tanah.’

item.title: Penang Undersea Tunnel Project 'Still Active' — 14 Years, Zero Construction, RM6.3B Price Tag
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-14

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 14 November 2025, Chow Kon Yeow told media that the Penang Undersea Tunnel Project is ’not an abandoned project but is still active and in the technical review and design completion phase.’ The RM6.3 billion project was proposed in 2011 under the Penang Transport Master Plan (PTMP). Fourteen years later, not a single metre of tunnel has been constructed. Meanwhile, the corruption trial of former CM Lim Guan Eng over the project continues, with MACC witnesses describing it as ‘akin to a land scam.’

item.title: [BM] AS Isytihar 'Kemenangan Terhadap China' Selepas Peroleh Ikrar Mineral Tanpa Had Daripada Anwar
item.description:
Said by: MalaysiaNow report

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-03

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 3 November 2025, MalaysiaNow melaporkan bahawa Amerika Syarikat telah “mengisytiharkan kemenangan terhadap China” selepas memperoleh ikrar daripada Anwar Ibrahim untuk tidak menyekat eksport mineral kritikal dan unsur nadir bumi ke AS. Di bawah ART AS-Malaysia, Malaysia komited untuk “mengelak daripada mengharamkan, atau mengenakan kuota ke atas, eksport mineral kritikal atau unsur nadir bumi ke AS” — komitmen perdagangan yang mengikat, bukan isyarat muhibah. Malaysia juga bersetuju untuk bekerjasama dengan firma Amerika “bagi mewujudkan kepastian untuk perniagaan meningkatkan kapasiti pengeluaran,” pada dasarnya menjamin akses AS kepada sumber mineral Malaysia selama-lamanya.

item.title: US Declares 'Victory Against China' After Securing Unlimited Minerals Pledge From Anwar
item.description:
Said by: MalaysiaNow report

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-03

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 3 November 2025, MalaysiaNow reported that the United States had “declared victory against China” after securing a pledge from Anwar Ibrahim to not restrict exports of critical minerals and rare earth elements to the US. Under the US-Malaysia ART, Malaysia committed to “refrain from banning, or imposing quotas on, exports to the US of critical minerals or rare earth elements” — a binding trade commitment, not a goodwill gesture. Malaysia also agreed to partner with American firms “to create certainty for businesses to increase production capacity,” essentially guaranteeing US access to Malaysian mineral resources in perpetuity.

item.title: 'Stop Lecturing Us on Sovereign Rights' — US Envoy Told Off Amid Anger Over Trade Deal
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian public and politicians

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-02

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Days after the US-Malaysia trade deal was signed, public anger boiled over. The US envoy was publicly told to “stop lecturing us on sovereign rights” amid growing fury over what critics called Anwar’s “surrender” to Washington. MalaysiaNow reported the confrontation. The deal required Malaysia to align with US export controls, sanctions, and trade enforcement — provisions widely seen as infringing on sovereignty. Adding insult to injury, details of the agreement were published on the White House website before being shared with the Malaysian Parliament, fueling perceptions that Malaysia was an afterthought in its own trade negotiations.

item.title: [BM] 'Berhenti Berceramah Soal Hak Kedaulatan Kami' — Duta AS Ditempelak Ketika Kemarahan Atas Perjanjian Dagang
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian public and politicians

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Beberapa hari selepas perjanjian dagang AS-Malaysia ditandatangani, kemarahan awam memuncak. Duta AS secara terbuka diberitahu supaya “berhenti berceramah soal hak kedaulatan kami” di tengah kemarahan yang semakin meningkat terhadap apa yang pengkritik panggil “penyerahan” Anwar kepada Washington. MalaysiaNow melaporkan konfrontasi tersebut. Perjanjian itu memerlukan Malaysia mematuhi kawalan eksport AS, sekatan, dan penguatkuasaan perdagangan — peruntukan yang dilihat secara meluas sebagai pencerobohan kedaulatan. Menambah keaiban, butiran perjanjian diterbitkan di laman web Rumah Putih sebelum dikongsi dengan Parlimen Malaysia, menyemarakkan persepsi bahawa Malaysia hanyalah renungan kemudian dalam rundingan dagangnya sendiri.

item.title: [BM] 'Berhenti Berkuliah Kami Soal Hak Kedaulatan' — Utusan AS Ditempelak Di Tengah Kemarahan Soal Perjanjian Perdagangan
item.description:
Said by: Malaysian public and politicians

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Beberapa hari selepas perjanjian perdagangan AS-Malaysia ditandatangani, kemarahan awam memuncak. Utusan AS diberitahu secara terbuka untuk “berhenti berkuliah kami soal hak kedaulatan” di tengah kemarahan yang semakin membara terhadap apa yang pengkritik panggil “penyerahan” Anwar kepada Washington. MalaysiaNow melaporkan konfrontasi itu. Perjanjian itu memerlukan Malaysia menyelaraskan dengan kawalan eksport, sekatan, dan penguatkuasaan perdagangan AS — peruntukan yang dilihat secara meluas sebagai mencabuli kedaulatan. Menambah penghinaan, butiran perjanjian diterbitkan di laman web Rumah Putih sebelum dikongsi dengan Parlimen Malaysia, mencetuskan persepsi bahawa Malaysia hanya pertimbangan kemudian dalam rundingnya sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Chow Akui 'Pembangunan Pesat' Pulau Pinang Tidak Dirasai Sesetengah Komuniti — Selepas 16 Tahun Pemerintahan DAP
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 2 November 2025, KM Pulau Pinang Chow Kon Yeow mengakui bahawa ‘pembangunan pesat’ negeri itu ’tidak dirasai oleh sesetengah komuniti.’ Beliau menggesa pemimpin DAP ‘kekal dekat dengan rakyat dan jaga akar umbi’ dan berkata parti mesti menumpukan penyelesaian masalah harian seperti banjir, kesesakan lalu lintas, bekalan air, dan pembaikan perumahan. Beliau mengakui bahawa menambah baik prestasi di peringkat bawahan akan mengukuhkan keyakinan awam terhadap DAP.

item.title: Chow Admits Penang's 'Rapid Development' Not Felt by Some Communities — After 16 Years of DAP Rule
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-02

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 2 November 2025, Penang CM Chow Kon Yeow admitted that the state’s ‘rapid development’ was ’not felt by some communities.’ He urged DAP leaders to ‘stay close to the people and take care of the grassroots’ and said the party must focus on solving everyday problems like flooding, traffic congestion, water supply, and housing repairs. He acknowledged that improving ground-level performance would reinforce public confidence in DAP.

item.title: [BM] Kebankrapan Peribadi Naik 5.7% — Trend Kebankrapan Isytihar Sendiri 'Membimbangkan'
item.description:
Said by: Department of Insolvency Malaysia

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Dalam sembilan bulan pertama 2025, Malaysia mencatatkan 4,875 kes kebankrapan peribadi — kenaikan 5.7% daripada tempoh sama 2024. Ketua Pengarah Jabatan Insolvensi memberi amaran tentang “kebimbangan yang semakin meningkat”: kenaikan kebankrapan isytihar sendiri, di mana rakyat Malaysia begitu tertekan dari segi kewangan sehingga secara sukarela mengisytiharkan diri bankrap dan bukannya menunggu pemiutang memaksa proses tersebut. Data menunjukkan tekanan kewangan tidak tertumpu kepada pemilik perniagaan sahaja — ia merebak kepada pekerja bergaji, profesional muda, dan peserta ekonomi gig.

item.title: [BM] Lowy Institute: 'Kejayaan Antarabangsa Anwar Masam Di Tanah Air' — Tindak Balas Perjanjian Perdagangan AS
item.description:
Said by: Lowy Institute Analysis

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada November 2025, Lowy Institute menerbitkan analisis perjanjian perdagangan AS-Malaysia (ART), menyimpulkan bahawa “kejayaan antarabangsa Anwar masam di tanah air.” Analisis itu mengenal pasti klausa ‘pil racun’ yang berfungsi sebagai “ujian kesetiaan” yang memerlukan Malaysia menyelaraskan dengan kepentingan strategik AS — termasuk kawalan eksport, penguatkuasaan sekatan, dan eksport mineral kritikal tanpa sekatan. Lowy Institute menyatakan tarif 19% ke atas barangan Malaysia dikekalkan, bukan dikurangkan ke sifar seperti yang dibayangkan oleh pembingkaian awam Anwar.

item.title: [BM] Parlimen Dijadikan Cap Getah — Cambuk PM Pastikan Rang Undang-Undang Lulus Tanpa Perbahasan Sebenar
item.description:
Said by: Opposition MPs / Parliamentary Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Walaupun PH berjanji mengukuhkan demokrasi berparlimen, Dewan Rakyat terus berfungsi sebagai cap getah dan bukannya badan perundingan sebenar. Rang undang-undang kerajaan lulus dengan pindaan minimum, kerja jawatankuasa bersifat pro-forma, dan cambuk kerajaan memastikan AP gabungan mengundi secara blok. Rang undang-undang had tempoh PM — salah satu janji reformasi utama PH — gagal di Parlimen kerana PH tidak mampu mengumpulkan AP sendiri yang cukup untuk menyokongnya. Fahmi Fadzil menyalahkan “kekeliruan pembangkang” atas kegagalan itu, sedangkan 8 AP PH sendiri tidak hadir mengundi.

item.title: [BM] Pengangguran Belia Terperangkap Pada 12.28% — Satu Daripada Lapan Anak Muda Malaysia Tak Dapat Kerja
item.description:
Said by: DOSM / ILO / World Bank Data

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sehingga penghujung 2025, kadar pengangguran belia Malaysia (umur 15-24) kekal terperangkap pada 12.28% — kira-kira 297,500 anak muda Malaysia menganggur. Ini tiga hingga empat kali ganda lebih tinggi daripada kadar pengangguran nasional keseluruhan 3.2%. Data DOSM, ILO, dan Bank Dunia semuanya mengesahkan sifat struktur masalah ini: Malaysia mengeluarkan graduan yang ekonomi tidak perlukan, manakala industri yang mengambil pekerja tidak dapat mencari tenaga kerja dengan kemahiran yang betul. “Ekonomi Madani” yang diraikan Anwar nampaknya tidak termasuk anak muda.

item.title: [BM] Rakyat Kata Inflasi 1.3% Adalah Pembohongan — 'Tak Tahu Dari Mana Madanon Dapat Nombor Ni'
item.description:
Said by: Public Sentiment / Social Media

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Kadar inflasi rasmi Malaysia untuk Oktober 2025 dilaporkan pada 1.3% oleh Jabatan Perangkaan (DOSM). Rakyat Malaysia bertindak balas dengan ejekan terbuka di media sosial, dengan komen seperti “tak tahu dari mana Madanon dapat nombor ni.” Jurang antara inflasi tajuk dan pengalaman sebenar amat ketara: inflasi makanan luar rumah berjalan pada 4.3-4.7%, jauh melebihi kadar tajuk. Kos sewa, penjagaan kesihatan, dan perbelanjaan pendidikan — kategori yang secara tidak seimbang menjejaskan isi rumah berpendapatan sederhana dan rendah — semuanya meningkat lebih cepat daripada angka komposit rasmi.

item.title: Lowy Institute: 'Anwar's International Success Sours at Home' — US Trade Deal Backlash
item.description:
Said by: Lowy Institute Analysis

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In November 2025, the Lowy Institute published an analysis of the US-Malaysia trade deal (ART), concluding that “Anwar’s international success sours at home.” The analysis identified ‘poison pill’ clauses that function as a “loyalty test” requiring Malaysia to align with US strategic interests — including export controls, sanctions enforcement, and unrestricted critical mineral exports. The Lowy Institute noted that the 19% tariff on Malaysian goods was maintained, not reduced to zero as Anwar’s public framing implied. The deal was characterised as a US strategic win dressed up as a bilateral partnership.

item.title: Parliament Reduced to Rubber Stamp — PM Whips Ensure Bills Pass Without Genuine Debate
item.description:
Said by: Opposition MPs / Parliamentary Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Despite PH’s promise to strengthen parliamentary democracy, the Dewan Rakyat continues to function as a rubber stamp rather than a genuine deliberative body. Government bills pass with minimal amendment, committee work is perfunctory, and the government whip ensures coalition MPs vote in bloc. The PM term limit bill — one of PH’s signature reform promises — failed in Parliament because PH couldn’t even muster enough of its own MPs to support it. Fahmi Fadzil blamed “opposition confusion” for the failure, when 8 of PH’s own MPs didn’t show up to vote.

item.title: Personal Bankruptcies Rise 5.7% — Self-Declared Bankruptcy Trend 'Growing Concern'
item.description:
Said by: Department of Insolvency Malaysia

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In the first nine months of 2025, Malaysia recorded 4,875 personal bankruptcy cases — a 5.7% increase from the same period in 2024. The Insolvency Department Director-General flagged a “growing concern”: the rise in self-declared bankruptcies, where Malaysians are so financially distressed they voluntarily declare themselves bankrupt rather than waiting for creditors to force the process. The data indicates that financial distress is not concentrated among business owners — it is spreading to salaried workers, young professionals, and gig economy participants.

item.title: Rakyat Says 1.3% Inflation is a Lie — 'Don't Know Where Madanon Gets These Numbers'
item.description:
Said by: Public Sentiment / Social Media

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysia’s official inflation rate for October 2025 was reported at 1.3% by the Department of Statistics (DOSM). Malaysians responded with open mockery on social media, with comments like “don’t know where Madanon gets these numbers.” The disconnect between headline inflation and lived experience is stark: food-away-from-home inflation ran at 4.3-4.7%, far exceeding the headline rate. Rental costs, healthcare, and education expenses — categories that disproportionately affect middle and lower-income households — all rose faster than the official composite figure suggests.

item.title: Youth Unemployment Stuck at 12.28% — One in Eight Young Malaysians Can't Find Work
item.description:
Said by: DOSM / ILO / World Bank Data

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: As of late 2025, Malaysia’s youth unemployment rate (ages 15-24) remains stuck at 12.28% — roughly 297,500 unemployed young Malaysians. This is three to four times higher than the overall national unemployment rate of 3.2%. DOSM, the ILO, and World Bank data all confirm the structural nature of the problem: Malaysia produces graduates the economy doesn’t need, while industries that are hiring can’t find workers with the right skills. The “Madani economy” that Anwar celebrates apparently doesn’t include young people.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul: 'Kita Tiada Pilihan Selain Berunding' — Pembelaan Paling Jujur Dan Mendakwa Soal Perjanjian Perdagangan AS
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MITI Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-29

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Berucap di Parlimen pada 29 Oktober 2025, Tengku Zafrul menyampaikan apa yang dimaksudkan sebagai pembelaan ART tetapi yang didengari pengkritik sebagai pengakuan kelemahan: ‘Kita tiada pilihan selain berunding. Suka atau tidak, kita perlu mempertahankan akses kita ke pasaran AS, walaupun di bawah tekanan.’ Beliau memanggil perjanjian itu ‘senario terbaik’ dan menuduh pengkritik ‘kejahilan mengenai rundingan sengit di sebalik tabir.’

item.title: Zafrul: 'We Had No Choice But to Negotiate' — The Most Honest and Damning Defence of the US Trade Deal
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MITI Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-29

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Speaking in Parliament on 29 October 2025, Tengku Zafrul delivered what he intended as a defence of the ART but what critics heard as an admission of weakness: ‘We had no choice but to negotiate. Whether we like it or not, we need to defend our access to the US markets, even when under pressure.’ He called the deal the ‘best case scenario’ and accused detractors of ‘ignorance regarding the intense, behind-the-scenes negotiations.’

item.title: [BM] Air Selangor: 27% Hilang Akibat Kebocoran — Amirudin Promosi Meter Pintar Sementara Paip Pecah
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-27

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 27 Oktober 2025, Amirudin memberitahu Parlimen bahawa projek perintis meter air pintar di Selangor telah terbukti berkesan — memetik Bukit Jelutong di mana air tidak berhasil (NRW) dicatatkan pada 27%. Beliau menggesa kerajaan persekutuan mengamalkan meter pintar di seluruh negara. Secara berasingan, kerajaan Selangor mengumumkan akan menanggung kenaikan kos air untuk lebih satu juta pengguna dan mempercepatkan penggantian paip pada 300km setahun, mensasarkan margin rizab air 20% menjelang 2030.

item.title: Selangor Water: 27% Lost to Leaks — Amirudin Touts Smart Meters While Pipes Burst
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-27

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 27 October 2025, Amirudin told Parliament that pilot smart water meter projects in Selangor had proven effective — citing Bukit Jelutong where non-revenue water (NRW) was recorded at 27%. He urged the federal government to adopt smart meters nationwide. Separately, the Selangor government announced it would absorb increased water costs for over one million users and accelerate pipe replacement at 300km per year, targeting a 20% water reserve margin by 2030.

item.title: [BM] Butiran Perjanjian Perdagangan AS Diterbitkan Di Laman Web Rumah Putih Sebelum Parlimen Malaysia Diberitahu
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MITI Minister / White House

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Apabila Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik AS-Malaysia ditandatangani pada 26 Oktober 2025, USTR menerbitkan helaian fakta terperinci di laman web Rumah Putih yang menggariskan komitmen Malaysia — termasuk akses pasaran keutamaan untuk barangan AS, komitmen mengenai mineral nadir bumi, dan jadual tarif. Ahli Parlimen Malaysia dan orang awam mengetahui butiran perjanjian perdagangan negara mereka sendiri daripada laman web kerajaan Amerika. Terma perjanjian itu diterbitkan di Washington sebelum dibentangkan di Putrajaya.

item.title: [BM] Malaysia Komited Untuk Tidak Pernah Mengharamkan Eksport Nadir Bumi Ke AS — Di Bawah Perjanjian Perdagangan Zafrul
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MITI Minister / USTR

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Di bawah Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik AS-Malaysia yang ditandatangani oleh Tengku Zafrul pada 26 Oktober 2025, Malaysia komited untuk tidak mengenakan ‘sekatan kuantitatif’ (larangan atau kuota) ke atas eksport mineral kritikal atau nadir bumi ke Amerika Syarikat. Helaian fakta USTR secara jelas menonjolkan perkara ini sebagai kemenangan AS. Sementara itu, Zafrul menolak dakwaan Mahathir bahawa Malaysia bersetuju membekalkan nadir bumi mentah pada pulangan rendah, dengan mengatakan dasar sedia ada mewajibkan pemprosesan domestik sebelum eksport.

item.title: [BM] Perjanjian Perdagangan AS-Malaysia Dipanggil 'Perjanjian Terburuk Sejak Merdeka' Dan 'Tindakan Menyerah Kalah'
item.description:
Said by: Tommy Thomas, Former Attorney General (and critics)

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

Perjanjian Yang Menjual Kedaulatan Malaysia

Pada 26 Oktober 2025, Anwar Ibrahim dan Donald Trump menandatangani Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik AS-Malaysia (ART) di Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN. Bekas Peguam Negara Tommy Thomas memanggilnya perjanjian terburuk yang Malaysia masuki sejak merdeka pada 1957. Beliau tidak membesar-besarkan.

Fakta-Fakta

Fakta: Perjanjian ini mengekalkan tarif AS 19% ke atas barangan Malaysia — turun dari 25%, tetapi masih menghukum mengikut sebarang standard. Tarif efektif Malaysia ke atas barangan AS sebelum perjanjian ini adalah kira-kira 6%. AS mendapat bahagian lebih baik tiga kali ganda.

item.title: [BM] RTM Salah Kenal Pasti TIGA Pemimpin ASEAN Secara Langsung — Panggil PM Singapura 'Lee Hsien Loong' Di Sidang Kemuncak Yang Malaysia Anjurkan
item.description:
Said by: RTM / Communications Ministry under Fahmi Fadzil

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 26 Oktober 2025, semasa siaran langsung majlis pembukaan Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-47 — yang Malaysia sendiri menjadi tuan rumah — penyiar kebangsaan Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM) salah mengenal pasti tiga pemimpin Asia Tenggara:

  • PM Singapura Lawrence Wong dipanggil Lee Hsien Loong (pendahulunya)
  • PM Thailand Anutin Charnvirakul dipanggil Srettha Thavisin (pendahulunya)
  • Presiden Indonesia Prabowo Subianto dipanggil Jokowi (pendahulunya) RTM mengeluarkan dua kenyataan permohonan maaf berasingan. Jabatan penyiaran berkata ia “mengambil perkara ini dengan serius” dan “tindakan sewajarnya telah diambil.”

🔥 KENAPA IA PENTING

Ini adalah detik Malaysia di pentas dunia. Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN adalah acara diplomatik utama rantau ini, dan Malaysia menjadi tuan rumah. Seluruh rantau sedang menonton. Dan penyiar kebangsaan Malaysia tidak mampu menyebut nama tiga ketua negara jiran dengan betul.

item.title: [BM] Tengku Zafrul Rundingkan Perjanjian Perdagangan AS Yang Pengkritik Panggil 'Perjanjian Terburuk Sejak Merdeka' — Kemudian Dinaikkan Pangkat
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, former MITI Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 26 Oktober 2025, Menteri MITI ketika itu Tengku Zafrul menandatangani Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik (ART) dengan Amerika Syarikat di Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-47 di Kuala Lumpur. Perjanjian itu mengkomitkan Malaysia untuk menyediakan akses pasaran keutamaan bagi produk AS merentas bahan kimia, jentera, kenderaan, tenusu, ayam, daging babi, beras, dan etanol bahan api. Malaysia juga komited untuk tidak mengenakan larangan atau kuota ke atas eksport mineral kritikal atau nadir bumi ke AS. Sebagai balasan, AS mengekalkan tarif timbal balik 19% ke atas barangan Malaysia — dengan hanya 60.4% baris tarif pada kadar sifar. Pengkritik dari seluruh spektrum politik, termasuk Mahathir dan Rafizi Ramli, memanggilnya penyerahan berat sebelah.

item.title: Malaysia Committed to Never Banning Rare Earth Exports to the US — Under Zafrul's Trade Deal
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MITI Minister / USTR

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Under the US-Malaysia Agreement on Reciprocal Trade signed by Tengku Zafrul on 26 October 2025, Malaysia committed to not imposing ‘quantitative restrictions’ (bans or quotas) on exports of critical or rare-earth minerals to the United States. The USTR fact sheet explicitly highlights this as a US victory. Meanwhile, Zafrul dismissed Mahathir’s claim that Malaysia agreed to supply unprocessed rare earth at low returns, saying existing policy mandates domestic processing before export.

item.title: RTM Misidentifies THREE ASEAN Leaders on Live TV — Calls Singapore's PM 'Lee Hsien Loong' at Summit Malaysia Hosted
item.description:
Said by: RTM / Communications Ministry under Fahmi Fadzil

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 26 October 2025, during the live broadcast of the opening ceremony of the 47th ASEAN Summit — which Malaysia was hosting — the national broadcaster Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM) misidentified three Southeast Asian leaders:

  • Singapore PM Lawrence Wong was called Lee Hsien Loong (his predecessor)
  • Thailand PM Anutin Charnvirakul was called Srettha Thavisin (his predecessor)
  • Indonesia President Prabowo Subianto was called Jokowi (his predecessor) RTM issued two separate apology statements. The broadcasting department said it “took the matter seriously” and that “appropriate action had been taken.”

🔥 WHY IT MATTERS

This was Malaysia’s moment on the world stage. The ASEAN Summit is the region’s premier diplomatic event, and Malaysia was the host. The entire region was watching. And Malaysia’s national broadcaster couldn’t get the names of three neighbouring heads of state right.

item.title: Tengku Zafrul Negotiated the US Trade Deal Critics Call 'Worst Agreement Since Independence' — Then Got Promoted
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, former MITI Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 26 October 2025, then-MITI Minister Tengku Zafrul signed the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) with the United States at the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur. The deal committed Malaysia to providing preferential market access for US products across chemicals, machinery, vehicles, dairy, poultry, pork, rice, and fuel ethanol. Malaysia also committed to not imposing bans or quotas on the export of critical or rare-earth minerals to the US. In return, the US maintained a 19% reciprocal tariff on Malaysian goods — with only 60.4% of tariff lines zero-rated. Critics from across the political spectrum, including Mahathir and Rafizi Ramli, called it a one-sided surrender.

item.title: US Trade Deal Details Published on White House Website Before Malaysian Parliament Was Told
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MITI Minister / White House

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: When the US-Malaysia Agreement on Reciprocal Trade was signed on 26 October 2025, the USTR published a detailed fact sheet on the White House website outlining Malaysia’s commitments — including preferential market access for US goods, commitments on rare earth minerals, and tariff schedules. Malaysian MPs and the public learned the details of their own country’s trade agreement from an American government website. The deal’s terms were published in Washington before they were presented in Putrajaya.

item.title: US-Malaysia Trade Deal Called 'Worst Agreement Since Independence' and 'Act of Surrender'
item.description:
Said by: Tommy Thomas, Former Attorney General (and critics)

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-10-26

The Deal That Sold Malaysia’s Sovereignty

On 26 October 2025, Anwar Ibrahim and Donald Trump signed the US-Malaysia Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) at the ASEAN Summit. Former Attorney-General Tommy Thomas called it the worst agreement Malaysia has entered since independence in 1957. He was not exaggerating.

The Facts

Fact: The deal maintains a 19% US tariff on Malaysian goods — down from 25%, but still punitive by any standard. Malaysia’s effective tariff on US goods before this deal was roughly 6%. The US got the better end by a factor of three.

item.title: [BM] Sistem Persekolahan Malaysia Dalam 'Kemerosotan' — Pelajar Lebih Biadap, Kurang Ingin Tahu, Guru Terbeban
item.description:
Said by: FMT Opinion / Teachers

Category: Education

Date: 2025-10-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 18 Oktober 2025, Free Malaysia Today menerbitkan rencana pendapat oleh guru-guru barisan hadapan yang menggambarkan sistem persekolahan dalam kemerosotan yang jelas. Penceritaan mereka terus terang: pelajar menatal TikTok di bawah meja semasa pengajaran, membentak guru apabila ditegur, enggan bekerjasama dengan aktiviti kelas, dan menunjukkan sedikit atau tiada rasa ingin tahu tentang apa yang diajar.

Guru-guru menggambarkan perjuangan yang kalah — bukan terhadap pelajar, tetapi terhadap algoritma. Gelung dopamin TikTok telah menjadi pihak berkuasa sebenar bilik darjah. Dan secara struktur, guru tiada apa-apa untuk melawan: tiada pedagogi yang dikemas kini, tiada dasar pengurusan peranti, tiada sokongan kesihatan mental, dan tiada pengakuan institusi bahawa masalah itu wujud.

item.title: Malaysia's Schooling System in 'Decline' — Students Ruder, Less Curious, Teachers Overwhelmed
item.description:
Said by: FMT Opinion / Teachers

Category: Education

Date: 2025-10-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 18 October 2025, Free Malaysia Today published an opinion piece by frontline teachers describing a schooling system in visible decline. The accounts were blunt: students scrolling TikTok under desks during lessons, snapping back at teachers when corrected, refusing to cooperate with classroom activities, and showing little to no curiosity about what’s being taught.

Teachers described fighting a losing battle — not against students, but against the algorithm. TikTok’s dopamine loop has become the real classroom authority. And structurally, teachers have nothing to fight back with: no updated pedagogy, no device management policy, no mental health support, and no institutional acknowledgment that the problem even exists.

item.title: 77% of Malaysians Struggle With Rising Living Costs — But Anwar Says Economy Is 'Strong'

The Facts

Fact: Consumer Frontiers International found 77% of Malaysians struggled with rising costs despite rising wages.

Fact: DOSM reported average monthly disposable household income increased 3.2% to RM7,584 in 2024.
