MalaysiaNow menghubungi beberapa pemimpin PH untuk komen — hampir semua enggan. Tony Pua, yang baru dua bulan lalu menyindir Najib, tidak menjawab panggilan. Rafizi Ramli, pejuang antirasuah paling lantang PH, juga membisu.

item.title: Rosmah Acquitted of All 17 Money Laundering Charges — PH Politicians Who Spent a Decade Attacking Her Go Silent
item.description:
Said by: PH Politicians (Tony Pua, Rafizi Ramli, et al.) / High Court

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-12-19

📌 What Happened

On December 19, 2024, High Court judge K. Muniandy acquitted and discharged Datin Seri Rosmah Mansor — wife of jailed former PM Najib Razak — of all 17 charges against her in a money laundering and tax evasion case involving RM7.09 million. The judge ruled the prosecution failed to present key elements of the offence. Rosmah had been charged in October 2018 with 12 counts of money laundering and 5 counts of failing to declare income. MalaysiaNow contacted multiple PH leaders for comment — almost all refused. Tony Pua, who had sarcastically mocked Najib just two months earlier, did not answer calls. Rafizi Ramli, PH’s most vocal anti-corruption crusader, also stayed silent.

item.title: [BM] Skor PISA Runtuh — Malaysia Hilang 1.6 TAHUN Pembelajaran, Kini 8 Tahun Di Belakang Singapura Dalam Matematik
item.description:
Said by: OECD PISA 2022 Report / ISIS Malaysia Analysis

Category: Education

Date: 2024-12-06

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Laporan PISA 2022, dikeluarkan pada Disember 2024, mendedahkan Malaysia mengalami antara lima penurunan terbesar di dunia merentas ketiga-tiga subjek. Matematik jatuh 31 mata (440 kepada 409), bacaan turun 27 mata (415 kepada 388), dan sains merosot 22 mata (438 kepada 416). ISIS Malaysia menganggarkan ini setara dengan 1.6 tahun pembelajaran yang hilang dalam matematik sahaja. 59% pelajar Malaysia kini di bawah kecekapan asas dalam matematik — naik daripada 41%. Hanya 1% pelajar Malaysia mencapai kecekapan tinggi. Jurang sosioekonomi semakin melebar, dengan pelajar kaya mengatasi pelajar kurang berkemampuan sebanyak 82 mata.

item.title: PISA Scores Collapse — Malaysia Loses 1.6 YEARS of Learning, Now 8 Years Behind Singapore in Math
item.description:
Said by: OECD PISA 2022 Report / ISIS Malaysia Analysis

Category: Education

Date: 2024-12-06

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The 2022 PISA report, released in December 2024, revealed Malaysia suffered among the top five largest declines globally across all three subjects. Mathematics dropped 31 points (440 to 409), reading fell 27 points (415 to 388), and science declined 22 points (438 to 416). ISIS Malaysia estimated this equates to 1.6 years of lost learning in mathematics alone. 59% of Malaysian students are now below basic proficiency in math — up from 41%. Only 1% of Malaysian students achieved high proficiency. The socioeconomic gap is widening, with wealthy students outperforming disadvantaged ones by 82 points.

item.title: [BM] Bloomberg: Malaysia 'Hadapi Tentangan Atas Rancangan Meluaskan Kawalan Internet'
item.description:
Said by: Bloomberg and critics

Category: Social

Date: 2024-12-04

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Disember 2024, Bloomberg melaporkan bahawa Malaysia menghadapi tentangan atas rancangan mengetatkan cengkaman ke atas internet. Kerajaan mencari kuasa dan penalti yang lebih luas untuk penyalahgunaan internet melalui peraturan baharu. Rest of World melaporkan bahawa pencipta kandungan di Malaysia menapis sendiri untuk mengelak tindakan keras — “Peraturan baharu menyukarkan untuk mencari rezeki,” kata mereka. ARTICLE 19 memanggilnya keputusan Mahkamah Persekutuan AKM yang mengembalikan peruntukan “sangat menyinggung” sebagai “pukulan kepada kebebasan bersuara.” Laman web berita kritikal disekat. SKMM diberi kuasa mengenakan denda ke atas platform sehingga RM10 juta.

item.title: Bloomberg: Malaysia 'Faces Backlash Over Plan to Broaden Internet Controls'
item.description:
Said by: Bloomberg and critics

Category: Social

Date: 2024-12-04

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In December 2024, Bloomberg reported that Malaysia faced backlash over plans to tighten its grip on the internet. The government sought broader powers and penalties for internet misuse through new regulations. Rest of World reported that creators in Malaysia were self-censoring to avoid crackdowns — “The new rules make it harder to make a living,” they said. ARTICLE 19 called the Federal Court’s CMA decision reinstating “grossly offensive” provisions “a blow to freedom of expression.” Critical news websites were blocked. MCMC was given powers to penalise platforms up to RM10 million.

item.title: [BM] Asia Maior: Anwar Meminggirkan 'Perbincangan Terbuka Tentang Pelbagai Garis Peminggiran'
item.description:
Said by: Asia Maior Academic Journal

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada akhir 2024, jurnal akademik Asia Maior menerbitkan penilaian terhadap tadbir urus Anwar Ibrahim, menyimpulkan bahawa beliau menghadapi cabaran “tanpa mempersoal secara bermakna wacana awam yang secara sejarahnya meminggirkan perbincangan terbuka tentang pelbagai garis peminggiran sosioekonomi.” Analisis itu mendokumentasikan bagaimana retorik reformis Anwar wujud bersama realiti status quo — mengekalkan struktur naungan, rangka kerja etnik dan susunan institusi yang sama yang beliau telah berjanji selama berdekad untuk membongkar.

item.title: [BM] Banjir 2024 Pindahkan Ratusan Ribu — Negeri-Negeri Utara Musnah Sekali Lagi
item.description:
Said by: ReliefWeb / East Asia Forum

Category: Other

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Disember 2024, banjir teruk di negeri-negeri utara memindahkan ratusan ribu rakyat Malaysia. Kelantan, Terengganu dan Pahang menanggung beban musim monsun. RM15 bilion telah diluluskan untuk mitigasi banjir selepas bencana dahsyat 2021, tetapi kemajuan sangat perlahan. Negeri-negeri yang sama yang dilanda banjir setiap tahun dilanda banjir semula, dengan komuniti yang sama menanggung kerugian yang sama. East Asia Forum mendokumentasikan bagaimana banjir 2024 mendedahkan kegagalan tadbir urus berterusan dalam kesiapsiagaan bencana dan pelaburan infrastruktur.

item.title: [BM] Pelanggaran Hak Tanah Orang Asli Berterusan — Komuniti Asal Dipindahkan Untuk Pembalakan Dan Perladangan
item.description:
Said by: Amnesty International / Indigenous Rights Groups

Category: Social

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sepanjang 2024, Orang Asli dan komuniti asal di Semenanjung Malaysia terus menghadapi pelanggaran sistematik hak tanah adat. Hutan datuk nenek moyang ditebang untuk konsesi pembalakan dan perladangan kelapa sawit, sering kali tanpa persetujuan bebas, termaklum dan terdahulu. Amnesty International membenderakan hak orang asal sebagai satu daripada tujuh bidang di mana Malaysia gagal memenuhi obligasi hak asasi manusia. Orang Asli membentuk hanya 0.2% perkhidmatan awam Malaysia walaupun merangkumi kira-kira 0.7% populasi — malah perwakilan berkadar pun dinafikan.

item.title: [BM] Yayasan Rosa Luxemburg: 'Rasuah, Jurang Kaum, Rasa Tidak Puas Hati Ekonomi' Di Bawah Anwar
item.description:
Said by: Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada akhir 2024, Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung (RLS), sebuah yayasan politik Jerman, menerbitkan penilaian terperinci tentang Malaysia di bawah Anwar Ibrahim. Laporan itu menyimpulkan: “Rasuah peringkat tinggi berterusan, ketegangan kaum meningkat dengan ahli politik mengeksploitasi isu sensitif, respons kerajaan tertumpu kepada mengurus insiden melalui undang-undang usang berbanding menggalakkan dialog terbuka.” RLS mendokumentasikan bagaimana kerajaan Anwar mengekalkan struktur naungan dan rangka kerja etnik yang sama yang dijanjikan untuk dibongkar, sambil menggunakan undang-undang penindas untuk mengurus bantahan berbanding menangani punca.

item.title: 2024 Floods Displaced Hundreds of Thousands — Northern States Devastated Again
item.description:
Said by: ReliefWeb / East Asia Forum

Category: Other

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In December 2024, severe flooding in northern states displaced hundreds of thousands of Malaysians. Kelantan, Terengganu, and Pahang bore the brunt of the monsoon season. RM15 billion had been approved for flood mitigation after the devastating 2021 disaster, but progress was glacial. The same states that flood every year flooded again, with the same communities bearing the same losses. East Asia Forum documented how the 2024 floods exposed continued governance failures in disaster preparedness and infrastructure investment.

item.title: Asia Maior: Anwar Sidelines 'Open Discussion on Multiple Lines of Disenfranchisement'
item.description:
Said by: Asia Maior Academic Journal

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In late 2024, the academic journal Asia Maior published an assessment of Anwar Ibrahim’s governance, concluding that he faced challenges “without substantially interrogating a public discourse that has historically sidelined open discussion on multiple socio-economic lines of disenfranchisement.” The analysis documented how Anwar’s reformist rhetoric coexisted with a status quo reality — maintaining the same patronage structures, ethnic frameworks, and institutional arrangements that he had spent decades promising to dismantle.

item.title: Orang Asli Land Rights Violations Continue — Indigenous Communities Displaced for Logging and Plantations
item.description:
Said by: Amnesty International / Indigenous Rights Groups

Category: Social

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Throughout 2024, Orang Asli and indigenous communities in Peninsular Malaysia continued to face systematic violations of customary land rights. Ancestral forests were cleared for logging concessions and palm oil plantations, often without free, prior, and informed consent. Amnesty International flagged indigenous rights as one of seven areas where Malaysia fell short of its human rights obligations. Orang Asli make up just 0.2% of Malaysia’s civil service despite comprising approximately 0.7% of the population — even proportional representation is denied.

item.title: Rosa Luxemburg Foundation: 'Corruption, Racial Divides, Economic Discontent' Under Anwar
item.description:
Said by: Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In late 2024, the Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung (RLS), a German political foundation, published a detailed assessment of Malaysia under Anwar Ibrahim. The report concluded: “High-level corruption persists, rising racial tensions with politicians exploiting sensitive issues, government response focused on managing incidents through archaic laws rather than promoting open dialogue.” RLS documented how the Anwar government maintained the same patronage structures and ethnic frameworks it had promised to dismantle, while using repressive laws to manage dissent rather than addressing root causes.

item.title: [BM] Banjir Terburuk Dalam Sedekad — 90,000 Dipindahkan, Cuti Menteri Dibekukan Terlambat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Other

Date: 2024-11-29

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada akhir November 2024, Malaysia mengalami banjir terburuk dalam sedekad. Lebih 90,000 orang dipindahkan merentasi 9 negeri, dengan Kelantan, Terengganu dan Pahang paling teruk terjejas. Anwar membekukan cuti menteri — tetapi hanya selepas krisis sudah meningkat ke tahap kecemasan. Banjir monsun tahunan, yang berlaku dengan ketepatan jam setiap tahun, sekali lagi mendedahkan infrastruktur yang tidak mencukupi dan kesiapsiagaan bencana yang lemah meskipun berbilion diperuntukkan untuk mitigasi banjir selepas banjir dahsyat 2021.

item.title: Worst Floods in a Decade — 90,000 Displaced, Ministers' Leave Frozen Too Late
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Other

Date: 2024-11-29

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In late November 2024, Malaysia experienced its worst floods in a decade. Over 90,000 people were displaced across 9 states, with Kelantan, Terengganu, and Pahang worst affected. Anwar froze ministers’ leave — but only after the crisis had already escalated to emergency levels. The annual monsoon flooding, which occurs with clockwork regularity every year, once again exposed inadequate infrastructure and disaster preparedness despite billions allocated for flood mitigation after the catastrophic 2021 floods.

item.title: [BM] Lawatan Luar Negara Anwar: 75% Dibiayai Syarikat Swasta — Kemudian Kerajaan Kata Sebenarnya Tidak
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister (and Fahmi Fadzil)

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-11-22

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada November 2024, Anwar memberitahu Parlimen bahawa syarikat swasta seperti Petronas dan Proton menanggung kira-kira 75% kos lawatan luar negaranya di bawah strategi perkongsian kos baru. Keesokan harinya, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil “menjelaskan” bahawa eksekutif korporat “membayar sendiri” manakala kerajaan menanggung delegasi Anwar. Kerajaan telah membelanjakan RM1.6 juta untuk mencarter pesawat bagi lawatan empat negara. Apabila disoal lebih lanjut, Anwar memanggilnya “zaman gila” bahawa ketelusan dihukum. Penganalisis CNA memberi amaran amalan itu “boleh mendedahkan kelemahan dalam rangka kerja pembiayaan politik Malaysia.”

item.title: Anwar's Overseas Trips: 75% Funded by Private Companies — Then Government Says Actually No
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister (and Fahmi Fadzil)

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-11-22

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In November 2024, Anwar told Parliament that private companies like Petronas and Proton covered approximately 75% of his overseas travel costs under a new cost-sharing strategy. The next day, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil “clarified” that corporate executives “paid their own way” while the government covered Anwar’s delegation. The government had spent RM1.6 million to charter a plane for a four-country trip. When questioned further, Anwar called it a “crazy era” that transparency was being punished. CNA analysts warned the practice “could expose vulnerabilities in Malaysia’s political financing framework.”

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Sahkan Akta Hasutan TIDAK Akan Dimansuhkan — Janji Tanda Tangan PH Rasmi Mati
item.description:
Said by: Shamsul Anuar Nasarah, Deputy Home Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-11-14

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 14 November 2024, Timbalan Menteri Dalam Negeri Datuk Seri Dr Shamsul Anuar Nasarah memberitahu Parlimen bahawa kerajaan tiada rancangan untuk meminda atau memansuhkan Akta Hasutan 1948. Beliau berkata Akta itu akan dikekalkan untuk ‘memelihara ketenteraman dan keselamatan awam.’ Kenyataan ini dibuat dalam Dewan Rakyat Anwar sendiri, oleh timbalan menteri Anwar sendiri, menamatkan sebarang lakonan bahawa PH akan menunaikan salah satu janji reformasi paling menentukan mereka. Menjelang awal 2026, sekurang-kurangnya 90 tangkapan telah dibuat di bawah Akta Hasutan sejak 2024 — di bawah pengawasan PH.

item.title: [BM] Nga Kor Ming Belanja RM4 Juta Untuk 4 'Tandas Pintar Kelas BMW' Sementara Rakyat Berjuang Dengan Kos Sara Hidup
item.description:
Said by: Nga Kor Ming, Housing and Local Government Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-11-14

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada November 2024, Menteri Perumahan dan Kerajaan Tempatan Nga Kor Ming mengumumkan bahawa RM4 juta telah diperuntukkan untuk membina empat tandas pintar “kelas BMW” di Kuala Lumpur dan Putrajaya — RM1 juta setiap tandas. Beliau membuat pengumuman itu di majlis Anugerah Tandas Terbaik Tahun (TOTYA) 2024, menggambarkannya sebagai sebahagian daripada peruntukan RM180 juta yang lebih luas selama tiga tahun untuk naik taraf tandas awam. Menjelang Jun 2025, bekas naib presiden MCA Ti Lian Ker menuntut kemas kini, menyatakan tiada laporan kemajuan sejak pengumuman.

item.title: Government Confirms Sedition Act Will NOT Be Repealed — PH's Signature Promise Officially Dead
item.description:
Said by: Shamsul Anuar Nasarah, Deputy Home Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-11-14

📌 What Happened

On November 14, 2024, Deputy Home Minister Datuk Seri Dr Shamsul Anuar Nasarah told Parliament that the government has no plans to amend or repeal the Sedition Act 1948. He said the Act would be maintained to ‘preserve public order and security.’ This statement was made in Anwar’s own Dewan Rakyat, by Anwar’s own deputy minister, ending any pretence that PH would deliver on one of its most defining reform promises. By early 2026, at least 90 arrests had been made under the Sedition Act since 2024 — under PH’s watch.

item.title: Nga Kor Ming Blows RM4 Million on 4 'BMW-Class Smart Toilets' While Rakyat Struggles With Cost of Living
item.description:
Said by: Nga Kor Ming, Housing and Local Government Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-11-14

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In November 2024, Housing and Local Government Minister Nga Kor Ming announced that RM4 million had been allocated to build four “BMW-class” smart toilets in Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya — RM1 million per toilet. He made the announcement at the Toilet of the Year Award (TOTYA) 2024 ceremony, describing it as part of a broader RM180 million allocation over three years for public toilet upgrades. By June 2025, former MCA vice-president Ti Lian Ker demanded an update, noting zero progress reports since the announcement.

item.title: [BM] Kekurangan Beras Timbulkan Kebimbangan Sekuriti Makanan — Anwar Mahu 'Lebih Pemantauan'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada penghujung 2024, kekurangan beras secara sporadik melanda Malaysia bersama banjir yang dahsyat. Rak pasar raya kehabisan jenis beras tempatan di beberapa negeri. Respons Anwar ialah menyeru “pemantauan dan penguatkuasaan yang kerap” — tindak balas lazim kerajaan apabila tiada pelan. Malaysia mengimport lebih 30% bekalan berasnya, dan industri padi domestik telah diabaikan selama berdekad. Harga beras global mencecah paras tertinggi bertahun-tahun akibat sekatan eksport India, kesan El Niño terhadap hasil tuaian Asia Tenggara, dan gangguan rantaian bekalan.

item.title: Rice Shortages Deepen Food Security Fears — Anwar Wants 'More Monitoring'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In late 2024, sporadic rice shortages hit Malaysia alongside devastating floods. Supermarket shelves emptied of local rice varieties in multiple states. Anwar’s response was to call for “frequent monitoring and enforcement” — the government’s default when it has no plan. Malaysia imports over 30% of its rice supply, and the domestic padi industry has been neglected for decades. Global rice prices hit multi-year highs due to India’s export restrictions, El Niño impacts on Southeast Asian harvests, and supply chain disruptions.

item.title: [BM] Sistem Levi Pekerja Asing Pelbagai Peringkat — Diumumkan 2023, Masih Belum Dilaksanakan Sepenuhnya
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-10-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada September 2023, Anwar mengumumkan sistem levi pelbagai peringkat untuk pekerja asing yang direka bagi mengurangkan pergantungan Malaysia terhadap tenaga kerja import. Sistem ini diulang dalam Belanjawan 2025 dengan butiran lanjut. Persekutuan Majikan-Majikan Malaysia (MEF) mengadu sistem itu masih tidak adil dan pelaksanaannya tidak mencukupi. Janji Anwar untuk memotong pergantungan pekerja asing kepada 15% tenaga kerja menjelang 2025 tidak dipenuhi. Sehingga akhir 2025, Malaysia masih menggaji kira-kira 2.2 juta pekerja asing berdokumen, dengan anggaran 1-2 juta tidak berdokumen — pergantungan yang tidak berubah secara bermakna di bawah PH.

item.title: [BM] SPRM Rampas RM6J Dan Bekukan Aset Berkaitan MB Inc Selangor Dalam Siasatan Rasuah Perlombongan Pasir
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari / MACC

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-10-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Oktober 2024, Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) merampas RM6 juta dan membekukan aset berkaitan Menteri Besar Incorporated (MBI) Selangor berhubung siasatan rasuah perlombongan pasir. Ketua Pesuruhjaya SPRM Azam Baki mengesahkan bahawa lima firma berkaitan seorang ahli politik Selangor sedang disiasat atas dakwaan rasuah melibatkan konsesi perlombongan pasir. Siasatan mendedahkan rangkaian kontrak dan pembayaran yang menimbulkan persoalan tentang integriti kelulusan perlombongan pasir Selangor.

item.title: Foreign Worker Levy Multi-Tier System — Announced 2023, Still Not Fully Implemented
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-10-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In September 2023, Anwar announced a multi-tier levy system for foreign workers designed to reduce Malaysia’s dependency on imported labour. The system was repeated in Budget 2025 with further details. The Malaysian Employers Federation (MEF) complained the system was still unfair and insufficiently implemented. Anwar’s promise to cut foreign worker dependency to 15% of the workforce by 2025 was not met. As of late 2025, Malaysia still employed approximately 2.2 million documented foreign workers, with an estimated 1-2 million undocumented — a dependency that has not meaningfully changed under PH.

item.title: MACC Seizes RM6M and Freezes Assets Linked to Selangor Menteri Besar Inc in Sand Mining Corruption Probe
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari / MACC

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-10-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In October 2024, the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) seized RM6 million and froze assets linked to Selangor Menteri Besar Incorporated (MBI) in connection with a sand mining corruption probe. MACC Chief Commissioner Azam Baki confirmed that five firms linked to a Selangor politician were under investigation for alleged corruption involving a sand mining concession. The probe uncovered a network of contracts and payments that raised questions about the integrity of Selangor’s sand mining approvals.

item.title: [BM] AP DAP Dipaksa Sokong Pindaan Kewarganegaraan 'Regresif' — Majlis Peguam Kecam Kerajaan 'Sekeras-Kerasnya'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / DAP Leadership

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-10-17

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 17 Oktober 2024, Parlimen meluluskan Rang Undang-Undang Pindaan Perlembagaan 2024 dengan 206 undi — jauh melebihi majoriti dua pertiga yang diperlukan. Rang undang-undang ini meminda peruntukan kewarganegaraan, termasuk perubahan yang diberi amaran oleh pertubuhan masyarakat sivil, organisasi hak asasi, dan Majlis Peguam Malaysia akan menghapuskan perlindungan untuk kanak-kanak terbiar dan yatim. Apabila rang undang-undang ini pertama kali dibentangkan pada Mac, perpecahan timbul dalam DAP, dengan beberapa AP tidak berpuas hati kerana dipaksa menyokong apa yang Majlis Peguam panggil pindaan ‘regresif.’ AP-AP tersebut diarahkan akur dengan pendirian kerajaan. Majlis Peguam meluluskan resolusi sebulat suara di AGM mengecam kerajaan Anwar ‘sekeras-kerasnya’ atas peruntukan regresif tersebut.

item.title: DAP MPs Whipped Into Supporting 'Regressive' Citizenship Amendments — Malaysian Bar Condemns Government 'in the Strongest Possible Terms'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / DAP Leadership

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-10-17

📌 What Happened

On October 17, 2024, Parliament passed the Constitution (Amendment) Bill 2024 with 206 votes — well above the two-thirds majority required. The bill amended citizenship provisions, including changes that civil society groups, rights organisations, and the Malaysian Bar warned would strip protections from abandoned children and foundlings. When the bill was first tabled in March, a split emerged within DAP, with several MPs unhappy about supporting what the Malaysian Bar called ‘regressive’ amendments. Those MPs were warned to toe the government line. The Malaysian Bar passed a unanimous resolution at its AGM condemning the Anwar government ‘in the strongest possible terms’ for the regressive provisions.

item.title: [BM] Zon Kewangan Khas Forest City — Cukai 0% Untuk Golongan Kaya Raya Sementara Rakyat Bayar SST 8%
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Securities Commission

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-10-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Oktober 2024, kerajaan PH melancarkan Zon Kewangan Khas (ZKK) Forest City di Johor, menawarkan cukai korporat 0% sehingga 15 tahun untuk perniagaan yang layak, cukai 0% untuk pejabat keluarga bernilai tinggi, dan insentif untuk syarikat fintech, pengurusan dana dan aset digital. ZKK direka untuk menyelamatkan Forest City — projek hartanah bernilai RM400 bilion yang disokong China yang kebanyakannya kosong — dengan mengubahnya menjadi hab kewangan. Sementara itu, rakyat Malaysia biasa membayar SST 8% ke atas perkhidmatan harian termasuk penjagaan kesihatan, pendidikan dan sewa.

item.title: Forest City Special Financial Zone — 0% Tax for the Ultra-Rich While Rakyat Pays 8% SST
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Securities Commission

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-10-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In October 2024, the PH government launched the Forest City Special Financial Zone (SFZ) in Johor, offering 0% corporate tax for up to 15 years for qualifying businesses, 0% tax for ultra-high-net-worth family offices, and incentives for fintech, fund management, and digital asset companies. The SFZ was designed to rescue Forest City — a RM400 billion Chinese-backed property development that sat largely empty — by transforming it into a financial hub. Meanwhile, ordinary Malaysians pay 8% SST on everyday services including healthcare, education, and rent.

item.title: [BM] Kontroversi Pensijilan Halal — Bukan Islam Terperangkap Dalam Pertembungan Keterlaluan Agama
item.description:
Said by: Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, DPM / Teresa Kok, MP

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-09-15

Halaman asal tidak mempunyai kandungan.

item.title: [BM] Skandal Penderaan Kanak-Kanak GISBH — Amirudin Kata Penderaan 'Diselindungi Dengan Beralih Kepada Perniagaan'
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2024-09-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Susulan skandal GISBH (Global Ikhwan Services and Business Holdings) yang melibatkan penderaan seksual dan fizikal kanak-kanak di rumah kebajikan, Amirudin menyatakan bahawa organisasi itu telah ‘menyembunyikan penderaan dengan beralih kepada perniagaan’ — mengesyorkan bahawa peralihan GISBH daripada gerakan Al-Arqam yang diharamkan kepada empayar perniagaan yang sah membolehkannya menyembunyikan kegiatan jenayah. Ratusan kanak-kanak diselamatkan dari premis berkaitan GISBH di seluruh Malaysia, dengan ramai ditemui di Selangor.

item.title: GISBH Child Abuse Scandal — Amirudin Says Abuses Were 'Concealed by Shifting to Business'
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Social

Date: 2024-09-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Following the explosive GISBH (Global Ikhwan Services and Business Holdings) scandal involving sexual and physical abuse of children in welfare homes, Amirudin stated that the organisation had ‘concealed abuses by shifting to business’ — suggesting that GISBH’s transition from the banned Al-Arqam movement into a legitimate business empire allowed it to hide criminal activity. Hundreds of children were rescued from GISBH-linked premises across Malaysia, with many found in Selangor.

item.title: Halal Certification Controversy — Non-Muslims Caught in Crossfire of Religious Overreach
item.description:
Said by: Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, DPM / Teresa Kok, MP

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-09-15

Debate erupted over forcing non-Muslim businesses to get halal certification. Kelantan required it for premises serving Muslims. Teresa Kok argued it should remain voluntary. Zahid had to clarify no cabinet decision was made.

item.title: [BM] Hannah Yeoh Tergila-gila Dengan Pemain Badminton Thai Yang Baru Singkirkan Lee Zii Jia Malaysia — Pekak Nada Di Olimpik
item.description:
Said by: Hannah Yeoh, Youth and Sports Minister (then)

Category: Social

Date: 2024-08-07

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Ogos 2024 di Sukan Olimpik Paris, pemain badminton Malaysia Lee Zii Jia tersingkir dalam separuh akhir perseorangan lelaki oleh pemain Thailand Kunlavut Vitidsarn — kekalahan yang memilukan peminat Malaysia yang mengharapkan pingat Olimpik. Beberapa hari kemudian, Menteri Belia dan Sukan Hannah Yeoh memuat naik swafoto bersama Kunlavut di Instagram, memujinya. SCMP melaporkan beliau “dihentam di media sosial kerana siaran ‘peminat tegar.’” Mothership memanggilnya “tidak sensitif.” Yeoh mempertahankan siarannya, berkata Malaysia “bukan kalah tak sportif” dan bahawa tugasnya ialah “memupuk budaya persaingan sihat.”

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Fangirls Over Thai Shuttler Who Just Eliminated Malaysia's Lee Zii Jia — Tone-Deaf at the Olympics
item.description:
Said by: Hannah Yeoh, Youth and Sports Minister (then)

Category: Social

Date: 2024-08-07

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In August 2024 at the Paris Olympics, Malaysian shuttler Lee Zii Jia was knocked out in the men’s singles semi-final by Thailand’s Kunlavut Vitidsarn — a devastating loss for Malaysian fans hoping for an Olympic medal. Days later, Youth and Sports Minister Hannah Yeoh posted selfies with Kunlavut on Instagram, praising him. SCMP reported she was “smashed on social media for ‘fangirl’ post.” Mothership called it “insensitive.” Yeoh defended her post, saying Malaysia is “not a sore loser” and that it was her duty to “instil a culture of healthy competition.”

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Fadzil Paksa Pelesenan Media Sosial Ke Atas Platform — Pengkritik Panggil Ia Versi PH Penapisan Internet
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2024-07-28

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 28 Julai 2024, kerajaan PH mengumumkan bahawa platform media sosial dengan lebih 8 juta pengguna di Malaysia dikehendaki memohon lesen kawal selia daripada SKMM, berkuat kuasa 1 Ogos. Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil berkata langkah itu diperlukan untuk membanteras jenayah siber termasuk penipuan dalam talian, eksploitasi kanak-kanak, dan deepfake. Menjelang penghujung 2025, Fahmi mengugut tindakan undang-undang terhadap platform yang tidak mematuhi. Pada Januari 2026, SKMM menyekat sementara ciri AI Grok milik X atas kebimbangan deepfake. ARTICLE 19 menyeru Malaysia “menghentikan pengenaan tergesa-gesa pengesahan elektronik mandatori,” memberi amaran tentang implikasi terhadap privasi dan kebebasan bersuara.

item.title: Fahmi Fadzil Forces Social Media Licensing on Platforms — Critics Call It PH's Version of Internet Censorship
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2024-07-28

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 28 July 2024, the PH government announced that social media platforms with more than 8 million users in Malaysia would be required to apply for a regulatory licence from MCMC, effective 1 August. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil said the measure was needed to combat cyber offences including online scams, child exploitation, and deepfakes. By late 2025, Fahmi was threatening legal action against non-compliant platforms. In January 2026, MCMC temporarily blocked X’s Grok AI feature over deepfake concerns. ARTICLE 19 called on Malaysia to “halt hasty imposition of mandatory electronic verification,” warning about implications for privacy and free speech.

item.title: [BM] Harga Diesel Melompat 56% Semalaman — Anwar Kata Pengkritik Akan Serang Beliau Walau Apa Pun
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-06-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 10 Jun 2024, harga diesel di Semenanjung Malaysia melompat daripada RM2.15 kepada RM3.35 seliter — kenaikan 56% semalaman. Menteri Kewangan II Amir Hamzah Azizan mengumumkan pengapungan harga pada 9 Jun, berkuat kuasa keesokan harinya — satu hari notis untuk kejutan yang merambat melalui logistik, harga makanan, dan perniagaan kecil. Sabah, Sarawak, dan Labuan kekal pada RM2.15. Anwar memberitahu wartawan: “Kita juga perlu tahu bahawa apa sahaja yang kita buat, kita akan dikritik hebat dengan segala jenis fitnah dan pembohongan.” Tindak balasnya terhadap rakyat yang menghadapi kenaikan kos 56% adalah mengadu tentang kualiti kritikan yang diterimanya.

item.title: [BM] Harga Diesel Melompat 56% Semalaman Ketika PH Mansuh Subsidi — Rakyat Disuruh 'Ketatkan Tali Pinggang'
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II; Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-06-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 10 Jun 2024, kerajaan PH memansuhkan subsidi diesel di Semenanjung Malaysia, menyebabkan harga melompat daripada RM2.15 kepada RM3.35 seliter semalaman — kenaikan 56%. Menteri Kewangan II Amir Hamzah Azizan membingkaikannya sebagai “rasionalisasi subsidi bersasar” dan mengumumkan Sistem Kawalan Diesel Bersubsidi untuk sektor yang layak. Kesannya serta-merta: kos pengangkutan melonjak, harga makanan naik, dan perniagaan memindahkan kos kepada pengguna. Kerajaan menjanjikan isi rumah B40 dan M40 akan dilindungi melalui bantuan tunai BUDI MADANI, tetapi bayaran dikritik secara meluas sebagai tidak mencukupi.

item.title: Diesel Price Jumps 56% Overnight — Anwar Says Critics Will Attack Him Regardless
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-06-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 10 June 2024, diesel prices in Peninsular Malaysia jumped from RM2.15 to RM3.35 per litre — a 56% increase overnight. Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah Azizan announced the price float on 9 June, effective the next morning — one day’s notice for a shock that rippled through logistics, food prices, and small businesses. Sabah, Sarawak, and Labuan remained at RM2.15. Anwar told reporters: “We must also know that whatever we do, we will be severely criticised with all sorts of slander and lies.” His response to citizens facing a 56% cost increase was to complain about the quality of criticism he was receiving.

item.title: Diesel Price Jumps 56% Overnight as PH Removes Subsidies — Rakyat Told to 'Tighten Belts'
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II; Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-06-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 10 June 2024, the PH government removed diesel subsidies in Peninsular Malaysia, causing the price to jump from RM2.15 to RM3.35 per litre overnight — a 56% increase. Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah Azizan framed it as “targeted subsidy rationalisation” and announced a Subsidised Diesel Control System for eligible sectors. The impact was immediate: transport costs surged, food prices climbed, and businesses passed the costs on to consumers. The government promised B40 and M40 households would be protected through BUDI MADANI cash assistance, but payments were widely criticised as insufficient.

item.title: [BM] Kad Akhbar Sebagai Senjata — Kod Etika Baharu Biarkan Kerajaan Tentukan Siapa Wartawan 'Sebenar'
item.description:
Said by: Freedom House / Journalists’ Union

Category: Social

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada pertengahan 2024, kerajaan mengeluarkan Kod Etika Wartawan yang dikemas kini yang secara efektif mewujudkan sistem pelesenan de facto untuk kewartawanan di Malaysia. Akses media ke acara kerajaan, sidang akhbar, dan sumber rasmi semakin bergantung pada pematuhan kod — bermakna media yang menerbitkan laporan kritikal berisiko kehilangan akses. Freedom House mendokumentasikan ini sebagai satu bentuk penapisan lembut. Penapisan kendiri menjadi mekanisme: cerita kritikal berisiko kehilangan akses, boikot pengiklanan daripada syarikat berkaitan kerajaan, atau siasatan SKMM.

item.title: [BM] Kekerasan Berlebihan Polis Di Protes — Pemimpin Reformasi Kini Guna Polis Rusuhan Terhadap Penyokong Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Lawyers for Liberty / Suaram / Bersih

Category: Social

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sepanjang 2024, pelbagai insiden polis menggunakan kekerasan berlebihan dan tangkapan awal terhadap penunjuk perasaan aman didokumentasikan di bawah kerajaan Anwar. Lawyers for Liberty, Suaram, dan Bersih semuanya mengeluarkan kecaman. Polis melakukan lawatan rumah untuk memberi amaran kepada peserta perhimpunan, menangkap penganjur sebelum acara, dan mengerahkan kekuatan yang tidak setimpal pada demonstrasi. Akta Perhimpunan Aman — yang PH telah berjanji untuk mereformasi — digunakan untuk mewajarkan penindasan terhadap kebebasan sivil yang sama yang pernah diperjuangkan PH.

item.title: [BM] Rangkaian Dwi 5G: Berbilion Dibazir Untuk Kompromi Politik — Satu Rangkaian Sudah Memadai
item.description:
Said by: Telecom Analysts / Consumers

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada pertengahan 2024, kerajaan PH mengubah pelancaran 5G Malaysia daripada rangkaian borong tunggal (Digital Nasional Berhad, DNB) kepada model rangkaian dwi — membenarkan rangkaian 5G kedua dibina bersama DNB. Langkah ini dilihat secara meluas sebagai kompromi politik untuk menampung pengendali telekomunikasi utama yang mempunyai hubungan politik dan yang menentang model rangkaian tunggal. Pendekatan rangkaian dwi menggandakan kos infrastruktur, memecah kecekapan spektrum, dan melambatkan perluasan liputan luar bandar — semuanya untuk menyelesaikan masalah politik, bukan masalah teknikal.

item.title: [BM] SKMM Sekat Laman Berita Kritikal — MalaysiaNow, Asia Sentinel, UtusanTV Ditapis
item.description:
Said by: Freedom House Report 2024

Category: Social

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada pertengahan 2024, SKMM menyekat laman berita yang kritikal terhadap kerajaan termasuk MalaysiaNow, UtusanTV, TV Pertiwi, dan Asia Sentinel. Kod Etika baharu secara efektif memberikan atau menghalang akses media berdasarkan pematuhan — mewujudkan sistem pelesenan de facto untuk kewartawanan. Seorang lelaki dijatuhi hukuman 6 bulan penjara kerana hantaran Facebook yang menghina Sultan. Laporan Freedom House 2024 mendokumentasikan kebebasan internet Malaysia yang merosot di bawah PH, menandakan sekatan laman berita dan perluasan kuasa penyederhanaan kandungan SKMM sebagai kebimbangan utama.

item.title: Dual 5G Network: Billions Wasted on Political Compromise — One Network Would Have Sufficed
item.description:
Said by: Telecom Analysts / Consumers

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In mid-2024, the PH government shifted Malaysia’s 5G rollout from a single wholesale network (Digital Nasional Berhad, DNB) to a dual-network model — allowing a second 5G network to be built alongside DNB. The move was widely seen as a political compromise to accommodate major telecom operators with political connections who had opposed the single-network model. The dual-network approach doubles infrastructure costs, splits spectrum efficiency, and delays rural coverage expansion — all to solve a political problem, not a technical one.

item.title: MCMC Blocks Critical News Sites — MalaysiaNow, Asia Sentinel, UtusanTV Censored
item.description:
Said by: Freedom House Report 2024

Category: Social

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In mid-2024, MCMC blocked news outlets critical of the government including MalaysiaNow, UtusanTV, TV Pertiwi, and Asia Sentinel. A new Code of Ethics effectively grants or bars media access based on compliance — creating a de facto licensing system for journalism. A man was sentenced to 6 months for a Facebook post insulting a Sultan. Freedom House’s 2024 report documented Malaysia’s internet freedom as declining under PH, flagging the blocking of news sites and the expansion of MCMC’s content moderation powers as key concerns.

item.title: Police Excessive Force at Protests — Reformasi Leader Now Uses Riot Police Against His Own Supporters
item.description:
Said by: Lawyers for Liberty / Suaram / Bersih

Category: Social

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Throughout 2024, multiple incidents of police using excessive force and pre-emptive arrests against peaceful protesters were documented under the Anwar government. Lawyers for Liberty, Suaram, and Bersih all issued condemnations. Police conducted home visits to warn potential rally participants, arrested organisers before events, and deployed disproportionate force at demonstrations. The Peaceful Assembly Act — which PH had promised to reform — was used to justify suppression of the same civil liberties PH once championed.

item.title: Press Cards as Weapons — New Code of Ethics Lets Government Decide Who Is a 'Real' Journalist
item.description:
Said by: Freedom House / Journalists’ Union

Category: Social

Date: 2024-06-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In mid-2024, the government released an updated Code of Ethics for Journalists that effectively creates a de facto licensing system for journalism in Malaysia. Media access to government events, press conferences, and official sources is increasingly dependent on compliance with the code — meaning outlets that publish critical reporting risk losing access. Freedom House documented this as a form of soft censorship. Self-censorship becomes the mechanism: critical stories risk loss of access, advertising boycotts from government-linked companies, or MCMC investigations.

item.title: [BM] 30% Calon SPM GAGAL Sekurang-kurangnya Satu Mata Pelajaran — Gred Lulus 20% Dalam Matematik Bukan Pendidikan, Ia Pembohongan
item.description:
Said by: Education Ministry Data / Independent Analysis

Category: Education

Date: 2024-05-27

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Dalam keputusan SPM 2023 yang dikeluarkan pada Mei 2024, kira-kira 30% calon gagal sekurang-kurangnya satu mata pelajaran. Matematik mempunyai kadar kegagalan tertinggi pada 25.9%, diikuti sains pada 25%. Mata pelajaran terbaik adalah Quran dan Sunnah pada 84%. Laporan menunjukkan ambang lulus untuk matematik mungkin serendah 20% — bermakna pelajar yang mendapat 4 daripada 5 soalan salah masih “lulus.” Kerajaan sebelum ini telah memansuhkan peperiksaan UPSR (Tahun 6) dan PMR (Tahun 9), menghapuskan satu-satunya pusat pemeriksaan diagnostik yang boleh mengenal pasti pelajar yang bergelut awal.

item.title: 30% of SPM Candidates FAIL At Least One Subject — A Pass Grade of 20% in Math Is Not Education, It's a Lie
item.description:
Said by: Education Ministry Data / Independent Analysis

Category: Education

Date: 2024-05-27

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In SPM 2023 results released in May 2024, approximately 30% of candidates failed at least one subject. Mathematics had the highest failure rate at 25.9%, followed by science at 25%. The best-performing subject was Quran and Sunnah at 84%. Reports indicate the pass threshold for mathematics may be as low as 20% — meaning a student who gets 4 out of 5 questions wrong still “passes.” The government had previously abolished UPSR (Year 6) and PMR (Year 9) examinations, removing the only diagnostic checkpoints that could identify struggling students early.

item.title: [BM] Kebebasan Akhbar Menjunam 34 Tangga Ke Kedudukan 107 — 'Situasi Sukar' Di Bawah PH
item.description:
Said by: Reporters Without Borders (RSF)

Category: Social

Date: 2024-05-03

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Mei 2024, Wartawan Tanpa Sempadan (RSF) mengeluarkan Indeks Kebebasan Akhbar Dunia 2024, di mana Malaysia menjunam 34 tangga — dari ke-73 ke ke-107 — di bawah kerajaan PH. RSF mengklasifikasikan Malaysia sebagai “situasi sukar” untuk kebebasan akhbar. Kejatuhan ini didorong oleh pertuduhan hasutan terhadap wartawan dan aktivis, sekatan kandungan SKMM, keperluan pelesenan media sosial, dan penahanan wartawan FMT Rex Tan. Walaupun selepas pemulihan separa ke ke-88 pada 2025, Malaysia masih ketinggalan daripada kedudukan 2023 di bawah PH.

item.title: [BM] KFC Tutup 100+ Cawangan Akibat Boikot Pro-Palestin — Kerajaan Menonton Dari Tepi
item.description:
Said by: QSR Brands Holdings (KFC operator)

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-05-03

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Mei 2024, KFC Malaysia menutup sementara lebih 100 cawangan akibat boikot berkaitan konflik Gaza. Beribu-ribu pekerja Malaysia — kebanyakan keluarga B40 berpendapatan rendah — menghadapi pengurangan waktu kerja atau kehilangan pekerjaan. Jualan global McDonald’s jatuh 0.1% pada 2024 dan 1% pada S1 2025, didorong terutamanya oleh boikot di negara majoriti Muslim termasuk Malaysia. Gerakan boikot dicetuskan oleh aktivis media sosial dan ahli politik pembangkang — terutamanya PAS dan PN — yang membingkaikan penggunaan di rangkaian makanan segera Barat sebagai keterlibatan dalam konflik Gaza. Tindak balas kerajaan amat ketara ketiadaannya — tiada menteri menyokong atau menentang boikot.

item.title: KFC Closes 100+ Outlets Amid Pro-Palestine Boycott — Government Watches From the Sidelines
item.description:
Said by: QSR Brands Holdings (KFC operator)

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-05-03

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In May 2024, KFC Malaysia temporarily closed over 100 outlets amid boycotts linked to the Gaza conflict. Thousands of Malaysian workers — mostly low-income B40 families — faced reduced hours or outright job losses. McDonald’s global sales fell 0.1% in 2024 and 1% in Q1 2025, driven largely by boycotts in Muslim-majority countries including Malaysia. The boycott movement was fueled by social media activists and opposition politicians — particularly PAS and PN — who framed consumption at Western fast-food chains as complicity in the Gaza conflict. The government’s response was conspicuously, strategically absent — no minister endorsed or opposed the boycott.

item.title: Press Freedom Plunges 34 Spots to 107th — 'Difficult Situation' Under PH
item.description:
Said by: Reporters Without Borders (RSF)

Category: Social

Date: 2024-05-03

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In May 2024, Reporters Without Borders (RSF) released the 2024 World Press Freedom Index, in which Malaysia plunged 34 places — from 73rd to 107th — under the PH government. RSF classified Malaysia as a “difficult situation” for press freedom. The collapse was driven by sedition charges against journalists and activists, MCMC content blocking, social media licensing requirements, and the arrest of FMT journalist Rex Tan. Even after a partial recovery to 88th in 2025, Malaysia still trails its 2023 ranking under PH.

item.title: [BM] Saga Kasino Forest City — Anwar Ugut PENJARA Bagi Mereka Yang Melaporkannya
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-05-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Mei 2024, Anwar Ibrahim menyifatkan dakwaan mengenai kasino di Forest City di Johor sebagai “berniat jahat” dan mencadangkan mereka yang menyebarkan khabar angin boleh dipenjarakan. SCMP melaporkan bahawa Anwar dan hartawan yang dikaitkan dengan Zon Kewangan Khas Forest City “didesak supaya menarik balik ugutan” selepas tindak balas agresif itu mendapat kecaman. Chegubard — aktivis yang melaporkan rancangan kasino tersebut — sebenarnya telah didakwa di bawah Akta Hasutan kerana hantaran media sosialnya. Tindak balas kerajaan terhadap kewartawanan mengenai Forest City bukanlah ketelusan atau penafian dengan bukti — ia adalah ugutan penjara.

item.title: Forest City Casino Saga — Anwar Threatens JAIL for Those Who Report on It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-05-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In May 2024, Anwar Ibrahim called allegations about a casino at Forest City in Johor “malicious” and suggested those spreading the rumours could face jail. SCMP reported that Anwar and tycoons connected to the Forest City Special Financial Zone were “urged to walk back threats” after the aggressive response drew backlash. Chegubard — the activist who reported on the casino plan — was actually charged with sedition for his social media post. The government’s response to journalism about Forest City was not transparency or denial with evidence — it was threats of imprisonment.

item.title: [BM] Chegubard Didakwa HASUTAN Kerana Melaporkan Dakwaan Kasino Forest City — Janji Kebebasan Bersuara Reformasi Mati
item.description:
Said by: Johor Sessions Court / Badrul Hisham (Chegubard)

Category: Social

Date: 2024-04-30

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 30 April 2024, aktivis Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) didakwa di bawah Akta Hasutan era kolonial Malaysia atas hantaran media sosial mengenai rancangan kasino di Forest City, Johor. Akta Hasutan adalah undang-undang yang sama yang PH berjanji untuk memansuhkan semasa kempen pilihan raya 2018 dan 2022. Sehingga Mac 2026, rayuan Chegubard masih belum selesai di Mahkamah Sesyen Johor Bahru. Bukannya memansuhkan Akta Hasutan, kerajaan Anwar kini menjadikannya senjata terhadap pengkritik — buku panduan yang sama tepat-tepat digunakan oleh BN terhadap Anwar sendiri pada tahun 1990-an.

item.title: Chegubard Charged with SEDITION for Reporting Forest City Casino Claims — Reformasi's Free Speech Promise Dies
item.description:
Said by: Johor Sessions Court / Badrul Hisham (Chegubard)

Category: Social

Date: 2024-04-30

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 30 April 2024, activist Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) was charged under Malaysia’s colonial-era Sedition Act for a social media post about casino plans at Forest City in Johor. The Sedition Act is the same law PH promised to repeal during its 2018 and 2022 election campaigns. As of March 2026, Chegubard’s appeal is still pending at the Johor Bahru Sessions Court. Instead of repealing the Sedition Act, the Anwar government is now weaponising it against critics — the exact same playbook used by BN against Anwar himself in the 1990s.

item.title: [BM] Stoking Allah KK Mart — Kedai Dibom Molotov Sementara Anwar Suruh Orang Ramai Jangan Jadi Hakim
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-03-25

Bom Api Dan Ceramah Tentang Kesabaran

Pada Mac 2024, stoking yang tertera perkataan “Allah” ditemui dijual di cawangan KK Super Mart. Apa yang menyusul adalah berminggu kemarahan, seruan boikot, dan tiga serangan bom Molotov ke atas kedai. Kerajaan Anwar mengambil beberapa hari untuk merespons. Apabila PM akhirnya bersuara, beliau memberitahu orang ramai jangan bertindak sebagai “pendakwa atau hakim.”

Fakta

Fakta: Pada 13 Mac 2024, stoking dengan perkataan “Allah” ditemui di KK Super Mart di Sunway City. Hanya 14 pasang ditemui di tiga cawangan.

item.title: KK Mart Allah Socks — Stores Firebombed While Anwar Tells Public Not to Be Judge
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-03-25

Firebombs and a Lecture on Patience

In March 2024, socks bearing the word “Allah” were found for sale at KK Super Mart outlets. What followed was weeks of outrage, boycott calls, and three Molotov cocktail attacks on stores. Anwar’s government took days to respond. When the PM finally spoke, he told the public not to act as “prosecutor or judge.”

item.title: [BM] Kenaikan Tarif Elektrik + SST Ke Atas Elektrik — Pukulan Berganda Pada Bil Bulanan Rakyat
item.description:
Said by: Energy Commission / Consumer Groups

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Mac 2024, kerajaan mengenakan SST 8% ke atas elektrik komersial, menambah kos yang dilepaskan perniagaan terus kepada pengguna melalui harga barangan dan perkhidmatan yang lebih tinggi. Digabungkan dengan pengembangan SST yang lebih luas dan pembuangan subsidi diesel, rakyat Malaysia menghadapi kejutan kos tiga kali ganda: minyak lebih mahal, kos elektrik lebih tinggi, dan harga yang lebih tinggi untuk segala yang menggunakan minyak dan elektrik — iaitu segala-galanya. Di bawah sistem GST BN, elektrik untuk kegunaan domestik adalah berkadar sifar, bermakna pengguna tidak membayar cukai penggunaan ke atasnya.

item.title: [BM] Lebih 10,000 Pelajar SPM Langsung Tidak Duduki Peperiksaan — Sistem Pendidikan Sedang Berdarah
item.description:
Said by: Education Ministry / DOSM

Category: Education

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Lebih 10,160 calon SPM berdaftar — 2.6% daripada jumlah keseluruhan — tidak menduduki peperiksaan sekolah terpenting Malaysia pada 2023. Ini bukan ralat pembundaran; ia mewakili lebih sepuluh ribu anak muda Malaysia yang terputus sepenuhnya daripada sistem pendidikan. Digabungkan dengan kadar pendaftaran pengajian tinggi hanya 42.57% (berbanding 93% Singapura dan purata global 51.98%), pengangguran belia yang terperangkap pada 12.28%, peruntukan belanjawan pendidikan tinggi yang susut dari 6.8% pada 2010 ke 4.3% pada 2025, dan 7,681 kes buli yang dilaporkan, sistem ini sedang berdarah kehilangan pelajar di setiap peringkat.

item.title: [BM] Lebih 10,000 Pelajar SPM Langsung Tidak Menduduki Peperiksaan — Sistem Pendidikan Kehilangan Pelajar
item.description:
Said by: Education Ministry / DOSM

Category: Education

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Lebih 10,160 calon SPM yang berdaftar — 2.6% daripada jumlah keseluruhan — tidak menduduki peperiksaan sekolah terpenting Malaysia pada 2023. Ini bukan ralat pembundaran; ia mewakili lebih sepuluh ribu anak muda Malaysia yang meninggalkan sistem pendidikan sepenuhnya. Digabungkan dengan kadar kemasukan pengajian tinggi hanya 42.57% (berbanding 93% Singapura dan purata global 51.98%), pengangguran belia kekal pada 12.28%, peruntukan bajet pendidikan tinggi yang jatuh dari 6.8% pada 2010 kepada 4.3% pada 2025, dan 7,681 kes buli yang dilaporkan, sistem ini kehilangan pelajar di setiap peringkat.

item.title: [BM] SST Dinaikkan Dari 6% Ke 8%, Kemudian Diperluaskan Ke Kesihatan, Sewa, Pendidikan — Cukai 'Perlu' Ke Atas Rakyat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim (Finance Minister) and MOF

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Mac 2024, cukai perkhidmatan Malaysia dinaikkan dari 6% ke 8%. Kemudian pada Julai 2025, SST diperluaskan untuk meliputi enam kategori baharu: sewaan dan pajakan, pembinaan, perkhidmatan kewangan, kesihatan swasta, pendidikan, dan perkhidmatan kecantikan. Cukai jualan 5-10% juga dikenakan ke atas buah-buahan import dan “makanan laut premium.” Anwar, yang juga memegang portfolio Menteri Kewangan, menggambarkan pengembangan itu sebagai “perlu” untuk kemampanan fiskal. Straits Times menggambarkannya sebagai sebahagian daripada “periuk panas berita ekonomi buruk” bersama kenaikan tarif elektrik, pemotongan subsidi, dan perubahan gas masak. CNA bertanya: “Perlu, tetapi pada kos apa kepada perniagaan dan pengguna?”

item.title: Electricity Tariff Hike + SST on Electricity — Double Whammy on Rakyat's Monthly Bills
item.description:
Said by: Energy Commission / Consumer Groups

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In March 2024, the government imposed 8% SST on commercial electricity, adding costs that businesses pass directly to consumers through higher prices for goods and services. Combined with the broader SST expansion and diesel subsidy removal, Malaysians faced a triple cost shock: higher fuel, higher electricity costs, and higher prices for everything that uses fuel and electricity — which is everything. Under BN’s GST system, electricity for domestic use was zero-rated, meaning consumers paid no consumption tax on it.

item.title: Over 10,000 SPM Students Didn't Even Sit for the Exam — Education System Haemorrhaging
item.description:
Said by: Education Ministry / DOSM

Category: Education

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: More than 10,160 registered SPM candidates — 2.6% of the total — did not sit for Malaysia’s most important school examination in 2023. This is not a rounding error; it represents over ten thousand young Malaysians who disengaged from the education system entirely. Combined with a tertiary enrollment rate of just 42.57% (versus Singapore’s 93% and the global average of 51.98%), youth unemployment stuck at 12.28%, a higher education budget share that dropped from 6.8% in 2010 to 4.3% in 2025, and 7,681 reported bullying cases, the system is haemorrhaging students at every level.

item.title: SST Hiked From 6% to 8%, Then Expanded to Healthcare, Rent, Education — 'Necessary' Tax on the Rakyat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim (Finance Minister) and MOF

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In March 2024, Malaysia’s service tax was hiked from 6% to 8%. Then in July 2025, the SST was expanded to cover six new categories: rental and leasing, construction, financial services, private healthcare, education, and beauty services. Sales tax of 5-10% was also imposed on imported fruits and “premium seafood.” Anwar, who also holds the Finance Minister portfolio, described the expansion as “necessary” for fiscal sustainability. The Straits Times described it as part of a “hotpot of bad economic news” alongside electricity tariff hikes, subsidy cuts, and cooking gas changes. CNA asked: “Necessary, but at what cost to businesses and consumers?”

item.title: [BM] Polis Tindas Perhimpunan Bersih Di Bawah Kerajaan PH — Golongan Reformis Menjadi Penindas
item.description:
Said by: PH Government; Police (PDRM)

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-02-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 26-27 Februari 2024, Bersih mengadakan perhimpunan menggesa kerajaan PH melaksanakan reformasi politik yang dijanjikan semasa kempen pilihan raya 2022 — termasuk kebebasan institusi, langkah antirasuah, dan pengawasan parlimen. Polis merespons dengan tindakan keras yang mendapat kecaman segera daripada masyarakat sivil. Lawyers for Liberty mengeluarkan kenyataan mengecam respons kerajaan, mengkritik kekurangan pemahaman polis terhadap Akta Perhimpunan Aman dan Perlembagaan Persekutuan. Bersih juga menyerahkan memorandum kepada kerajaan menggesa pelaksanaan reformasi yang lama tertangguh.

item.title: [BM] Polis Tindas Perhimpunan Bersih Di Bawah Kerajaan PH — Reformis Menjadi Penindas
item.description:
Said by: PH Government; Police (PDRM)

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-02-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 26-27 Februari 2024, Bersih mengadakan perhimpunan menyeru kerajaan PH melaksanakan reformasi politik yang dijanjikan semasa kempen pilihan raya 2022 — termasuk kebebasan institusi, langkah anti-rasuah, dan pengawasan parlimen. Polis bertindak dengan tindakan keras yang segera mendapat kecaman daripada masyarakat sivil. Lawyers for Liberty mengeluarkan kenyataan mengecam respons kerajaan, mengkritik kurangnya pemahaman polis terhadap Akta Perhimpunan Aman dan Perlembagaan Persekutuan.

item.title: [BM] Polis Ugut Peserta Perhimpunan Bersih — Kerajaan PH Guna Taktik Sama Yang Pernah Dikecam
item.description:
Said by: Bersih / Lawyers for Liberty

Category: Social

Date: 2024-02-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Februari 2024, kerajaan PH menghantar amaran polis bahawa demonstrasi yang dirancang Bersih adalah haram. Pegawai melawat rumah peserta dan mengeluarkan amaran sebelum perhimpunan. Lawyers for Liberty (LFL) mengecamnya sebagai “pengkhianatan oleh PH,” memetik penggunaan taktik ugutan yang sama yang PH pernah lawan. CSIS mencatatkan bahawa kumpulan masyarakat sivil “terbelah antara pakatan sejarah mereka dengan PH dan kegagalan kerajaan melaksanakan agenda reformasinya.” Bersih — gabungan reformasi pilihan raya yang merupakan sekutu terdekat PH semasa era BN — kini dilayan sebagai ancaman.

item.title: Police Crack Down on Bersih Rally Under PH Government — The Reformists Become the Repressors
item.description:
Said by: PH Government; Police (PDRM)

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-02-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 26-27 February 2024, Bersih held a rally calling on the PH government to implement the political reforms it had promised during the 2022 election campaign — including institutional independence, anti-corruption measures, and parliamentary oversight. Police responded with a crackdown that drew immediate condemnation from civil society. Lawyers for Liberty issued a statement condemning the government’s response, criticising the police’s lack of understanding of the Peaceful Assembly Act and the Federal Constitution. Bersih also handed a memorandum to the government urging implementation of long-delayed reforms.

item.title: Police Threaten Bersih Rally Participants — PH Government Uses Same Tactics It Once Condemned
item.description:
Said by: Bersih / Lawyers for Liberty

Category: Social

Date: 2024-02-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In February 2024, the PH government sent police warnings that Bersih’s planned demonstration was illegal. Officers visited participants’ homes and issued warnings ahead of the rally. Lawyers for Liberty (LFL) condemned it as “a betrayal by PH,” citing the government’s use of the same intimidation tactics PH had once fought against. CSIS noted that civil society groups are “torn between their historical alliance with PH and the government’s failure to implement its reform agenda.” Bersih — the electoral reform coalition that was PH’s closest ally during the BN era — was now being treated as a threat.

item.title: [BM] Ringgit Jatuh Ke Paras Terendah 26 Tahun — Anwar Kata 'Membimbangkan' Tetapi Ekonomi Sihat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-02-23

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Februari 2024, ringgit Malaysia jatuh ke 4.7965 berbanding dolar AS — paras terendah sejak Krisis Kewangan Asia 1998. Bloomberg melaporkan ringgit “terdedah kepada kejatuhan ke arah paras rendah tahun lepas” disebabkan kerapuhan politik dan halangan ekonomi. Anwar mengakui kejatuhan itu “membimbangkan” tetapi menegaskan ekonomi kukuh, menunjuk kepada RM329.5 bilion dalam pelaburan yang diluluskan pada 2023 sebagai bukti. Penganalisis menyatakan bahawa walaupun penunjuk makro kelihatan baik, rakyat Malaysia biasa melihat pendapatan boleh guna menyusut apabila kos import meningkat secara menyeluruh.

item.title: Ringgit Crashes to 26-Year Low — Anwar Says 'Concerning' But Economy Is Fine
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-02-23

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In February 2024, the Malaysian ringgit crashed to 4.7965 against the US dollar — its lowest since the 1998 Asian Financial Crisis. Bloomberg reported the ringgit was “vulnerable to a drop toward last year’s low” due to political fragility and economic headwinds. Anwar acknowledged the fall was “concerning” but insisted the economy was strong, pointing to RM329.5 billion in approved investments in 2023 as evidence. Analysts noted that while macro indicators looked decent, average Malaysians saw disposable income shrink as import costs rose across the board.

item.title: [BM] Keputusan Mahkamah Persekutuan Mengenai Undang-Undang Syariah Kelantan — PH Meraikan, Kemudian Senyap Soal Reformasi
item.description:
Said by: Federal Court of Malaysia

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-02-09

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Februari 2024, Mahkamah Persekutuan membatalkan 16 daripada 18 peruntukan yang dicabar dalam Kanun Jenayah Syariah Kelantan sebagai tidak berperlembagaan, memutuskan bahawa negeri yang ditadbir PAS itu telah melampaui kuasa perundangannya. Pemimpin PH pada awalnya meraikan keputusan itu sebagai kemenangan bagi keluhuran perlembagaan. Kemudian kerajaan senyap sepenuhnya mengenai reformasi yang lebih luas. Walaupun keputusan itu mewujudkan asas undang-undang yang jelas untuk menangani pencerobohan serupa di negeri lain, tiada tindakan perundangan diambil. Pelbagai negeri mempunyai peruntukan setanding yang kekal tidak disentuh.

item.title: [BM] Keputusan Mahkamah Persekutuan Mengenai Undang-Undang Syariah Kelantan — PH Raikan, Kemudian Senyap Soal Reformasi
item.description:
Said by: Federal Court of Malaysia

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-02-09

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Februari 2024, Mahkamah Persekutuan membatalkan 16 daripada 18 peruntukan yang dicabar dalam Kanun Jenayah Syariah Kelantan sebagai tidak berperlembagaan, memutuskan bahawa kerajaan negeri PAS telah melampaui kuasa perundangannya. Pemimpin PH pada mulanya meraikan keputusan itu sebagai kemenangan keluhuran perlembagaan. Kemudian kerajaan senyap sepenuhnya mengenai reformasi lebih luas. Walaupun keputusan itu mewujudkan asas undang-undang jelas untuk menangani pencerobohan serupa di negeri-negeri lain, tiada tindakan perundangan diambil. Pelbagai negeri mempunyai peruntukan sebanding yang kekal tidak disentuh.

item.title: Federal Court Ruling on Kelantan Shariah Laws — PH Celebrates, Then Goes Quiet on Reform
item.description:
Said by: Federal Court of Malaysia

Category: Religion

Date: 2024-02-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In February 2024, the Federal Court struck down 16 out of 18 challenged provisions in Kelantan’s Shariah Criminal Code as unconstitutional, ruling that the PAS-governed state had overstepped its legislative authority. PH leaders initially celebrated the ruling as a victory for constitutional supremacy. Then the government went completely silent on broader reform. Despite the ruling creating a clear legal foundation to address similar overreach in other states, no legislative action was taken. Multiple states have comparable provisions that remain untouched.

item.title: [BM] Hukuman Penjara Najib Dipotong Separuh — Lembaga Pengampunan Di Bawah Pengawasan Anwar
item.description:
Said by: Pardons Board / King of Malaysia

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-02-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 2 Februari 2024, Lembaga Pengampunan — yang beroperasi di bawah kuasa perlembagaan Yang di-Pertuan Agong, dengan PM sebagai ahli — memotong separuh hukuman penjara 12 tahun Najib Razak kepada 6 tahun atas peranannya dalam skandal 1MDB. Denda RM210 juta Najib juga dikurangkan kepada RM50 juta. Keputusan itu datang di tengah kontroversi “adendum diraja,” dengan pihak Najib mendakwa dokumen tambahan wujud yang memberikan tahanan rumah. Reuters melaporkan pengampunan itu datang “di tengah tuduhan kemunduran reformasi.” Pengkritik memanggilnya urusan bilik belakang untuk mengekalkan UMNO dalam gabungan — UMNO telah menjadikan pembebasan Najib sebagai prasyarat untuk sokongan berterusan kepada kerajaan Anwar.

item.title: [BM] Hukuman Penjara Najib Dipotong Separuh — Lembaga Pengampunan Di Bawah Pentadbiran Anwar
item.description:
Said by: Pardons Board / King of Malaysia

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-02-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 2 Februari 2024, Lembaga Pengampunan — yang beroperasi di bawah kuasa perlembagaan Yang di-Pertuan Agong, dengan PM sebagai ahli — memotong separuh hukuman penjara 12 tahun Najib Razak kepada 6 tahun atas peranannya dalam skandal 1MDB. Denda RM210 juta Najib juga dikurangkan kepada RM50 juta. Keputusan itu berlaku di tengah kontroversi “adendum diraja,” dengan pihak Najib mendakwa dokumen tambahan wujud memberikan tahanan rumah. Reuters melaporkan pengampunan itu berlaku “di tengah tuduhan kemunduran reformasi.” Pengkritik memanggilnya urusan belakang tabir untuk mengekalkan UMNO dalam gabungan.

item.title: Najib's Jail Sentence Halved — Pardons Board Under Anwar's Watch
item.description:
Said by: Pardons Board / King of Malaysia

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-02-02

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 2 February 2024, the Pardons Board — which operates under the constitutional authority of the King, with the PM as a member — halved Najib Razak’s 12-year jail sentence to 6 years for his role in the 1MDB scandal. Najib’s RM210 million fine was also reduced to RM50 million. The decision came amid a “royal addendum” controversy, with Najib’s camp claiming an additional document existed granting house arrest. Reuters reported the pardon came “amid accusations of backsliding on reforms.” Critics called it a backroom deal to keep UMNO in the coalition — UMNO had made Najib’s release a precondition for continued support of Anwar’s government.

item.title: [BM] Skor PISA Malaysia Merosot Paling Banyak Antara Negara Asia Tenggara — Anwar Kata 'Tidak Boleh Dalam Penafian'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2024-01-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Keputusan PISA 2022 Malaysia — mengukur kualiti pendidikan pelajar 15 tahun — menunjukkan kemerosotan terbesar antara semua negara Asia Tenggara yang diuji. Skor merosot merentasi matematik, sains, dan bacaan. Anwar menjawab dengan mengatakan Malaysia “mesti tahu keadaan urusan kita dan tidak boleh dalam keadaan penafian.” Menteri Pendidikan mengakui sistem “menggagalkan guru dan pelajar.” CNA melaporkan politik — terutamanya ketegangan antara keperluan Bahasa Melayu dan kemahiran Bahasa Inggeris — menjadi punca kesukaran reformasi pendidikan. Tiga tahun kemudian, pakar mengatakan tiada apa berubah di lapangan.

item.title: [BM] Skor PISA Malaysia Merosot Paling Teruk Di Kalangan Negara Asia Tenggara — Anwar Kata 'Tidak Boleh Nafikan'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2024-01-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Keputusan PISA 2022 Malaysia — mengukur kualiti pendidikan pelajar berumur 15 tahun — menunjukkan kemerosotan terbesar di kalangan semua negara Asia Tenggara yang diuji. Skor jatuh merentas matematik, sains, dan bacaan. Anwar merespons dengan mengatakan Malaysia “mesti mengetahui keadaan sebenar dan tidak boleh dalam keadaan menafikan.” Menteri Pendidikan mengakui sistem itu “mengecewakan guru dan pelajar.” CNA melaporkan bahawa politik — terutamanya ketegangan antara keperluan bahasa Melayu dan kecekapan bahasa Inggeris — berada di sebalik kesukaran reformasi pendidikan. Tiga tahun kemudian, pakar mengatakan tiada apa yang berubah di lapangan.

item.title: Malaysia's PISA Scores Decline Most Among Southeast Asian Countries — Anwar Says 'Cannot Be in Denial'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Education

Date: 2024-01-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysia’s 2022 PISA results — measuring education quality among 15-year-olds — showed the biggest decline among all Southeast Asian countries tested. Scores dropped across mathematics, science, and reading. Anwar responded by saying Malaysia “must know the state of our affairs and cannot be in a state of denial.” The Education Minister admitted the system “failed both teachers and students.” CNA reported that politics — particularly the tension between Malay language requirements and English proficiency — is behind the difficulty of education reform. Three years later, experts say nothing has changed on the ground.

item.title: [BM] Amnesty International 2024: Anwar 'Mengkhianati Ikrar Reformasi Yang Dibuat Kepada Pengundi Malaysia'
item.description:
Said by: Amnesty International / Shayna Bauchner

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-01-11

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2024, laporan tahunan Amnesty International menyatakan Anwar Ibrahim telah “mengkhianati ikrar reformasi yang dibuat kepada pengundi Malaysia supaya dapat mengekalkan gabungannya.” Laporan itu, ditulis oleh penyelidik Shayna Bauchner, mengenal pasti tujuh bidang di mana Malaysia gagal memenuhi kewajipan hak asasi manusia, termasuk kebebasan bersuara, kebebasan perhimpunan, kebebasan media, hak pendatang, hak LGBTQ+, dan hukuman mati. Amnesty menyatakan kerajaan bukan sahaja gagal memajukan reformasi tetapi secara aktif menggunakan undang-undang penindas yang dijanjikan akan dimansuhkan.

item.title: [BM] Amnesty International 2024: Anwar 'Mengkhianati Janji Reformasi Yang Dibuat Kepada Pengundi Malaysia'
item.description:
Said by: Amnesty International / Shayna Bauchner

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-01-11

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2024, laporan tahunan Amnesty International menyatakan bahawa Anwar Ibrahim telah “mengkhianati janji reformasi yang dibuatnya kepada pengundi Malaysia supaya beliau boleh mengekalkan gabungannya.” Laporan itu, ditulis oleh penyelidik Shayna Bauchner, mengenal pasti tujuh bidang di mana Malaysia gagal memenuhi tanggungjawab hak asasi manusianya, termasuk kebebasan bersuara, kebebasan berhimpun, kebebasan media, hak pendatang, hak LGBTQ+, dan hukuman mati. Amnesty menyatakan bahawa kerajaan bukan sahaja gagal memajukan reformasi tetapi secara aktif menggunakan undang-undang menindas yang dijanjikan untuk dimansuhkan.

item.title: [BM] HRW 2024: 'Agenda Reformasi Terbantut' — Kerajaan Gagal Tunaikan Ikrar Dalam Tahun Pertama
item.description:
Said by: Human Rights Watch

Category: Social

Date: 2024-01-11

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2024, Human Rights Watch mengeluarkan Laporan Dunia 2024, memberikan keputusan menghancurkan terhadap tahun pertama Anwar Ibrahim: “Agenda Reformasi Terbantut.” HRW menyatakan Anwar telah “sebahagian besarnya gagal menunaikan ikrar menangani penindasan dan rasuah” dan menyeru kerajaan “beriltizam semula kepada agenda menghormati hak dengan menukar janji kempen yang diketepikan menjadi tindakan.” Laporan itu mendokumenkan kegagalan merentasi kebebasan bersuara, perhimpunan, kebebasan media, dan reformasi institusi. Setahun kemudian, penilaian HRW 2025 lebih keras: “Kemunduran Hak.”

item.title: [BM] HRW 2024: 'Agenda Reformasi Terbantut' — Kerajaan Gagal Tunaikan Janji Dalam Tahun Pertama
item.description:
Said by: Human Rights Watch

Category: Social

Date: 2024-01-11

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2024, Human Rights Watch mengeluarkan Laporan Dunia 2024, memberikan keputusan yang dahsyat terhadap tahun pertama Anwar Ibrahim berkuasa: “Agenda Reformasi Terbantut.” HRW menyatakan bahawa Anwar telah “sebahagian besarnya gagal menunaikan janjinya untuk menangani penindasan dan rasuah” dan menyeru kerajaan “mengembalikan komitmen kepada agenda yang menghormati hak dengan menukarkan janji kempen yang diketepikan menjadi tindakan.” Laporan itu mendokumentasikan kegagalan merentas kebebasan bersuara, perhimpunan, kebebasan media, dan reformasi institusi. Setahun kemudian, penilaian HRW 2025 lebih keras lagi: “Kemunduran Hak.”

item.title: Amnesty International 2024: Anwar 'Betrayed the Reform Pledges He Made to Malaysian Voters'
item.description:
Said by: Amnesty International / Shayna Bauchner

Category: Politics

Date: 2024-01-11

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2024, Amnesty International’s annual report stated that Anwar Ibrahim had “betrayed the reform pledges he made to Malaysian voters so he could hold his coalition together.” The report, authored by researcher Shayna Bauchner, identified seven areas where Malaysia fell short of its human rights obligations, including freedom of expression, freedom of assembly, media freedom, migrant rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and the death penalty. Amnesty noted that the government had not only failed to advance reforms but had actively used repressive laws it had promised to repeal.

item.title: HRW 2024: 'Reform Agenda Stalled' — Government Failed to Uphold Pledges in First Year
item.description:
Said by: Human Rights Watch

Category: Social

Date: 2024-01-11

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2024, Human Rights Watch released its 2024 World Report, delivering a damning verdict on Anwar Ibrahim’s first year in office: “Reform Agenda Stalled.” HRW stated that Anwar had “largely failed to uphold his pledges to address repression and corruption” and called on the government to “recommit to a rights-respecting agenda by turning its sidelined campaign promises into action.” The report documented failures across freedom of expression, assembly, media freedom, and institutional reform. A year later, HRW’s 2025 assessment was even harsher: “Rights Backslide.”

item.title: [BM] Pangkalan Data PADU Dilancar Sebagai Mimpi Ngeri Privasi — Sesiapa Dengan Nombor IC Anda Boleh Akses Data Anda
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2024-01-02

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 2 Januari 2024, Anwar melancarkan Hab Pangkalan Data Pusat (PADU) — sistem yang bertujuan merevolusikan penyampaian subsidi dengan menyasarkan bantuan kepada mereka yang memerlukan. Lebih 233,000 pengguna mendaftar pada hari pelancaran. Dalam 48 jam, penyelidik keselamatan mendapati pengesahan itu sangat lemah: sesiapa yang mempunyai nombor IC dan poskod rumah orang lain boleh mendaftar dan mengakses data mereka. CybersecurityAsia memanggilnya “mimpi ngeri privasi.” Sarawak menghentikan penyertaannya sepenuhnya pada Mac 2024, memetik kebimbangan mengenai autonomi negeri dan data peribadi rakyat. Menjelang pertengahan 2025, PADU senyap-senyap diketepikan — reformasi subsidi RON95 langsung tidak menggunakannya, menggunakan data pendaftaran kenderaan JPJ sebaliknya.

item.title: [BM] Pangkalan Data PADU Dilancarkan Sebagai Mimpi Ngeri Privasi — Sesiapa Dengan Nombor IC Anda Boleh Akses Data Anda

Lebih 233,000 pengguna mendaftar pada hari pelancaran. item.title: PADU Database Launches as Privacy Nightmare — Anyone With Your IC Number Can Access Your Data
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Social

Date: 2024-01-02

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 2 January 2024, Anwar launched the Central Database Hub (PADU) — a system meant to revolutionise subsidy delivery by targeting aid to those who need it. Over 233,000 users registered on launch day. Within 48 hours, security researchers discovered the authentication was laughably weak: anyone armed with another person’s IC number and home postcode could register and access their data. CybersecurityAsia called it a “privacy nightmare.” Sarawak halted its participation entirely in March 2024, citing concerns over state autonomy and citizens’ personal data. By mid-2025, PADU was quietly sidelined — the RON95 subsidy reform bypassed it entirely, using JPJ vehicle registration data instead.

item.title: [BM] SPRM Rampas Ilham Tower Daim Dalam Siasatan Pengubahan Wang Haram — Pendakwaan Terpilih Atau Akauntabiliti Tulen?
item.description:
Said by: Azam Baki, MACC Chief Commissioner / Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2023-12-21

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 21 Disember 2023, SPRM merampas Ilham Tower 60 tingkat di Kuala Lumpur — bernilai anggaran RM1 hingga RM1.5 bilion — di bawah Seksyen 51 Akta Pencegahan Pengubahan Wang Haram (AMLA). Rampasan ini sebahagian daripada siasatan yang semakin meluas terhadap bekas menteri kewangan Tun Daim Zainuddin berhubung urus niaga korporat 1997 bernilai RM2.3 bilion melibatkan Renong Bhd dan United Engineers Malaysia (UEM), kedua-duanya dikaitkan dengan UMNO. Ketua Pesuruhjaya SPRM Tan Sri Azam Baki mengesahkan rampasan itu. Daim menafikan sebarang salah laku dan mengekalkan pendirian bahawa siasatan bermotif politik. SPRM juga mendakwa Daim dan isterinya Naimah Abdul Khalid kerana gagal mengisytiharkan harta, dan mengeluarkan notis untuk mengesan empat orang anak Daim.

item.title: [BM] SPRM Rampas Menara Ilham Milik Daim Dalam Siasatan Pengubahan Wang Haram — Pendakwaan Terpilih Atau Akauntabiliti Tulen?
item.description:

Category: Politics
